luis_cobbler.ability: You start knowing 1 good & 1 evil character: they are either both in-play or not at all.
luis_cobbler.firstNightReminder: Show the Cobbler 1 in-play good character token & 1 in-play evil character token, or 1 not-in-play good character token & 1 not-in-play evil character token.
luis_cobbler.flavor: That’s odd. I could’ve sworn that I left this pair here.

luis_doppelganger.ability: You start knowing an in-play Townsfolk & have their ability. If you die, they are drunk.
luis_doppelganger.firstNightReminder: Show the Townsfolk character token marked HAS ABILITY.

luis_birdwatcher.ability: You start knowing the alignment of the player X steps clockwise from you. [X Birdwatchers (up to 3)]
luis_birdwatcher.firstNightReminder: Wake the Birdwatchers one at a time, & count 1 step clockwise per in-play Birdwatcher. Show either good or evil thumbs according to the alignment of that player.

luis_palmist.ability: Each night, you get advice or a clue by learning 3 characters.
luis_palmist.firstNightReminder: Show 3 character tokens to form a piece of advice or a clue.
luis_palmist.otherNightReminder: Show 3 character tokens to form a piece of advice or a clue.
luis_palmist.flavor: I went to the palmist and asked her to read. No heart line, no sun line, no life line, no need.

luis_wigsnatcher.ability: Each night, choose a player: if they die tonight, you become their character.
luis_wigsnatcher.firstNightReminder: The Wig Snatcher chooses a player.
luis_wigsnatcher.otherNightReminder: The Wig Snatcher chooses a player.

jinxes.reason: If Leviathan is in play & the player the Wig Snatcher chose dies by execution, the Wig Snatcher becomes their character that night.
If the Wig Snatcher-chosen player dies by nomination or execution and the Wig Snatcher is still alive, the Wig Snatcher uses their ability tonight.
The Wig Snatcher cannot become the Spy.
The Wig Snatcher cannot become the Widow.

luis_wigsnatcher.flavor: The moment froze time, yet the room ran hot. The soundtrack of Whitney toned out, precise, blaring. Glamour, destruction. It was so simple yet so cataclysmic, an assassination without weapon or trace. I reached and released: suddenly, rose petals.

luis_hierophant.ability: Each night, choose a player: you learn how helpful they are being to their team.
luis_hierophant.firstNightReminder: The Hierophant points at a player. Give the appropriate thumb signal.
luis_hierophant.otherNightReminder: The Hierophant points at a player. Give the appropriate thumb signal.
luis_hierophant.flavor: Come with me, and I shall show you the way.

luis_mycologist.ability: Each night, choose 2 players (not yourself): if either is evil, neither can die tonight or tomorrow day.

jinxes.reason: The Pit-Hag cannot create an evil Mycologist.

luis_mycologist.flavor: Yes? Yes, come in. I see you have the observations for specimen 8723. Oh, this is interesting. Very interesting indeed.

luis_luchador.ability: Each night, choose an evil character: if in play, they must choose an alive player to kill, but if it’s you, they die instead.
luis_luchador.otherNightReminder: The Luchador chooses an evil character. Put the Luchador to sleep. If chosen character is in play: Wake the target. Show the THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU & Luchador tokens. They choose an alive player.

luis_seedsman.ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): tomorrow they publicly choose whose character you learn, but it’s false if the 1st is evil.
luis_seedsman.firstNightReminder: The Seedsman points to a player.
luis_seedsman.otherNightReminder: Show the 2ND player's character token, or a different one if the Seedman is marked FALSE INFO. The Seedsman points to a player.
luis_seedsman.flavor: The best time to plant a tree was 20 years ago. The second best time is 19 years ago.

luis_courier.ability: Each day, you may visit the Storyteller to learn a task & its reward.
luis_courier.flavor: Your correspondence, sire. What's this? The war has already begun?

luis_locksmith.ability: Each day, you may guess players' characters (not yourself): if all are correct, all can't die tonight.

jinxes.reason: If the Leviathan is in play, Locksmith-protected players are safe from all evil abilities.
If Riot is in play, Locksmith-protected players are safe from all evil abilities.

luis_locksmith.flavor: How did I get here? What is my job? Here, let me answer both questions in 2 words.

luis_tealeaf.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a player: a Minion, if chosen, swaps characters with you.
luis_tealeaf.firstNightReminder: The Tea-Leaf might choose a player. If they chose a Minion: Show the YOU ARE & Minion tokens. Swap the Tea-Leaf & Minion tokens. Put the old Tea-Leaf to sleep. Wake the old Minion. Show the YOU ARE and Tea-Leaf tokens.
luis_tealeaf.otherNightReminder: The Tea-Leaf might choose a player. If they chose a Minion: Show the YOU ARE & Minion tokens. Swap the Tea -Leaf & Minion tokens. Put the old Tea-Leaf to sleep. Wake the old Minion. Show the YOU ARE and Tea-Leaf tokens.

jinxes.reason: If a good Tea-Leaf becomes the Spy, they do not see the Grimoire.
If a good Tea-Leaf becomes the Summoner, they choose which Demon, but the Storyteller chooses which player. They do not get bluffs.
If a good Tea-Leaf becomes the Widow, they do not see the Grimoire.

luis_tealeaf.flavor: Yes, yes. Look at the leaves. Focus your mind & soul onto the tea. They say… they SAY… that you really ought to learn cockney rhyming slang.

luis_rancher.ability: Once per game, during the day, declare that if an evil player is executed today, 1 good player dies.

jinxes.reason: If the Rancher uses their ability and an evil player dies due to being nominated that day, a good player dies.

luis_goldsmith.ability: Once per game, during the day, publicly choose a player: you give this ability to them. On the final night, learn the Demon player.
luis_goldsmith.otherNightReminder: If the game will or is likely to end tomorrow night, wake the player with the Goldsmith's ability. Show the THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU info token and the Goldsmith character token then point to the Demon.

jinxes.reason: If an executed Goldsmith doesn't have their ability, the Cannibal doesn't gain it.
If the Philosopher gains the Goldsmith’s ability using their own, the player who currently has the Goldsmith's ability loses it.
If the Pixie learns the Goldsmith, they only get the Goldsmith's ability, if the player who currently has the Goldsmith's ability dies.

luis_bookie.ability: You start by choosing 2 alive players (not yourself): if the 1st dies before the 2nd, you learn an evil player & choose again.
luis_bookie.firstNightReminder: The Bookie points at 2 alive players.
luis_bookie.otherNightReminder: If the 2ND player died first, the Bookie loses their ability. If the 1ST player died first, point to an evil player and the Bookie points at 2 alive players.
luis_bookie.flavor: Well, the way I see it is that it’s like the stock market. If someone is doing well, you put your money on them.

luis_mosaicist.ability: If the Demon kills you, each night from now on, learn a Minion player & their character.
luis_mosaicist.otherNightReminder: If the Demon kills the Mosaicist, the Mosaicist gains their ability. If they have their ability, wake the Mosaicist, point at a Minion player & show their character token.

jinxes.reason: Each night, the Leviathan chooses an alive player (different to previous nights): a chosen Mosaicist gains their ability but does not die.
Each night, the Riot chooses an alive player (different to previous nights): a chosen Mosaicist gains their ability but does not die.

luis_mosaicist.flavor: lili li ale. ale li suli

luis_guardian.ability: If the Demon kills you, each night after, learn who & what they attacked. Once per game, choose that they don’t die.
luis_guardian.otherNightReminder: If the Demon kills the Guardian, the Guardian gains their ability. If they have their ability, wake the Guardian & point to the marked players. They either nod their head yes or shake their head no. If they nodded their head yes, the marked players do not die.

jinxes.reason: Each night, the Leviathan chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Guardian gains their ability but does not die. They learn which characters the Leviathan chooses.
Each night, the Riot chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Guardian gains their ability but does not die. They learn which characters the Riot chooses.

luis_guardian.flavor: Do you hear me? I know, it hurts. But the sun will rise again. To the ends of the afterlife... death shall not take you.

luis_ka.ability: If the Demon kills you, each night from now on, you learn if the Demon 1) nominated, 2) was nominated, or 3) both today.
luis_ka.otherNightReminder: If the Demon kills the Ka, the Ka gains their ability. If they have their ability, wake the Ka & give a finger signal.

jinxes.reason: Each night, the Leviathan chooses an alive player (different to previous nights): a chosen Ka gains their ability but does not die.
Each night, the Riot chooses an alive player (different to previous nights): a chosen Ka gains their ability but does not die.

luis_ka.flavor: Anyone's heart can be lighter than a feather, granted the existence of a heavy enough feather.

luis_haberdasher.ability: If the Demon chooses their good neighbors (except you) with their ability, they immediately lose it until dawn, even if you died tonight.

jinxes.reason: If the Leviathan nominates & executes a Haberdasher-protected-player, the Haberdasher-protected-player does not die.
If a Riot player nominates (or nominates & executes) a Haberdasher-protected-player, the Haberdasher-protected-player does not die.

luis_haberdasher.flavor: I'm the best in the business, dear! The devil himself wouldn't dare touch you with such fashionable brims. Hell will freeze over before a single seam pops!

luis_balatro.ability: Demons must attack alive Minions (if they can die). [+1 Minion]

luis_deacon.ability: The good player who is the most correct can't die.
luis_deacon.flavor: It is called: Eucharist, because it is an action of thanksgiving to God.

luis_embalmer.ability: If a player dies by execution, their alive neighbours are drunk until dusk tomorrow.
luis_embalmer.flavor: If you ask me, I'd say it's quite weird to give a baby frankincense and myrrh as a gift.

luis_fetch.ability: If another ability kills you, you learn this & die the next night instead unless evil is executed after.
luis_fetch.otherNightReminder: If the Fetch is marked SECOND CHANCE and an evil player is not marked EXECUTED TODAY, they die.. Otherwise, nothing happens.

jinxes.reason: If the Leviathan is in play, and the Fetch is executed, they die 2 nights later instead unless an evil player is executed tomorrow.
Players who die due to a player nominating them register as executed to the Fetch.

luis_marquess.ability: If your closest alive evil player is not the Demon, you can't die.
luis_marquess.flavor: Look at the coward, this foul-smelling, pre-mesozoic, invertebrate ne’er-do-well. Until its thirteen eyes are looking into my two, I will stay here, doing what I love most: amassing wealth.

luis_prizefighter.ability: Good players who nominate you die at night.
luis_prizefighter.otherNightReminder: If the Prizefighter is due to kill a good player, they die.
luis_prizefighter.flavor: Float like a butterfly. Sting like a bee.

luis_regent.ability: Once per game, during the day, publicly declare that, tonight, your alive neighbours learn who the other is if the other is good.
luis_regent.flavor: Brring brrrring! Hello my lovelies, I'm here now! I know you had to suffer the time that I wasn't but don't you worry your little head, I am here now. There, there. Brrrring brring.

luis_seraph.ability: Good players who you nominate & kill by execution learn you are in play.
luis_seraph.otherNightReminder: If the Seraph nominated & killed a good player by execution today, wake the executee & show the Seraph character token.
luis_seraph.flavor: Young one. Walk with me for a moment. Gaze upon my light. I am here to help. I am here to guide you home.

luis_blabbermouth.ability: You know a phrase. Each dusk, if publicly, no other alive good player said it or a Minion guessed it (even if dead), your team loses.
luis_blabbermouth.flavor: Did you hear about Maria? I heard she’s hiding in the inn. Yeah, we can’t let anyone know.

luis_bulwark.ability: If a neighbour dies, the next alive player in that direction (if good) dies too.

luis_conjuror.ability: When you learn that you died, publicly choose a Demon character: from now on, the Demon must have its ability.
luis_conjuror.flavor: I’m telling you, I can exorcise this Demon! I just need one… more… try…

luis_knifethrower.ability: If you die, you might not & the Demon may choose a player tonight: they die.
luis_knifethrower.otherNightReminder: If the Knife Thrower SURVIVED death, wake the Demon. They might point at a player.
luis_knifethrower.flavor: Some may question my one-person act as a thing of grotesque, even foolish confidence, yet I am quick to disagree. Yes, I'm strapped to this wheel, but a trained hand always gets the knife between the fing- OH GOD…

luis_mirage.ability: An extra rule is in play, even if dead. Each day, if you guess it, you lose your ability & learn this.
luis_mirage.flavor: Is it just me or do you see that?

luis_moonflower.ability: If you die & the next executee is good, your team loses.

jinxes.reason: Players who die by a good player nominating them register as executed to the Moonflower.

luis_nightshade.ability: Each night, a player (if good) is drunk & gets reversed info until dusk. You then learn the previous player.
luis_nightshade.otherNightReminder: Point to the INFATUATED player. A different player becomes INFATUATED.
luis_nightshade.flavor: Belladonna. It's Italian for 'Pretty Lady'. But I assure you, I can be much more than that.

luis_nimrod.ability: If you did not nominate a Minion today, evil players may choose to rise tonight (Demons may not if 1 lives)..
luis_nimrod.otherNightReminder: If the Nimrod did not nominate a Minion today, wake evil players & show the THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU & Nimrod tokens. Allow them to choose if they rise or not.
luis_nimrod.flavor: What do you mean Mr Morozov is back??? Haven’t you ever heard that if you don’t see them, they can’t see you? Or… maybe we do need something better than a timeout chair.

luis_porcher.ability: If you die, the Demon has a 2nd Demon ability (they choose which): each night, they choose which to wake for (if possible).
luis_porcher.otherNightReminder: If the Porcher died today or tonight, show the Demon the THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU & the Porcher token. Allow them to choose a Demon character.

jinxes.reason: If the Demon gains the Kazali’s ability, they may wake for it once to choose new Minion characters for their Minions.
If Legion is in play and the Porcher dies, nothing happens.
If the Demon gains the Leviathan’s ability after Day 5, the game continues for 1 more day.

If the Demon gains the Lil’ Monsta’s ability and chooses to wake for it (they must 1st), Minions & Demons wake to choose who babysits Lil’ Monsta. Whoever babysits Lil’ Monsta is the only "Demon", but the only original Demon is "the Demon" to the Porcher.
If the Demon gains the Lleech’s ability, they must wake for it to choose a host.
If Riot is in play and the Porcher dies, nothing happens. If the Demon gains the Riot’s ability after Day 3, Minions become Riot and nominees die & must nominate again.
If the Demon gains the Yaggababble’s ability, they must wake for it learn a secret phrase.

luis_porcher.flavor: Pigs are filthy, but a good source of protein regardless.

luis_registrar.ability: When you learn that you died, declare that, going clockwise, half of alive good players must claim who they are, or your team loses.
luis_registrar.flavor: What’s your name? Your occupation? Where do you live? How would you rank your coworkers from 1-10? Where were you on the night of the 7th? Have you met the magic man and gained his mystical powers? Have you discovered the secret 13th dimension? Finally, how are you feeling today?

luis_rodent.ability: If 1 of your Townsfolk neighbours die, the 1 in the other direction is drunk from now on, even if you are dead.
luis_rodent.otherNightReminder: If a Townsfolk neighbour died, the other becomes drunk immediately. If you haven't done this yet, do so now.

luis_seadog.ability: Things that happen to you might happen to another player instead.
luis_seadog.flavor: Oy! I won't just sit here and take that! Here, my good pal Bill will instead.

luis_tailor.ability: If an evil player was nominated today, they may choose a not-in-play character (not an extra Demon) to become tonight.
luis_tailor.otherNightReminder: One at a time, wake each player marked FITTING TONIGHT, show them the THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU & Tailor tokens. Allow them to choose a new character.
luis_tailor.flavor: What will it be this time, Grandmaster Sokolov? A white dress? Yes, of course. Yes, the sword is complementary. Arthur, would you like to show the gentleman to the fitting room?

luis_trophyhunter.ability: Each day, if the Demon is nominated & evil does not die, good loses.
luis_trophyhunter.flavor: You only shoot once. If you hit, you catch some nice game. If you miss, run.

luis_anomaly.ability: Once per game, at night, choose that, the words “good” & “evil” are swapped in abilities until dusk.
luis_anomaly.flavor: Tear the entire hinges down. Let's rewrite the history out. Blow the doors off their books. Turn it upside down, inside place.

luis_anubis.ability: If an Outsider dies, a 2nd might become a not-in-play Townsfolk tonight (you know them) & vice versa. [-1 to +1 Outsider]
luis_anubis.otherNightReminder: If an Outsider died today or tonight, a 2nd might become a Townsfolk, & vice versa. If so, wake the turned player. Show the YOU ARE token & their new character token. Put them to sleep. Then wake the Anubis. Show the THIS PLAYER IS token, point to the turned player, & show their new character token.

jinxes.reason: If the Anubis creates a Damsel, they don't learn who it is.
The Anubis cannot create a Heretic.
If there is a spare token, the Anubis can create an extra Village Idiot. If so, the drunk Village Idiot might change.

luis_anubis.flavor: Heavy is the heart that brings balance.

luis_autarch.ability: Townsfolk that nominate are poisoned until tomorrow dusk. If none do, evil wins. 1 good player learns if you die.
luis_autarch.otherNightReminder: If the Autarch died: wake a good player and show the Autarch character token. Swap any POISONED reminders for YESTERDAY reminders.
luis_autarch.flavor: Free? I wouldn’t say ‘free’. More like ‘under new management’.

luis_boggart.ability: You know the Grimoire, as soon as you draw this token. You look in the bag & replace a token. The Storyteller replaces a 2nd. [???]
luis_boggart.firstNightReminder: When the Boggart draws their token, show them the Grimoire & let them look in the bag. You both replace a token.

luis_centurion.ability: If 5 or more non-Travellers live, you & the Demon can’t die. If only evil lives at dawn, evil loses.
luis_centurion.otherNightReminder: If only evil players live, evil loses.

jinxes.reason: The Lleech host registers as the Demon to the Centurion.

luis_centurion.flavor: Stand as one until one stands. Survive the hell that makes glass sand.

luis_chariot.ability: Each night, choose 2 alive players (not yourself): if one is executed tomorrow, the other is instead.

jinxes.reason: If the Goblin was nominated & claimed to be the Goblin today, the Chariot is poisoned until dusk.
If the Fearmonger & Chariot chose the same player, they both learn this, and the Chariot is poisoned until dusk if the Fearmonger nominates them.
If the Chariot swaps the executee, the executee registers as evil to the Leviathan ability.

luis_chariot.flavor: If you don't mind the wailing of the unwashed masses, the gnashing of the teeth, and the wheels grinding through the foulest-smelling muck you've ever encountered, there's no better place than the hippodrome.

luis_chupacabra.ability: Each night, you may choose a player nominated by evil today: they die.
luis_chupacabra.otherNightReminder: The Chupacabra might point at a player.

luis_cowboy.ability: Each day, you may publicly guess any players’ characters: if all are correct, all die.

jinxes.reason: If the Cowboy is in play, the Spy does not see the Grimoire, until the Cowboy dies.
If the Cowboy is in play, the Widow does not see the Grimoire, until the Cowboy dies.

luis_cowboy.flavor: This town ain’t big enough for the seven of us…

luis_crawler.ability: You know an alive player: if 1 is executed, they learn you're in play. If 2 are, your team wins.
luis_crawler.otherNightReminder: If the Crawler's target has died, the Crawler learns another player. Then if a player is marked EXECUTED, show the target the Crawler's character token.

jinxes.reason: If the Storyteller would gain the Crawler’s ability, a living Minion gains it in addition to their own & learns this.
Players who die to being nominated by an opposing player to the Crawler register as being executed to the Crawler.

luis_crawler.flavor: Remember me when you feel a chill down your spine, or when you see a shadow move in an alleyway, or when you meet Anubis. I’ll be there, tipping the scales.

luis_dedalis.ability: Each night, choose a player: they must privately answer a riddle correctly or die tomorrow night.
luis_dedalis.firstNightReminder: The Dedalis points at any player. Put the Dedalis to sleep. Wake the chosen player and show them the THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU info token and the Dedalis token.
luis_dedalis.otherNightReminder: If the player marked CHOSEN does not have the CORRECT reminder, they die. The Dedalis points at any player. Put the Dedalis to sleep. Wake the chosen player and show them the THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU info token and the Dedalis token.
luis_dedalis.flavor: Pay attention to these walls. A ball of string won’t help you in this labyrinth.

luis_drillsergeant.ability: Each nomination, votes are tallied instantly on 3, even if dead. The Storyteller can nominate & you suggest who each night.
luis_drillsergeant.firstNightReminder: The Drill Sergeant might point to any number of players.
luis_drillsergeant.otherNightReminder: The Drill Sergeant might point to any number of players.
luis_drillsergeant.flavor: When the hurricane comes, will you be in its wake? No, you will be the storm! When the ground shakes, will you fall? No, you will be the damage! When hell is raised will you be burnt? No, you will be the fire!

luis_genie.ability: Things that evil players are mad about might become true.
luis_genie.flavor: Fake it until you feel it. Feel it until it's real. Reel them in until they listen. They will listen to our will.

luis_leftenent.ability: You poison good players who choose the Demon with their abilities, & then learn who they are. 1 good player might then learn you too.

jinxes.reason: Until a Demon is made, the Leftenent poisons and learns good players who choose the Summoner with their abilities. When a Demon is made, if they would be poisoned by the Leftenent, they are not.
If the Plague Doctor gives the Storyteller the Leftenent ability, a good player might learn who a Minion is instead of the Leftenent, when a player gets poisoned.

luis_leftenent.flavor: I scour the waves for a sign, an enemy. I used to pray for the sailors pulled away from port town lovers, bone by bloated bone, that the sea shan't take those who desired her. She reduced my eyes to spectral pearls, forever alone, thus I shall sink those starry-eyed fools. Sink, sank, sunk.

luis_mistress.ability: If the number of players mad as Outsiders isn’t expected, a mad player might be executed. [-1 or +1 Outsider]
luis_mistress.flavor: Sorry, the Grand Manor does not have a vacancy for you; our charity can only go so far. Good luck with your time in the taiga.

luis_piper.ability: Once, even if dead, 1 alive evil player may publicly choose a player before nominations: today, good wins if & only if they are executed.
luis_piper.flavor: Everybody has a goal to which their working for / But working men like us workmen are working for a lord / We have nothing left to loose but that which ties us down / If the guards stop us a journey-in', we burn the castle down / Lads, lass, make the ground quake / Rattle their bones, like the rattle of a snake / And make to battle with a strength of that viper / We'll chop off your bloomin' head, for it's time to pay the piper

luis_runeeater.ability: You have the ability of the most recent character killed by the Demon. You know which & might register as they would.

jinxes.reason: The Leviathan’s most recent nominee registers as the most recent kill to the Rune Eater.
The Riot’s most recent nominee registers as the most recent kill to the Rune Eater.

luis_spawn.ability: If there has been 1 nomination per Townsfolk or none nominated today, you become a not-in-play Demon tonight.

luis_vampire.ability: The 1st evil player nominated by evil today lives if executed. Townsfolk who nominate you poison you both until dawn.

jinxes.reason: If the Plague Doctor gives the Storyteller the Vampire ability, a living Minion gains the Vampire ability in addition to their own ability, and learns this.

luis_vampire.flavor: We live forever, you know? Seeing human generations rise and wither, watching them wage wars that they’ll inevitably all lose. I can give you this wisdom. I just need to take a bit… of your blood.

luis_axt.ability: Each night, choose 2 sets of 2 players: tomorrow, sets are executed together. If most players are dead or none died today, evil wins.
luis_axt.firstNightReminder: The Axt points to 2 players. Then 2 more.
luis_axt.otherNightReminder: The Axt points to 2 players. Then 2 more.

jinxes.reason: If the Farmer dies due to the Axt's ability, the Farmer uses their ability.
If the Goblin is executed due to the Axt's ability, nothing happens.
If Axt is in play and the Grandchild dies by execution, the Grandmother might be executed too. The Grandmother doesn’t die due to their ability as normal.
If the Hatter dies when the dead outnumber the living the Demon cannot choose Axt. If the Demon chooses Axt, they might not wake tonight.
If the Axt is in play, the Innkeeper-protected-players are safe from the Axt.
If the Axt is in play, and at least 1 player has being executed due to the Axt's ability, the King learns an alive character each night.
If the Axt is in play & no execution occurs when the dead are 1 player away from outnumbering the living, good wins.
If the Princess nominated & executed a player on their 1st day, no player can be executed due to the Axt’s ability tomorrow.
If the Ravenkeeper dies due to the Axt's ability, the Ravenkeeper uses their ability.
If the Saint is executed due to the Axt's ability, nothing happens.

luis_axt.flavor: If a tree falls, and no-one is around, I will be the one to hear it.

luis_bloodwrite.ability: Each night, you may choose 2 players (they learn this): they die tomorrow night. Players who offer the most might not die.
luis_bloodwrite.firstNightReminder: The Bloodwrite might point at 2 players. Put the Bloodwrite to sleep. Wake the chosen players individually and show them the THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU info token and the Bloodwrite token.
luis_bloodwrite.otherNightReminder: You may act out 1 offer given to you today accordingly Otherwise, they die The Bloodwrite might point at 2 players. Put the Bloodwrite to sleep. Wake the chosen players individually and show them the THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU info token and the Bloodwrite token.

jinxes.reason: The Summoner may choose a player to become the Bloodwrite on the 2nd night.

luis_bloodwrite.flavor: We'll start the bidding at 5 gold pieces. 6. 7. Constant Intoxication. An arm and a leg from the man in the wheelchair. Going once…

luis_crown.ability: Each night, you may choose 2 sets of 2 players: all choose which dies. If a Minion is dead & you die this way, evil wins.
luis_crown.otherNightReminder: The Crown might choose 4 players.. Wake all players and announce the pairs that the Crown has chosen in order. Allow all players to vote. Put all players to sleep. The most voted pair dies. Add shrouds accordingly. On a tie, wake the Crown. They point to a pair. Add shrouds accordingly. If there is a MINION DEAD & the Crown dies this way, evil wins.

jinxes.reason: If the Crown is executed, and there's an alive Mastermind, the Crown chooses 2 pairs of players tonight. If the pair containing the Mastermind dies, evil wins. Otherwise, good wins.

luis_crown.flavor: .smra ym struh ti taht,deedni,yvaeh os shgiew tI.dnal ot tey ti etipsed yvaeh su no gnihgiew,htgnerts ruo yb denekaew,esir ot su rof gnitiaw ti ees dna pu kool lla eW.drows eht htaeneb tis lla eW

luis_flabberghast.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Players who disagree with you might die.
luis_flabberghast.flavor: His highness demands that you walc wrth the drafgjs and shafgle by your hip. Do not ever gfsh your dgsabesh while His majesty is at attendance. Do you udgnerstnad?

luis_hethaesta.ability: Only you & 1 good player know what your ability is. If an evil player dies, it becomes, "Each night, choose a player: they die."
luis_hethaesta.firstNightReminder: One at a time, wake the Hethaesta and the player who KNOWS to let them know the custom ability. Run the Hethaesta's ability, if applicable.
luis_hethaesta.otherNightReminder: Run the Hethaesta's ability, if applicable.
luis_hethaesta.flavor: Everything is metal if you try, hit and heat hard enough. It'll all become music to your ears... Take all the damned looks you like, you won't remember a thing.

luis_iswaeva.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Minions might register as anything.
luis_iswaeva.flavor: I don't get why anyone would be afraid of the dark. In the light, you can see everything dangerous. In the dark, why, you almost forget the machete is there.

luis_kukalpa.ability: Each night, even if dead, choose a player: they die. The 1st player (not yourself) to nominate you "is the Demon" instead of you.
luis_kukalpa.otherNightReminder: The Kukalpa points at a player, even if dead.

jinxes.reason: Only the Kukalpa registers as "the Demon" to the Banshee.
If a good player is “the Demon”, only the Kukalpa registers as “the Demon” to the Boffin.
If "the Demon" is not the Kukalpa and the Exorcist chooses them, the Kukalpa wakes to learn who the Exorcist is then doesn’t wake that night, instead of “The Demon”.
If the Goblin "is the Demon", they have no ability.
Only the Kukalpa registers as "the Demon" to the Grandmother.
Only the Kukalpa registers as "the Demon" to the King.
Only the Kukalpa registers as "the Demon" to the Lunatic.
Only the Kukalpa registers as "the Demon" to the Monk.
If the Kukalpa kills the Sage, 1 of the 2 players they learn is "the Demon".
If the Saint is "the Demon", they have no ability.
If "the Demon" is not the Kukalpa and they die, the Scarlet Woman becomes “the Demon” (as though they had nominated the Kukalpa).
Only the Kukalpa registers as "the Demon" to the Soldier.
Only the Kukalpa registers as "the Demon" to the Poppy Grower.
The Vizier can die by execution if they are "the Demon"

luis_kukalpa.flavor: Me? You think I'm the monster? Look at yourselves. Cheering around the gallows as the sacrifice dies for your bloodlust... Here, hold this crown. It was always too big for my purposes.

luis_matsuraid.ability: Evil votes secretly don't count & only 2 are required. Killed executees' teams lose. After day 3, evil wins. [Some players are evil]
luis_matsuraid.otherNightReminder: Change the Matsuraid reminder for the next day.

jinxes.reason: If the Matsuraid is in play and the Banshee is 'About to Die', all players learn this and the Banshee gains their ability.
If the Barber is nominated and the Matsuraid is in play, they use their ability.
If the Boomdandy explodes and the Matsuraid is in play, the game does not end and only good pointing counts. If no one dies after 1 minute, the Boomdandy’s team wins.
If the Matsuraid is in play, the first player to receive votes each day registers as the recently killed executee to the Cannibal.
If the King is alive & nominated by an evil player and the Choirboy is alive, the Choirboy uses their ability tonight, if the Matsuraid is in play.
The Engineer and Matsuraid can not both be in play at the start of the game. If a Matsuraid is created, some players become evil. If this happens after Day 3, the game continues for 1 more day.
If the Matsuraid is exorcised, evil wins 1 day later.
If a good Farmer dies by execution before Day 3 and the Matsuraid is in play, the game does not end and the Farmer uses their ability.
If the Fearmonger’s target is nominated by the Fearmonger and a good player votes, their team loses if the Matsuraid is in play.
If the Matsuraid is in play, the Flowergirl learns how many times a Demon voted.
If the Goblin publicly claims to be the Goblin and is executed, their team wins.
If an Outsider was nominated and the Matsuraid is in play, the Godfather uses their ability that night.
If the Hatter is nominated and the Matsuraid is in play, they use their ability. If a Matsuraid is created, some players become evil. If this happens after Day 3, the game continues for 1 more day.
If the Matsuraid is in-play, votes for the Innkeeper-protected players secretly do not count.
If the Klutz is nominated and the Matsuraid is in play, they use their ability. They cannot choose themself.
If an evil player is executed and the Matsuraid is in play, the Mastermind uses their ability.
If no execution occurs on Day 3 and the Matsuraid is in play, the Mayor’s team wins.
Each day, if a Minion dies by execution and the Matsuraid is in play, evil wins 1 day later.
If the Matsuraid is in play, votes for the Monk-protected player secretly do not count.
If the Moonchild is nominated and the Matsuraid is in play, they use their ability.
If eyes were closed while voting & the Matsuraid is in play, the nominee learns if they are 'About to Die'.
If a Matsuraid is created, some players become evil. If this happens after Day 3, the game continues for 1 more day.
If the Plague Doctor is nominated and the Matsuraid is in play, they use their ability.
If the Matsuraid is in play & the Princess nominates an ally on their 1st day, all votes for them secretly don’t count.
If the Psychopath is executed and the Matsuraid is in play, the game does not end if they killed someone that day.
If the Ravenkeeper is nominated by an evil player and the Matsuraid is in play, they use their ability.
If the Matsuraid is in play and a good player votes for the Saint, the Saint’s team loses.
If the Sage is nominated by an evil player and the Matsuraid is in play, they use their ability.
If the Matsuraid is in play, votes for the Soldier secretly do not count.
If the Summoner creates Matsuraid, some players become evil. The chosen player must be one of the Summoner's good living neighbours.
If the Sweetheart is nominated and the Matsuraid is in play, they use their ability.
If the Matsuraid is in play, the first player to receive votes each day registers as being executed to the Undertaker.

luis_matsuraid.flavor: Hands on their hips, hands on their shoulders. Behind, side, front, behind, side, front. Masks up and speak not.

luis_nonow.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. If you die, 1 Townsfolk neighbour, if alive, becomes an evil Nonow tonight (once). [-1 Outsider]
luis_nonow.otherNightReminder: If the Nonow died (once only): Replace one of the Nonow's Townsfolk neighbours' tokens with the spare Nonow token. Wake the target. Show them the YOU ARE & Nonow tokens and give a thumbs-down. The Nonow chooses a player. If the Nonow dies, do the previous step now.

luis_pestilence.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. If they had no ability, 1 of their Townsfolk neighbours die too.
luis_pestilence.otherNightReminder: The Pestilence points at a player. If the chosen player did not have an ability: 1 of their townsfolk neighbours die too.
luis_pestilence.flavor: My, oh my. What has this plague done to this town?

luis_plunderbuzz.ability: You start knowing a trait. Each night, choose a player: if they have it, they die. If all who do are dead, kill any 2 players.
luis_plunderbuzz.firstNightReminder: Choose a trait. Wake the Plunderbuzz and let them know their trait.
luis_plunderbuzz.otherNightReminder: The Plunderbuzz may choose a player OR chooses 2 players if no alive players have their trait. or

luis_sham.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die & their neighbours’ votes secretly don’t count tomorrow (unless just 3 players live).
luis_sham.flavor: We all have a five-leaf clover out there for each of us. I believe. I believe…

luis_dealer.ability: Each night, you know what happens to whoever picks up the phone when it rings tomorrow: they learn what happens too.
luis_dealer.flavor: I must say this is not only a massive opportunity for you, but also a massive risk for me. I’m doing this just for you. All you have to do is shake my hand, and we can do great things. What d’ya say?

luis_fashionista.ability: Each night, you know what happens to whoever picks up the phone when it rings tomorrow: they learn what happens too.
luis_fashionista.flavor: No, No, No. That’s too on the nose. Let’s try something more avant-garde.

luis_icarus.ability: Nominations that do not receive a 50% majority kill the nominator immediately.
luis_icarus.flavor: It seems Daedalus, our little master crafter over here, had some WAX WINGS OF HIS OWN. DIDN’T HE? Wanted to see his son fall, fall from the sky. Oh, how CLOSE TO THE SUN HE FLEW.

luis_pedlar.ability: If you agree, dead players may give vote tokens & spend 2 to regain their ability. You are sober & healthy.
luis_pedlar.flavor: Oh, my brother, spare a dime from your pocket and peruse my illustrious wares! There’s the sequel the director never wanted you to see with all new actors, antiquities from Atlantis and flashed watches you can set yourself for optimal timekeeping… all for a reasonable price, I’m sure you would agree.

luis_prophet.ability: Each day, publicly choose a player (not yourself): they may visit the Storyteller to privately ask & learn about 1 decision they made.

luis_rook.ability: Once per game, at night, the Demon may become poisoned & choose a player: they swap characters after dusk.
luis_rook.otherNightReminder: If the SWAP? reminder is placed, wake the Demon & show the Rook token. They might point at a player.

luis_soulbinder.ability: During setup, name 2 characters. Both are in play, or not at all. Named Outsiders might replace Townsfolk.
luis_soulbinder.firstNightReminder: At the start of the night, announce which two characters are bound together by the Soul Binder.
luis_soulbinder.flavor: My child, you are yet to know what love is.

luis_ephemera.ability: Each dawn, the Storyteller gives new advice about this script, or something bad happens to them.
luis_ephemera.flavor: It’s quicker to switch to your Minion, than to reload your nomination!

luis_puck.ability: Executees add 2 tokens to the bag & choose 1 alive player to draw from it: they get something good (if it’s good) or bad (if not).

odyssey_aerialist.ability: On the night you die, learn one player of each character type. If a good player's execution or ability killed you, you are drunk.
odyssey_aerialist.otherNightReminder: If they died, wake them and tell them one player each of the Minion, Demon, Townsfolk, and Outsider types.
odyssey_aerialist.flavor: Hahahaha! Can you smell it? The sulfur wind is tearing at my parachute! Listen! The rhythm of snapping shinbones beats any death metal! Among the audience my brains are about to splatter, the most embarrassed one is the Demon!

odyssey_alewife.ability: When a Minion is executed, they do not die but become drunk.
odyssey_alewife.flavor: This special reserve of mine isn't for just anyone. Only when a great personage like yourself walks through the door do I bear to bring it up from the cellar. Have a taste, it'll put strength in your every limb! But don't rush; sip it slowly. Drink too fast and the kick hits you all at once, and I couldn't lift you back up.

odyssey_arbiter.ability: If you nominate & execute another good player, they do not die.
odyssey_arbiter.flavor: Order. I have not come to hear excuses, nor to display mercy. Your sins and merits are already carved into my eyes. I favor no lord and pity no weakling. The innocent, however clumsy of tongue, shall never face the blade; the guilty, however glib, shall never escape judgment. Now, bring them forward.

odyssey_bard.ability: Each day, publicly choose any players: Townsfolk among them are drunk until you choose again. Tonight, learn how many you made drunk.
odyssey_bard.otherNightReminder: Tell them how many players are currently drunk due to their ability.
odyssey_bard.flavor: Every soul my fingertips touch falls into dream. While you stagger in your cups, I count the trembling strings... three? five? Those numbers will tell me how many 'honest men' betray the shape of lies within their sweet dreams.

odyssey_bellringer.ability: The 1st time you nominate a player, you may ask their character: if they lie, you are immediately executed.
odyssey_bellringer.flavor: It is old, and I am old. But it can still ring, ring loud enough for the whole town to hear. People ask me if I'm afraid. I say, a bellringer doesn't fear the sound fading away; he fears that nobody can understand the sound of the bell. Tomorrow's toll, I probably won't come back from. So be it. A lifetime of sound, traded for one instant of truth. Worth it.

odyssey_bugcatcher.ability: If you nominate another player, that night learn if they are the Demon.
odyssey_bugcatcher.otherNightReminder: If the Bug Catcher nominated another player today, wake them and tell them yes or no.
odyssey_bugcatcher.flavor: Crickets, katydids, rhinoceros beetles! Dragonflies, mantises, fireflies! Butterflies, grasshoppers, scarabs! All of you, into my net!...Ha! Got you!

odyssey_centaur.ability: Each night, choose a player (different to last night): if their type matches last night's player, they die.
odyssey_centaur.firstNightReminder: Wake them and let them choose a player.
odyssey_centaur.otherNightReminder: Wake them and let them choose a player.
odyssey_centaur.flavor: If justice arrives too late, my iron hooves will deliver it personally. Don't fear the fate of being trampled, my hooves, at least, are merciful: they don't disguise themselves as hope, nor drag out into despair. They are the most honest pity I can give you.

odyssey_constable.ability: On your 1st night, learn an Outsider or Minion player. If you die at night, learn one of the other type. [+1 Outsider]
odyssey_constable.firstNightReminder: Tell them a Minion or Outsider character.
odyssey_constable.otherNightReminder: If they died tonight, wake them and tell them a Minion or Outsider character (of a different type to last time).
odyssey_constable.flavor: Footprints. Mud stains. Scratches on the windowsill. Every detail you overlook speaks to me. I've worked one hundred and thirty-two cases and convicted ninety-seven people, not one wrongful verdict, not one that got away. You think you can be number one hundred and thirty-three? I'll be watching.

odyssey_cowboy.ability: 1 Minion knows you're in play. If they nominate, you learn this tonight. If 1 of you nominates the other, the nominee is executed.
odyssey_cowboy.firstNightReminder: Wake a Minion and tell them the Cowboy is in play.
odyssey_cowboy.otherNightReminder: If the Minion who learned the Cowboy is in play nominated today, wake the Cowboy.
odyssey_cowboy.flavor: When the countdown ends, the speed of my draw is the length of the rest of your life.

odyssey_dame.ability: Each night, learn an in-play character. If an evil player is dead, you are drunk.
odyssey_dame.firstNightReminder: Wake them and tell them a character in play.
odyssey_dame.otherNightReminder: Wake them and tell them a character in play.
odyssey_dame.flavor: There are two kinds of drunk in this world. The first comes from drinking too much of the same wine; the second from hearing too many different lies. The first kind passes after a night's sleep. The second kind seeps into your bones. I drink with different people almost every day; I know the first kind can't hurt me, but I also know that after the second kind happens too many times, you never wake up again. So tell me: am I drunk right now, or sober?

odyssey_druid.ability: If both your living neighbors are the same alignment, the Demon learns this and can only attack them.
odyssey_druid.flavor: Nature has predators and prey. Wolves eat deer, deer eat grass, grass eats the bones in the soil. Every mouth devours another mouth. That is not cruelty, it is balance. But there is one predator for which nature arranged no natural enemy. When it feeds, it is not to live, not from hunger, but only for sport. Since nature prepared no chains for it, I shall become its natural enemy.

odyssey_faultbot.ability: Each night, you learn if all other Townsfolk abilities have worked normally since dawn.
odyssey_faultbot.firstNightReminder: Wake them and tell them yes or no.
odyssey_faultbot.otherNightReminder: Wake them and tell them yes or no.

odyssey_geisha.ability: On your 1st night alive & your 1st night dead, learn a living player: the 2 are on opposing alignments.
odyssey_geisha.firstNightReminder: Wake them and tell them one player.
odyssey_geisha.otherNightReminder: If they died today, wake them and tell them one player.
odyssey_geisha.flavor: The girl next door threw herself into the river over a man. When they fished her out, the smile was still on her lips. Everyone called her foolish, called her mad. I said nothing. I knew she wasn't mad, she'd simply done the math. Mama taught us: for a girl of the house, true feelings mean giving more than you get. But that girl said, never feeling anything is the real bad bargain; you pay with your whole life. 'Living' and 'having lived' differ by one word, and by a whole lifetime. She had lived, and that made it worth it.

odyssey_hangedman.ability: When the game ends, if you voted with your vote token, whoever wins, loses & whoever loses, wins.

jinxes.reason: Puck cannot turn an evil player into the Hanged Man. If Puck creates an evil Philosopher who chooses the Hanged Man, that Philosopher immediately loses their ability.

odyssey_hangedman.flavor: Habit teaches you to look downward; I hang upside down to teach you to look upward. When the blood rushes to your brain, common sense turns inside out. Once you learn to see the world inverted, the world gives you a new perspective.

odyssey_herald.ability: Once per game, at night, choose another player: learn 2 different players. All 3 are different character types. [+1 Outsider]
odyssey_herald.firstNightReminder: Let them choose another player, then tell them two players.
odyssey_herald.otherNightReminder: Let them choose another player, then tell them two players.
odyssey_herald.flavor: This book records the heraldry of seventeen families of the town. When one house marries another's daughter, the crest gains a border. When a branch splits off, it gains a dividing line. When a house breeds a traitor, the whole shield is cloven in two, see this page. I do not paint patterns; I paint bloodlines. Every stroke is a covenant, every color block a verdict.

odyssey_hunter.ability: If a player you've nominated today dies tonight, you are woken to choose a player: they die.
odyssey_hunter.flavor: My traps were laid long ago; dead leaves over the game trails hide the iron teeth. Now I need only lie behind the brush and let my breath merge with the wind. The moment its hind leg steps into the snare and its body lurches off balance, pull the trigger, and the dust settles.

odyssey_joker.ability: Each night, choose another player: you learn their suit. The 4 suits correspond to the 4 character types.
odyssey_joker.firstNightReminder: Wake them to choose another player, and tell them that player's suit.
odyssey_joker.otherNightReminder: Wake them to choose another player, and tell them that player's suit.
odyssey_joker.flavor: I hear the spades conspiring, the hearts trembling, the clubs snickering, the diamonds standing firm. Don't be nervous, I'm just a harmless clown.

odyssey_ladyofthelake.ability: Each night, learn if today's executee is a Townsfolk. If they are alive, instead learn if both their neighbors are Townsfolk.
odyssey_ladyofthelake.otherNightReminder: If a player was executed today, wake them.
odyssey_ladyofthelake.flavor: The lake water is my mirror, reflecting hearts; the moonlight is my eye, beholding truth. I come from the shimmering waves to guide wandering souls. If your heart is honest, I shall grant you clear revelation; if you hide in shadow, the lake will show the ripples you cannot conceal.

odyssey_lunarknight.ability: Each night, if nobody died by execution today, you are woken to choose a player: if they are a Minion, they die.
odyssey_lunarknight.otherNightReminder: If nobody died by execution today, let them choose a player; if they chose a Minion, mark that Minion 'Dead'.
odyssey_lunarknight.flavor: On still nights free of the smell of blood, a deer leaps across the creek, moonlight slips through the gauze window, and the tip of my spear slips through the chest of sin.

odyssey_marmonk.ability: When the Demon attacks you, an evil player is attacked instead.
odyssey_marmonk.flavor: Bamboo meets the frost with heaven-high pride; the fiercer the wind snaps its boughs, the stronger its spirit grows. A hollow heart takes in the force of storm and cloud; one inch of gentle bosom embraces all eight wilds.

odyssey_martyra.ability: If a Minion dies by execution, you die that night, and all evil characters are drunk until dusk tomorrow.
odyssey_martyra.otherNightReminder: If the 'Martyrdom' token is in play, they die.
odyssey_martyra.flavor: The olive branch at my throat is Apollo's shackle, and a faint light in the sea mist. When my dagger opens my throat, lies will scatter with the bloody haze. Remember: my death is not the end, but the dawn in which you stare into the truth.

odyssey_medium.ability: If a Townsfolk you nominated dies by execution, they learn that night that the Medium is in play.
odyssey_medium.otherNightReminder: If the 'Learn' reminder was placed, wake the player marked 'Learn' and tell them the Medium is in play.
odyssey_medium.flavor: I don't like talking, but the dead do.

odyssey_mermaid.ability: Each day, you may publicly accept a player's compliment: evil abilities cannot affect them until you accept another player's compliment.
odyssey_mermaid.flavor: Little darlings on the shore, do your ears itch? That's because my singing has burrowed into your hearts! Everyone in town knows, the moment I open my mouth, even the seagulls can't bear to fly away~ I'm in a wonderful mood today, so each of you may make one wish, but you have to compliment me first! Starting with you, yes, the one in the hat. 'Mermaid sister is the fairest'? Hmm... barely passing. Come here and high-five me!

odyssey_miko.ability: Each night, choose 2 players that neighbor each other (not yourself): you learn if either of them is a Minion.
odyssey_miko.firstNightReminder: Let them choose two neighboring players other than themself.
odyssey_miko.otherNightReminder: Let them choose two neighboring players other than themself.
odyssey_miko.flavor: The ancient tree before the shrine told me something filthy has mixed into the town. I'll do for the tree what it cannot, sink my roots into the soil, pull the evil out, and return it to the clear breeze. Don't worry, it won't hurt. A purified soul will smell plum blossom on the wind.

odyssey_mummy.ability: If an evil player nominates & executes you, or if you die from an evil player's ability, you rise on the final day.
odyssey_mummy.flavor: Anubis weighed my soul and granted me return to the mortal world. Beneath my shroud there is no selfishness, only the cold answers I brought back from the underworld.

odyssey_ninja.ability: Each day, if you are the first or the last player to nominate, and the player you nominated is evil, they die that night.
odyssey_ninja.otherNightReminder: Replace the 'Assassinate' reminder with the 'Dead' reminder.
odyssey_ninja.flavor: I've been crouching on the rafters for three days. I watched you while you ate; I listened while you whispered. I'm in no hurry. I wait only for that one second when you finally drop your guard, then a gust of wind, a shadow, the softest thud of a body falling. Killing never takes strength, only timing.

odyssey_notary.ability: Each night, you learn if today's executee & their nominator are the same alignment.
odyssey_notary.otherNightReminder: Wake them and tell them yes or no.
odyssey_notary.flavor: I threw this register away once, then picked it back up. That day's record, I raised my seal three times and never brought it down. The two names on that page were too alike; alike not like enemies, but like brothers.

odyssey_onmyoji.ability: Each night, you learn a player: they are of a different alignment to the player you learned last night.
odyssey_onmyoji.firstNightReminder: Wake them and tell them any one player.
odyssey_onmyoji.otherNightReminder: Wake them and tell them any one player.
odyssey_onmyoji.flavor: Heaven and earth, mountain and lake, thunder, wind, water, fire, the eight trigrams interlock... Complete!

odyssey_painter.ability: On your 1st night, learn an in-play character. Each night, choose a player: if they are the character recently learned, learn another.
odyssey_painter.firstNightReminder: Tell them an in-play character, and place the 'Most Recently Learned' reminder by that player's character token.
odyssey_painter.otherNightReminder: Let them choose a player. If they chose the player marked 'Most Recently Learned,' tell them a new in-play character.
odyssey_painter.flavor: You all say to paint skin with 'flesh color,' but what flesh color is there? Your face holds the white of flour drifting from the mill next door; his carries the orange of the iron foundry; a child's cheeks are rose red with a dab of lemon yellow. Before I paint a person, I smell them, and mix my pigments by scent. The virtue of oils is that colors can be compounded fresh, like a prescription. When this face is done, you'll find the sitter by following the smell.

odyssey_paladin.ability: Each night, you learn 2 players: either both are not Minions, or both are not Demons. The 2 clue types alternate each night.
odyssey_paladin.flavor: Last night I knelt before the holy altar in prayer, and the voice of God fell on my shoulders like flame: 'Go to that town, my lambs are there.' So I came. There is no rust on my armor, for every scratch has been washed in holy water; my blade stays forever warm, for God's power flows within it. Where there is injustice, where there is weeping, there is my battlefield.

odyssey_paperboy.ability: Each day, you may visit the Storyteller to learn something. If you say it publicly, learn tonight if it is true.
odyssey_paperboy.otherNightReminder: If they read the news aloud today, wake them and tell them whether it is true.
odyssey_paperboy.flavor: Extra! Extra! Today's headlines! Today's headlines!

odyssey_pearldiver.ability: On your 1st night, you learn how many steps you are from an evil player.
odyssey_pearldiver.firstNightReminder: Show them a number, their distance from an evil player.
odyssey_pearldiver.flavor: Everything I take from the sea, the sea takes something from me. At forty, it took my hearing; at fifty, one knee. But what I've earned in return is sight of the undercurrents' direction, and the smell of rust in the water before a storm. Does the sea bully people? No, things at sea are far fairer than things ashore.

odyssey_perfumer.ability: Once per game, at night, you may choose a player or an evil character: they learn the Perfumer is in play.
odyssey_perfumer.firstNightReminder: Let them choose a player or a character.
odyssey_perfumer.otherNightReminder: Let them choose a player or a character.
odyssey_perfumer.flavor: Tonight I've prepared two perfumes: one frank as a love letter, the other... (suddenly leaning close) like a rose on a bear trap. Darling, guess which one you're smelling?

odyssey_psychic.ability: Each night, choose a player: if they are dead, you learn their team.
odyssey_psychic.otherNightReminder: Wake them and tell them good or evil.
odyssey_psychic.flavor: My gift lets me smell the scent of souls. A good soul smells like grass after rain, sweet with morning dew; an evil soul smells like scorched leather, mingled with blood and sulfur. The one who passed last night, his scent is spreading through my nostrils right now... Would the lady wearing perfume and the gentleman who hasn't bathed please step back, so I can tell you accurately whether he was a lamb or a jackal.

odyssey_ranger.ability: If 1 of your alive neighbors dies, you are woken that night to choose a player: if they are a Minion, they die.
odyssey_ranger.otherNightReminder: If an alive player neighboring the Ranger died today, let them choose a player.
odyssey_ranger.flavor: No grave for hounds and hawks, the forest crows are their burial.

odyssey_riddler.ability: Each day, you may visit the Storyteller to learn a riddle. The riddle's answer points to a character in play.
odyssey_riddler.flavor: No way, no way, don't tell me someone actually can't guess it?

odyssey_ronin.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a player: if the Demon attacks them tonight, an evil player is attacked instead & you regain your ability.
odyssey_ronin.otherNightReminder: Let them choose a player and place the 'Riposte' reminder by that player.
odyssey_ronin.flavor: Child, do not be afraid. Close your eyes. Feel the flow of killing intent with your heart.

odyssey_scalebearer.ability: On your 1st night, you learn a player: 2 players of the opposing alignment are equidistant from them.
odyssey_scalebearer.firstNightReminder: Wake them and tell them one player.
odyssey_scalebearer.flavor: Seventy percent of this town's precious trades pass over my scale. Gold, silver, jewels, musk, ginseng, all through my hands. I've made many enemies. Short-changers hate me, cheats curse me, someone once splashed filthy water on my doorstep. I won't move. Where the scale is, there I am. Only when the scale runs false should I move.

odyssey_sensate.ability: Each night, the Demon chooses an alive player (not you): you & the Demon learn their character.
odyssey_sensate.firstNightReminder: Wake the Demon to choose a player and tell the Demon what character they are. Put the Demon to sleep, then wake the Sensate and tell them what character that player is.
odyssey_sensate.otherNightReminder: Wake the Demon to choose a player and tell the Demon what character they are. Put the Demon to sleep, then wake the Sensate and tell them what character that player is.
odyssey_sensate.flavor: The vision of darkness, I've accepted it on behalf of the light. I am no prophet; I make no prophecies. I merely borrow the Demon's eyes to expose his tricks and send him on his way.

odyssey_skipper.ability: Each night, learn if the Demon is clockwise or anti-clockwise of the executee. If an evil player was executed, you are drunk until dawn.
odyssey_skipper.flavor: An offering to Poseidon will turn my compass toward the Demon's hiding place, clockwise or anti-clockwise, clearer than any chart. The price of sacrificing a traitor is a cup of bitter divine wine. Lads, remember to wake me before dawn!

odyssey_somnmaid.ability: The 1st time the Demon attacks you, you do not die & learn their character.
odyssey_somnmaid.flavor: Every night I pray, begging God to let me meet someone 'who shouldn't be saved.' At last, you've come. Your curiosity about me and mine about you are the two ends of the same rope. You're wondering: 'Will this woman tremble before me?' I'm wondering: 'Will this man kneel before me?' We each harbor our own thoughts, but as long as we draw close enough, those thoughts become the same warmth. Stay, even if only for one night, and let me light you a candle that never needs to go out.

odyssey_tanner.ability: On your 1st night, you learn the evil character nearest to you.
odyssey_tanner.flavor: The inside of this boot shaft is badly worn, that's from rubbing on a stirrup. Coming to my shop, you must be a courier? I've no ready-made military gear here, only freshly soaked cowhide for making belly-bands for the town's donkeys. Well then, your sole's about to fall off. Half-sole repair, or a whole new piece?

odyssey_thecatadventurers.ability: Each day, a player who has not explored may publicly choose to explore. If they live that night, you learn an opposing player.
odyssey_thecatadventurers.otherNightReminder: If today's explorer is alive, wake them and tell them a player on the opposing team to the explorer.
odyssey_thecatadventurers.flavor: Good afternoon, meow, everyone. The Cat Adventurers have come at the riddle's call, and we're honored to lighten your town's burdens, meow. We need a brave soul familiar with the local terrain to clear our path, meow. Before that, I'm obliged to inform you all that venturing into danger carries enormous risk, meow. Now then, which brave soul will join the glorious Cat Adventurers, meow?

odyssey_truelove.ability: On your 1st day, you may have the Storyteller witness you swap characters with other players, then privately learn if anyone lied.
odyssey_truelove.flavor: Your eyes are avoiding me. That's all right, take your time. Let me take out my true heart first so you can inspect the goods. Once you're satisfied it isn't fake, you can decide whether to take out yours. No need to decide now, I can wait. A true heart can't be rushed, and it can't be faked.

odyssey_tuner.ability: On your 1st night, you learn an Outsider character and a Minion character. Exactly one of them is in play.
odyssey_tuner.firstNightReminder: Tell them one Minion character and one Outsider character.
odyssey_tuner.flavor: In the dissonant chord there is a whiff of Minion... and that sudden microtone is plainly the panicked heartbeat of an Outsider.

odyssey_valkyrie.ability: Each night, deaths are delayed until you learn who died. You may choose to be the only death instead.
odyssey_valkyrie.otherNightReminder: Tell them which players are about to die tonight, and let them choose whether to die instead.
odyssey_valkyrie.flavor: Standing on the border of life and death, I feel the weight of life more than anyone. I have seen too much sacrifice, too many pointless deaths. But among you, I still long to see a different final chapter, one that shines with the light of wisdom and resounds with the echo of courage.

odyssey_vanguard.ability: Each night before the final day, choose: either you cannot die tonight, or your 2 alive neighbors cannot die tonight.
odyssey_vanguard.otherNightReminder: Let them point at themself or the players beside them.
odyssey_vanguard.flavor: Hey, you look pretty tough. But you have a fatal weakness, you're afraid. Because you've realized that no matter which angle you circle around to, I'm already standing in front of it.

odyssey_viking.ability: When you vote with your vote token, the nominee is executed immediately.
odyssey_viking.flavor: I smell the fear on you, stinking like rotting meat. The death you dread is merely a threshold in my eyes. Step across it, and the Valkyries will lead me to Valhalla. You, though, you'll just rot in the ground after death, too foul even for the maggots. So when I personally send you on your way, that's not an execution; it's a purification. Kneel properly, don't make me say it twice.

odyssey_warlock.ability: If the Demon kills you, each night from now on, choose a player: they die.
odyssey_warlock.flavor: This contract was never a transaction, but a complete sacrifice. I staked my whole fated death, let my flesh rot back to dust, and let my soul bear the punishment of eternal damnation, all to trade for this demonic power. Do you see the black flames wreathing me? Every leaping dark fire is a rehearsal of the torture I must suffer when I fall into hell in my next life. Do not come provoke me: one who has already lived through the torment of eternal death keeps not a shred of mercy for the mortal world.

odyssey_witcher.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a player: they die & the Demon cannot attack tonight. If you kill the Demon, swap characters & alignments.
odyssey_witcher.otherNightReminder: Wake them and let them choose a player; mark the chosen player with the 'Dead' reminder.
odyssey_witcher.flavor: Every Demon head I sever twists my shadow a little more. The townsfolk keep telling me to be careful not to get hurt, but they don't know, the real danger is hearing my own heartbeat grow more and more like Its. I've begun to like the taste of raw meat, to relish their screams as they flee. The hunt? It's just pressing my other self into the mud. When the day comes that I can't draw this sword and there's no light left in my eyes, find me, and kill me with it.

odyssey_witness.ability: Each day, visit the Storyteller to learn a true statement about a character type. If that type's count is abnormal, it is false.
odyssey_witness.flavor: I have seen Townsfolk pray by candlelight, and seen them write curses at the wall's base; I have seen Outsiders knock bearing gifts, and seen them secretly dig up coffins from the graveyard; I have seen Minions grovel at their master's shoes, and seen them kneel in repentance before the idol; I have seen the Demon's hands soaked in blood, and seen them moved to sorrow by a baby's cry. You think I'm telling good from evil? No, I'm merely looking into the same mirror, reflecting two different kinds of light.

odyssey_beekeeper.ability: A player is poisoned, even after you die. Each night, choose a player: if they are poisoned by you, they become healthy.
odyssey_beekeeper.otherNightReminder: Wake them and let them choose a player.
odyssey_beekeeper.flavor: I'm terribly sorry, these naughty little ones have hurt you. This is honey from my own hives; a dab of it will bring the swelling and pain right down. Please, do accept it.

odyssey_bloodthief.ability: Before the final day, when the only alive evil player dies, you become their character & alignment.
odyssey_bloodthief.flavor: The muddled Demon, the witless Minions, the farce that fumbled the victory is over. Now, watch closely: the one-of-a-kind reversal!

odyssey_catchorus.ability: A player is drunk. At dusk, the Storyteller might name a song: if everyone sings it together, all Townsfolk are sober & healthy until dusk.
odyssey_catchorus.flavor: Attention! Attention! The Cat Chorus is officially taking over tonight, meow! Repeat, the Cat Chorus is officially taking over tonight, meow! Our mission: lead everyone partying until dawn, meow! Stay sharp, meow! Follow the beat and stomp together! One, two, three, four! Meow! Meow! Meow! Meow!

odyssey_donquixote.ability: 1 player registers as a Demon, even if you die. During the day, you may privately learn who, then another player will.
odyssey_donquixote.flavor: Look! That towering giant, waving its long arms, awaits my challenge! What? You say it's a windmill? No, no, you are mistaken. They move, they breathe, they mock my hesitation. My lance is ready, my steed is neighing. Don't hold me back, glory calls!

odyssey_gargoyle.ability: The 1st time another player nominates you, they die. If you killed an evil player, you become their character & alignment.
odyssey_gargoyle.flavor: The wind between the stone cracks is the sleep-talk of my thousand-year slumber. The moon on the eave's corner is my poem line mottled across eternity. I hold ancient secrets and watch over the long night's end. When the bell tolls, the stubborn stone opens its eyes, all who gaze upon me shall be devoured by hell.

odyssey_heiress.ability: The 1st time you are about to die, 2 alive players might die instead of you.
odyssey_heiress.flavor: Call me 'my Lady,' not 'miss,' and certainly not 'girl.' Anyone can be a miss, there is only one Lady. My father has three hundred servants, fifty estates, and twelve titles, do you know which ones? No? Then hold your tongue and mind how you address me. 'My Lady', that is the only thing you need remember.

odyssey_hellsoutcast.ability: Each day before nominations, if a Minion publicly names you: you turn evil & swap characters with the Demon, who becomes drunk.
odyssey_hellsoutcast.flavor: They clipped my wings and cast me into the wasteland. Every inch of rotting earth is counting down, until hell enthrones its new king.

odyssey_kappa.ability: On the final day, you may privately learn how many Outsiders are in play. [Any number of Outsiders]
odyssey_kappa.flavor: I know. I know it all. Just wait until that day, I will know it all!

odyssey_loverbound.ability: On your 1st night, choose another player: after you or they die, the other might die at any time.
odyssey_loverbound.flavor: They say dying for love means leaving together. Wrong. Dying for love is when you're gone and I'm still here, but every step I take lands on the road you walked. You walked too fast, I couldn't keep up. But it's all right; every road has an end. When that day comes, I won't say goodbye. I'll say: wait for me, this time, let me walk in front. I've finally understood: dying for love was never two people's deaths, but one person's life being too long, so long it can only be ended another way.

odyssey_moblawyer.ability: Each night, you learn a player: tomorrow, if either you or they would be executed, the other might be executed instead.
odyssey_moblawyer.firstNightReminder: Wake the Mob lawyer and point at the player marked 'Client.'
odyssey_moblawyer.otherNightReminder: Wake the Mob lawyer and point at the player marked 'Client.'
odyssey_moblawyer.flavor: Good day, my client. Have you seen the recent news? Allow me to read it to you: 'Your daughter works as a serving-girl at the inn and often pilfers the establishment's goods; your wife sneaks into the noble hunting grounds every week to pick fruit and vegetables against the law; and the tithes you've reported these past years show signs of considerable under-declaration and tampering.' I mean nothing by it, client. As long as tomorrow in court you testify word for word as written on this paper, I shall pretend I never heard any of it.

odyssey_myconid.ability: Minions that die by execution keep their ability. You do too.
odyssey_myconid.flavor: Dead mushrooms grow mushrooms. Dead bad people grow mushrooms too.

odyssey_piratecatking.ability: Dead players may give up vote tokens. On the final day, if you are dead, players who have split 12 vote tokens.
odyssey_piratecatking.flavor: Wealth, fame, power, the cat-man who owned everything in this world, Pirate Cat King Gol D. Meowger. His single sentence before execution sent the whole world to the seas! 'You want my treasure, meow? If you want it, you can have it all, go find it, meow! I left every treasure in that place, meow!' And so, all cat-folk set sail for the Grand Line in pursuit of their dreams, and the world entered the Great Age of Pirate Cats!

odyssey_rascal.ability: On your 1st night & 1st day, Townsfolk abilities yield false info.
odyssey_rascal.flavor: The fisherman said he's taking his fish to market tomorrow morning; the seamstress said she can't be bothered to lock her door at noon; the artist is out drinking at the brothel tonight. I overheard it all! Tomorrow morning, the fisherman opens his creel to find only three toads. The seamstress can't pry apart her glue-stuck scissors. And, and! Best of all, the artist will wake up and fall flat on his face, because I tied his shoelaces together!

odyssey_scarecrow.ability: You think you are a Townsfolk character, but you are not. If you die, no-one dies at the next execution.
odyssey_scarecrow.flavor: Crows are clever. Before they peck me, they stand on me for a while, testing whether I'm alive. Once they're sure I'm straw, they peck away at ease. Before you push the next person up there, couldn't you do a test too, first see what this scarecrow looks like when it burns. Then decide whether to burn the next one.

odyssey_squidgirl.ability: If you die, you might not & all Townsfolk are drunk until dusk tomorrow.
odyssey_squidgirl.flavor: Pshhh, ah! It's already leaking! Oh no, oh no, it's going out of control! Pshhhhhh

odyssey_titan.ability: On the first night, you turn evil and gain the abilities of all Minions not in play. [The Titan counts as a Minion during setup]
odyssey_titan.firstNightReminder: Wake the Titan, tell them they have turned evil, and show them all Minion character tokens not in play.
odyssey_titan.flavor: I once held up the sky; now I only want to tear it down. The gods call me 'evil', then I shall be evil incarnate, the primordial darkness that devours all light. I have sacrificed my broken body to a will older than the abyss, in exchange for world-shaking power. A snap of my fingers shatters stars; a breath withers all things. This time, there is no salvation, only gods kneeling at my feet in eternal despair.

odyssey_twoface.ability: Each night, you change to the alignment opposing the last player who died by execution.
odyssey_twoface.otherNightReminder: If the player who died by execution today is on the opposite team to them, wake them and tell them their new team.
odyssey_twoface.flavor: One thought of good, and the heart knows no bounds. One thought of evil, and the square inch imprisons itself. One thought arising, good and evil beget each other. One thought fallen, mortal and saint are both forgot.

odyssey_visagiste.ability: If you nominate or are nominated by a Minion or Demon, they may become a not-in-play same-type character tonight, even if you are dead.
odyssey_visagiste.otherNightReminder: Wake the players with a "Makeover" reminder by them.
odyssey_visagiste.flavor: The same touch of rouge, on the cheek it's shyness, at the corner of the eye it's allure, at the lips it's spite. One face, three places, three faces. My clients always say 'just do whatever,' but I never do whatever. I have to look at her bone structure first, then her features, and only then decide who she'll become tonight.

odyssey_whiteknight.ability: Once per game, a player who is mad about wanting to survive might not die when executed.

jinxes.reason: if a player does not die by execution because of the Devil's Advocate's or the White Knight's ability, then the next day neither the White Knight's nor the Devil's Advocate's ability can affect them.

odyssey_whiteknight.flavor: I sank into the muddy, barren soil, where salty tears and pained moans stretch on without end, slowly suffocating under fragile pride and tenderness. But if you are willing to call my name, even if it tears my rotting skin apart completely, even with the last breath of strength left in me, I will come and save you.

odyssey_wolfboy.ability: When all other Wolfboys are dead, you become a not in play evil Minion. [Outsiders might be Wolfboys]
odyssey_wolfboy.otherNightReminder: If a Wolfboy changed character today, wake them and tell them their new character and team.
odyssey_wolfboy.flavor: You call us 'Wolfboys,' as if we were a pack. We never were. The only thing we share is this: we were all cast out by the town. You hate us, and we hate you. The wolf pack has no name, and neither do I. But one day the Demon will grant one of us a new name, a real name. And on that day, he will use that name to knock on every one of your doors.

odyssey_yeti.ability: If the Demon publicly guesses you (once), you are executed instead of them. Each day, if no-one is executed, your team loses.
odyssey_yeti.flavor: The wind will sweep away my tracks; every flake of new snow is a seal.

odyssey_clone.ability: Once per game, at night, you may choose a player: they die, and you become their character.
odyssey_clone.flavor: Invade, absorb, reshape. The key to it all lies in that code called DNA. Or in the ignorant parlance of this era, should I call it, the soul?

odyssey_codex.ability: Once per game, on your Xth night, choose players X times: they are poisoned until dusk. Players chosen multiple times die instead.
odyssey_codex.firstNightReminder: The number of nights they have been in play tonight is how many times they may choose (players).
odyssey_codex.otherNightReminder: The number of nights they have been in play tonight is how many times they may choose (players).
odyssey_codex.flavor: Program activated... instructions received. Executing operation on Target #1 once; target is expected to lose consciousness immediately. Executing operation on Target #2 twice; total cellular disintegration of the target is expected.

odyssey_crosswing.ability: On your Xth night, you may poison players X steps away from you until dusk.
odyssey_crosswing.firstNightReminder: Wake Crosswing; they nod or shakes their head.
odyssey_crosswing.otherNightReminder: Wake Crosswing; they nod or shakes their head.
odyssey_crosswing.flavor: People always say wings are a token of flight toward the light, yet they don't know some wings are born to measure the reach of shadows. Touched souls, do not panic, do not pursue. You merely happen to be standing in the gap between me and the light.

odyssey_cyclops.ability: Each night, choose a player: you & the Demon learn their character. If an Outsider, they learn the Cyclops is in play. [+1 Outsider]
odyssey_cyclops.flavor: I've only got one eye, but this eye works real well. Whatever you're doing in your house, I can see it crystal clear from the hilltop. Don't blame me for peeking, my master told me to watch, and I just do as I'm told. That thing you muttered before bed last night? I heard that too, my ears aren't bad either.

odyssey_darkknight.ability: Each night, learn the Outsider who died today & guess their character: if correct, a player dies. [+1 Outsider]
odyssey_darkknight.otherNightReminder: Wake them and point to the Outsider player who died today; have them guess their Outsider character.
odyssey_darkknight.flavor: Life is nothing but a fraud, you dead soul. I will speak your name, strip away your attachments, and take you with me to savor the exquisite taste of a living being's extinction.

odyssey_daruma.ability: Players who answer questions you ask might die. If you answer another's questions, you might die. You can't die any other way.
odyssey_daruma.flavor: Is everyone here? What are you all doing? What day is it today? What secrets hide in this room? Won't anyone talk with me? Would one more word hurt? Would speaking it aloud bring calamity? Can't I just ask casually?

odyssey_dawnyx.ability: The good team cannot win while you live. Demons who die by execution regain their ability at dawn.
odyssey_dawnyx.flavor: You paint the dawn golden, how tender. The dawn I see is purple: the color of bruised blood, the bruise left when the night is sucked dry alive. The Demon wakes within that bruise, drinking the last drop of darkness before daybreak. You think the demons scatter when the light comes? No. When the light comes, I can finally see your faces. Now, the sky is bright, the game begins anew.

odyssey_doll.ability: You think you are a good character. If the Demon kills you, they choose a player: they become a Doll. [You neighbor the Demon]
