jinxes.reason: The Doll does not learn three not-in-play characters; instead, the Demon additionally learns three not-in-play characters (these may be the same as the Demon's bluffs). Non-original Dolls do not interact with the Snitch's ability.

odyssey_doll.flavor: They say I'm a good kid... but I keep hearing the stitches split. That string of numbers on the tag on my back... is it counting down? My lord, you need a new friend, don't you? This time I'll lie down in the coffin obediently...

odyssey_hekatonkheires.ability: If you die by execution, you may publicly declare you are the Hekatonkheires: your next vote is worth as many votes as you received.
odyssey_hekatonkheires.flavor: The blood of the Hundred-Handed never yields! Every shard that executes me becomes another arm lifting my boulder. I will smash through your hypocrisy, though it be hard as the walls of Troy.

odyssey_illus.ability: If your neighbors live, Townsfolk players' abilities yield false information.
odyssey_illus.flavor: Tonight you will have a dream. In the dream you'll meet someone you deeply love. You'll kiss her, you'll embrace her, you'll smell the reassuring scent in her hair. Then you'll wake. But in the waking world, her scent will become carrion and bile. Every breath will make you vomit. Yet she'll still smile at you. She'll say, 'What's wrong, darling?' And then you'll forget you ever loved anything that wasn't her. And I, I am the thing that isn't her.

odyssey_kitsune.ability: Each night, choose a player & an Outsider character: if not in play, they become it. If they are it, they die. [-1 or +1 Outsider]
odyssey_kitsune.otherNightReminder: Have them choose a character and a player.
odyssey_kitsune.flavor: You kneel too perfectly, that can't be newly learned. Such bone-deep etiquette belongs only to the Shogunate's descendants. But the Shogunate fell fifteen years ago... Intriguing. So are you the Shogunate's orphaned young lady, or the informer who sold out her whole family? Don't tremble, darling, I'm only asking in passing. What do you say?

odyssey_lepergnome.ability: If a Townsfolk chooses you with their ability, they become a Leper Gnome & you lose this ability. You win & lose with evil, even if dead.
odyssey_lepergnome.flavor: Come here! Embrace me! What on earth are you afraid of!

odyssey_narcotizer.ability: Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned until you choose again. When they become healthy, they learn the Narcotizer is in play.
odyssey_narcotizer.flavor: Darling, do you prefer lidocaine or ether? Oh... I didn't bring either, how about we make do with this hammer today? I promise it won't hurt.

odyssey_puck.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a non-Demon character: they die. If not in play, choose a player: they become that character.
odyssey_puck.otherNightReminder: Have them choose a character. If that character is not in play, have them choose a player.

jinxes.reason: When an evil player becomes the Hanged Man or gains the Hanged Man's ability (e.g., an evil Philosopher), they immediately lose that ability.

odyssey_puck.flavor: Come on, come on! Let's turn this serious deduction into a playground! I promise, winks, I'll make everything extra, extra 'fun'! Quick, let me see who'll be lucky enough to become my new toy today?

odyssey_shaman.ability: Once per game, at night, choose 4 characters of different types: for each not in play, a same-type player becomes that character.
odyssey_shaman.flavor: Crave power? I'll grant it. Crave freedom? I'll grant that too. But the price is losing your human shape. Kneel, and let me stuff your souls into sheepskins. Tremble, you'll find yourselves growing fur, dropping to all fours, your minds left with nothing but chewing and fleeing. Don't worry about getting lost, the pen I've prepared for you lies just ahead.

odyssey_sphinx.ability: Each night, choose a character: tomorrow they are publicly asked a yes/no question. If they answer incorrectly, they might be executed.
odyssey_sphinx.firstNightReminder: Wake the Sphinx and have them choose a character.
odyssey_sphinx.otherNightReminder: Wake the Sphinx and have them choose a character.

jinxes.reason: When the Sphinx chooses the Damsel, the Damsel immediately loses their ability.

odyssey_sphinx.flavor: The eyes of mortals are forever blinded by lies, but my gaze pierces every disguise. When fate's interrogation descends, only those who see the truth shall survive.

odyssey_toxblast.ability: When a player dies by execution, their Townsfolk neighbors are poisoned until dusk. If no-one is executed, all Townsfolk are poisoned.
odyssey_toxblast.flavor: My masterpiece flows beneath his skin! Those exquisite compounds! The moment the noose tightens, they'll burst from every orifice and wound of his like a rain of brilliant fireworks, landing on your faces, seeping into your lungs. Beautiful, isn't it?

odyssey_twinflower.ability: You think you are a Townsfolk character, but you are not. [+1 Twinflower, the two Twinflowers sit next to each other]
odyssey_twinflower.flavor: Twin shadows bloom as one; good and evil leave their traces. Two flowers on a single stem, bound together by fate.

odyssey_venomtail.ability: The 1+X Townsfolk nearest to you clockwise are poisoned. [No Outsiders in play. X is the number of Outsiders removed by you]
odyssey_venomtail.flavor: See this beautiful tail behind me? Bought it from an outlander at a steep price. Every segment is one of your poisoned, blackening neighbors; every segment is silently rotting. It grows longer and heavier as it drags. Don't fret, once the venom crawls through your bones, you'll be pinned onto it too, swaying behind me forever.

odyssey_versifier.ability: Each night, learn a word of a famous phrase or poem. The 1st player to recite the whole phrase is executed, even if you are dead.
odyssey_versifier.firstNightReminder: Wake them and show them a character.
odyssey_versifier.otherNightReminder: Wake them and show them a character.
odyssey_versifier.flavor: The bright moon startles the crows, restless in their roost; the water-clock runs low, the windlass draws from the golden well.

odyssey_witchdoctor.ability: Each night, you may choose a player: they are poisoned & their death is delayed until you choose again.
odyssey_witchdoctor.flavor: When the serpent staff strikes the earth and jungle smoke rises, breathe deep this bewitching incense of mandrake and wolfsbane. Do not resist this divine gift, this is the indestructible body, this is the rapture of the heart, this is the ultimate bliss of the mortal world.

odyssey_yasha.ability: Each night, you may choose a player you nominated today, or who nominated you: they die, even if you are dead.
odyssey_yasha.otherNightReminder: Have them choose a player with a "Grudge" reminder.
odyssey_yasha.flavor: My belly has been hollow for a thousand years, never filled. This emptiness is not lust of the flesh, it is the fear you've forgotten. By day you laugh and chat at ease, but when you turn over in the deep night, whose breath is that chill on your back? It is I, standing by your pillow, counting your breaths one by one. I am in no hurry, for hunger is the finest seasoning. The moment you unconsciously speak my name, that is when my feast begins.

odyssey_yukionna.ability: On your 1st night alive & your 1st night dead, choose a player: they are poisoned.
odyssey_yukionna.flavor: Love severed, incense spent, the moon a hook; the infatuated soul chases snow toward the netherworld. Icy winds mourn her shadow, her heart unsettled; freezing rain soaks her robes, her hatred unspent. Resentment frosts through flesh and bone; hatred becomes a long rope binding guilt. Life and death entwined without end; love and hate imprisoned, never ceasing.

odyssey_archlich.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. The 1st time you choose each dead player, they choose 2 players: chosen non-demons die.
odyssey_archlich.flavor: I hear it. The unwillingness toward death in your soul, the hunger for power. The world fears you, but I admire you. Accept this gift. Your corpse shall become my first masterpiece; your will shall become the law that judges all living things. Breathe, this sweet terror... it shall be the first meal of your rebirth.

odyssey_arthur.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. The 1st time you would kill a Minion, 2 players die instead & you swap characters with that Minion.
odyssey_arthur.flavor: When the Lady of the Lake handed me the sword, she hid another sentence, 'You will drown in your own glory.' Now I rise to the surface, spitting out resentment and regret, only to find I've long grown scales and claws. Fallen? This is my rebirth. Everyone who betrayed me will be hung to dry on the ruins of Camelot. I have returned, with a rusted holy sword and a heart of stone.

odyssey_cerberus.ability: Each night, choose a player: if they are evil, choose another player: both die. Minions you kill keep their ability.
odyssey_cerberus.otherNightReminder: Wake them and have them choose a player; if they choose an evil player, have them keep choosing.

jinxes.reason: If Cerberus kills the Mastermind, the Mastermind keeps their ability even if Cerberus dies by execution.

odyssey_cerberus.flavor: I gnaw upon your flesh, ferry your soul across, and then, wander with me at the gates of Hell.

odyssey_chimera.ability: Each night, gain the ability of a non-Chimera Demon (different to your last 2 choices) until dusk. [-1 Outsider]
odyssey_chimera.otherNightReminder: Have them choose a Demon character other than the Chimera.
odyssey_chimera.flavor: Three heads, six eyes, all watching you. My lion fangs crave your throat, my goat horns aim at your heart, my serpent's venom is ready on my tongue. Still standing there trembling? Good, I don't like prey that falls too quickly. Struggle, and give all three of my heads something to do.

odyssey_corruptus.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die, even if they could not. Dead Outsiders win & lose with you, if you are dead. [+0 to 1 Outsider]
odyssey_corruptus.flavor: Embrace the darkness, outlander. I will forge your death and your wails into armor, forge the ostracism and malice you've suffered into a blade, and then you shall follow me, and take your revenge upon them.

odyssey_dretch.ability: Each night, a player dies. When nominated, you may declare you are the Dretch: if good players outnumber evil, a Minion becomes the Dretch.
odyssey_dretch.flavor: K'zhak! K'zhak! Dretch! Dretch! (Abyssal: Come! Dretches!)

odyssey_echo.ability: Each night, choose a character: they die. If that character is not in play, next night you choose an additional character (stackable).
odyssey_echo.flavor: Time is not linear, and neither is death. Every unanswered cry, after echoing, converges into a deafening shriek. The Echo never forgets; the Echo never forgives. The Echo is the net fate has laid, the more you struggle, the tighter you're bound.

odyssey_hydra.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. If you are executed before the final day, a good & an evil player become the Hydra.
odyssey_hydra.flavor: What you call 'the end' is nothing but life's basest, laughable illusion. My existence is life's own blind, greedy, endlessly replicating ugly truth. Execution? When every corner of your town writhes with my form, you will finally understand, you were never slaying a Demon; you were only helping me... evolve.

odyssey_khorne.ability: Each night, choose 2 players: they die. If a good player died today, 1 of the players you choose tonight does not die.
odyssey_khorne.flavor: You're too timid, even your blade trembles. You don't deserve to stand here; you defile your banner and your glory. Only the warriors who dared look me in the eye, who charged at me, who tried to strike back even as they fell, deserve my mourning, however brief. And you? You deserve to be casually chopped down, unknown to all, with not even a fly bothering to land on your corpse.

odyssey_kraken.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. The 1st time you die, you live but register as dead & may only choose your living neighbors.
odyssey_kraken.flavor: I rise from an abyss where even the corpses of gods cannot sink. I have heard the first cry of the tearing crust; in the cleft between magma and absolute zero, I forged my heart into an undying molten core. Vitality is the only luggage I brought back from the deep dive. I am the Kraken, immortality walking the abyss.

odyssey_minotaur.ability: Each night, choose a living player: they die. If all evil players have died by execution, your team wins (not on the last day).
odyssey_minotaur.otherNightReminder: Have them choose an alive player.
odyssey_minotaur.flavor: Do you know the labyrinth's true brilliance? It isn't making people lost, it's making people believe every step lands in the right direction. For a thousand years, I've fled on wounded hooves, looking spent and finished. They chased me through stone gate after stone gate, thinking it a shortcut to victory. But there is no guiding thread here, no marks for turning back. Those seemingly open passages, every turn leads to a trapdoor or a spike pit. Every approach, every 'almost got him', is nothing but an illusion I tailored for them. When they excitedly greet their 'victory', what awaits them is only the boundless darkness in the labyrinth's depths.

odyssey_nurgle.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die, and the players neighboring them are poisoned until your next attack.
odyssey_nurgle.flavor: Oh, my poor child, you're not looking well, your face is too clean, your skin too smooth. That won't do. Come, let Grandfather hold you; it's been days since I embraced a new face. Your body lacks something warm, something... that grows slowly. Once my little 'gift' stirs in your belly, you'll discover what a reassuring feeling rot can be. Don't be afraid, there'll be a little swelling, a little itching, but that's just my children saying hello. When you bloom all over, you'll thank me.

odyssey_siren.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die & you may choose to lose this part of your ability: Townsfolk abilities yield false info.
odyssey_siren.otherNightReminder: Have them choose a player, then they choose whether to take their bow.
odyssey_siren.flavor: Hush... listen, this gentle tide is my whisper. When my song sounds, the truths you chase are nothing but phantom lights in my stage set. If I take my bow and exit, will you wake with a start, or fall into an even deeper illusion?

odyssey_skeletonking.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. If your team wins, Townsfolk who gave up their vote tokens also win. [+1 Outsider]
odyssey_skeletonking.flavor: My patience is shorter than your life. Last chance, bow your head, offer your loyalty, and I shall grant you the right to press your knees to the ground. My throne never lacks kneeling men; it lacks men clever enough. Your bones look hard enough, but I've seen harder, ground to dust, all of them. One last time: yield, or shatter?

odyssey_slaanesh.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. You may choose they learn you are Slaanesh. The last who learned wins & loses with you, even if dead.
odyssey_slaanesh.flavor: Kneel, not to beg for mercy, but to receive. I am the part of your dreams you dare not wake into. With every step I take toward you, a gorgeous flower blooms from the ground, watered with pleasure, rooted in desire, their fragrance making you forget everything. You call this 'depravity'? How laughable. Come, give me your hand. Let me tell you, restraint is a lie, discipline a shackle; only indulgence is the perfect home for this flesh of yours.

odyssey_theseaborn.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. The Storyteller has Minion abilities of their choosing & helps you win. [No Minions, any Outsiders]
odyssey_theseaborn.flavor: My dear child, noble blood of Poseidon runs in your veins, how could I allow those filthy, lowly Minions to serve you? While you slept upon the waves, your father's trident churned the entire Aegean. Every ship that dared set sail before dawn was torn apart by the storm. When the last sailor sinks to the seabed, is that stillness not your father's gentlest lullaby?

odyssey_tornado.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Each dusk, you swap characters with the alive evil player nearest to you clockwise.
odyssey_tornado.flavor: Your blades? Too dull. Your arrows? Too slow. Your eyes? They can probably only catch my footprints, provided I bother leaving any on the ground. Don't get me wrong, I'm not afraid of you, I just can't be bothered to be touched. A mortal brushing my hem? Filthy.

odyssey_tzeentch.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. You have an extra bluff. On the 1st night, choose a bluff: you gain it's ability.
odyssey_tzeentch.firstNightReminder: Have them choose one of three bluff characters.
odyssey_tzeentch.flavor: There's no need to strain to discern my outline, the shape standing before you now will melt and twist the next second. I am master of every disguise; I have buried countless false avatars among the crowds. So-called loyalty, alignment, good and evil, all are shells to blind the mortal. I never conquer by brute force; with cunning I turn allies against each other and bring convictions crashing down. Ceaseless change is the only truth, and I am the Lord of Change.

odyssey_luckystar.ability: Players who draw this token recive a reward (all players know what) and draw another token. [This token is added as an extra]
odyssey_luckystar.flavor: Ding-dong! The doorbell rings, and you open the door to find a box of chocolates labeled 'For today's luckiest person'. Have one, sweetness till tomorrow, and good luck after you finish!

odyssey_tango.ability: During initial setup, the Storyteller publicly designates a character: if that character is in play, an Outsider is added or removed.
odyssey_tango.flavor: Tonight's lead dancer is, the Scarlet Woman! Let's give a warm round of applause as the Scarlet Woman takes the stage to lead the dance! What? She's not here?

odyssey_wardsurveillance.ability: The Storyteller might tell Demon & Minion players anything about the Lunatic. The Lunatic might learn other players are the Lunatic.
odyssey_wardsurveillance.flavor: Lunatic #1 had Stargazy Pie tonight, and Lunatic #2 had a three-minute private meeting with his 'Minion' today! Report complete!

odyssey_hellsroulette.ability: After nominating, players roll a 6-sided die: if its number has already been rolled, they die, and all dice are reset.
odyssey_hellsroulette.flavor: The rules are simple, take a deep breath, then pull the trigger.

odyssey_lethe.ability: Evil players might think they are good characters & the Storyteller acts for them. The game only ends when all evils die, then everyone wins.
odyssey_lethe.flavor: The world fears me, saying I wash away all past lives. But they don't know, to forget one's sins is also to forget one's innocence. The deepest punishment here is not remembering what you did wrong, but never again remembering what you ever did.

menagerie_astrologer.ability: On your first night, learn three statements. Once per game, at night, you learn if any have become true.
menagerie_astrologer.firstNightReminder: Give the Astrologer three statements about the game. Nod or shake your head depending on whether any of the Astrologer's statements have come true.
menagerie_astrologer.otherNightReminder: Nod or shake your head depending on whether any of the Astrologer's statements have come true.
menagerie_astrologer.flavor: Who are we to believe we know better than the cosmos?

menagerie_banker.ability: You start knowing three characters: one is in play.
menagerie_banker.flavor: Resumes lie; medical records lie; but bank records can be trusted. Even the devil needs somewhere to put their money that isn't a sock drawer.

menagerie_cartographer.ability: You start knowing two players: one is in the longest line of good players.
menagerie_cartographer.flavor: Live your life by a compass, not a clock.

menagerie_chameleon.ability: Each night, you gain a new ability and learn two characters it could belong to. Once per game, the ability is that of an Outsider or Minion.
menagerie_chameleon.firstNightReminder: Assign the Chameleon's character and wake the Chameleon at the point in the night order corresponding to that character. Show the Chameleon two characters prior to any further effects.
menagerie_chameleon.otherNightReminder: Assign the Chameleon's character and wake the Chameleon at the point in the night order corresponding to that character. Show the Chameleon two characters prior to any further effects.
menagerie_chameleon.flavor: Every person has their own shape, shade and hue. I am all of them.

menagerie_cleric.ability: You start knowing a secret phrase. Once per day, if 5 or more players live and you say it publicly during a nomination, that nominee can't die until dusk.
menagerie_cleric.firstNightReminder: Give the Cleric a secret phrase.
menagerie_cleric.flavor: The power that words command can be immeasurable if chosen wisely.

menagerie_conspiracist.ability: You start knowing 1 player. If you are 'mad' that they are evil, when they die, learn their alignment and that of 1 living neighbour. If you claim to be the Conspiracist, lose this ability.
menagerie_conspiracist.firstNightReminder: Give the Conspiracist a player's name; give that player the Hunch token.
menagerie_conspiracist.otherNightReminder: If the marked player has died today or tonight, mark the Conspiracist with the Knew All Along token: they learn that player's alignment, and that of one living neighbour.

jinxes.reason: If the Harpy makes the Conspiracist mad at another player, the Conspiracist must be mad at both.

menagerie_conspiracist.flavor: Don’t you see? Don’t you see it? Look at the connections! Just look! It’s so obvious. If we assume that Mister Morozov is– no, wait… this goes deeper. This goes all the way to the top! I knew it all along!

menagerie_daredevil.ability: You register as evil and the Demon to good abilities. If you are executed and either 5 players remain, or the dead equal or outnumber the living, learn the Demon is one of two players.
menagerie_daredevil.otherNightReminder: If the Daredevil was executed today and 5 players remain, or the dead equal or outnumber the living, show the Daredevil two players, one of whom is the Demon.
menagerie_daredevil.flavor: Living on the edge isn't safe, but the view is certainly better.

menagerie_dentist.ability: Each night, choose a character. You learn if they are dead.
menagerie_dentist.flavor: Lying through your teeth doesn't count as flossing.

menagerie_disciple.ability: On your first night, you learn if either of the Evangelist's living neighbours are evil.
menagerie_disciple.otherNightReminder: Wake the Disciple: nod or shake your head.

jinxes.reason: If the Drunk becomes the Disciple, they remain drunk.
If the Stowaway becomes the Disciple, they are drunk.
If a living Demon becomes the Disciple and there are 5 or more players alive, this triggers the Scarlet Woman's ability. (Travellers don't count.).

menagerie_disciple.flavor: Thank you for being the shepherd that ushers me unto salvation.

menagerie_evangelist.ability: Once per game, at night, select a player. If they agree, they become the Disciple.
menagerie_evangelist.otherNightReminder: Wake the Evangelist and ask them if they want to use their ability. If they do, wake the player they choose and ask them if they wish to become the Disciple.
menagerie_evangelist.flavor: Lost! Lost! Lost! Better a whole world on fire than a soul lost!

menagerie_gatekeeper.ability: Each night, if you nominated today, learn one not-in-play character. [+0 or +1 Outsider]
menagerie_gatekeeper.otherNightReminder: If the Gatekeeper nominated today, the Gatekeeper learns a not-in-play character.

menagerie_guardian.ability: Each night, learn a player. From night 2, pick a player (not yourself). If the Demon chooses them at night, learn whether the Demon is a known player.
menagerie_guardian.firstNightReminder: Show the Guardian one player. Mark that player with the Known token.
menagerie_guardian.otherNightReminder: Show the Guardian one player. Mark that player with the Known token. Ask the Guardian to pick a player. If that player was chosen by the Demon, nod or shake your head.

menagerie_houndmaster.ability: If you die at night, pick a player: you learn the number of steps from them to the nearest evil player.
menagerie_houndmaster.otherNightReminder: If the Houndmaster dies at night, wake them and ask them to pick a player. Show them a number.
menagerie_houndmaster.flavor: A hunter without a hound is an orchestra without a conductor.

menagerie_lostlover.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a living player (not yourself): if either chooses the Lost Lover, 1 learns the in-play Demon; the other, in-play Minions. If either guesses wrong, both get false info. [+Lost Lover]
menagerie_lostlover.firstNightReminder: Wake the Lost Lover marked 'First'. Ask them if they wish to use their ability. If they select the other Lost Lover, they receive the info noted in the Lost Lover's ability, or false info if not. Wake the other and do the same if the first Lost Lover declines.
menagerie_lostlover.otherNightReminder: Wake the Lost Lover marked 'First'. Ask them if they wish to use their ability. If they select the other Lost Lover, they receive the info noted in the Lost Lover's ability, or false info if not. Wake the other and do the same if the first Lost Lover declines.

jinxes.reason: If the Philosopher gains the Lost Lover ability, one Lost Lover is drunk, not both. If no other Lost Lover is in play, learn either an in-play Demon, or one in-play Minion.
If the Pixie is mad as the Lost Lover, they gain the ability if one Lost Lover dies.

menagerie_lostlover.flavor: And she as much in love, her means much less / To meet her new belovèd anywhere / But passion lends them power, time means, to meet / Temp’ring extremities with extreme sweet.

menagerie_martyr.ability: Once per game, at night, you may learn the character of a player chosen by the Demon tonight, and die in their place.
menagerie_martyr.otherNightReminder: The Martyr may choose to use their ability. If they do, mark the Martyr as Dead. The Martyr learns the character marked Dead by the Demon.

jinxes.reason: If the Martyr is protected by the Innkeeper on the night they use their ability, the Martyr does not die, but learns arbitrary information.

menagerie_martyr.flavor: The only thing that lingers longer than the blood of a martyr is the guilt of the one who survives.

menagerie_mechanicalman.ability: Each night, receive a task from the Storyteller. If completed before dusk, receive information about the game that night.
menagerie_mechanicalman.firstNightReminder: Give the Mechanical Man a task that they must complete. This task can be completed the following day, or any subsequent day.
menagerie_mechanicalman.otherNightReminder: If the Mechanical Man has completed their task, provide information about the game and give the Mechanical Man a new task that they must complete. If no task was completed, only give a new task.
menagerie_mechanicalman.flavor: 6reetin(g)s, Ma5ter. 1 live 7o /serve/. I /serve/ to liv3. Aw4iting inpu7.

menagerie_medicineman.ability: Each night, learn if either of your living neighbours are poisoned, drunk or mad.
menagerie_medicineman.firstNightReminder: The Medicine Man learns a yes or no.
menagerie_medicineman.otherNightReminder: The Medicine Man learns a yes or no.

jinxes.reason: The Mutant registers as mad to the Medicine Man.
The Sleeper, and the Minion they are making drunk, register as mad to the Medicine Man.
The Mime registers as mad to the Medicine Man if they are to learn information tonight.
The Yang registers as mad to the Medicine Man.

menagerie_medicineman.flavor: Hush, now. One spoonful of wild sage; a pinch of rosehip; a dash of calendula; boiled with nettle should do it. But drink quickly - you are fading fast… and this tastes terrible.

menagerie_mentalist.ability: Each night, learn the character of a living player you had a private chat with today. If you spoke with only one living player, this info is false.
menagerie_mentalist.otherNightReminder: Wake the player, and show them a character of a living player they spoke with privately.
menagerie_mentalist.flavor: I don't need to see the future. I just need to understand the present. (Creator credit: Mega)

menagerie_mime.ability: If you are 'mad' as a good character today, learn if it is in play the next night.
menagerie_mime.otherNightReminder: If the Mime was successful during the day, wake them and nod or shake your head, depending on whether the character is in play.

menagerie_mortician.ability: Once per game, at night, choose an alive player. The Undertaker, if chosen, learns a character killed at night. Each night, learn if dead neighbours are targeted by an ability. [+the Undertaker]
menagerie_mortician.otherNightReminder: Wake the Mortician: they may choose to use their ability. If they agree, they choose a player. The Undertaken, if chosen, is woken. Show them a character that has died tonight. Nod or shake your head at the Mortician depending on whether a dead neighbour was targeted by an ability.

jinxes.reason: If the Philosopher has the Undertaker's ability, they receive info from the Mortician. If alive, the Undertaker receives false info.

menagerie_mortician.flavor: It's thankless work, but I'd be concerned if it wasn't.

menagerie_oldsheriff.ability: You start knowing how many evil players are sitting within 3 steps of you. This number may be 1 higher or lower. [-1 Outsider]
menagerie_oldsheriff.firstNightReminder: Give the Old Sheriff a number corresponding to the number of evil players within 3 steps of them either side, 1 higher or lower than the actual number.
menagerie_oldsheriff.flavor: Upholdin’ the law’s tough work, but if you’re real careful-like, you just might see the autumn years. ’Course, it goes without sayin’ – you should never trust an ol’ man in a young man’s game, heh.

menagerie_presentpeeker.ability: Each night, learn if a living neighbour has a bad present. If both living neighbours are good, their presents give a boon regardless.
menagerie_presentpeeker.firstNightReminder: Give a thumbs up or thumbs down.
menagerie_presentpeeker.otherNightReminder: Give a thumbs up or thumbs down.
menagerie_presentpeeker.flavor: This one feels soft... must be socks. But this one -- THIS one feels heavy!

menagerie_prophet.ability: Each day, before nominations, you may make a public statement about today’s executee. At night, learn if it was true.
menagerie_prophet.otherNightReminder: Give the Prophet a yes/no depending on whether their statement about the day’s executee was true. If no-one was executed today, do not wake the Prophet.
menagerie_prophet.flavor: I sense… a fair complexion, shoulder-length auburn hair… weathered hands… good of heart… it is you! The town washerwoman - today, you will meet your end! So say I, so shall it be.

menagerie_ronin.ability: On your first night, you and the Demon learn two players, one of which is your ally. If the Demon kills your ally, learn an evil player, and the 1st time you die, you don't.
menagerie_ronin.firstNightReminder: Mark a player with the Ally token and another with the Wrong token. Wake the Ronin and show them those players. Wake the Demon and show them those players.
menagerie_ronin.otherNightReminder: If the Ronin's learned player has died tonight, wake the Ronin and show them an evil player. Mark the Ronin with the Has Ability token.
menagerie_ronin.flavor: 身をあさく思、世をふかく思ふ.

menagerie_seer.ability: Each night, the Demon chooses 1 alive player (not a Minion or Demon), unique to previous choices. Learn that player. If you are chosen, the Demon learns who you are.
menagerie_seer.firstNightReminder: The Demon selects a player. Show that player to the Seer if they are good; show an arbitrary player if they are drunk. If the Demon chooses the Seer, show the Seer's player to the Demon.
menagerie_seer.otherNightReminder: The Demon selects a player. Show that player to the Seer if they are good; show an arbitrary player if they are drunk. If the Demon chooses the Seer, show the Seer's player to the Demon.

jinxes.reason: If the Goon has not been chosen tonight, they become the alignment of the Seer, not the Demon; the Seer is drunk as a result.
The Spy can be chosen by the Demon at night.
If a Summoner is in play and no Demon is in play, the Summoner chooses for the Seer’s ability instead.
The Doppelganger can be chosen by the Demon at night.
The Vortox can choose any player at night as part of the Seer's ability.

menagerie_seer.flavor: These visions can be wielded as a weapon - but all too often, people of my ilk find those weapons turned against me.

menagerie_shinkan.ability: If you die at night, all evil players are drunk the next day and night.
menagerie_shinkan.otherNightReminder: If the Shinkan has died tonight, mark all evil players as drunk.

menagerie_sleeper.ability: One Minion is drunk, and they learn this. You might register as an evil Minion.
menagerie_sleeper.firstNightReminder: Select a Minion and give them the ‘Slept’ reminder token. Inform that Minion that a Sleeper is in play.

jinxes.reason: If the Baron is made drunk by the Sleeper, the Sleeper learns there is a Baron in play.
If the Marionette is made drunk by the Sleeper, the Demon does not learn who they are.
If the Evil Twin is made drunk by the Sleeper, they are still paired with a good player, but the game does not end if the good player dies.
If the Summoner is drunk on the 3rd night, the Summoner chooses which Demon, but the Storyteller chooses which player.
If the Vizier loses their ability, they learn this. If the Vizier is executed while they have their ability, their team wins.

menagerie_sleeper.flavor: report day 2 STOP infiltration successful STOP no suspicion must lay low STOP do not rescue STOP destroy upon receipt STOP

menagerie_smith.ability: On your first night, create an ability for yourself, agreed to by the Storyteller. The Demon learns a clue as to its nature.
menagerie_smith.firstNightReminder: The Smith proposes an ability. It can be agreed to or negotiated. Wake the Demon and provide a hint as to the nature of the agreed ability.
menagerie_smith.otherNightReminder: If applicable, wake the Smith at a point in the night appropriate to their ability.
menagerie_smith.flavor: With fire and strength, I shape the world.

menagerie_swindler.ability: Once per game, at night, receive a good player's info and three players that may have sent it. That info is wrong for both players.
menagerie_swindler.otherNightReminder: From Night 2: Wake the Swindler and ask if they wish to use their ability. If they do, when a player of your choice receives info tonight, it is wrong: send a copy of that info to the Swindler. If no info is left to send, the Swindler learns nothing.

jinxes.reason: The Spy may register to the Swindler’s ability.
If a Vortox is in play, the Swindler produces and receives correct information.

menagerie_swindler.flavor: Ho there - yes, you in the dirty apron! You look like a lucky fella. And you, miss! You with those lovely scissors in hand! Something tells me luck is on your side this fine day. Don't be scared, I don't bite. Now, watch closely as I place the ball under the cup...

menagerie_thaumaturge.ability: Each night, choose a player. The first Minion ability that targets this player targets that Minion instead. Affected Minions learn you are 1 of 2 players.
menagerie_thaumaturge.firstNightReminder: The Thaumaturge chooses a player. If any Minion ability targets them, inform the Minion that they are targeted instead. Inform that Minion that the Thaumaturge is the corresponding player and one wrong player.
menagerie_thaumaturge.otherNightReminder: The Thaumaturge chooses a player. If any Minion ability targets them, inform the Minion that they are targeted instead. Inform that Minion that the Thaumaturge is the corresponding player and one wrong player.

jinxes.reason: The Assassin is unaffected by the Thaumaturge's ability, but still learns the two players that might be the Thaumaturge.

menagerie_thaumaturge.flavor: Fie, fie I say! Back to whence you came, foul minion!

menagerie_wiretapper.ability: On Night 1, if you use your ability, the Demon learns one in-play character as part of their bluffs, and 1 Townsfolk is drunk until dusk. The Demon learns you are in play.
menagerie_wiretapper.firstNightReminder: The Wire Tapper may use their ability. If they say yes, replace a Demon bluff with an in-play character (not the Wire Tapper). Mark one Townsfolk as Wires Crossed.

jinxes.reason: If the Snitch is in play, one Minion bluff is also affected by the Wire Tapper: no additional Townsfolk are made drunk.

menagerie_barfly.ability: On your first day, you must publicly guess 5 players' characters (not including yourself or Travellers). If the majority are incorrect, one player is drunk from now on, even if you are dead.
menagerie_barfly.flavor: Ey, 'ey you there... you're the wazscherwoman, yeah? The Zzaint? Oh, schorry about that. Get a lil'... a lil'... hic - 'ey, 'ey you - the unnertaker, aye-- oh, bugger it: barkeep! Wassail for all! (Creator credit: Twindels)

menagerie_blasphemer.ability: The first Townsfolk you speak to privately becomes a not-in-play Outsider if you die. If you die without speaking to a Townsfolk, or if all Outsiders are in play, another player might die that night.
menagerie_blasphemer.otherNightReminder: If the Blasphemer has died today or tonight, wake the Townsfolk marked 'Doomed' and show them the YOU ARE token. Assign them a not-in-play Outsider character.
menagerie_blasphemer.flavor: Alas, my wounds are mortal. With my dying breath, I cast thee out!

menagerie_colossus.ability: You might not die if executed. Your neighbours might register as a Colossus of your alignment.
menagerie_colossus.flavor: No. Weather is same up here. Yes. Doorway is hard.

menagerie_eccentric.ability: If you are nominated by evil and executed, your team loses. Anyone 'mad' that you are in play might die. You cannot self-nominate. [Your token is a square]

jinxes.reason: The Faux Paw nominating the Eccentric does not trigger the Eccentric's ability.
If the Spy and the Eccentric is in play, the Eccentric is drunk.
If the Widow and the Eccentric is in play, the Eccentric is drunk.

menagerie_eccentric.flavor: Up is down! Left is right! Day is night! I am not me! I am you! Or are you me? Wait, I'm me? Round and round we go... Oh ho!

menagerie_egotist.ability: One Townsfolk player who nominates you or votes on your execution is drunk until dawn, even if you are dead. You cannot self-nominate.
menagerie_egotist.flavor: How dare you? I'll have you know I am good friends with Baron Morozov - VERY good friends - and he can have you hanged for this. Who do you think you are? You know, you're awfully talkative for a lowly librarian. I bet you don't even read books. I've read over a hundred. Not to mention--

menagerie_fixer.ability: On your first night, choose 3 players (not yourself). If 2 are among the last 3 alive, you win with the winning team, even if dead. If any die, you might die at any time.
menagerie_fixer.flavor: Now listen here, bub. I've got five hundred bones on Morozov over there, so no funny stuff. Stick to the plan, and make sure he makes it out alive. If he goes down, we all go down. You get me?

menagerie_missionary.ability: You must ask the player you wish to nominate for permission. If you nominate without permission, you might die tonight.
menagerie_missionary.flavor: Hello there! Could you spare a moment to learn about our lord and-- ah, of course, have a nice day.

menagerie_oaf.ability: If a non-Demon ability would target you, it might target a living neighbour instead. If targeted 3 times, lose your ability & die at night.
menagerie_oaf.otherNightReminder: If the Oaf has been targeted by 3 abilities in total thus far, they die.

jinxes.reason: The Saboteur can redirect abilities from - but not to - the Oaf without triggering its ability.

menagerie_oaf.flavor: Uh oh. Sorry. Uh ohhhhh. Sorryyyyy.

menagerie_partypooper.ability: You do not know you are the Party Pooper. You think you are a Townsfolk, but you are not. Presents you give or receive are always a bane.
menagerie_partypooper.flavor: So I says... I says... Whatchu talkin' at me for? You're not my bozz! Y'know? I zwear, this year has been a total BUST. And y'know what? The turkey was unzh-- un-- it didn't have any SALT on it.

menagerie_recordkeeper.ability: If you are executed, the Demon sees the Grimoire tonight.
menagerie_recordkeeper.otherNightReminder: If the Record Keeper has died by execution today, show the Demon the Grimoire.

jinxes.reason: If a Damsel is in play, they are drunk when the Record Keeper dies.
If the Poppy Grower is in play and the Record Keeper dies, the Demon does not see the Grimoire until the Poppy Grower dies.

menagerie_recordkeeper.flavor: You would be surprised as to what people are capable of when they think nobody is watching.

menagerie_snoop.ability: You start knowing a neighbour's character (Travellers don't count); if they are evil, info you receive is arbitrary. The Demon starts knowing the player and character of the other neighbour.
menagerie_snoop.firstNightReminder: Show the Snoop a neighbour's character, or any good character if evil. Wake the Demon and show them that THIS PLAYER IS and their corresponding character.
menagerie_snoop.flavor: I've always wondered what's behind this door--

menagerie_stowaway.ability: You do not know you are the Stowaway. You think you are an in-play Outsider, but you are not. [+0 or +1 Outsider]

jinxes.reason: The Drunk cannot be a Stowaway.

menagerie_stowaway.flavor: Gods above, this crate is heavy!

menagerie_thrall.ability: Once per game, a Minion may give you a task for the next day. If you reveal the task, or 5 or more players live and you fail by dusk, the Demon gains a Minion ability.
menagerie_thrall.firstNightReminder: Inform a Minion of your choice that the Thrall is in play. Wake that Minion and ask if they wish to give the Thrall a task.
menagerie_thrall.otherNightReminder: Wake the Minion that learned of a Thrall and ask if they wish to give the Thrall a task. If the Thrall failed or revealed their task, inform the Demon of the Minion ability they have gained.

jinxes.reason: The Demon cannot gain the Evil Twin ability.
If the Thrall fails their task, a living Minion gains the Goblin ability in addition to their own ability, and learns this.
If the Thrall fails their task, a living Minion gains the Scarlet Woman ability in addition to their own ability, and learns this.
If the Thrall fails their task, a living Minion gains the Boomdandy ability in addition to their own ability, and learns this.
If the Thrall fails their task, a living Townsfolk becomes the Thrall.

If the Demon has a neighbour who is alive and a Townsfolk or Outsider when the Thrall has failed their task, that player becomes an evil Marionette. If there is already an extra evil player, this does not happen.
If the Thrall fails their task, a living Minion gains the Doppelganger ability in addition to their own ability, and learns this.
If the Thrall fails their task, a living Minion gains the Lady Lace ability in addition to their own ability, and learns this.

menagerie_thrall.flavor: Evil doesn't always look like a monster. Sometimes, it just looks like someone following orders.

menagerie_yang.ability: If you are good, you might not die. Each night, choose a player different to last night: if good, they cannot die, but are drunk until dusk. If you are 'mad' about being an Outsider, you might be executed, even if dead.

jinxes.reason: The Marionette can neighbour the Yang.

menagerie_yang.flavor: Water seeks to quench fire, but it must not linger, lest it boil.

menagerie_arbiter.ability: Each night, you may make a unique rule until dusk, agreed to by the Storyteller. If a good player breaks that rule, at night, choose a player: they die.
menagerie_arbiter.firstNightReminder: Negotiate a rule with the Arbiter. Once agreed, announce it during the night. It takes effect immediately.
menagerie_arbiter.otherNightReminder: The Arbiter selects a player to kill if a rule was broken. Negotiate a rule with the Arbiter. Once agreed, announce it during the night. It takes effect immediately.

jinxes.reason: If the Arbiter's rule would conflict with the Zealot's ability, the Zealot is deemed to not have broken a rule.
If the Arbiter's rule would conflict with the Butler's ability, the Butler is deemed to not have broken a rule.
If the Arbiter's rule would conflict with the Golem's ability, the Golem is deemed to not have broken a rule.
If the Arbiter's rule would conflict with the Thrall's task, the Thrall is deemed to not have broken a rule.
The Alchemist registers as evil to their own ability.

menagerie_arbiter.flavor: I am the law, so, I won. (Creator credit: Mega)

menagerie_blackmailer.ability: Each night, choose two players. The first must vote with the second. If they do not, one or both might die.
menagerie_blackmailer.firstNightReminder: The Blackmailer chooses two players. Place the 'First' token on the first player chosen, and the 'Second' token on the second player chosen.
menagerie_blackmailer.otherNightReminder: The Blackmailer chooses two players. Place the 'First' token on the first player chosen, and the 'Second' token on the second player chosen.

jinxes.reason: The Zealot, if forced to vote with another player, must still adhere to their own ability. Neither the Zealot or the Blackmailer's other target die as a result.
The Butler, if forced to vote with another player, must still adhere to their own ability. Neither the Butler or the Blackmailer's other target die as a result.

menagerie_blackmailer.flavor: Even the most honourable person is forced to yield to blackmail once or twice in their life, if only to keep the peace. (Creator credit: Matt)

menagerie_chatterpox.ability: Minion and Demon abilities may be falsely shown or announced to players. They may malfunction in some way.
menagerie_chatterpox.firstNightReminder: Show, or announce a Minion or Demon ability as they would normally: you may break the rules or change the phrasing of these abilities.
menagerie_chatterpox.otherNightReminder: Show, or announce a Minion or Demon ability as they would normally: you may break the rules or change the phrasing of these abilities.
menagerie_chatterpox.flavor: Hey Gerald, didja ever hear the one about the beermonger hiding as the town's innkeeper? They called him the fearmonger! Wait, is that how it goes? Hey, you try gettin' the words out right with a hand up your--

menagerie_counterfeiter.ability: On Nights 1 and 2, you see the Grimoire, with characters removed: you may move 1 unique reminder token in play.
menagerie_counterfeiter.firstNightReminder: Remove characters from the Grimoire (including bluffs) and show the Counterfieter the Grimoire. They may move 1 unique reminder token they see.
menagerie_counterfeiter.otherNightReminder: Remove characters from the Grimoire (including bluffs) and show the Counterfieter the Grimoire. They may move 1 unique reminder token they see.

jinxes.reason: If the Counterfeiter moves the Lunch token to an evil player, it becomes the Cannibal's Poisoned token.

If the Counterfeiter moves the Is The Marionette token from the evil Marionette to a good player, that player becomes the evil Marionette: the previous Marionette turns good and regains their ability.
If the Counterfeiter moves the Mad token, the player it moves to is informed that they are mad as the character the Cerenovus chose.

If the Counterfeiter moves the Mad token, the player it moves to is informed that they are mad at the same player the Harpy chose. If they move the 2nd token, the player with the Mad token is informed their target has changed.

If the Counterfeiter moves the First token, the player it moves to is informed that they must vote with the same player the Blackmailer chose. If they move the Second token, the player with the First token is informed their target has changed.

menagerie_counterfeiter.flavor: If you're not cheating, you're not trying. (Creator credit: George)

menagerie_crook.ability: Nominations are not public, and are instead given privately to the Storyteller during the day. Each night, learn players who nominated evil, & you may make yourself drunk until dusk.
menagerie_crook.firstNightReminder: The Crook may choose to make themselves drunk until the following night. Announce the Crook is in play at Dawn if the Crook is sober.
menagerie_crook.otherNightReminder: Show the Crook the player(s) who nominated evil players today. The Crook may choose to make themselves drunk until the following night. Announce the Crook is in play at Dawn if the Crook is sober.

jinxes.reason: The Town Crier learns one player who nominated along with their usual information.
Players who would die by the Witch's ability die along with the day's executee.
Players who would die by the Golem's ability die along with the day's executee.
Players who would die by the Virgin's ability die instead of the day's executee.
If the Gerrymanderer is in play, only one evil nomination counts towards its ability.

menagerie_crook.flavor: Citizens - your vote counts! This is democracy inaction! Oh ho, did I say 'inaction'? A mere slip of the tongue, I assure you. Now, if you'll cast your votes in these booths... do mind the gap.

menagerie_doppelganger.ability: 1 Townsfolk is poisoned and registers as an evil Minion. You learn a Townsfolk character and register as that character, and good: even if dead. One player knows the Doppelganger is one of two characters. [-1 or +1 Outsider]
menagerie_doppelganger.firstNightReminder: Mark one Townsfolk as Duplicated; note another in-play or out-of-play character as the other character to provide to a player. Wake that player, and tell them that the Doppelganger is the character marked as Duplicated, and the other character.
menagerie_doppelganger.flavor: You think I am, therefore I am.

menagerie_efreet.ability: The first time a Minion dies by execution (not yourself), they become good, but are not told. Choose a player: if good, they turn evil, and learn this. You might register as a different Minion, even if dead.
menagerie_efreet.otherNightReminder: If a Minion was executed during the day and is marked with 'Turns Good', change their alignment but do not inform them. Wake the Efreet, and ask them to choose a player. If good, they turn evil. Inform that player of their alignment change.
menagerie_efreet.flavor: You have outlived your usefulness. Make room for another.

menagerie_embalmer.ability: Players who die due to another character's ability register as alive. Once per game, at night, you may make yourself drunk from now on.
menagerie_embalmer.otherNightReminder: Wake the Embalmer and ask if they wish to make themselves drunk. If yes, mark them with the Drunk reminder token.

jinxes.reason: The Lycanthrope may choose any player, living or dead, as part of its ability. If they choose a dead player, their kill fails.
The Professor may choose any player, living or dead, as part of its ability.
If the Virgin's ability would execute a Townsfolk, this is not announced and the day does not end.
If the Cerenovus' ability would execute a player, this is not announced and the day does not end.
If the Boomdandy is executed, the Embalmer is immediately drunk.

menagerie_embalmer.flavor: فَٱلْيَوْمَ نُنَجِّيكَ بِبَدَنِكَ لِتَكُونَ لِمَنْ خَلْفَكَ ءَايَةًۭ ۚ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ عَنْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا.

menagerie_firebug.ability: On Night 1, a player holds the bomb. Each night, that player chooses a living player to hold the bomb. If the Demon chooses a player with the bomb, they choose again. You learn evil players holding the bomb.
menagerie_firebug.otherNightReminder: Wake the player holding the Firebug's bomb and inform them they are holding it, and they choose a player. If an evil player is selected, wake the Firebug to inform them.

jinxes.reason: If the Alchemist gains the Firebug's ability and the Demon chooses a player holding the bomb, the Storyteller makes the Demon's second choice. The Alchemist does not learn if evil players hold the bomb.
If the Goon is chosen to hold the bomb, that player can change the Goon's alignment and become drunk. The Goon holds the bomb regardless of whether this happens.
The Pukka does not get to choose again if they choose a player holding the bomb on Night 1.

menagerie_firebug.flavor: They told me I have an explosive personality, and I chose to take that literally.

menagerie_gerrymanderer.ability: If 5 or more players live, and 3 nominations failed today, choose a player tonight: they die.
menagerie_gerrymanderer.otherNightReminder: If the Gerrymanderer has the ‘Democracy Manifest’ reminder token, wake the Gerrymanderer; they select a player.
menagerie_gerrymanderer.flavor: Stand up, and let every voice be heard! Mine especially.

menagerie_labefana.ability: Each night, pick a player. You learn what is in their present, and once per game, may change it to a boon or bane. [+1 or -1 Outsider]
menagerie_labefana.firstNightReminder: La Befana chooses a player. Show them the present that player has. They may give you a thumbs up or thumbs down to change it to a boon or bane.
menagerie_labefana.otherNightReminder: La Befana chooses a player. Show them the present that player has. They may give you a thumbs up or thumbs down to change it to a boon or bane.
menagerie_labefana.flavor: La Befana vien di notte / Con le scarpe tutte rotte / Con le toppe alla sottana / Viva viva La Befana!

menagerie_ladylace.ability: Each night, choose a player. They are poisoned until you die. Before dawn on the night equal to Minions +1, you die, even if drunk or poisoned.
menagerie_ladylace.firstNightReminder: Lady Lace chooses a player. Mark Lady Lace with the token corresponding to the night equal to Minions +1.
menagerie_ladylace.otherNightReminder: Lady Lace chooses a player. If the night number corresponds with the token currently on Lady Lace, they die at the conclusion of the night and all poison effects are removed.

jinxes.reason: Lady Lace still dies if their time expires while under the effects of the Preacher’s ability.
If the Storyteller gains Lady Lace’s ability, they may poison 2 players on subsequent nights: on the 3rd night, all effects are removed.
Lady Lace still dies if their time expires while poisoned due to the Thaumaturge's ability.

menagerie_ladylace.flavor: Pardon the interruption, but this drink comes courtesy of the fair lady in the red dress. She sends her warmest regards.

menagerie_muckraker.ability: Each day, 3 living players must make a different public statement about the game, or good loses. Tonight, if 1 statement was false, a player dies.
menagerie_muckraker.otherNightReminder: If a player has made an incorrect statement for the Muckraker, the player marked 'Slandered' dies.
menagerie_muckraker.flavor: Sir, please. It's right there, in print, clear as day. 'MAYORAL SCANDAL - CAVORTING WITH DEMONS' - save your lies for the courts.

menagerie_necromancer.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a dead player (not a Demon). You gain their ability.
menagerie_necromancer.otherNightReminder: The Necromancer chooses a player. Mark that player with the 'Raised' reminder token. From then on, wake the Necromancer at the point in the night order corresponding to that character.

jinxes.reason: If the Necromancer gains the Virgin's ability and 5 or less players live (Travellers don't count), the Necromancer's ability fails.
If the Necromancer gains the Golem's ability and 5 or less players live (Travellers don't count), the Necromancer's ability fails.

menagerie_necromancer.flavor: Ⱄⱆⱃⰳⰵ Ⰵⱅ Ⰿⰻⱀⰻⱄⱅⱃⰰ Ⰿⰻⱈⰻ... Ⱄⱆⱃⰳⰵ Ⰵⱅ Ⰿⰻⱀⰻⱄⱅⱃⰰ Ⰿⰻⱈⰻ...

menagerie_saboteur.ability: Each night, choose two players. The first character ability that targets or learns something about the first player now targets the second.
menagerie_saboteur.firstNightReminder: The Saboteur chooses two players. Place the 'First' token on the first player chosen, and the 'Second' token on the second player chosen.
menagerie_saboteur.otherNightReminder: The Saboteur chooses two players. Place the 'First' token on the first player chosen, and the 'Second' token on the second player chosen.

jinxes.reason: If the Saboteur is chosen by the Preacher, and they have redirected an ability from themselves to another player, another Minion is affected by the Preacher's ability instead. The Saboteur learns this.
If the Alchemist has the Poisoner ability and targets the Saboteur, the Saboteur is poisoned, even if they have redirected an ability from themselves to another player.

menagerie_wispr.ability: You might register as adjacent to different players for good abilities. Once per game, at night, you may become drunk: a good player learns this.
menagerie_wispr.firstNightReminder: Place the 'Neighbour' tokens on two adjacent players (not including the Wispr). The Wispr may choose to make themselves drunk. If they do, remove the 'Neighbour' tokens; choose a good player and show them the Wispr token.
menagerie_wispr.otherNightReminder: The Wispr may choose to make themselves drunk. If they do, remove the 'Neighbour' tokens; choose a good player and show them the Wispr token.

jinxes.reason: If the Wispr is targeted by the Preacher's ability, a good player (not the Preacher) sees the Wispr's token.
If the Storyteller gains the Wispr's ability, that ability is given to a living Minion instead.
If the Alchemist gains the Wispr's ability, they learn the name of one of their new neighbours.

menagerie_wispr.flavor: They start to bob and weave as if they're excited you've come to join 'em, and it's not until you've walked a ways that you notice they don't seem to be growing much closer.

menagerie_abomination.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. You have two Minion abilities. [-1 Minion, -1 Outsider]
menagerie_abomination.firstNightReminder: Assign the Abomination with two on-script Minion abilities and inform the Abomination of the powers they have. They are performed in the corresponding point in the night order.

jinxes.reason: If the Abomination gains the Scarlet Woman ability, that ability is given to a living Minion instead.
If the Abomination gains the Vizier ability, they are safe from execution only once.
The Abomination cannot gain the Mastermind ability.
The Abomination cannot gain the Boomdandy ability.
The Abomination cannot gain the Summoner ability.
The Abomination cannot gain the Efreet ability.
The Abomination cannot gain the Necromancer ability.
If the Abomination gains the Goblin ability, they may lose this ability until dusk each night, and learn if this happens.

menagerie_abomination.flavor: We are many. But we are one.

menagerie_baku.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. One Townsfolk you speak to yields false information until dawn.
menagerie_baku.flavor: If you hear the whispers that float on the wind, they may not hear your screams.

menagerie_chronos.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Townsfolk information swaps between true and false each night. Once per game, you may swap this order, and a good player learns this.
menagerie_chronos.otherNightReminder: The Chronos chooses a player. Swap the Tick (true) and Tock (false) tokens. They may also elect to use their ability. If they do, swap Tick (true) and Tock (false) tokens, and inform a good player of this.
menagerie_chronos.flavor: Tick. Tock. Tick. Tock. Tock. Tick.

menagerie_ein.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. On your first night, choose a player. The first time this happens, they become an evil Zwei. If you both live when 3 players live, evil wins. [-1 Minion]

jinxes.reason: If the Zwei lives and the Ein dies, the Zwei becomes the Demon.
If the Barber dies, only the Ein is asked if they wish to swap characters. They may swap with the Zwei.

menagerie_ein.flavor: Wer weiß? Der Teufel ist ein Eichhörnchen.

menagerie_hypnox.ability: On Night 1, choose players equal to Minions +1: they are poisoned. Each night, choose a player: they die. You may instead turn chosen players into sober evil Minions & one sober evil Hypnox, & die. [No Minions, +1 Outsider]
menagerie_hypnox.firstNightReminder: Wake the Hypnox, and allow them to choose players equal to the number of Minions +1.

jinxes.reason: A Hypnox can not create a Summoner. If the Summoner creates a Hypnox, poisoned players are arbitrarily selected; the Summoner must be one of them.

menagerie_hypnox.flavor: What is this but a play on suggestibility? Their addled mind wants this. You can’t make someone do something they don’t want to do. Or can you?

menagerie_krampus.ability: Each night, pick a player: their boon becomes a bane. Each night, a player might die.
menagerie_krampus.flavor: Warst nicht brav, drum hoppla-hopp, kommt das Krampus im galopp.

menagerie_patientzero.ability: Each night, the nearest healthy, good neighbour of the most recently killed executee dies: the other is poisoned. Each day, if no living player is executed, evil wins.
menagerie_patientzero.otherNightReminder: All effects that took place last night are removed. The player marked 'Dead' is killed. The player marked 'Poisoned' is poisoned.

jinxes.reason: The Soldier is safe from Patient Zero’s abilities: if one would target a Soldier, it jumps to the next player over instead.

If the Tea Lady’s ability would activate via execution, this fulfils Patient Zero’s condition around execution. If it would activate at night, good neighbours are safe from Patient Zero’s abilities, but effects jump to the next player over instead.
The player protected by the Monk is safe from Patient Zero: poisoning or death jumps to the next player over instead.

menagerie_patientzero.flavor: Subject is showing remarkable promise. We shall inject another dose and apply 10,000 volts in the hope that reanimation might occur. Subject’s extremities are black and atrophied - our data did not predict this. To attending partners: caution.

menagerie_polterghast.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Once per game, at night, you may choose to register as dead & poison 1 Townsfolk neighbour.
menagerie_polterghast.otherNightReminder: The Polterghast chooses a player. They may also choose to use their ability to feign death. Give them the 'Play Dead' token and announce them as dead in the morning.

jinxes.reason: If the Polterghast dies while registering as dead, the Scarlet Woman becomes the Polterghast whose ability has already been used.

menagerie_polterghast.flavor: Over my dead body', you say? Well, if you insist.

menagerie_seiren.ability: Each night, choose a player: they become your alignment. The previously changed player dies: they swap back before dawn, even if the Seiren is drunk. Anyone 'mad' about being evil might be executed. [-1 Minion]
menagerie_seiren.firstNightReminder: The Seiren selects a player: mark them with the 'Turned' reminder, wake them, and inform them of their new alignment.
menagerie_seiren.otherNightReminder: The Seiren selects a player: mark them with the 'Turned' reminder, wake them, and inform them of their new alignment. The previously turned character dies; inform them that they are their previous alignment before the next day begins.

jinxes.reason: The Evil Twin's good player still counts as good for the purposes of the Evil Twin's ability when turned by the Seiren.
The Monk's ability fails if they try to protect a player already turned evil by the Seiren.

menagerie_seiren.flavor: It is said their song is honey-sweet, carried on rotten air. Among the salt and carrion, it is a tonic that heals and soothes. Pray you never hear it.

menagerie_shogun.ability: All players know you are the Shogun. Minions & Demons do not know each other. Each day, publicly choose a player: they die. After execution, players may nominate you & if executed while Minions live, your team wins. [+1 Minion, No Outsiders]

jinxes.reason: The Scarlet Woman cannot become the Demon. Instead, the Scarlet Woman instead gains the ability of the first Minion to die.
The Goblin's ability no longer ends the game. Instead, if the Goblin's ability would trigger, they may immediately choose a player: they die.
If a Mastermind's ability would trigger, players must execute a living player that day. If that player is good, evil wins.
The Shogun learns who the Spy is. The Spy does not see the Grimoire, but instead learns which Minions are in play.
The Widow learns who the Shogun is. The Widow does not see the Grimoire, but instead learns which Minions are in play.
If the Boomdandy's ability would trigger, the Shogun must die. Good wins if a Minion is chosen. If the Boomdandy is the only living Minion, the Boomdandy's ability does not trigger.
The Slayer can use their ability on Minions.
If the Record Keeper is executed, the Shogun does not see the Grimoire: they instead learn who their Minions are.
The Shogun does not receive bluffs. If the Poppy Grower dies, the Shogun and Minions instead learn players who are dead Minions.
The Magician is also announced as the Shogun. The Shogun must tell the Storyteller who they are killing privately.
The Lunatic is also announced as the Shogun. If they target a Minion with their ability, that Minion might die. If they target the Shogun with their ability, their team loses.
If the Mayor is killed by the Demon when 3 players live, the Mayor's team wins.
If the Vizier and Shogun are in play, the Shogun is not announced at the start of the game, but the Vizier is. The Vizier can die during the day.

menagerie_shogun.flavor: 分をわきまえろ痴者が。

menagerie_umbra.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Minions you choose for the first time swap characters with you and poison one Townsfolk neighbour until dusk. [-1 Outsider]
menagerie_umbra.otherNightReminder: The Umbra selects a player: mark them as dead - if a Minion is chosen instead and has not been chosen previously, inform the Umbra that they are now that Minion, and wake the Minion to tell them they are now the Umbra. Mark one Townsfolk neighbour as poisoned.
menagerie_umbra.flavor: People are like shadows. They disappear when it gets dark.

menagerie_yin.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. If you choose Yang, they become evil, then swap characters with you. If 5 or more players remain and you die, a living Yang becomes an evil Yin-Yang. [-1 Minion, +Yang]
menagerie_yin.flavor: Water may quell a fire, but in the end, the storm comes, and what is a storm if not water’s surrender to the fire?

menagerie_yinyang.ability: Each night, choose two players: at least one, or both, die. Yin learns who you are.

jinxes.reason: The Yin-Yang cannot be swapped to as part of the Hatter's ability.

menagerie_yinyang.flavor: Opposites, when combined, can create something greater than themselves alone.

menagerie_zwei.ability: Your good non-Traveler neighbours are poisoned. If the Ein dies, you become the Ein. This can only happen once.
menagerie_zwei.otherNightReminder: If the Ein died today, wake the Zwei and inform them they are now the Ein.

jinxes.reason: If Lunatic is a Zwei, they start seeing a Townsfolk or Outsider token.

menagerie_zwei.flavor: Anderenseites... Das Eichhörnchen ist ein Teufel.

menagerie_madscientist.ability: Each night, choose a dead player. They are poisoned and alive until dusk.
menagerie_madscientist.otherNightReminder: The Mad Scientist chooses a dead player.

menagerie_tactician.ability: Each night, choose a player. You may give them advice: they learn this, and whether it will help your team win the game.
menagerie_tactician.otherNightReminder: The Tactician chooses a player and offers advice to the Storyteller. The Storyteller wakes that player, provides that advice, and gives a thumbs up or down.
menagerie_tactician.flavor: Let your plans be dark and impenetrable as night, and when you move, fall like a thunderbolt.

menagerie_taxidermist.ability: Dead votes can be used to nominate. If you die, travel out or are exiled, choose 1-3 players: they regain their vote token.
menagerie_taxidermist.flavor: The difference between the tax man and the taxidermist is that the taxidermist leaves the skin.

menagerie_mercysociety.ability: Each night, one player learns which alignment the Storyteller believes is winning: good, evil, or neither. Drunk or poisoned players may receive false info.
menagerie_mercysociety.firstNightReminder: Wake one player and show them the Mercy Society token, as well as a thumbs up, thumbs down, or both.
menagerie_mercysociety.otherNightReminder: Wake one player and show them the Mercy Society token, as well as a thumbs up, thumbs down, or both.

jinxes.reason: If the General is in play at the same time as the Mercy Society, evil learns that a General is in play. The General's information is false once per game.

menagerie_mercysociety.flavor: Inter arma caritas. Per humanitatem ad pacem.

menagerie_peanutgallery.ability: Before characters are drawn, spectators choose one player. They win and lose with that player.

menagerie_parasitoid.ability: On Night 1, learn a player. You are in their seat for the purposes of executions and deaths.
menagerie_parasitoid.firstNightReminder: Assign a unique player to each seat, and send their name to the player sitting in that seat. In the event of an odd number of players, one player receives their own name.
menagerie_parasitoid.flavor: ...While this creature feeds upon and grows inside the host creature, should the host be predated upon, the nematomorph is at risk of death.

menagerie_pyro.ability: There are no nominations. At the end of each day, the player with the most players pointing at them is executed. Dead players who point at themselves are not counted.

jinxes.reason: The Goblin must publicly claim to be the Goblin before end of day, instead of during nominations.

menagerie_pyro.flavor: Papa! Look at the pretty colours in the sky! Wow, that was a big one! Oh... Mr. Morozov must have been tired - he's fallen asleep.

menagerie_santaclaus.ability: On Night 1, each player gives a present to a unique player. Boons given by good players help the good team, and vice versa. On the night the dead equals or outnumbers the living, all players open their presents.
menagerie_santaclaus.firstNightReminder: Wake each player and ask them to choose a player. If that player has already been chosen, prompt them to choose again. If there is an odd number of players, one player receives a present from the Storyteller, and learn this.
menagerie_santaclaus.otherNightReminder: Go around the Grimoire and apply the effects of presents, either publicly or privately.
menagerie_santaclaus.flavor: He sees you when you're sleeping, he knows when you're awake, he knows if you've been bad or good, so be good for goodness sake!

tirfar_actionhero.ability: If you die at night, an opposing player you nominated this game dies (unless either team would win).
tirfar_actionhero.otherNightReminder: If the Action Hero died tonight, choose an opposing player who they nominated: If neither team would win, mark them as "DEAD" and announce them as such in the morning.
tirfar_actionhero.flavor: Does this dining chair have an ejector seat, and if so, how?

tirfar_admiral.ability: Once per game, during the day, visit the Storyteller to learn the ally who is harming, or the enemy who is helping, your team the most.
tirfar_admiral.flavor: I really do not see the signal!

tirfar_aesthete.ability: Each night, learn a character the Storyteller believes you should think about.
tirfar_aesthete.otherNightReminder: Wake the Aesthete & inform them of the character you think they should think about.
tirfar_aesthete.flavor: Caesar adsum iam forte. Brutus aderat. Caesar sic in omnibus. Brutus sic inat.

tirfar_agent.ability: You think you're another Townsfolk. All players start knowing the Demon character.

tirfar_apothecary.ability: Evil Plague Doctors register as Minions, even if you die. [Minions are evil Plague Doctors]

jinxes.reason: Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.

tirfar_apothecary.flavor: Put this in any liquid thing you will, / And drink it off; and, if you had the strength / Of twenty men, it would dispatch you straight.

tirfar_arkansonney.ability: If you find me, make a wish. 1 Outsider knows a clue to where [I'm hidden. +1 Outsider]

jinxes.reason: The Pit-Hag cannot create an Arkan Sonney.
The Boffin can only grant the Arkan Sonney's ability if it is in play, and the Demon learns a clue to where it's hidden.
The Philosopher does not gain the Arkan Sonney's ability, but learns a clue if it's in play. If it isn't, they learn this.

tirfar_bard.ability: Evil players might think good players are the characters they're mad they are, even if you die.
tirfar_bard.flavor: Open gates, a calm song, and an army of their own imagination.

tirfar_biker.ability: If all (& only) Outsiders agree, they become Bikers [+0 or +1 Outsider]
tirfar_biker.flavor: Speed has never killed anyone. Suddenly becoming stationary, that's what gets you.

tirfar_boxer.ability: You are safe from Minions. If chosen by one, learn each other's characters.
tirfar_boxer.firstNightReminder: If a Minion chose the Boxer, wake both & inform them of each other's characters
tirfar_boxer.otherNightReminder: If a Minion chose the Boxer, wake both & inform them of each other's characters

jinxes.reason: The Boxer may open their eyes during voting, even if drunk or poisoned.

tirfar_boxer.flavor: Still a man hears what he wants to hear, and disregards the rest.

tirfar_bursar.ability: Each night, if 3 or more non-trivial public statements were made yesterday, learn if most were true.
tirfar_bursar.otherNightReminder: If 3 or more non-trivial public statements were made, tell the Bursar if most were true

tirfar_clown.ability: Each night, players might die. Your team only loses if you die & only wins if 2 players live. Minions know you. [No Demon, +1 Minion]
tirfar_clown.flavor: I visit Doctor, he says "Cure is simple, find the Demon". "But Doctor," I cry-

tirfar_consort.ability: If you're executed, publicly choose a new player: if they're evil, you're executed at dusk tomorrow instead.

jinxes.reason: If the Consort chooses an evil player, the Vortox's ability does not work until dawn

tirfar_consort.flavor: Don't you want to hear how the story ends?

tirfar_constable.ability: Once per game, during the day, publicly choose a player: if they are a Minion, they die & you regain this ability.
tirfar_constable.flavor: Only crimes can take place in darkness. Punishment has to be done in the light. This is our job; To light a candle in the dark.

tirfar_cosmonaut.ability: Each day, you may visit the Storyteller to learn a cryptic hint about the gamestate.
tirfar_cosmonaut.flavor: My mother said, to get things done: You better not mess with Major Tom.

tirfar_crook.ability: Each night, you learn how confident the Demon is.
tirfar_crook.flavor: There's one way to find out if a man is honest - ask him. If he says, 'Yes,' he's a damned liar.

tirfar_curarist.ability: The Demon's neighbors register as good Outsiders to Townsfolk. On the final day, you may privately learn an Outsider. [+0 or +1 Outsider]
tirfar_curarist.flavor: Not all visions deceive. Some merely reveal what you’ve been too blind to notice.

tirfar_dean.ability: If the Demon is the only living evil player, you learn who they are tonight.
tirfar_dean.otherNightReminder: If all evil players who are not the Demon are dead, wake the Dean & point at the Demon player
tirfar_dean.flavor: You don't need a miracle, you just need five minutes without distractions. As it turns out, thinking is a lot easier when nobody's yelling.

tirfar_despot.ability: All players know you are the Despot. You cannot die. [+1 Minion]
tirfar_despot.flavor: There are, always and only, bad people. But some of them are on opposite sides.

tirfar_doyenne.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a player: all Townsfolk except them learn false info tonight.
tirfar_doyenne.firstNightReminder: Wake the Doyenne. If they nod their head, mark the player they choose with SAFE:: and give all other Townsfolk false info until dawn.
tirfar_doyenne.otherNightReminder: Wake the Doyenne. If they nod their head, mark the player they choose with SAFE:: and give all other Townsfolk false info until dawn.
tirfar_doyenne.flavor: Let the gossip rage and the lies pour down. Come sit by the fire, dear, and have some tea while the storm passes.

tirfar_duke.ability: Each night, choose a player: you learn a character type they are not.
tirfar_duke.firstNightReminder: Wake the Duke & have them choose a player. Tell them a character type that player is not
tirfar_duke.otherNightReminder: Wake the Duke & have them choose a player. Tell them a character type that player is not
tirfar_duke.flavor: I'm sorry, is this some sort of peasant joke I'm too rich to understand?

tirfar_escapeartist.ability: Executions on you fail if you're nominated by an opposing player. 1 player registers falsely to you.
tirfar_escapeartist.flavor: Never tell the audience how good you are, they will soon find out for themselves.

tirfar_farrier.ability: You start by choosing a Townsfolk: the Pixie learns them instead. If it is not-in-play, you register as it to the Pixie. [+the Pixie]
tirfar_farrier.flavor: You said: The Shining Ones. You said: The Fair Folk. And you spat, and touched iron. But generations later, you forgot about the spitting and the iron, and you forgot why you used those names for them, and you remembered only that they were beautiful.

tirfar_firewalker.ability: Each night, Minions wake to choose unique alive good players: you learn who. If you are chosen this way, you die.
tirfar_firewalker.otherNightReminder: Wake each Minion & prompt them to choose a player: If they choose an evil, previously chosen, or dead player, shake your head & prompt them to choose again. Unless the only chosen player is the Fire-Walker, inform them of the chosen good players.
tirfar_firewalker.flavor: One step at a time, one single solitary step.

tirfar_furzeburner.ability: You start by choosing 3 players: chosen Minions become Outsiders until either your 3rd day or you die.
tirfar_furzeburner.firstNightReminder: Have the Furze-Burner choose 3 players: Any chosen Minions become Outsiders.
tirfar_furzeburner.otherNightReminder: Change the 1 token to the 2 token, or the 2 token to the 3 token.

jinxes.reason: On the 3rd night, Outsiders created by the Furze-Burner become Minions before the Summoner wakes.

tirfar_furzeburner.flavor: Sevow' a-dhelher ha kebmer with a'n mog, vaw, na wra eythin plegya dhe dhen gwadn y golon. Emava ow mires en garow, martesen, bes thera vy ow clerya an rosow ma hirra vel ty dhe anella, ow lesky an coth m'alja an skyll glas trovya spas lowr dhe vewa pan vo gwenton ow tos.

tirfar_geologist.ability: Each day, you may visit the Storyteller to say a number: you learn something that has that answer.
tirfar_geologist.flavor: Put the Rhyolite next to the Olivine, and the Topaz next to the Basalt. I have everything exactly where I want it to be. Almost.

tirfar_hawkshaw.ability: You start knowing a player fewer steps from a Minion than they are from the Demon.
tirfar_hawkshaw.firstNightReminder: Wake the Hawkshaw and point to a player with fewer steps to a Minion than to a Demon.
