tirfar_hawkshaw.flavor: I've booked us lodgings on the top floor, next to a respectable dealer in stolen property. As I've heard, good fences make good neighbors.

tirfar_hippie.ability: If an evil player nominated another today, you die tonight.
tirfar_hippie.otherNightReminder: If the Hippie is marked DIES TONIGHT, kill them
tirfar_hippie.flavor: That's just like, your opinion man...

tirfar_houndsman.ability: If 1 & only 1 alive neighbor is evil, learn who: if your team wins while they live, your team loses instead, even if you die.

tirfar_interrogator.ability: Each night, choose a player: if they’re evil, you might learn this. This ability is safe from all others.

tirfar_kaiser.ability: If no-one died yesterday, you alone decide who is executed from now on.
tirfar_kaiser.flavor: Where my Guards appear, there is no room for democracy. The enemy must be vanquished completely and I will dictate the peace terms at the point of my soldiers' bayonets.

tirfar_laird.ability: You start knowing 3 players: 1 is the Demon if (& only if) you neighbor a Minion.

jinxes.reason: If the Vizier neighbors the Laird, the Vizier is not announced.

tirfar_laird.flavor: O, wad some Power the giftie gie us, to see oursels as others see us.

tirfar_landsknecht.ability: The 1st good player the Demon kills who is fewer steps from them than from you becomes evil & you learn this.
tirfar_landsknecht.flavor: The problem with mercenaries is that they need to be paid to start fighting. And, unless you are very lucky, you end up paying them even more to stop.

tirfar_lemming.ability: Good players who nominate you become Lemmings. If 1 Lemming dies, that night, all do.
tirfar_lemming.otherNightReminder: Inform all players who became Lemmings today that they did so. If one died, kill all others.
tirfar_lemming.flavor: Let's play Follow-the-Leader! I'll go first!

tirfar_magus.ability: Each night, you may choose a player: today, privately learn their alignment (arbitrary if all other alive Magi did). [+0 to +2 Magi]

tirfar_mariner.ability: Once per game, at night, you may register as dead from now on: you learn a fact each night & die if an evil player guesses you (once).
tirfar_mariner.otherNightReminder: Wake the Mariner & ask if they want to use their ability. If they have, silently start communicating facts to them.
tirfar_mariner.flavor: Listen, Stranger! Storm and Wind, a Wind and Tempest strong! For days and weeks it play'd us freaks, like Chaff we drove along. Listen, Stranger! Mist and Snow, and it grew wond'rous cauld: and Ice mast-high came floating by as green as Emerauld.

tirfar_mentor.ability: 1 good player can't die. If you guess who (once), they become a Mentor when you die.

tirfar_midwife.ability: Once per game, at night, 1 player dies & another lives.
tirfar_midwife.flavor: There are plenty of people in Ravenswood bluff for whom my face has been the first and last thing they'd ever seen, which probably made the bit in the middle seem quite uneventful by comparison.

tirfar_milkmaid.ability: If you die at night, learn 1 evil player. [+0 or +1 Milkmaid]
tirfar_milkmaid.otherNightReminder: If a Milkmaid died, wake them and point to an evil player.

tirfar_mowltaker.ability: Each night, choose a player: chosen Outsiders die & learn you are the Mowltaker. [+0 or +1 Outsider]
tirfar_mowltaker.otherNightReminder: Wake, have them choose a player. If that player is an outsider, kill them and inform them of who the Mowltaker is
tirfar_mowltaker.flavor: I've been looking for a weird hill to die on, and all the real ones are too far from my house. So this is mine.

tirfar_official.ability: Minions know an Official is in play. Each night, if the Demon wasn't nominated today, all Minions are drunk until dusk.
tirfar_official.flavor: I bear the king's seal and the king's paperwork. I speak with the king's voice, but never with his mercy.

tirfar_orator.ability: You start knowing a rule: if all players on your team follow it, your team wins if an opposing player is then executed.
tirfar_orator.flavor: Anyone who is capable of getting themselves made Leader should on no account be allowed to do the job

tirfar_orchardkeeper.ability: There are an even number of Outsiders in play. [+0 or +1 Outsiders]

jinxes.reason: 1 Townsfolk might become an Outsider during setup.
1 Townsfolk might become an Outsider during setup.
1 Townsfolk might become an Outsider during setup.

tirfar_orchardkeeper.flavor: Get it? Because pairs sounds like pears? Oh, nevermind.

tirfar_ornithologist.ability: Minions & Demons don't learn their characters until you die & wake without prompt. [Minions & Demons draw blank tokens]
tirfar_ornithologist.otherNightReminder: If dead, inform minions & demons of their characters
tirfar_ornithologist.flavor: My mist nets are set up, I have my binoculars, I have my sandwiches. All I need to do now is wait.

tirfar_plotter.ability: Each day, you may visit the Storyteller to learn a piece of advice that harms the winning team.
tirfar_plotter.flavor: The last man to enter Parliament with honest intentions was Guy Fawkes

tirfar_postmaster.ability: You start knowing a direction: your Townsfolk neighbor in that direction learns false info & the other true.
tirfar_postmaster.flavor: Neither rain nor snow, nor glom of nit.

tirfar_punk.ability: On the 1st night, before evil info, choose a player: if evil, they swap characters & alignments with a good player.
tirfar_punk.firstNightReminder: Wake the Punk & get them to choose a play. If applicable, swap that player's character & alignment. Put the Punk to sleep.
tirfar_punk.flavor: I fought the law (The law won)

tirfar_rabbi.ability: 1 Minion has the Golem's ability: if they nominated today, they learn this.
tirfar_rabbi.flavor: אַ גולם אָן אַ רבֿ איז בלויז אַ זייער גרויסער פּראָבלעם.

tirfar_ratcatcher.ability: When the Demon kills you or a Minion they learned, they learn a Minion. If that Minion lives on the final day, good wins.
tirfar_ratcatcher.otherNightReminder: Add the reminder token "Infested" to a Minion
tirfar_ratcatcher.flavor: The best way to catch a rat is to treat it like a king. Draw those young sirs to the table, and treat them to a platter of fancy cheeses, perhaps a cracker or two. The plan is now in motion.

tirfar_rockstar.ability: Each night, guess how many players would wake tonight: if correct (once), they instead learn you are the Rockstar.
tirfar_rockstar.firstNightReminder: If the trigger is met, all players that would wake tonight instead learn who the Rockstar is.
tirfar_rockstar.otherNightReminder: If the trigger is met, all players that would wake tonight instead learn who the Rockstar is.

tirfar_snail.ability: Only you & the Demon can kill each other. If just 3 players live, the Demon dies.

jinxes.reason: If the Boomdandy's ability triggers, the Snail's doesn't.

tirfar_snail.flavor: Alone at the edge of a universe, humming a tune

tirfar_student.ability: Once per game, visit the Storyteller to learn something you did right. Once, while dead, do so to learn something you did wrong.

jinxes.reason: The Student may visit the Storyteller to learn something they did wrong once any player dies.

tirfar_student.flavor: Ahh, I see my mistake. 'Embarazada' does not mean 'Embarrassed

tirfar_talentscout.ability: Each night, you learn a player with a character the Storyteller was excited to be in play this game until none remain.
tirfar_talentscout.flavor: You got potential, kid. Potential for being a huge disappointment, but potential nonetheless.

tirfar_troll.ability: If the Demon kills you at night, a Minion dies instead. If you left your seat in the town square today, you're drunk until dawn.
tirfar_troll.otherNightReminder: If the Troll left their seat today, they are drunk. If they would die to the Demon, mark a minion as "DEAD" instead
tirfar_troll.flavor: May the dawn take you all, and be stone to you!

tirfar_twoheadedcalf.ability: All Townsfolk are sober, healthy, & get true info. On your 2nd night, you (& only you) die.
tirfar_twoheadedcalf.firstNightReminder: All Townsfolk are sober, healthy, & get true info
tirfar_twoheadedcalf.otherNightReminder: On your 2nd night, you (& only you) die.
tirfar_twoheadedcalf.flavor: And as he stares into the sky, there are twice as many stars as usual.

tirfar_vicar.ability: On your 1st night, choose 1 player for each expected Minion: if you all live, you're all safe from the Demon.
tirfar_vicar.firstNightReminder: Wake the vicar, and get them to choose players equal to the starting number of minions.
tirfar_vicar.flavor: The Lord is a shoving leopard.

tirfar_warhero.ability: If you die by execution, your nominator's allies don't wake tonight.
tirfar_warhero.flavor: Hats off, lads. For one night, the guilty lie still.

tirfar_weatherwise.ability: The 1st time a player changes 1) character & 2) alignment, you learn this.
tirfar_weatherwise.flavor: Tis an ill wind that blows nobody no good, and even the harshest tide lifts all boats, but not tonight. Something's changed.

tirfar_whaler.ability: You start knowing 1 in-play evil character. If the character you know dies, you learn another tonight.
tirfar_whaler.firstNightReminder: Show the Whaler the character of the player with the "KNOWS" reminder
tirfar_whaler.otherNightReminder: If the player with the "KNOWS" reminder died today or tonight, wake the Whaler & show them a new in-play evil character.
tirfar_whaler.flavor: I know not all that may be coming, but be it what it will, I'll go to it laughing

tirfar_aide.ability: Each night, even if you die, the Demon is given some tokens to silently ask the Storyteller a question.
tirfar_aide.flavor: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.

tirfar_babysitter.ability: Outsiders do not learn if they are "the Demon", even if you are dead. [+Lil' Monsta]
tirfar_babysitter.firstNightReminder: If an Outsider is holding Lil' Monsta, don't tell 'em!
tirfar_babysitter.otherNightReminder: If an Outsider is holding Lil' Monsta, don't tell 'em!
tirfar_babysitter.flavor: You're my replacement, thank heavens you've come! What does 'M' stand for?

tirfar_barometz.ability: If you died today or tonight, 2 players equidistant from you become evil Minions & learn the Demon. [-1 Minion]
tirfar_barometz.otherNightReminder: If the Barometz died today or tonight, 2 players equidistant from them become minions, turn evil, and learn the demon.
tirfar_barometz.flavor: Cradled in ſnow and fann'd by arctic air / Shines, gentle Barometz! thy golden hair; / Rooted in earth each cloven hood deſcends, / And round and round her flexile neck ſhe bends; / Crops the grey coral moſs, and hoary thyme, / Or laps with roſy tongue the melting rime.

tirfar_believer.ability: Each night, learn a player: you are mad they are evil or you might be executed.
tirfar_believer.flavor: Did you see it? I saw it... It crashed in the woods. I saw it... It's one of us. I saw it... It's you.

tirfar_canary.ability: If you are the 1st player to die the way you did, something bad happens & you may visit the Storyteller to learn what.
tirfar_canary.flavor: The cruellest irony is a miner who dies so his canary might live.

tirfar_catlady.ability: Each night, even if dead, the Demon chooses a player: you learn who &, if all living allies have been chosen, your team loses if 1 is executed.
tirfar_catlady.flavor: Cats don't hunt seals. They would if they knew what they were and where to find them. But they don't, so that's all right.

tirfar_cavalier.ability: At your 1st dusk, publicly choose 3 players: if a good player you chose is executed, your team loses, even if dead.
tirfar_cavalier.flavor: For king and country! And gold, as it happens. Silver's good too, and I've been partial to decent malt when the occasion allows...

tirfar_churl.ability: When you die, the Demon's attacks can't be prevented from now on.
tirfar_churl.flavor: You'll never plough a field by turning it over in your mind.

tirfar_draper.ability: If you died today or tonight, Minions may choose Townsfolk to become, but keep their ability.
tirfar_draper.otherNightReminder: If the Draper died today or tonight, wake the Minions & prompt them to choose townsfolk characters to gain the ability of & register as.

tirfar_equerry.ability: If you died today or tonight, the Demon gains the ability "If you kill yourself this way, a Minion becomes your character" & learns this.
tirfar_equerry.otherNightReminder: If the Equerry died today or tonight, the demon gains the ability to starpass. Tell the demon this.
tirfar_equerry.flavor: Calm down, Thunderfoot. I don't know what's got you all spooked like this, it's almost like you see something I don't...

tirfar_everyman.ability: You think you're another good character. If you publicly resign, you win. [All other players are secretly Storytellers]
tirfar_everyman.flavor: And in case I don't see ya, good afternoon, good evening, & goodnight

tirfar_explorer.ability: The Demon's ability has been changed & they know what it is. You know the change, but not the ability.
tirfar_explorer.flavor: And of course, the thing you must not do if the ape is enraged, is the Macarena.

tirfar_fenoderee.ability: If the Demon was nominated today, they may choose if they swap characters with a Minion tonight.
tirfar_fenoderee.otherNightReminder: If the Demon was nominated today, wake them and ask if they want to swap characters with a minion: If they do, they swap characters with a minion of your choice.
tirfar_fenoderee.flavor: I must say, I simply don’t understand this outrage. You wished for the killer to go away. All I did was answer

tirfar_ghosthunter.ability: On the final day, even if dead, guess the in-play Demon: if correct, they die. [The Demon could be anything]
tirfar_ghosthunter.firstNightReminder: Did you put in a Ghost?
tirfar_ghosthunter.flavor: Spirits are basically just cranky fans, bro. I've got this. Rolling in three, two...

tirfar_gobemouche.ability: If you are mad that any information is false, you might be executed.
tirfar_gobemouche.flavor: It is more from carelessness about truth than from intentional lying, that there is so much falsehood in the world.

tirfar_hudie.ability: You think you're a Townsfolk. Once per game, you & some players wake to lose your abilities, even if dead. The Demon learns who.
tirfar_hudie.otherNightReminder: Wake the Húdié at some point & tell them & some townsfolk they're the Húdié. Tell the demon too pretty please <3

jinxes.reason: If the Demon would have the Húdié ability, they do not think they are a Townsfolk & do not lose their own ability.

tirfar_hudie.flavor: Five more minutes, please? You wouldn't believe the dream I just had. I mean, you were there, and you were there, and you, and you, and you were there....

tirfar_kabuki.ability: If you're mad you're a Townsfolk, you might become one. [+0 or +1 Outsider, most Outsiders are Kabuki]

tirfar_kipperer.ability: If you died today or tonight, 1 Minion becomes an unlisted character & you learn which.

tirfar_magpie.ability: If you are nominated, gain a fresh Outsider ability & keep it after death.

jinxes.reason: The Magpie gains & learns that they gain the Butler's ability the night after they would gain it.
The Magpie gains & learns that they gain the Zealot's ability the night after they would gain it. They lose the Zealot's ability on death.

tirfar_margrave.ability: If only Outsiders & Demons live, Demons turn good & alive Outsiders turn evil, even if you're dead.
tirfar_margrave.flavor: We all have our own reasons for wanting this foul Demon dead. My reason? Competition.

tirfar_nidhoggr.ability: The Demon may choose to register as dead or rise at any time. If you died today or tonight, you learn if they have a vote token.
tirfar_nidhoggr.flavor: There, Malice-Striker held corpses of the dead, the wolf-torn men. Do you still seek to know? And for what?

tirfar_oboist.ability: Either all learned numbers are increased by 1, or decreased by 1 (but not less than 0). When you die, this ability is inverted.

tirfar_orc.ability: You might be good or evil & don't know which until you stop being a living Orc, or it's the final night. [Some Outsiders are Orcs]
tirfar_orc.flavor: Looks like meat's back on the menu, boys!

tirfar_orienteer.ability: Each night, choose a unique alive player: if the Demon, Minions become Demons & you learn this.
tirfar_orienteer.flavor: We can't stop here, this is bat country!

tirfar_ostrich.ability: Players might not learn things they otherwise should.
tirfar_ostrich.flavor: Bad news? Lovely. I'll be in the sand until it all blows over.

tirfar_psychopomp.ability: Dead Minions keep their abilities, even if you're dead. Once per game, at night, guess all dead Minions: if correct, they lose them again.
tirfar_psychopomp.flavor: All things that are, are ours. But we must care. For if we do not care, we do not exist. If we do not exist, then there is nothing but blind oblivion. And even oblivion must end someday. Lord, will you grant me just a little time? For the proper balance of things. To return what was given. For the sake of prisoners and the flight of birds. Lord, what can the harvest hope for, if not for the care of the reaper man?

tirfar_quaaltagh.ability: If you draw this token, you may redraw, but learn false info once. Townsfolk become leftover evil characters. [+1 Townsfolk in the bag]
tirfar_quaaltagh.firstNightReminder: Distribute tokens but don't send them out. Find the player with the Quaaltagh token, ask them if they want to redraw. If they do, mark them with the 'FIRSTFOOT' reminder. Randomly choose a character distributed after the Quaaltagh, and make the marked player them. Then, inform the player who had the token the 'FIRSTFOOT' marked player is now that they drew the Quaaltagh token, and repeat. Then send out tokens. If there is 1 fewer evil at the end, 1 townsfolk becomes it.
tirfar_quaaltagh.otherNightReminder: You may chose to make any players marked "FIRSTFOOT" learn false info, and remove their reminder token.
tirfar_quaaltagh.flavor: Blein Vie Noa! Slaynt vie, bea veayn, beeal fliugh as baase ayns Mannin!

tirfar_sabredancer.ability: Each night, become the alignment of the player you nominated today: if they are the Demon, you are drunk instead.
tirfar_sabredancer.flavor: I can dance the Csárdás, I can dance the Căluș, but the Sabbath of Sulphur? No-one can dance the Sabbath of Sulphur!

tirfar_scullerymaid.ability: The Demon has a not-in-play Minion ability, even if you die. You both know which.
tirfar_scullerymaid.firstNightReminder: Tell the Scullery Maid what ability the Demon has. Tell the Demon the ability too.
tirfar_scullerymaid.flavor: I do apologise, I only left the back door open. I never thought anything would come in and stay....

tirfar_shrew.ability: The 1st dawn you're dead, publicly choose 1 alive player: if they are not executed today, your team loses at dusk.
tirfar_shrew.flavor: And that's what she is, the Queen of Refuse! So bow down to her if you want, bow to her! Bow to the Queen of Slime, the Queen of Filth, the Queen of Putrescence! Boo! Boo! Rubbish! Filth! Slime! Muck! Boo! Boo! Boo!

tirfar_spacefarer.ability: If another ally nominates & executes the Demon, your team loses. When you learn that you died, choose a living player to gain this ability.
tirfar_spacefarer.flavor: I got your distress call and came as quickly as I wanted to!

tirfar_tsarevna.ability: Players who are mad you aren't the Tsarevna might be executed.

tirfar_unicorn.ability: Minions start knowing an improbable condition & you know a clue to it. If it happens (once), you're executed, even if dead.
tirfar_unicorn.firstNightReminder: Tell the Minions the condition. Tell the Unicorn a clue.
tirfar_unicorn.flavor: You may have been young and foolish then, but you're old and foolish now! See clear! Don't let the glamour get you! See what's in front of your eyes! It's a damn great horse with a horn on the end!

tirfar_vagrant.ability: You're only in play if you shouldn't be, & vice versa. [+1 or -1 Outsider]
tirfar_vagrant.flavor: If every hope abandons you, there's peace in that, you know? And when you hit rock bottom, there's only one way left to go.

tirfar_vanguard.ability: You know who the Demon is. [Outsiders are secretly evil. Demons & Minions are secretly good. +? Outsiders]
tirfar_vanguard.flavor: If the landslide is big enough, even square pebbles will roll.

tirfar_vigilante.ability: Players who are mad you're evil might die at night.
tirfar_vigilante.otherNightReminder: If someone was "mad" the Vigilante was evil, they might die at night.
tirfar_vigilante.flavor: Villains are everywhere, that's how I know that I'm the hero!

tirfar_whiteelephant.ability: Once per game, at night, the Demon chooses who you are. If you died today, they may choose another tonight. [You don't start in play]
tirfar_whiteelephant.firstNightReminder: Wake the Demon, show the white elephant token, then ask if they wish to use the ability. If so, get them to choose a player, then change that player into the White Elephant.
tirfar_whiteelephant.otherNightReminder: Wake the Demon, show the white elephant token, then ask if they wish to use the ability. If so, get them to choose a player, then change that player into the White Elephant.
tirfar_whiteelephant.flavor: I bequeath thee with my finest elephant. Sure, it is loud, always hungry, and smells worse than a drunkard’s bile. But think of how jealous your friends will be!

tirfar_yeoman.ability: If there's only 1 Yeoman in play, 1 Townsfolk is drunk. Otherwise, 1 Outsider is. [+0 or +1 Yeoman]
tirfar_yeoman.flavor: Hey, hey, stop me if you've hic heard this one before "There once was a man from Nantucket...

tirfar_alpha.ability: You know who the Lycanthropes are & who they choose at night: you choose which choices die. There is only 1 faux paw. [+? Lycanthropes]
tirfar_alpha.flavor: Throw me to the wolves, and I'll come back pregnant.

tirfar_anoia.ability: Players with blank tokens redraw (if no good do, change character), but follow your rule or might be executed. [1 extra Blank Token]
tirfar_anoia.flavor: Sooner or later, every curse is a prayer.

tirfar_basilisk.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a signal: players who see it tonight die, even if you do.

tirfar_buggane.ability: If a living Outsider is nominated & you claim to be the Buggane, their team loses if they are not executed. [+1 Outsider]

jinxes.reason: Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.

tirfar_bureau.ability: At any time, you may declare that evil is losing: if the Storyteller agrees, they become the Demon & the Demon becomes a Bureau.
tirfar_bureau.flavor: Your performance has been noted. Your replacement will be less merciful.

tirfar_cambium.ability: The 1st Minion to die (even you) becomes a Minion character of your choice, then keeps their ability.

jinxes.reason: If the Vigormortis kills a Minion, activating the Cambium's ability, the Cambium may choose to use their ability on the next Minion to die instead.

tirfar_cambium.flavor: If all the mountains were of silver and gold, what would they profit a man who lives in constant fear of death? Hence, there cannot be in the whole world anything better than our Medicine, which has power to heal all the diseases of the flesh.

tirfar_carpenter.ability: If you die by execution, your nominator becomes a not-in-play evil Minion tonight.

tirfar_chameleon.ability: You start knowing 1 in-play good character & they know a Chameleon is in play: your ability is based on theirs.
tirfar_chameleon.firstNightReminder: Inform the Chameleon what character their ability is based on, and what it is. Wake the good player
tirfar_chameleon.flavor: Loving would be easy if your colours were like my dreams: Red, gold and green, red, gold and green

tirfar_charlatan.ability: Each night, choose 2 players: their info is nonsensical until dusk.
tirfar_charlatan.firstNightReminder: Wake & have the Charlatan choose 2 players; Mark those players with the 'Conned' reminder. Until dusk, give both of those players nonsensical information
tirfar_charlatan.otherNightReminder: Wake & have the Charlatan choose 2 players; Mark those players with the 'Conned' reminder. Until dusk, give both of those players nonsensical information
tirfar_charlatan.flavor: Left cup, centre cup, right cup... Right cup, centre cup, left cup... Left cup, centre cup, no cup... You follow?

tirfar_clairvoyante.ability: You start knowing a Grimoire &, even if you die, your team wins if it becomes real. The 1st time something goes wrong, it doesn't.
tirfar_clairvoyante.flavor: A prophecy that can be thwarted by any common farmer is undeserving of the name. But darling, you’ll find your fate will not be forsaken so easily

tirfar_colour.ability: Only you know your ability. Outsiders know you're in play & may guess it each day: they learn how close they are. [+1 Outsider]
tirfar_colour.firstNightReminder: Show the Colour their ability. Do whatever needs to be done to satisfy the Colour's ability.
tirfar_colour.otherNightReminder: Do whatever needs to be done to satisfy the Colour's ability.
tirfar_colour.flavor: ...not quite mustard, not quite plum, not quite red, not quite green, not quite white, not quite blue...

tirfar_decimus.ability: Each night, you may choose that a random player (not the Demon) dies.

tirfar_dullahan.ability: Each night, you may choose a player: all players learn their character. Tomorrow night, they die.
tirfar_dullahan.flavor: Where paths end and names are forgotten, the rider still knows the way. What loses its head loses its mercy, and what hears the hooves too late is already counted among the dead.

tirfar_fraudster.ability: If all dead good players have their vote token on the final day, your team wins.
tirfar_fraudster.flavor: Trust me, your money's not safe in their hands. The system is rigged, the banks are bleeding you dry- cash out now before they lock the doors and leave you with nothing.

tirfar_goatherd.ability: Players who raise their hand at night turn evil. Then, if most players are evil, followers turn good & your team wins.
tirfar_goatherd.firstNightReminder: Announce that the goatherd calls for followers, whether the goatherd is in play or not.
tirfar_goatherd.otherNightReminder: Announce that the goatherd calls for followers, whether the goatherd is in play or not.
tirfar_goatherd.flavor: For sheep are stupid, and have to be driven; but goats are intelligent, and need to be led.

tirfar_governess.ability: Each day, if a player is nominated, you may publicly forbid that nomination: unless they were evil, you can't die until dusk.
tirfar_governess.flavor: Just because they're a vile, man-eating monster doesn't mean being polite goes out the window. Righteousness is no substitute for good manners.

tirfar_jarl.ability: Outsiders are drunk, even if you die at night. [+3 Outsiders]
tirfar_jarl.flavor: We're tearing up this place tonight- Literally.

tirfar_luddite.ability: Each night, you may choose a player: their ability becomes slightly worse until you die, & they learn this.
tirfar_luddite.flavor: You better back down, or there'll be another accident involving me, the toaster, the waste disposal, and this fourteen pound lump-hammer.

tirfar_maw.ability: Until just 5 players live, you steal the characters of killed executees. They get them back when you die.
tirfar_maw.flavor: What would one taste, mh, take..?

tirfar_mawmett.ability: Each day, you may visit the Storyteller & offer something: the Storyteller offers something in return.

tirfar_moreau.ability: You know X. [You choose which players are which Outsiders. Up to X Outsiders]
tirfar_moreau.firstNightReminder: Wake the Moreau to choose which players are which outsiders
tirfar_moreau.flavor: An animal may be ferocious and cunning enough, but it takes a real man to tell a lie

tirfar_operative.ability: Players who are mad they learned info about you might be poisoned.
tirfar_operative.flavor: Deep in the desert in '47, I was there. Remember Roswell? No? You can thank me later.

tirfar_perkeo.ability: If the Demon kills you at night & the next player to be executed is evil, your team wins.
tirfar_perkeo.flavor: Let's play a game: It's called watching me play the fool. I know you like to play- in fact I think you're making up the rules.

tirfar_playwright.ability: You start knowing another script. Each night, choose which script is being played but keep this ability.
tirfar_playwright.flavor: Destiny is funny stuff, you know? You can't trust it. Often you can't even see it. Just when you think you have it cornered it turns out to be something else- coincidence, maybe, or providence. You bar the door against it, and it's standing behind you. Then, just when you think you have it nailed down, it walks away with the hammer.

tirfar_ronin.ability: You are a Traveller too. If you are exiled, your team wins. [You discussed this before setup, -? to +? Outsiders]
tirfar_ronin.flavor: I used to be a sellsword, but I took the name too literally. I lost a lot of fights after that.

tirfar_samedi.ability: The 1st time you die, you live but register as dead. Living votes don't count & a majority isn't required. Vote tokens aren't spent.
tirfar_samedi.flavor: In the silence came the drumming, making the music that had gone before seem as insignificant as the cluttering of crickets. This was the real blood music; all other music that had ever been written was merely a pitiful attempt to sing along.

tirfar_scion.ability: Outsiders may visit the Storyteller to become drunk, even if you're dead. If all do, choose a Demon to become. [1 to +? Outsiders]
tirfar_scion.flavor: They say the night is darkest before the dawn. What they don't tell you is which star rises first. Follow it, and you'll learn why they once called it by another name.

tirfar_scorpion.ability: If you die by execution, all players learn that the next living executee's team loses.
tirfar_scorpion.flavor: Сказала лягушка скорпиону: "Но теперь мы оба наверняка утонем." Сказал скорпион лягушке: "Лол, Лмао.

tirfar_spindoctor.ability: You are the Bounty Hunter's 1st target. If they're mad you're evil, they're poisoned, even if you're dead. [+the Bounty Hunter]
tirfar_spindoctor.flavor: Rumour is information distilled so finely that it can filter through anything. It does not need doors and windows - sometimes it does not need people.

tirfar_valetdechambre.ability: Each night, choose any number of players: if they would choose players tonight, they choose characters instead, & vice versa.
tirfar_valetdechambre.flavor: I understand your choice completely, sir, it's only that I'd do it differently. Here, hand me the reins, and I can show you the limits of your power.

tirfar_watcher.ability: Each night, you may choose a player: if they do not nominate & execute a player tomorrow, or are mad they must, they die that night.
tirfar_watcher.flavor: DO YOU TAKE US AS A JOKE? YOU HAD ONLY ONE RULE, AND YOU MADE A MOCKERY OF IT. THIS WILL NOT GO UNPUNISHED.

tirfar_yadaljawza.ability: From the 3rd time a player is named, any players who do so might be executed.
tirfar_yadaljawza.flavor:
Najam, najam, najam, far. 
What are we but wounds and scars?
Blinding vision, I can't cry.
Ghost of brilliance, yet to die.

tirfar_adipocere.ability: Good wins if (& only if) you're executed on day 6, even if dead. If you're dead on night 6, 1 good player learns this.

jinxes.reason: The Adipocere can't prevent the good team from winning due to the Cult Leader.
The Adipocere can't prevent the good team from winning due to the Alsaahir.

tirfar_adipocere.flavor: Seven hundred winged creatures waiting in line. Sixty-seven eyes are focused watching them dine. Seven of the brethren are turning their heads. This is how the village people bury their dead.

tirfar_architeuthis.ability: All other players think a Demon that wins after X days is in play: evil wins 1 day sooner than that.

tirfar_artimort.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die at dawn.
tirfar_artimort.flavor: This whole time I've been playing chess, while you've all been playing chess... like idiots.

tirfar_automata.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. On the final day, if any Minions live, good wins. [+1 Minion]
tirfar_automata.flavor: Twenty-eight teeth interlocked, intertwined. Bismuth and bronze, beryl and brass. Twenty-eight teeth interlocked, intertwined.

tirfar_behemoth.ability: Each night, choose 2 players: 1 dies. If they're different character types, both do. [-1 or +1 Outsider]
tirfar_behemoth.flavor: A fire's hatred // For nothing is sacred // I will make them feel my pain.

tirfar_cacophony.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Outsiders nominated today might be executed. [+1 Outsider]

tirfar_calx.ability: If the Outsider lives, evil wins after day 3. Otherwise, choose 2 players each night: they die. [1 Outsider]
tirfar_calx.flavor: The heart of man can be a terrible thing. A vile blackness building up inside, begging to be freed.

tirfar_drascal.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. You have an unlisted Minion ability: on night 3, lose it, & 1 good player learns what it was.
tirfar_drascal.firstNightReminder: If the Drascal's Minion ability does something, rember!
tirfar_drascal.flavor: Power for me- but not for thee!

tirfar_eris.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. If you're executed before the final day (ending the game), both teams lose.
tirfar_eris.flavor: All affirmations are true in some sense, false in some sense, meaningless in some sense, true and false in some sense, true and meaningless in some sense, false and meaningless in some sense, and true and false and meaningless in some sense.

tirfar_falsehydra.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. The living can't communicate with the dead. When 3 players live, the dead choose 1 to speak with.
tirfar_falsehydra.flavor: They say that a man dies twice // First when he breathes his last // And second when his name is a distant past. // But come into my nest, seeking those who you lost; // and you, my prey, I shall then kill you twice.

tirfar_fawn.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. If a Minion died today, choose 3 instead.
tirfar_fawn.flavor: In the forest there lay an ominous sight; if you see a young deer, dare not ye approach it, for its mother lies waiting

tirfar_gourdo.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. The 1st time you're executed with less than a 75% majority, you live but register as dead.
tirfar_gourdo.otherNightReminder: Wake the Gourdo. They point to a player. That player dies.
tirfar_gourdo.flavor: Cut me open. Go on. There is more of me than you have blades for.

tirfar_hand.ability: Each night, a player might die. The dead are evil & lose if only 3 players live & no nominations occur. [No evil characters]
tirfar_hand.flavor: I don't wanna play this silly game, I wanna do it this way, I wanna do it exactly this way. It doesn't matter if you're a Townsfolk or an Outsider or a Minion or a Demon! You're all going down, none of these niceties, this is a death match for a reason.

tirfar_iscariot.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. On the final day, all players learn they may not talk & 1 good player chooses who is executed.
tirfar_iscariot.flavor: Don't let yourself slip; tossing in the dice starts with losing your grip.

tirfar_jabberwocky.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Bluffs are in-play characters. [Good characters are duplicates. +0 or +1 Outsider]
tirfar_jabberwocky.flavor: Ewe fought vis wood bee eigh Jabberwocky kwot, deedn't ewe?

tirfar_jouyll.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. "The Demon" is whoever you are mad it is: if it's no-one, it's you. You must have this ability.

jinxes.reason: If the Mastermind uses their ability, the Jouyll can't kill tonight.

tirfar_jouyll.flavor: Jesus cried inside the manger, but his tears were never once written about. And was he weeping Hallelujah? Or was he weeping for the sins he lived without?

tirfar_kalibre.ability: Players may choose to die. You start by choosing 2 good players: if 1 dies this way, all learn this. If both do, or day 3 ends, evil wins.
tirfar_kalibre.flavor: As with all things the world shall end. The final bullet shall leave thy chamber, and all things shall be reloaded. What died by fire shall rise by powder, and the game shall begin anew.

tirfar_kinginyellow.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. If you lose, players mad you are in play lose with you. [-1 Outsider]
tirfar_kinginyellow.flavor: Forget not Carcosa, where the black stars hang in the heavens; where the shadows of the thoughts of men grow long in the afternoon; where the twin suns go down into the Lake of Hali: and thy mind shall bear for ever the memory of the Pallid Mask.

tirfar_kohladder.ability: Each day, a player must be executed: their living neighbors die. If you'd die this way, instead live but register as dead.

tirfar_llythos.ability: If a player nominates & executes an opposing player, their team wins. After day 4, evil wins.
tirfar_llythos.flavor: I present to you an even playing field. But my, what a shovel can do.

tirfar_mirriedancer.ability: Players register as the character type above theirs (below if you added an Outsider). After day 4, evil wins. [-1 or +1 Outsider]

tirfar_moloch.ability: Each night, choose 2 players: they die. Each day, the 1st player to try to nominate instead dies.
tirfar_moloch.otherNightReminder: Wake the Moloch & prompt them to kill 2 players.

tirfar_myrkkymato.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die & poison 1 good neighbor until dusk.
tirfar_myrkkymato.otherNightReminder: Wake and have them choose a player: They die, & mark one of their good neighbors with the "poisoned" reminder.
tirfar_myrkkymato.flavor: Great holes secretly are digged where earth's pores ought to suffice, and things have learnt to walk that ought to crawl.

tirfar_olalla.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Outsiders you kill keep their ability & poison 1 Townsfolk neighbor. [+1 Outsider]
tirfar_olalla.flavor: We are all such as He. There is in all of us—ay, even in me—a sparkle of the divine. Like Him, we must endure for a little while, until morning returns bringing peace

tirfar_premotira.ability: Each dusk, if most players raise their hand & a Minion was executed today, or most don't & you were, evil wins. After day 5, evil wins.
tirfar_premotira.flavor: Odd thing, ain't it... you meet people one at a time, they seem decent, they got brains that work, and then they get together and you hear the voice of the people. And it snarls.

tirfar_stauhuld.ability: Each night, choose 3 players: they might die before dusk.
tirfar_stauhuld.flavor: Will no-one rid me of these troublesome Townsfolk?

tirfar_stowawry.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. 1 good player knows the unlisted Minion is 1 of 2 players. [A Minion has an unlisted Minion character]
tirfar_stowawry.flavor: What's in these boxes? Uhhh... not Minions?

tirfar_temptation.ability: Each night, choose 2 players: they die. Good players who cover their eyes instead of waking can't die tonight.
tirfar_temptation.otherNightReminder: Find out which players wish to cover their eyes- mark all good players here as SAFE. Do not wake these players. When a player does wake, inform them of all players with their eyes covered, including evil ones. Then, wake the Temptation, and get them to choose 2 players. Mark those 2 players as DEAD.
tirfar_temptation.flavor: There is a charm about the forbidden that makes it unspeakably desirable.

tirfar_whakaata.ability: Your team loses if you're dead. You don't learn Minions. After day 3, evil wins. [+1 Good Whakaata]
tirfar_whakaata.flavor: You better start believing in demons, pākehā-- you ARE one!

tirfar_chorus.ability: You're evil. You can't vote or nominate. [You don't enter alone]

tirfar_comptroller.ability: At any time during the day, you may rearrange the Grimoire without looking.
tirfar_comptroller.flavor: Of course I'm on top of my paperwork! I have a Clean Desk policy. It's a Clean Floor strategy that's eluding me at the moment...

tirfar_concessionist.ability: Each night, choose an alive player: if they agree, you choose if they are 1) poisoned until dusk, or 2) cannot die until dawn.

tirfar_curator.ability: Only you know what your object does. Only other players may use it.

tirfar_hitchhiker.ability: Each dawn, publicly choose a new place to sit. Your alive neighbors can't die at night, if they're your alignment.
tirfar_hitchhiker.flavor: Life is like a grapefruit. Well, it's sort of orangey-yellow and dimpled on the outside, wet and squidgy in the middle. It's got pips inside, too. Oh, and some people have half a one for breakfast.

tirfar_minister.ability: Dead players may nominate & vote as if alive for 1 day after dying.

tirfar_sexton.ability: Each night, learn who died: they register as alive during the day. Tomorrow, you may choose 1 & learn a fact about them.
tirfar_sexton.flavor: Don't ever laugh as a hearse goes by, for you may be the next to die. And when Death brings her cold despair, ask yourself, "Will anyone care?

tirfar_apocrypha.ability: Once per game, at night, deaths are arbitrary.
tirfar_apocrypha.flavor: They understood that there was something older than wisdom, and it was fire, and something truer than words, and it was ashes.

tirfar_armaments.ability: If there are more evil players than expected, executions fail if only evil voted.
tirfar_armaments.flavor: And Saint Attila raised the hand grenade up on high, saying, "O Lord, bless this Thy hand grenade that with it Thou mayest blow Thine enemies to tiny bits, in Thy mercy." And the Lord did grin and the people did feast upon the lambs and sloths and carp and anchovies and orangutans and breakfast cereals, and fruit bats and large trout

tirfar_devouringbag.ability: The Storyteller might ignore setup abilities.

tirfar_ladyofsorrows.ability: If an evil player would lose the game with their choice, they might have no effect.
tirfar_ladyofsorrows.flavor: And thus the angel said unto Jacob "Stop hitting thyself, stop hitting thyself" but lo he could not, for the Angel was hitting him with his own hands.

tirfar_mixologist.ability: Drunk or poisoned players cannot learn true info.
tirfar_mixologist.flavor: One tequila, two tequila, three tequila, floor!

tirfar_rumrunner.ability: Each night, Demons may choose to become drunk until 1) dawn or 2) dusk.

tirfar_zeitgeist.ability: If there are fewer than 7 players, some characters cannot be in play. All players know which.
tirfar_zeitgeist.flavor: It's just another sign of the times, Mrs Jones, it's just another sign of the times.

tirfar_bageler.ability: The Circle is now the Torus.
tirfar_bageler.flavor: x = (R + rcos(φ))cos(θ), y = (R + rcos(φ))sin(θ), & z = rsin(φ), where 0 ≤ θ < 2π and 0 ≤ φ < 2π. Want cream cheese with that?

tirfar_ceo.ability: Players register as alive during the day (not to this) if both their neighbors live.
tirfar_ceo.flavor: Tell you what, you can have the weekend off. Treat yourself.

tirfar_dragon.ability: Townsfolk might become leftover characters. [+? Tokens in the bag]
tirfar_dragon.flavor: My armour is like tenfold shields, my teeth are swords, my claws spears, the shock of my tail a thunderbolt, my wings a hurricane, and my breath death!

tirfar_gotterdammerung.ability: Someone must die by execution each day. Someone must die each night.
tirfar_gotterdammerung.flavor: The mountains were ancient before the first word was spoken, and they shall outlast the last. Yet even the mountains know, in the deep language of stone, that there is an ending written for them. There is an ending written for all things.

tirfar_littlegirl.ability: Instead of tokens, players draw small relevant objects.
tirfar_littlegirl.flavor: I'm sorry Mrs. Dolly, we're all out of pretend cake, but I do have some pretend biscuits you can have with your imaginary tea.

tirfar_parasomnia.ability: Players might wake at any time (or not at all). Days might end early.
tirfar_parasomnia.flavor: Sleep gently if you must, for I walk where clocks lose their courage and dreams forget their endings. I am the hush between breaths; the place where even morning hesitates.

tirfar_speaker.ability: While voting, players vote yes & no with their thumb up or down. Total votes are proportional to the number of alive voters.
tirfar_speaker.flavor: The occupational hazards are the three As: arrogance, alcoholism, and adultery. If you suffer from only one, it's thought you're doing quite well.

tirfar_waitress.ability: Before the game begins, all players vote for some setup choices.
tirfar_waitress.flavor: Hey Jimmy! Get me a script with nuthin!

tirfar_xanadu.ability: The Storyteller announces an unlisted character that might be in play: evils learn if it is.
tirfar_xanadu.flavor: Like many people who appear to have everything, his life has been tinged with tragedy. Well, actually it hasn't, but we can only hope

potato_actorthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Each night, learn the character the Storyteller thinks it would be most beneficial for you to be mad about today
potato_actorthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Wake the Actor. Show them the character you think they would most benefit from being 'mad' about.
potato_actorthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: Wake the Actor. Show them the character you think they would most benefit from being 'mad' about.
potato_actorthepotatopatchpart1.flavor:
To be, or not to be, that begs the question:
Whether it's nobblier in the mind to suffer
The arrows and slings of outrageous fortune,
Or to take arms against an ocean of troubles
And end them. To die—to sleep,
No more; and by sleep, I say we end
The heart atack and the thousand electric shocks
That flesh's hair to: it's a constallation
Devoutly to be wicked. To diet, to sleep;
To sleep, purchase the dream—hey, there's the rub:
For in that sleet of dreams what death may come,
When we have shuffled off this portal coil,
Must give us pause—————————
That makes calamari of so long life.

potato_archerthepotatopatchpart1.ability: You start knowing how many Minions are between you and the Demon, going clockwise.
potato_archerthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Wake the Archer. Show them a number on your fingers equal to the number of minions between them and the demon, starting with the player to their left.
potato_archerthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: I can hit the apple off a man's head from fifty paces away! Usually because I hit the man and the apple falls down with him.

potato_architectthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a Demon and a Minion. In play chosen characters become different characters of the same type.
potato_architectthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Wake the Architect. If they wish to use their ability, let them choose a minion and a demon. If either are in play, they change character to a new character (of your choosing) of the same type.
potato_architectthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: Wake the Architect. If they wish to use their ability (and haven't done so already), let them choose a minion and a demon. If either are in play, they change character to a new character (of your choosing) of the same type.
potato_architectthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: That wall's a foot too short. One bad storm and the whole east side'll come crashing down. Not a hard fix, neither. But do they ever ask me what I think? No.

potato_aviatorthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Each night, if a player died by execution today, learn a player of different character type to them.
potato_aviatorthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: If a player died by execution today, wake the Aviator. Show them a player whose character type is not the same as that player.

potato_barristerthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Each night learn how many evil players nominated yesterday. You cannot learn a 0.
potato_barristerthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: Wake the Barriter. For every 'Nominated' reminder token on the grimoire, show that number to the Barrister. If there are no tokens, show any number greater than 0. Remove all of the 'Nominated' reminder tokens.
potato_barristerthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: Chaos! Chaos in the court! Oh wait, hang on, not that, the other thing.

potato_bookbinderthepotatopatchpart1.ability: You start knowing a not-in-play Townsfolk. While you are "mad" that you are that character, you cannot die.
potato_bookbinderthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Wake the Bookbinder. Show them a good character that isn't in play. Send them back to sleep.
potato_bookbinderthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: You can learn almost anything from a book. Except how to read.

potato_brokerthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Once per game, at night, choose to make the Demon and a good player drunk until dusk.
potato_brokerthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: Wake the Broker. They either shake their head no or nod their head yes. If they said yes, choose a good player. Place a 'Drunk' reminder token next to them, and the demon. Both are drunk.
potato_brokerthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: I’m doubling down on high-yield convertible derivatives post-Fed pivot while we short the overleveraged small-caps riding the dead cat bounce—this is a classic bull trap in a quantitative easing echo chamber, baby!

potato_candlemakerthepotatopatchpart1.ability: On your first night, choose 3 characters. If you die at night, learn if any of them killed you.
potato_candlemakerthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Wake the Candlemaker. They choose three characters. Mark all in play characters with 'Illuminated'.
potato_candlemakerthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: If the Candlemaker died tonight and the character who caused their dead has an 'Iluminated' reminder token on them, wake the Candlemaker, Show them that character.
potato_candlemakerthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: Most people keep their bees for the honey. But I think it's a shame not to take full advantage of the situations when presented with them.

potato_charburnerthepotatopatchpart1.ability: The Demon doesn’t know who their Minions are.
potato_charburnerthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: There's a poetry in it. Burn wood with no thought to it, and it turn to ash. But under the right conditions it bcomes an even greater source of fuel.

potato_cheesemongerthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Each Night, Choose a player. Chosen Minions learn that they are chosen and if executed today, their team loses
potato_cheesemongerthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Wake the Cheesemonger. They choose a player. If they choose a minion, mark that player with the 'Cheesed Off' reminder token. Wake that minion. how them the 'This Character Selected You' info token, and the Cheesemonger character token.
potato_cheesemongerthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: Wake the Cheesemonger. They choose a player. If they choose a minion, mark that player with the 'Cheesed Off' reminder token. Wake that minion. how them the 'This Character Selected You' info token, and the Cheesemonger character token.

potato_chimneysweepthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Each night, choose a player. Learn a Minion and Demon they aren’t.
potato_chimneysweepthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Wake the Chimneysweep. They chooe a player. Show them a minion character and a demon character. Neither can be the character of the player they chose.
potato_chimneysweepthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: Wake the Chimneysweep. They chooe a player. Show them a minion character and a demon character. Neither can be the character of the player they chose.
potato_chimneysweepthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: Oy fank yew Gov'na! I ain't never seen so shiny a farvin' since me ma and pa gave me an allowance for me 'levenf birfday! I'll be spendin' it own sugar plumbs and licroish, I will!

potato_cobbler1thepotatopatchpart1.ability: If you die at night, choose a player (not yourself). Learn 2 other players. The first is on their team and the second isn't.
potato_cobbler1thepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: If the Cobbler died tonight, wake the Cobbler, they choose a player besides yourself. Show them two more players. The first must be on their team, the second isn't.
potato_cobbler1thepotatopatchpart1.flavor:
Slice apples, toss with sugar, cinnamon, lemon juice.
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀
Pour into greased baking dish.
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀
Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, milk, and melted butter into a thick batter.
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀
Spread over apples.
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀
Bake at ~180°C until golden and bubbly (~45 min).
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀
Serve warm. Ice cream optional, but recommended.

potato_connoisseurthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Each night choose to make exactly one player drunk or poisoned.
potato_connoisseurthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Wake the Connoisseur. Let them choose if they want to activate their ability. If they do, and there are too many players drunk or poisoned, flip all but one token. If there are none, choose a player, mark them with the Conniseur's 'Drunk' reminder tokn: they are drunk.
potato_connoisseurthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: Wake the Connoisseur. Let them choose if they want to activate their ability. If they do, and there are too many players drunk or poisoned, flip all but one token. If there are none, choose a player, mark them with the Conniseur's 'Drunk' reminder tokn: they are drunk.
potato_connoisseurthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: I enjoy the little things in life. And the big things. Turns out, if you look hard enough, there's a lot here to love.

potato_cooperthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Each night, choose a living player (not yourself), guess their alignment. Learn a player, on their team if correct.
potato_cooperthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Wake the Cooper. They choose a player besides themself, and guess an alignment, thumbs up for good, thumbs down for evil. If they are correct, point them at a player who is on the same team as the player they chose. Otherwise point them at any player.
potato_cooperthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: Wake the Cooper. They choose a player besides themself, and guess an alignment, thumbs up for good, thumbs down for evil. If they are correct, point them at a player who is on the same team as the player they chose. Otherwise point them at any player.
potato_cooperthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: Everyone likes the bartender, everyone likes the brewer, no one spares a thought for the Cooper.

potato_coronerthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Each Night choose a player. If they died tonight, learn 2 characters, one of which caused it
potato_coronerthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: Wake the Coroner. They choose a player. If that player died tonight, show them two characters, one of which caued it.
potato_coronerthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: I could never work at a morgue, I'm too hungry.

potato_cowboythepotatopatchpart1.ability: Once per game, choose to kill your nominee. If you do so, good only wins if all evil players are dead, even if you are executed.

potato_crossexaminerthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Each night learn how many nominations were between different alignments.
potato_crossexaminerthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: Wake the Cross-Examiner. Show them a number on your hands for each 'Crossed' reminder token on your grimoire. Remove all 'Crossed' reminder tokens.
potato_crossexaminerthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: Erm, akchually, according to the testimony of our witness, you couldn't've been in the bank at 4:55. Quite the contradiction, don't you think?

potato_crusaderthepotatopatchpart1.ability: If you die at night, you may choose a Minion to die. If not in play, a good player might die.
potato_crusaderthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: If the Crusader died tonight, wake them. They may choose a minion. If that minion is in play, they die. Otherwise, you may choose a good player, they die.
potato_crusaderthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: We will take back the promised lands from the heathens who have corrupted it! Who promised it to us? I don't know! What did the heathens do to deserve this? I don't remember! Look, do you want to keep asking questions or do you want to chop up heretics?

potato_directorthepotatopatchpart1.ability: If just 3 players live, and a Minion is executed, your team wins, even if you are dead. The Demon knows you are in play
potato_directorthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Wake the Demon. Show them the 'This Character Selected You' info token, and the Director character token.
potato_directorthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: Amazing! Perfect! It was exactly what we need! But just to be sure let's do it again another twenty or thirty times.

potato_druidthepotatopatchpart1.ability: You start knowing how many Minion/Outsider pairs there are. [Minimum 1 Outsider]
potato_druidthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Wake the Druid; show them a number on your fingers equal to the number of minion/outsider pairs there are.
potato_druidthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: You'd be surprised what you can learn when you sit down and listen to nature.

potato_eremitethepotatopatchpart1.ability: Once per game, the Storyteller will warn you of something to come.
potato_eremitethepotatopatchpart1.flavor: Toothy Sharks will devour the town! Councilor Thornwell has a portal to hell in her tower! The Hag in the Dreadwood has sent impish spies! And the Necromancer in the Keelboat is at the center of it all!

potato_forecasterthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Once per game, privately visit the Storyteller to name an event. Learn how likely it is to occur.
potato_forecasterthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: They used to use bones, and bird's entrails. Now they use barometers and satellites. But to me, it's all the same. The more you try and set the future in stone, the more twisted it becomes. Best to just let hat happens happen, before you get tied up in knots.

potato_forseerthepotatopatchpart1.ability: You know when you will die.
potato_forseerthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Wake the Forseer. Show them a number. Mark them with the relevant numbered reminder token.
potato_forseerthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: If this night's number is the same as the Forseer's number, the Forseer might die.
potato_forseerthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: I'm a lion-taming knife-juggling, skydiving firefighter. And why not? It won't be the death of me.

potato_graverobberthepotatopatchpart1.ability: You cannot die while exactly 1 evil player is dead
potato_graverobberthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: You might think it's a bit reprehensible that I steal from the dead, but you should know, non of them have complained thus far.

potato_groundskeeperthepotatopatchpart1.ability: [The Grimoire is arranged according to a pattern, +The Gardener]
potato_groundskeeperthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: Eyy Orp! Mahnd the graass wou'd'n yer! I'v'n jus' plaanter'd that this mornan'!

potato_heiressthepotatopatchpart1.ability: If you die at night, choose 2 players (not yourself), learn 1 more. If possible, exactly one of the 3 is evil.
potato_heiressthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: If the Heiress died tonight, they chooe two players who aren't themself. If you can, choose a third person so that exactly one player among them is evil. Otherise, show them any player.
potato_heiressthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: Oh my! One such as myself would never stoop to an activity so depraved! Certainly not at 2am last Thursday night while it was raining!

potato_horsethepotatopatchpart1.ability: Each night, choose a player. A chosen Demon swaps characters with a living unchosen Minion, if possible
potato_horsethepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Wake the Horse. They choose a player. If they are a minion, mark that player with 'Stable'. If that player is a demon, they swap characters with a minion, and are then markd with 'Stable'.
potato_horsethepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: Wake the Horse. They choose a player. If they are a minion, mark that player with 'Stable'. If that player is a demon, they swap characters with a minion that does not have a 'Stable' reminder token, and are then marked with 'Stable'. If there is no such minion, nothing happens.
potato_horsethepotatopatchpart1.flavor:
In almost any concievable theater of operations, the presence of horse calvalry... will be of vital significance" - George S Patton
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀
"Horses were never wrong. They did what they did for a reason, and it was up to you to figure it out." - Janette Walls
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀
"There is something about the outside of a horse that is good for the inside of a man." - Winston Churchil
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀
"A horse is a projection of peoples' dreams about themselves - strong, powerful, beautiful - and it has the capability of giving us esscape from our mundane existence." - Jaden Smith

potato_illisionistthepotatopatchpart1.ability: [The Demon believes themself to be a different Demon]
potato_illisionistthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: Percieving is seeing. Seeing is believing. And believing is reality, when you consider: how can we know something is wrong if all our observations point to the contrary? If you can't see it, smell it, hear it or touch it, was it every really there at all? Oh? You think it was? Well why don't you prove it.

potato_kirinthepotatopatchpart1.ability: All Minions and Demons know you are in play. Each night, you might learn an evil player “mad” about learning information that is true.
potato_kirinthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Wake each minion and demon in turn. Show them the 'This Character Has Selected You', and the Kirin's Character Token.
potato_kirinthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: If you believe an evil player has been 'Mad' about larning information that is true, wake the Kirin. Point at that evil player.
potato_kirinthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: The way the light shimmers off everything, like, like it all suddenly woke up the moment you saw it. And you realize maybe the water and the mountains and the forest and the... yes, the rainbow and the stars and the sky are all looking back at you thinking the same thing? That we are a part of the everything. That maybe there's just one thing and we are all it.

potato_leprechaunthepotatopatchpart1.ability: A Minion knows you are in play. [The bluffs are in play, instead]
potato_leprechaunthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Wake a minion. Show them the 'This Character has Selected You' info token, and the Leprechaun's character token.
potato_leprechaunthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: UP THE IRISH!!! Mother Machree, Erin Go Bragh, Macnamarra's band, Lucille Ogle, Kathlen Norah Dely, Sean o'Casey and Albert Lebenthal! The wearin' o' the Green, sure an' begorra, Toora, loora, la. Did Your Mother Come from Ireland? It's a Long way to Tipperary! When Irish Eyes Are Smiling! King O'Murphy, King O'Toole, King O'Sullivan, King O'Risom!

potato_magisterthepotatopatchpart1.ability: You start knowing 2 numbers, one of which is the length of the longest line of consecutive good players.
potato_magisterthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Wake the Magister. Show them two numbers. At least one must be the length of the longest line of consecutive good players.
potato_magisterthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: A leader is the other party of a great transaction. The people sell their agency and freedoms, in exchange of leadership, order and security. But it require trust. Tyranny is thus, the greatest act of fraud that man can commit.

potato_matredthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Each night, choose 2 players. If neither are Townsfolk, one is drunk until dusk
potato_matredthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Wake the Maître d'. They choose two players. If neither are a townsfolk, one is drunk until dusk (your choice).
potato_matredthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: Wake the Maître d'. They choose two players. If neither are a townsfolk, one is drunk until dusk (your choice).
potato_matredthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: As you weesh, monsieur! I weel 'ave zat for you right away! Zut alors, I cannot wait for ze révolution...

potato_matadorthepotatopatchpart1.ability: The Demon can only choose living players at night
potato_matadorthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: La diferencia entre el hombre y la bestia es que la bestia se deja llevar por sus deseos, mientras que el hombre es tentado por ellos. Ceder a la tentación es borrar la línea que los separa.

potato_matchmakerthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Each night, choose a player. Learn a player they have something in common with.
potato_matchmakerthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Wake the Matchmaker. They will choose a player. Show them a player they have something in common with.
potato_matchmakerthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: Wake the Matchmaker. They will choose a player. Show them a player they have something in common with.
potato_matchmakerthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: I'm actually a matchbox salesman by trade. Playing cupid is just a hobby.

potato_mediumthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Once per game, at night, wake all dead evil players.
potato_mediumthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: Wake the Medium. Show them the "DO YOU WANT TO USE YOUR ABILITY?" Reminder Token. If they indicate no, send them back to sleep. If they indicate yes, wake all dead evil players. Let everyone see each other. Send all awake player back to sleep.
potato_mediumthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: Well. This is awkawrd, isn't it? Sorry for executing you lot. But I must say, you did sort of deserve it, or you wouldn't be here.

potato_mendicantthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Each night, learn 2 players. Both or neither are good, sober and healthy
potato_mendicantthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Wake the Mendicant. Show them two players. if one of them is good sober and healthy, the other one must also be good sober and healthy.
potato_mendicantthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: Wake the Mendicant. Show them two players. if one of them is good sober and healthy, the other one must also be good sober and healthy.
potato_mendicantthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: I do not wish to live in a world that is bereft of kindness, generosity and charity.

potato_musicianthepotatopatchpart1.ability: On the first night, choose a Townsfolk for each base Minion. Not in play characters are bluffs.
potato_musicianthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Wake the Musician. They choose a townsfolk for each base minion.
potato_musicianthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: My reed may taste like metal, but I don't stop playing. It's rare to find a nice thing to do that doesn't cost you something, but that is the price we have to pay for kindness.

potato_mycologistthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Each night, choose a player (not the same as last night): If opposing, they must be “mad” about something of the Storyteller’s choice or might be executed.
potato_mycologistthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Wake the Mycologist. They point at a player. If that player is not on the Mycologists' team, they are mad. Wake them, show them the 'This Character has Selected You' info token, and the Mycologists' character token, and then convey what they must be mad about using a phone, a piece of paper, or whatever means you see fit.
potato_mycologistthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: Wake the Mycologist. They point at a player who is not the same as the player they chose last night. If that player is not on the Mycologists' team, they are mad. Wake them, show them the 'This Character has Selected You' info token, and the Mycologists' character token, and then convey what they must be mad about using a phone, a piece of paper, or whatever means you see fit.
potato_mycologistthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: Aren't mushrooms fasinating? This one kills you, this one reveals untold secrets to you, and this one tastes great in a risotto. Try not to mess them up, I made that mistake before.

potato_paladinthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Each night, choose a player. If the Demon kills you, learn how many evil players you chose.
potato_paladinthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Wake the Paladin. They point to a player: mark that player with 'Sensed'.
potato_paladinthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: Wake the Paladin. If the Paladin is alive, they point to a player: mark that player with 'Sensed'. If they died tonight, show a number on your fingers equal to the number of 'Sensed' tokens on evil players.
potato_paladinthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: Spell slots? You mean Smite slots.

potato_palmreaderthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Each night, choose 3 players. Learn an evil character of a player chosen, a not in play character if all are good.
potato_palmreaderthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Wake the Palm Reader. They choose three players. Show them an evil character they chose. If all characters they chose are good, they learn a not in play character.
potato_palmreaderthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: Wake the Palm Reader. They choose three players. Show them an evil character they chose. If all characters they chose are good, they learn a not in play character.
potato_palmreaderthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: This line means you will live a long life. This line mans you will have a troubled love life. And this line means you need to be more careful handling sharp knives.

potato_pianistthepotatopatchpart1.ability: On your first day, ask a unique public question, answered by a number. Each night, learn a wrong number.
potato_pianistthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: Wake the Pianist. Show them a number that is not the correct anwer to their question.
potato_pianistthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: The don't call it the lowly piano, after all.

potato_pidgeonkeeperthepotatopatchpart1.ability: If you die via a normal execution, tonight, wake to learn how many evil players voted for and nominated for you.
potato_pidgeonkeeperthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: If the Pidgeonkeeper died via execution today: show on your hands the number of evil players that voted for them, plus one if their nominator was evil.
potato_pidgeonkeeperthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: You dare come inta' da home of da Pidgeon Messiah? Oh, you's made a big mistake dare, pal. Go! My grey angels! Avenge meeeee!!!

potato_potionsmasterthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Each Night, learn a player who is drunk, poisoned, a Minion or a Demon.
potato_potionsmasterthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Wake the Potions Master. Show them a player who is drunk, poisoned, a minion or a demon.
potato_potionsmasterthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: Wake the Potions Master. Show them a player who is drunk, poisoned, a minion or a demon.
potato_potionsmasterthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: Even if what you are saying were true, we'd never surrender to a creature like you!

potato_privateeyethepotatopatchpart1.ability: Each Night learn a character. Guess their player. If correct, a player who would die tonight, doesn’t.
potato_privateeyethepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: Mark a player with the 'Person of Interest' reminder token. Show the Private Eye that player. Let them guess their character. If they are correct, place the 'Protected' reminder token next to any player who was otherwise going to die tonight: they don't.
potato_privateeyethepotatopatchpart1.flavor: It was a grizzly morning. I was reading yesterday's paper, because I was too lazy to get today's from the letterbox. Not that I minded, I only got them for the word searches. But my hunt for 'Clues' and 'Leads' were interrupted when she walked in. She was like a tall glass of water, except she wasn't made of glass. She wore the kind of heels you'd wonder how she didn't stumble in, but I didn't, because I saw her stumble on her way in, and she was clearly hoping I hadn't. She was wearing a dress that might've been red, but this is a noir detective story, so there wasn't any colour. She had the kind of eyes that asked for trouble, and the kinda mouth that looked for it. Don't ask me what her ears were for. "My husband has gone missing. The Police are no help. I was wondering if you could be of assistance." she purred, like a cat that was trying to get you to feed it a second dinner. "Murder." I said plainly. She noded. "I expect so. He had a lot of enemies. And more secrets. But he left quite the inheritance..." she glanced around my office, which looked like it hadn't been finished by the decorators. It hadn't, of course, I ran outta money to pay them. "I can pay handsomely, mister". "Detectve." I said, absent mindedly. "Detective, then." she scowled, rolling her eyes. "Here" she said, sliding a crisp business card onto my desk. "Don't keep me waiting". I noded, sagely. "I'll take it". She smiled, showing me those too-white teeth for the first time, but not the last. She strutted out of there like a peacock that doesn't know what a lion is, but me? I hadn't taken a word she'd said in; I was still doing the crossword.

potato_prophetthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Each Night, choose an evil character. Learn which half of the town square they are in, arbitrarily if not in play
potato_prophetthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Wake the Prophet. They choose an evil character. Gesture to half of all players. If the character they chose is in play, they must be one of them.
potato_prophetthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: Wake the Prophet. They choose an evil character. Gesture to half of all players. If the character they chose is in play, they must be one of them.
potato_prophetthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: I have seen it in dreams. I have seen it in the beasts. A force darker than night will beset us. This I have been told. I can help to uproot this blight, but I cannot do it alone. None of us can. Our stength is in the majority. Remember. We outnumber them.

potato_quartermasterthepotatopatchpart1.ability: If you die at night, choose a living player. If the Demon, learn a Demon they aren’t. Otherwise, learn which Demon is in play.
potato_quartermasterthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: If the Quartermaster died tonight, wake them. They choose a player. If they chose the demon, show them a not-in-play demon. otherwise, show them the in-play demon's character token.
potato_quartermasterthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: Can we please stop executing! I have to fill out a form ever time we execute someone. Two if it's the demon.

potato_roguethepotatopatchpart1.ability: You start knowing an in-play Minion ability. If you die at night, learn a not-in-play Minion ability.
potato_roguethepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Wake the Rogue. Show them the token of a minion ability somone one has.
potato_roguethepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: If the Rogue died tonight, wake the Rogue. Show them the token of a minion ability no-one has.
potato_roguethepotatopatchpart1.flavor: ...so there I was, lock halfway picked, alarm bell ringing, the golem on it's way, when who should show up but the guild master! Turns out it was his mansion I was robbing!

potato_rustlerthepotatopatchpart1.ability: If you die at night, choose all players in order. Learn the character of the first evil player you chose
potato_rustlerthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: If the Rustler died tonight, wake them. They chooe all players. Remember the character of the first evil player they chose. They learn that character
potato_rustlerthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: How dare you Sherriff! Of course these are my cows. All the best ranchers take their cattle down Vulture Gulley in the dead of night, don't'cha know?

potato_skaldthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Each night learn how many times an evil player voted for an evil player yesterday.
potato_skaldthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: Wake the Skald. Show them a number on your fingers for every 'Voted' reminder token on the grimoire. Remove all 'Voted' reminder tokens.
potato_skaldthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: Fortíð vár er í sögum várum. Ef vér minnumst þeirra eigi, kunna þær eins vel aldregi at hafa orðit.

potato_sketchartistthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Each night, learn a player of different alignment to last night. Once per game, you are drunk until dusk.
potato_sketchartistthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Wake the Sketch Artist. Point them at any player. Mark that player with the 'Known' reminder token.
potato_sketchartistthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: Wake the Sketch Artist. You may make them Drunk. Point them at any player, if sober, they must differ in alignment to the previous player. Mark that player with the 'Known' reminder token.
potato_sketchartistthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: This is my rainbow pony OC. She has pink rainbow wings, diffrent coloured eyes, and she's the daughter of an angel. She's super cool, and everyone loves her and she's super smart and funny. Anyway, what's this about the guy who mugged you?

potato_smugglerthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Each night choose a living player. If evil, you cannot die by execution tomorrow.
potato_smugglerthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Wake the Smuggler. Let them choose a player. If tht player is evil: mark the Smuggler with the 'Safe' reminder token. Send the Smuggler back to Sleep.
potato_smugglerthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: Wake the Smuggler. Let them choose a player. If tht player is evil: mark the Smuggler with the 'Safe' reminder token. Send the Smuggler back to Sleep.
potato_smugglerthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: Officer? What? Noooooo! These aren't illegal fireworks... These are props! For the play! Now if you don't mind I'm in a hurry. I have to be in Ravenwood Bluff by new years.

potato_sorcererthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Each night, choose a unique player (not yourself), then learn if exactly one of tonight and last night's picks is a Townsfolk.
potato_sorcererthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Wake the Sorcerer, they point to a player that is neither themself nor chosen before.
potato_sorcererthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: Wake the Sorcerer, they point to a player that is neither themself nor chosen before., mark that player with 'Last Pick'. If the chosen player and the previously picked player are both or neither townsfolk, shake your head, otherwise, nod.
potato_sorcererthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: Wild magic can be a real pain sometimes. You don't know resent like being blown up by your own fireball.

potato_swordswallowerthepotatopatchpart1.ability: On your first day, publicly choose a character of each type. Tonight, learn how many are in play.
potato_swordswallowerthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: If the Sword Swallower made a guess yesterday, wake them. Show them a number on your fingers in accordance with how many in play characters they chose.
potato_swordswallowerthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: It's better with lemon juice and lime. Of course, I really should chew my food, or I'll choke. Now if you'll excuse me I should shut up; It's rude to talk when you're eating.

potato_tailorthepotatopatchpart1.ability: If an Outsider died tonight, learn who they are. [+1 Outsider]
potato_tailorthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: If an Outsider died tonight, wake the Tailor, show them the Outsider
