potato_tailorthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: Of all the worst things that could happen, this is the! Worst! Possible! Thing!

potato_talentscoutthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Each Night, learn who the Storyteller believes has been most helpful at getting their team to win.
potato_talentscoutthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: Wake the Talent Scout. Show them the player you believe has been most helpful at getting their team to win.
potato_talentscoutthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: Hot Dog! Now that kid's got skill! But he's got a face only a mother could love. I guess I'll keep looking...

potato_therapistthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Once per game, during the day, privately ask the Storyteller any subjective question
potato_therapistthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: My patients are the worst! One guy keeps telling me about voices in his head, someone else goes on and on about how much they like burning things, the worst one was this fellow who kept insisting I was violating client confidentialiy, whatever that is. Buch'a loonies, if you ask me.

potato_timekeeperthepotatopatchpart1.ability: You start knowing how likely the Storyteller thinks the game is to end with exactly 2 players alive.
potato_timekeeperthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: Quartz decays and Bronze rusts. The sun has no such flaws. Unless it's night, I suppose.

potato_toxicologistthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Each night: learn a player. If yesterday’s execution was drunk or poisoned, the player you learn is evil
potato_toxicologistthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: Wake the Toxicologist. Show them a player. That player must be evil if there was a player who was drunk or poisoned at the moment of execution yesterday.
potato_toxicologistthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: People let too much get in their system nowadays. It's no good, really. Really it's just not thinking, absent mindedly giving in to vices and greed. Oh, pass the doughnuts, will you?

potato_truckerthepotatopatchpart1.ability: You start knowing if the player furthest from the Demon is a Townsfolk.
potato_truckerthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Wake the Trucker. Nod or shake your head depending on if the player furthest from the demon is a townsfolk. If there are two players of equal distance, count again, ignoring the Trucker's position.
potato_truckerthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: Hurry up! We's running late! We gat'a git these shipments to the coast in two hours! Hang on! It were Daylight-savings las' night! That means we'cn have an hours nap!

potato_tzarthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Each night learn an in play character. You might learn false information from now onwards.
potato_tzarthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: You may mark the Tzar with the 'False' reminder token. If they don't have the 'False' reminder token, show them an in-play character, otherwise show them a not-in-play character.
potato_tzarthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: You may mark the Tzar with the 'False' reminder token. If they don't have the 'False' reminder token, show them an in-play character, otherwise show them a not-in-play character.
potato_tzarthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: Власть, которая не является абсолютной, вовсе не власть.

potato_vigilantethepotatopatchpart1.ability: Once per game, at night, choose 2 living players. The worse of the 2 for your team to die dies.
potato_vigilantethepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: Wake the Vigilante. Gesture for them to choose to use their ability. If they do, They will choose to players. Choose whichever one you believe would be worst for the Vigilate's team to die. They die
potato_vigilantethepotatopatchpart1.flavor: I am not the hero that Ravenswood Bluff deserves. I am also not the hero it needs. I'll be honest, I was supposed to be on the evil team, but they already had two minions, so here we are.

potato_wardenthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Players that are not the Demon cannot become the Demon.
potato_wardenthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: There. Now yous lot ain't going nowhere! Hoo-wee, I am dog-tired. I'm'n'a take me a nap on this chair right next to the bars, with my keys a-dangin' from my pocket now, y'hear.

potato_whittlerthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Once per game, during the day, visit the Storyteller to learn a crucial piece of information, but not why it’s important.
potato_whittlerthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: Always whittle away from yourself. That's the first rule of whittling. The second rule of whittling is not to fall in love with what you whittle.

potato_witnessthepotatopatchpart1.ability: You start knowing an evil player. If they publicly guess you (once) and the living outnumber the dead, your team loses.
potato_witnessthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Wake the Witness. Point at an evil player.
potato_witnessthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: Wit Ness? No, no, no, you must have me confued for someone else. My name is Shmitt Shmess. It's German. Ja.

potato_woodcarverthepotatopatchpart1.ability: You start knowing the closest evil player’s character type, Demon if equal.
potato_woodcarverthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Wake the Woodcarver. Point at either the word 'Minions' or the word 'Demons' on a script, depending on if there is a Minion closer to the Woodcarver or a Demon. If the two are equidistant, show Demon.
potato_woodcarverthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: Never underestimate what one man can do with a knife, a block of wood, and dedication.

potato_yogithepotatopatchpart1.ability: Drunk or poisoned players receive false information
potato_yogithepotatopatchpart1.flavor: अगर हम सही हैं, तो हम सही हैं। अगर हम गलत हैं, तो हम गलत हैं। लेकिन हमें कोई भी काम आधा-अधूरा नहीं करना चाहिए।

potato_authorthepotatopatchpart1.ability: When you die, if the next player the Demon kills is themself (ending the game) your team loses.
potato_authorthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: The only thing I love more than writing stories is fantasising about writing stories. I need to stop procrastinating...

potato_bartender1thepotatopatchpart1.ability: On your first night, choose 2 players. One is drunk if good, and if they would die at night, another player dies in their place, even if you are dead
potato_bartender1thepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Wake the Bartender. They choose two players. If at least one is good, mark them with the 'Drunk' reminder token. Mark both with the 'Safe' reminder token.
potato_bartender1thepotatopatchpart1.flavor: We mustn't give in to our vices, in life. But we shouldn't abstain from them either. They are the difference between alive and living.

potato_beholderthepotatopatchpart1.ability: If you were 'mad' about being an Outsider today, the Demon might wake to choose a player and learn their character.
potato_beholderthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: If you believe the Beholder has not made an ernest attempt to convince the town that they are not an outsider, tonight you may wake the demon. Show them the 'This character Has Selected You' info token, then the Beholder's character token. They may choose a player. Show the Demon that player's character.
potato_beholderthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: Spies, Secrets, Listeners and Watchers, Everyone's all out to get me. My cook might poison me, my bodyguard letting in assassins, my advisor is whispering bad advice in my ears. I must kill them all, before they kill me!

potato_confectionerthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Once while you are alive, and once while you are dead, an evil player can ask the Storyteller to rate a course of action for it’s utility.
potato_confectionerthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: People think me and the Dentist are sworn enemies, but actually, I'm the only one keeping them in business.

potato_courtesanthepotatopatchpart1.ability: If you die at night, learn who you made evil. [A Townsfolk is Evil]
potato_courtesanthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Choose a Townsfolk. They are evil. Wake them, point at them, and give them a thumbs down.
potato_courtesanthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: If the Courtesan died tonight, wake them. Point at the player they turned evil.
potato_courtesanthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: Heya sweetheart! It's 3 coins for an hour and 10 coins for 3! Hang on...

potato_cultistthepotatopatchpart1.ability: If the Demon would kill you, they die, and you become the evil Demon.

potato_dentistthepotatopatchpart1.ability: If you die, evil players "Mad" about having good abilities might gain those abilities (but not wake to use them).
potato_dentistthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: Wider. Wider. Wideeerrr... Now bite on this. Wow those chompers look nasty. I bet they teach you their names in dentistry school.

potato_fanaticthepotatopatchpart1.ability: While the living outnumber the dead: If you are executed or not 'mad' about being the in play Townsfolk you start knowing, a good player might become evil.
potato_fanaticthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Wake the Fanatic. Show them an in-play townsfolk. Mark that townsfolk with the 'Idol' reminder token.
potato_fanaticthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: No way! The Washerwoman! I'm, like, you're biggest fan!

potato_ghoulthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Once per game, if you are dead, a player might die.
potato_ghoulthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: If the Ghoul is dead, consider killing someone. If so, mark the Ghoul with the 'No Ability' reminder token.

potato_hairdresserthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Each night, choose a unique pair of living players (not yourself). If both are evil, they swap characters.
potato_hairdresserthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: Wake the Hairdresser, they choose two players. Both must be alive, have not been chosen before or the Hairdresser. If both are evil, they swap characters.
potato_hairdresserthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: Oh! Well, this just won't do! SHANON! Cancel my 4:15! There's a follacular emergency I need to fix!

potato_jewelerthepotatopatchpart1.ability: The first time the Demon dies (ending the game) and 5 or more non-Travellers live, a Minion becomes a not-in play Demon, even if you are dead. If you live, choose which one.
potato_jewelerthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: If the demon died, and the Jeweler is alive, wake the Jeweler. Gesture for them to choose a demon. A minion is now that Demon. Otherwise, choose a demon yourself.
potato_jewelerthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: Did you know? The term for the weakest line upon which a diamond can be split is known as the cleavage!

potato_mephitthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Once per game, at night, a living good player becomes evil, and then if they are alive, good again the next night.
potato_mephitthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: If the Mephit's ability acts tonight, choose a living good player and mark them with the 'Evil' token. Wake them, and inform them that they are evil. If a player was made evil last night and is still alive, wake them and tell them that they are good. Give the Mephit the 'No Ability' reminder token
potato_mephitthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: If the Mephit's ability acts tonight, choose a living good player and mark them with the 'Evil' token. Wake them, and inform them that they are evil. If a player was made evil last night and is still alive, wake them and tell them that they are good. Give the Mephit the 'No Ability' reminder token
potato_mephitthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: Water and Earth, Fire and Air! I meddle your matters for all your despair! The nice turn naughty but the naughty turn nice, and once I've worked my mischief you won't see me twice!

potato_nannythepotatopatchpart1.ability: Each night, choose a unique, living player (not yourself). If you choose an evil player, a Townsfolk is drunk until dusk
potato_nannythepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: Wake the Nanny. They must choose a player who is alive, not the nanny, and has never been chosen before by the Nanny. If they choose an evil player, a player is drunk until dusk.
potato_nannythepotatopatchpart1.flavor: What's this baby doing in a bowler hat? Well, not to worry you little monster! I'll take care of you!

potato_ochrejellythepotatopatchpart1.ability: If you die at night, either a Townsfolk becomes an Ochre Jelly, or a Minion learns you died.
potato_ochrejellythepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: If the Ochre Jelly died at night either wake a good player and tell than that they are the Ochre Jelly, or wake a minion, show them the 'This Character Has Selected You' token, and then the Ochre Jelly token.

potato_patientthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Each night, if no-one is dead, die. If a player chooses for you to die tonight, no-one else can.
potato_patientthepotatopatchpart1.otherNightReminder: If no one has died tonight, the Patient dies.

potato_postmanthepotatopatchpart1.ability: Evil players start knowing the characters of evil players
potato_postmanthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: During the minion and demon info part of the night, after showing players their info, show them the 'Thi Character Has Selected You' token, the Postman token, and then every in play evil character.
potato_postmanthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: Your Post is here! You've got a few bills, a postcard from your gandmother, an RSPV to a co-worker' wedding, and what looks to be a love letter from your secret tyrst. Wow!

potato_ramthepotatopatchpart1.ability: On your first night choose 2 players. Something bad might happen if either is executed, even if you are dead. If you die at night, learn what.
potato_ramthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Wake the Ram. They choose two players. Mark both players with 'Horned'.
potato_ramthepotatopatchpart1.flavor: Baaa! Just kidding, I know how to talk. Don't have anything interesting to say, though.

potato_righthandmanthepotatopatchpart1.ability: On your first night, become the alignment of and learn the character of the player to your left. If you are drunk or poisoned on night 1, turn evil intead.
potato_righthandmanthepotatopatchpart1.firstNightReminder: Wake the Right Hand Man. If their leftwards neighbour is evil, they become evil. Point at them, give a thumbs down. Regardless, tell them the character of their leftwards neighbour.

potato_serpentthepotatopatchpart1.ability: If you die, tonight, the Demon may choose any number of players. Chosen players become not in play characters of the same type.

potato_attorneythepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night, choose a character. Tomorrow, if they are executed, all Townsfolk are poisoned until dawn.
potato_attorneythepotatopatchpart2.firstNightReminder: Wake the Attorney. They will choose a player.
potato_attorneythepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Attorney. They will choose a player. If their previous choice was executed, all Townsfolk are Poisoned.
potato_attorneythepotatopatchpart2.flavor: If the accused really was with their wife on the night of the murder, then how come my witness is certain that they were seen leaving the scene of the crime minutes after the victim was killed? Please pay no attention to the fact that I have never been seen in the same room as my witness, nor to the fact that he looks exactly like me, only with a very large moustache.

potato_chancellorthepotatopatchpart2.ability: Players you nominate or who nominate you are poisoned until dawn. If the Demon is poisoned, a player dies tonight.
potato_chancellorthepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: If the demon is poisoned, choose a player: They die.
potato_chancellorthepotatopatchpart2.flavor: And can we trust you to follow through with this plan?

potato_changelingthepotatopatchpart2.ability: Once per game, at night, Choose a player. They are poisoned. Next night, they die, and then you become their character.
potato_changelingthepotatopatchpart2.firstNightReminder: The Changeling might choose a player. If so, mark them with the Changeling's 'Poisoned' reminder token: They are Poisoned.
potato_changelingthepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: If no player is marked with the Changelings "Poisoned" reminder token: The Changeling might choose a player. If so, mark them with the Changeling's 'Poisoned' reminder token: They are Poisoned.. If there is a player marked with the Changelings "Poisoned" reminder token: they die. Add the Changeling's 'Dead' reminder token, and remove the Changeling' 'Poisoned' reminder token, they have become halthy immediately upon dying, due to the Changeling no longer being in play. Change the Changeling's character token for the token of the player they killed. Wake the Changeling, show them the 'You Are' token, then show them their new character. Send them back to sleep.
potato_changelingthepotatopatchpart2.flavor: I was born one hundred years ago, and since then I have not seen so many egg shells near the fire!

potato_consiglierethepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night choose a player. They are posioned, and cannot learn false information or die by execution until dusk.
potato_consiglierethepotatopatchpart2.firstNightReminder: Wake the Consigliere, they choose a player. mark them with the 'Resolved' token, they are poisoned, cannot learn false information, and cannot die by execution.
potato_consiglierethepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Remove the 'Resolved' token. Wake the Consigliere, they choose a player. mark them with the 'Resolved' token, they are poisoned, cannot learn false information, and cannot die by execution.
potato_consiglierethepotatopatchpart2.flavor: Even the shooting of your fatha was business, not personal. You should'a known that by now.

potato_exiledthepotatopatchpart2.ability: You start knowing all not in play Outsiders, & choose any to gain the ability of [-1 or +1 Outsiders]
potato_exiledthepotatopatchpart2.firstNightReminder: Wake the Exiled. Show them all not in play outsiders. Let them select any of those outsiders. Place those outsider's tokens near the exiled's, to remember what they have.
potato_exiledthepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: If the exiled has an ability that requires them to wake, they do so.
potato_exiledthepotatopatchpart2.flavor: Thirty-three years they left me to wander the wastes, with no shelter, no stability: just the endless horizon. They hoped I would die out here, that they could forget me, as though I would rot like every other relic sent out here. But I remained. I persisted. And I made some very influential friends. Would you like to meet some of them?

potato_femmefatalethepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night, see the Grimoire. The Storyteller might prompt you to make decisions for them.
potato_femmefatalethepotatopatchpart2.firstNightReminder: Wake the Femme Fatale. Show them the Grimoire for as long as they need. If you wish for them to make a decsion on your behalf, indicate using gestures, token or text as to what you want them to decide. You do not have to do as they request.
potato_femmefatalethepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Femme Fatale. Show them the Grimoire for as long as they need. If you wish for them to make a decsion on your behalf, indicate using gestures, token or text as to what you want them to decide. You do not have to do as they request.
potato_femmefatalethepotatopatchpart2.flavor: Mon chéri, 'asn't your mother ever warned you not to trust a pretty face? I've 'ad zis game in ze palm of my 'and ze moment you walked through ze door.

potato_genasithepotatopatchpart2.ability: [The Demon is jinxed to be stronger]
potato_genasithepotatopatchpart2.flavor: I have seen the City of Brass and the Citadel of Ten Thousand Pearls. I have met the Wind Dukes of Aaqa, and the Forgemasters at the Fountains of Creation. I have found wonders and majesties you could never dream of. And in all my years of plansewalking, the most important thing I learned is that the beings beyond our realm are especially... Malleable...

potato_harlequinthepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night choose a player and a character. They are ‘mad’ this character is in play, or might be executed
potato_harlequinthepotatopatchpart2.firstNightReminder: Wake the Harlequin. They choose a player. Mark that player with the 'Mad' reminder token. Send the Harlequin to sleep. Wake the chosen player. Show them the 'This chracter has selected you' token, then the Harlequin token, then the character they must be mad about being in play. Send them back to sleep.
potato_harlequinthepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Harlequin. They choose a player. Mark that player with the 'Mad' reminder token. Send the Harlequin to sleep. Wake the chosen player. Show them the 'This chracter has selected you' token, then the Harlequin token, then the character they must be mad about being in play. Send them back to sleep.

potato_huntressthepotatopatchpart2.ability: On your first night, choose an in play good character. They learn they have been chosen, and if they are executed, you become a not in play Demon. If a Demon is ever executed, Good wins.
potato_huntressthepotatopatchpart2.firstNightReminder: Wake the Huntress. Let them choose a good character. If it's not in play, make her choose again. Once she chooses an in-play character, confirm this, and send her back to sleep. Mark that player ith the 'Quarry' reminder token. Wake the player she chose. Show them 'thi character selected you' and then Huntress. Send them back to sleep.
potato_huntressthepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: If the Huntress' Quarry was executed, wake the Huntress. Show her 'you are' and then the token of a not in play Demon. She is this demon now.
potato_huntressthepotatopatchpart2.flavor: The Hunt is a sacred rite. A ritual of bloodshed and hunger. Death, traded for life. The wolf that eats is stronger. The hawk that catches is faster. The bear that kills may live another day. And your death... will do more than sustain me...

potato_illithidthepotatopatchpart2.ability: Players whose distance from you equals the current day number are poisoned.
potato_illithidthepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Move the Illithid's reminder token to the players one step further from the Illithid in the respective direction.
potato_illithidthepotatopatchpart2.flavor: What a long life you have lived. A son, a father, a brother. Across the continent and over the seas... Delicious...

potato_jesterthepotatopatchpart2.ability: Evil players nominated by evil players cannot die by execution today. If just 3 players live, you lose this ability.
potato_jesterthepotatopatchpart2.flavor: Oh do calm down. It ith just a joke, after all. I mutht thay, when I told it to your wife she laughed tho hard she nearly fell out of my bed!

potato_lamplighterthepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night, choose up to a third of the players. Chosen good players are sober and heathy until dusk. [All Outsiders are poisoned, +2 Outsiders]
potato_lamplighterthepotatopatchpart2.firstNightReminder: Wake the Lamp Lighter. Let them choose any number of good players. Mark those players with 'Sober and Healthy' reminder tokens.
potato_lamplighterthepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Lamp Lighter. Let them choose any number of good players. Mark those players with 'Sober and Healthy' reminder tokens.
potato_lamplighterthepotatopatchpart2.flavor: I like it better in t' dark. No whelps t' bother me, no sun t' blind me. Nar, It's much better like this.

potato_lieutennantthepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each day, visit the Storyteller with help on how to sell a bluff. If you are executed, your nominator becomes evil tonight.
potato_lieutennantthepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: If the Lieutennant was executed, turn their nominator evil.
potato_lieutennantthepotatopatchpart2.flavor: I did my duty for Queen and country!

potato_martyrthepotatopatchpart2.ability: You start knowing a word. The first time you say it, if you are dead, live, otherwise die or be executed.
potato_martyrthepotatopatchpart2.firstNightReminder: Wake the Martyr. Show them a word. Send them back to sleep.
potato_martyrthepotatopatchpart2.flavor: When snow is stained with Brother-Blood, and the light of burning thatch illuminates only carnage, we must know: what it is we will live for, and what it is we will die for.

potato_mothbornethepotatopatchpart2.ability: If you are executed, all Townsfolk are poisoned until dusk. When 4 players live, swap characters with the Demon.
potato_mothbornethepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: If the Mothborne was executed today, mark them with the 'All Townfolk are Poisoned' reminder token: all Townsfolk are Poisoned. If the number of living players just became 4, the demon become the Mothborne, and the Mothborne becomes the Demon. Wake each one in turn sho them 'You Are' and their new character.
potato_mothbornethepotatopatchpart2.flavor: They all ignore me. But that's ok... I have my moths. My pretty little moths. I don't need anyone else. Not now. I'm going into my cocoon now. I can't wait to see what I'll become when I emerge...

potato_physicianthepotatopatchpart2.ability: When a Minion is executed, they live, and die tonight
potato_physicianthepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: If a minion was protected by the Phyician, they die. Mark them with a shroud and the Physician's 'Dead' reminder token.
potato_physicianthepotatopatchpart2.flavor: Nein to vorry! Zanks to ze advances in modern medicine, you vill not be dying today! Howefah, I make no promises about tomorrow...

potato_poltergeistthepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night if you died by execution, and more than 3 players live, you may choose a living neighbor: they die. If you are executed while dead, your team loses.
potato_poltergeistthepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: If the Poltergeist is dead, wake them. They may choose one of their alive neighbours. If they do so, mark that player with the Poltergeist's 'Dead' reminder token: they are dead.

potato_slugthepotatopatchpart2.ability: Once per game, publicly guess all good player’s characters. If correct evil wins. All players know you are in play.

potato_stalkerthepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night, choose a player, learn their character. Or kill your last choice and lose your ability
potato_stalkerthepotatopatchpart2.firstNightReminder: Wake the Stalker. They choose a player. Mark that player with the Stalker's 'Last choice' reminder token. Show the Stalker what that player's character is. Send them back to sleep.
potato_stalkerthepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Stalker. If they indicate to kill, mark the 'Last Choice' player with 'Dead': They are dead, mark them with a shroud. Mark the Stalker with the 'No Ability' reminder token. Otherwie, They choose a player. Mark that player with the Stalker's 'Last choice' reminder token. Show the Stalker what that player's character is. Send them back to sleep.
potato_stalkerthepotatopatchpart2.flavor: Wow... You smell different when you're awake...

potato_wretchedthepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night, choose a player, if good, they receive false information and register falsely to Townsfolk until dusk.
potato_wretchedthepotatopatchpart2.firstNightReminder: Wake the Wretched. They choose a player. Mark that player ith the 'Wretchened' reminder token. Send the Wretched back to sleep.
potato_wretchedthepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Wretched. They choose a player. Mark that player ith the 'Wretchened' reminder token. Send the Wretched back to sleep.
potato_wretchedthepotatopatchpart2.flavor: They called me ugly. The pitied me! I... hhhate being pitied!

potato_yokaithepotatopatchpart2.ability: You register as alive, can vote and can nominate while dead.
potato_yokaithepotatopatchpart2.flavor: The Tengu, the Kappa, the Kuchisake-onna! The Amabie, the Oni, the Rokurokubi! We are spirits, we whistle and howl! You best hide away when we're on the prowl!

potato_byrionthepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night choose a player: they die. Executed players that can no longer act might poison one Townsfolk neighbor
potato_byrionthepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Byrion. They point at any player. That player dies.
potato_byrionthepotatopatchpart2.flavor: Hmm? Oh... hwat a sad thing to hear. Crumpled up and discarded like hwet tissue paper. Tragic, really.

potato_cadevermorethepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night choose a player; they die. Minions “mad” about being Minions might keep their ability if executed.
potato_cadevermorethepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Cadevermore. They point at any player. That player dies.
potato_cadevermorethepotatopatchpart2.flavor: Serve me proudly and we'll play forevermore! Pledge yourself to the Cadevermore!

potato_carideathepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night choose a player: they die. The first time the Caridea dies at night and the living outnumber the dead, the player 6 steps clockwise from you becomes the Caridea and a player turns evil.
potato_carideathepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Caridea. They point at any player. That player dies.
potato_carideathepotatopatchpart2.flavor: Are you tellin' me a Caridea fried this rice?

potato_dharvriikthepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night you may choose a player; they die. If you did not choose anyone, and someone died tonight, choose a player: they are poisoned from now on.
potato_dharvriikthepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Dharvriik. They might point at any player. That player dies. If they didn't, and a player later dies tonight immediately wake the Dharvriik and let them point at a player. Mark that player with the Dharvriik's 'Poisoned' reminder token: they are poisoned.
potato_dharvriikthepotatopatchpart2.flavor: It is debased and bestial to dirty one's hands with blood. I have better things to do. Besides, by the looks of it, these crazed townsfolk will do that task for me.

potato_draugrthepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night choose a player: they die. If executed, you live but register as dead. If just 3 players live, all players vote to kill all living or all dead players.
potato_draugrthepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Draugr. They point at any player. That player dies.
potato_draugrthepotatopatchpart2.flavor: Bolog aaz, mal lir! Qiilaan us dilon! Dir volaan!

potato_gashadokurothepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night choose a player: they die and turn evil until they lose thier vote token (even if you lose this ability).
potato_gashadokurothepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Gashadokuro. They point at any player. That player dies and turns evil. Wake that player. Show them the 'You Are' info token, then give a thumbs down, send them back to sleep.
potato_gashadokurothepotatopatchpart2.flavor: It's okayyy. You're one of us nowww. Don't be scareddd. Just keep your head down and stay quiet and you'll be okayyy.

potato_grogarthepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each Night, choose a player: they die. Outsiders you kill keep their ability when dead. [+1 Outsider]
potato_grogarthepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake Grogar. Let him choose a player. They die.
potato_grogarthepotatopatchpart2.flavor: Such confidence. Go! Try to take back your kingdom. I shall send you there myself. If you prevail, you may keep it. But when you fail, you will submit to me!

potato_hmorynthepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. The first time you kill an evil player, see the Grimoire.
potato_hmorynthepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Hæmoryn. They point at any player. That player dies. If that player is evil, show the Hæmoryn the grimoire.
potato_hmorynthepotatopatchpart2.flavor: Slit the palm. Your precious crimson will paint a glorious tapestry. I just need enough paint for the canvas... Thank you.

potato_hecanitethepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night choose a player: they die. On the first night, choose a player. Their ability secretly becomes: 'if just 3 players live, become evil'
potato_hecanitethepotatopatchpart2.firstNightReminder: Wake the Hecanite. They choose a player. Mark that player with the 'Bewitched' reminder token.
potato_hecanitethepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Hecanite. They point at any player. That player dies.
potato_hecanitethepotatopatchpart2.flavor: Milk doth sour, and fruit doth rot; bide thy years, and thou shalt canker too. Yet fret thee not — beauty lieth in the eye of the beholder.

potato_hijinthepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night (except the last) choose to let the player executed today survive. If you didn’t last night, choose a player: they die.
potato_hijinthepotatopatchpart2.firstNightReminder: Wake the Hijin. They choose: Thumbs up for survives, Thumbs down for no influence.
potato_hijinthepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Hijin. They choose: Thumbs up for survives, Thumbs down for no influence. if last night they gave a Thumbs down: they choose any player. That player dies.
potato_hijinthepotatopatchpart2.flavor: it displeeses me. down heyre in mye little den in the pyts with all uf my stuf. i want itt gon. mak it gow awy.

potato_idthepotatopatchpart2.ability: You think you are a good character, but you are not. Each night player(s) die based on what you did. Minion get 3 Bluffs.
potato_idthepotatopatchpart2.flavor: What are you talking about? Demons? Quotes? You're starting to get on my nerves, and I must warn you, I have quite the temper!

potato_kronosthepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night choose a player: they die. All players know you are in play. The day has no structure and cannot last for more minutes than half the number of living players.
potato_kronosthepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Kronos. They point at any player. That player dies.
potato_kronosthepotatopatchpart2.flavor: I see it all backwards. Your tiny minds could never grasp it all. It's almost a shame.

potato_luciferthepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each Night, Choose a player: they die. If you are dead, your team loses. [Your Minions are Demons that cannot kill, and register as Minions too]
potato_luciferthepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Lucifer. They point at any player. That player dies.

potato_mandragorathepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each Night choose 2 players: they die. All Minions know you are in play and if they are ‘mad’ about being a Minion, you might die. You don't learn who the Minions are.
potato_mandragorathepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Mandragora. They point at any two players. Both players die.
potato_mandragorathepotatopatchpart2.flavor: What's that? An Assassin? A Spy? A Poisoner? They sound like dreadful people; I'll have nothing to do with them!

potato_mantosthepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night choose a player: they die. If you are nominated by an evil player, swap characters with them tonight (Abilities are preserved).
potato_mantosthepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Mantos. They point at any player. That player dies.
potato_mantosthepotatopatchpart2.flavor: Souls are Software. Minds are Software. Brains are Hardware. Hearts are Hardware. Transfers are Easy. Everything is Mutable.

potato_matriarchthepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night, see the Grimoire and decide everyone’s information. Tonight If you lied, an evil player dies, otherwise, good.
potato_matriarchthepotatopatchpart2.firstNightReminder: Wake the Matriarch. Let them use whatever means neccessary to decide what everyone's information is.
potato_matriarchthepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Matriarch. Let them use whatever means neccessary to decide what everyone's information is. Send the Matriarch back to sleep. Choose a player, good if the Matriarch didn't give out false information, evil otherwise, they die.

potato_numiathepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night choose a player: they die. If you would be the first evil player to die, you live, but register as dead until the next night.
potato_numiathepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Numia. They point at any player. That player dies.
potato_numiathepotatopatchpart2.flavor: Tenets of Mankind! Violence! Greed! My lifeblood omits from the Abyss! Release me!

potato_ogbanje1thepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night choose a player. They become an evil Ogbanje and you die. If just 3 players live, and no good player nominates, your team loses. [No Minions]
potato_ogbanje1thepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Ogbanje. They point at any player. The Ogbanje dies, and the player they chose becomes the evil Ogbanje.
potato_ogbanje1thepotatopatchpart2.flavor: Hello! Going to try and keep me alive again? Wow! That's the spirit! I'm sure you've got this! Fifth time's the charm!

potato_ozymandiasthepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night choose a player: they die, then you learn the player the Storyteller thinks is the best or worst kill for tonight.
potato_ozymandiasthepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Ozymandias. They point at any player. That player dies. Then, point at a player whom you believe would have been the best or the worst kill.
potato_ozymandiasthepotatopatchpart2.flavor: My name is Ozymandias, King of Kings: Look on my works, ye Mighty, and despair!

potato_paimonthepotatopatchpart2.ability: The game ends if no-one dies by execution today. If all Demons are dead play for one more day: if a player is then executed, evil wins. [X Paimons, no Minions]
potato_paimonthepotatopatchpart2.flavor: They spawn from leaves in Lemegeton Clavicula Salomonis. We are foretold by Trismegistus' Tabula. I am of Goetia, the ninth spirit, and I am already dead.

potato_pyrusthepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night choose a player: they die. If you didn’t choose a good, sober and healthy Townsfolk, one might die in their place [+1 Outsider]
potato_pyrusthepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Pyrus. They point at any player. That player dies, unless they weren't a good, sober and healthy townsfolk, in which case one might die instead.
potato_pyrusthepotatopatchpart2.flavor: The f-flames of the b-bonfire will s-s-sear your skin and melt y-your eyeballs, ahahaHA!

potato_qandisathepotatopatchpart2.ability: On your 1st night, or if the player you chose last is dead, look at the Grimoire & choose a player. Each night player(s) die based on what they did.
potato_qandisathepotatopatchpart2.firstNightReminder: Wake the Qandisa. Show them the grimoire. They choose a player. Mark them with the 'Bad Omen' reminder token. Send the Qandisa back to sleep.
potato_qandisathepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Qandisa. Show them the grimoire. They choose a player. Mark them with the 'Bad Omen' reminder token. Send the Qandisa back to sleep. Then, choose a player or players the Bad Omen interacted with. They die.
potato_qandisathepotatopatchpart2.flavor: Kill you? I will twist you, burn you, break you. I will mutilate your friends and devour your family. But kill you? That would be far too kind.

potato_qixthepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night choose a player: they die. On your first night, choose a player: they learn this. If just 3 players live, they become evil.
potato_qixthepotatopatchpart2.firstNightReminder: Wake the Qix. They choose a player. Mark that player with 'Qualmish'. Send the Qix to sleep. Wake the Qualmist player. Show them 'This Character has selected you' and the Qix token.
potato_qixthepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Qix. They point at any player. That player dies. If jut three players live, wake the Qualmish player. Show them the 'You Are' token, and give a thumbs down. They are evil.
potato_qixthepotatopatchpart2.flavor: Quivering queries and quaint qualms won’t quell the quiet quagmire you’ve quickstepped into.

potato_quarpthepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night, if a player died today, choose 3 players: they die. On day 4, all players learn you are in play. After day 4, your team wins.
potato_quarpthepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: If a player died yesterday, Wake the Quarp: they choose three players. Chosen players die.
potato_quarpthepotatopatchpart2.flavor: Silence! There is a foul stain in my presence, and it is my holy duty to purge it. Blood begets Blood.

potato_quezotlthepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night, mark any number of players. Marked players are poisoned and cannot exceed half of all players. Each night a living marked or evil player dies
potato_quezotlthepotatopatchpart2.firstNightReminder: Wake the Que’zotl. They point at any number of players. Mark those players with the 'Poisoned' reminder token.
potato_quezotlthepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Que’zotl. They point at any number of players. Mark those players with the 'Poisoned' reminder token. A living marked player or an evil player dies.
potato_quezotlthepotatopatchpart2.flavor: You don't know it but you're going to die. It's on my calendar, see?

potato_rejicothepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night choose a player: they die. If you are executed and no evil players are dead, a Minion becomes Rejico.
potato_rejicothepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Rejico. They point at any player. That player dies.
potato_rejicothepotatopatchpart2.flavor: Efil dna h'tæd si a latrom t-pecnoc.

potato_vampyrethepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night choose a player: they die. The first time this doesn’t kill a player, you die and they become the evil Vampyre.
potato_vampyrethepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: The Vampyre points to a player. That player dies. If that player is still alive, and this has never happened before, they become the evil Vampire. Wake them, show them "YOU ARE", the Vampyre token, and a Thumbs Down. The Previous Vampyre Dies, even if they should not.
potato_vampyrethepotatopatchpart2.flavor: Despite common knowledge, we aren't just harmed by garlic, but all plants in the allium family. It sounds funny, but it's not. My cousin was killed by a shallot.

potato_volomichthepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night choose any number of players: they die. Your cannot kill a majority of the players. If no execution occured today, your team wins.
potato_volomichthepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Volomich. They point at any number of players. All chosen players die.
potato_volomichthepotatopatchpart2.flavor: Я беру только свою честную долю. Иначе — неправильно. Конечно, решать, что считается честной долей, буду я.

potato_vrithepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night choose 3 living unaligned players for today’s nominations. On night 3, you must choose yourself, and if you aren’t executed, your team wins.
potato_vrithepotatopatchpart2.firstNightReminder: Wake the Vri. They point at any three players (Who are not all on the same team). Mark all players with 'Chosen'.
potato_vrithepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Vri. They point at any three players (Who are not all on the same team). Mark all players with 'Chosen'. If this is Night 3, the Vri must chose themself.
potato_vrithepotatopatchpart2.flavor: Ono! The odd one out for the day has got too bee mee! But wil the kil for the day bee mee? Eye can not kno!

potato_wovaristhepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night choose a player: they die. If all your Minions are dead, choose 2.
potato_wovaristhepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Wovaris. They point at one or two players. Chosen players die.
potato_wovaristhepotatopatchpart2.flavor: Graaah! I don't need Them! I don't need anyone!

potato_wyvernthepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night choose a player: they die. Executed evil players guessed as the wrong character type live but register as dead.
potato_wyvernthepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Wyvern. They point at any player. That player dies.
potato_wyvernthepotatopatchpart2.flavor: Fen du hin sille ko Sovngarde!

potato_xayathepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night, if you didn’t kill 2 players last night, choose up to 2 players: they die.
potato_xayathepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: If the Xaya didn't kill two people last night: Wake the Xaya. They point at one or two players. Those players die.
potato_xayathepotatopatchpart2.flavor: Hibisscuss and Ssaffron, Ccinnamon and Sstar Anisse. Thesse Sspices are markss of Luxury. I can hardly be blamed for taking the time to enjoy them.

potato_babathepotatopatchpart2.ability: Once per day, publicly change one rule of Blood on the Clocktower. The Storyteller declares if your change happens or not. If you die, the rules go back to normal.

potato_bardthepotatopatchpart2.ability: Once per game, at night, make all players not on your alignment drunk until dusk
potato_bardthepotatopatchpart2.firstNightReminder: Wake the Bard. Let them chooe, yes or no. If they choose yes, mark them with the 'All Opposing Players are Drunk' info token.
potato_bardthepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Bard. Let them chooe, yes or no. If they choose yes, mark them with the 'All Opposing Players are Drunk' info token.
potato_bardthepotatopatchpart2.flavor: I actually learned how to play music at the same college as the Minstrel, from BMR. Of course, I can't stand the sedimentary life, so I became a traveller, while he sayed in Ravenswood Bluff. I do visit from time to time, especially when something interesting's going on in town, which, let's face it, is more often than not. But I'm rambilng. Anyway, here's Wonderwall.

potato_headhunterthepotatopatchpart2.ability: One per day, before nominations, you may publicly choose a player: they die. If the Demon would die to your ability, they live but register as dead (even if you lose this ability).
potato_headhunterthepotatopatchpart2.flavor: There's two common understandings of the word 'Head'. I hunt both.

potato_knowertobethepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night, choose 2 players. They register as each other’s character and alignment tonight, and might be sober and healthy.
potato_knowertobethepotatopatchpart2.firstNightReminder: Wake the Knower to be. They choose two players. Mark one with 'As Above' and the other with 'So below'. They register as each other's character and alignment. If you want either of them to be sober and healthy, mark them with the 'Panacea' Token.
potato_knowertobethepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Knower to be. They choose two players. Mark one with 'As Above' and the other with 'So below'. They register as each other's character and alignment. If you want either of them to be sober and healthy, mark them with the 'Panacea' Token.
potato_knowertobethepotatopatchpart2.flavor:
The sacrifice of oneself to the pursuit of knowledge
Is the highest tribute to the gods.

potato_koboldthepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night choose a player. They are woken to choose 2 characters for you to learn. If they are a Townsfolk, one must be their own.
potato_koboldthepotatopatchpart2.firstNightReminder: Wake the Kobold. They choose a player. Wake the player. Show them the 'this Character Selected You' info token, and the Kobold character token. They choose two characters. If they are a townsfolk, they must choose thier character as one of them. Send that player back to sleep. Wake the Kobold. Show them the characters given.
potato_koboldthepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Kobold. They choose a player. Wake the player. Show them the 'this Character Selected You' info token, and the Kobold character token. They choose two characters. If they are a townsfolk, they must choose thier character as one of them. Send that player back to sleep. Wake the Kobold. Show them the characters given.
potato_koboldthepotatopatchpart2.flavor: The humanoid is in the warren now. The humanoid is veeery confident. They won't last long. Yip Yip!

potato_lancerthepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each day, you may publicly choose a player. They are sober, healthy, and register as a good Townsfolk or Outsider until you choose again.
potato_lancerthepotatopatchpart2.flavor: Do right by your weapon, and your weapon will do right by you.

potato_mysticthepotatopatchpart2.ability: If 5 or fewer players live, tonight, an opposing player may choose to become your alignment (Once).
potato_mysticthepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: If five or fewer players live (including travellers), choose a player not on the Mystic's team. Wake them. Show them the "This Character has Selected You" info token. Let them choose yes or no. If they choose yes, they change alignment.
potato_mysticthepotatopatchpart2.flavor: Come, visit the village mystic! I warn you, you have a 1 in 6 chance of being transformed into a Slimy Little Toad for 3 turns!

potato_officerthepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night, a player is woken. They may choose a character and something that character could learn, which you learn
potato_officerthepotatopatchpart2.firstNightReminder: Wake a player. Show them the 'This character selected you' info token, and the Officer. They may choose a character. If that character could learn anything, they may convey that information. Send them back to sleep. If the player did, wake the Officer. Show them the character and what they conveyed.
potato_officerthepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake a player. Show them the 'This character selected you' info token, and the Officer. They may choose a character. If that character could learn anything, they may convey that information. Send them back to sleep. If the player did, wake the Officer. Show them the character and what they conveyed.
potato_officerthepotatopatchpart2.flavor: If anybody has any complains, they can leave them anonymously on my desk. I promise I'll get 'round to them... eventually.

potato_playwrightthepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night, choose a player. If they vote tomorrow, they are drunk until dawn.
potato_playwrightthepotatopatchpart2.firstNightReminder: Wake the Playwright. They choose a player. Mark that player with the 'At the Theatre' reminder token.
potato_playwrightthepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Playwright. They choose a player. Mark that player with the 'At the Theatre' reminder token.
potato_playwrightthepotatopatchpart2.flavor:
There once was a Traveller in fact,
Whose ability was really abstract.
They were on the evil team:
The Demon's name they had seen.
But was exiled before they could act!

potato_squidthepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night, choose a unique living player (not yourself). Only you and they may open their eyes during voting today, and your votes count double.
potato_squidthepotatopatchpart2.firstNightReminder: Wake the Squid. They choose any player that they haven't chosen before and who isn't themself. Give that player the 'Inky' reminder token.
potato_squidthepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Squid. They choose any player that they haven't chosen before and who isn't themself. Give that player the 'Inky' reminder token.

potato_thaumaturgethepotatopatchpart2.ability: Each night, choose 2 unique players (not Travellers). If they are on the same alignment they swap characters. Otherwise, the evil player chooses the good player's new good character (if not in play) and learns their old character.
potato_thaumaturgethepotatopatchpart2.otherNightReminder: Wake the Thaumaturge. They choose two players that they have never been chosen before. If they are on the same team, swap their characters. Otherwise, Wake the evil player. Tell them the character of the good player. Let them choose a good character. If not in play, the good player becomes that character.

potato_initiatethepotatopatchpart2.ability: If Legion is in play, each night, an announcement is made as if Al-Hadikhia has chosen 3 players. Announced players are woken to make a choice, but their choice has no meaning.
potato_initiatethepotatopatchpart2.flavor: I've got the invite. We all have. All of us, except you.

potato_potatofarmerthepotatopatchpart2.ability: Players mechanically “Mad” as, possessing the ability of, or thinking themself to be other characters, might register as such.
potato_potatofarmerthepotatopatchpart2.flavor: And that proves gold is only valuable because we agree it is, right? It’s just a dream. But a potato is always worth a potato, anywhere. A knob of butter and a pinch of salt and you’ve got a meal, anywhere. Bury gold in the ground and you’ll be worrying about thieves for ever. Bury a potato and in due season you could be looking at a dividend of a thousand per cent.

oblivion_forager.ability: You start knowing 3 players. The first 2 share a trait the 3rd does not possess.
oblivion_forager.flavor: Mama and Papa say that if I go huntin' for mushrooms, I'll go find something cool! I love seeing the birds and fungi and sometimes I pick up leaves to show them! But they don't want to see them when they are screaming at each other... Mama says she loves me more than anything in this house, and Papa says how he loves me more than anything in the world... but why don't they wanna see my leaf? It's symmetrical... I like it...,

oblivion_oldsalt.ability: You start knowing an in-play minion, and you cannot die whilst they are alive.
oblivion_oldsalt.firstNightReminder: Wake the Old Salt, and show them an in-play minion character.
oblivion_oldsalt.flavor: Weeeeellll me lad, you e've 'erd of the storms of seven'y-two?

oblivion_ombromanie.ability: You start knowing an out of play Minion and Demon. If you die at night, you may choose 1 to enter play.
oblivion_ombromanie.flavor: Qui aurait pensé que le renard, le lapin et l'oie étaient tous formés d'une seule main?

oblivion_postmaster.ability: You start knowing an in-play Minion. If you nominate & execute them whilst they live, your team wins.

oblivion_scareactor.ability: You start knowing which character the Demon thinks they are. If you die, they learn their character. [The Demon thinks they're another Demon]

oblivion_shearer.ability: You start knowing an incorrect number of Outsiders.
oblivion_shearer.flavor: One lot for Rufus, another for Mrs Smith down the road - One for Cass, and a final load for… Henri Hermit? Whose that? I’ve never heard of him before…

oblivion_seedsower.ability: You start knowing if only Townsfolk neighbour the Demon. The Stargazer is not in-play, & cannot enter play. [-the Stargazer]
oblivion_seedsower.flavor: This town has everything I could ever need. I retrace the steps of those ghosts, my father, his father & his father before him. This town has nurtured me, I will never betray it.

oblivion_stargazer.ability: You start knowing how many Townsfolk neighbour Minions. The Seedsower is not in-play, & cannot enter play. [-the Seedsower]
oblivion_stargazer.flavor: Family trees mean nothing if you’re not carving your name from the stars. I want my blood to be synonymous with the world, not just with a small thing in the middle of nowhere.

oblivion_pawnbroker.ability: You start knowing a character of each type, at-least 1 is in play. Each night, you learn if one was nominated yesterday. [+0 or +1 Outsider]
oblivion_pawnbroker.firstNightReminder: Wake the Pawnbroker and show 1 character of each type, atleast 1 of which is in-play.
oblivion_pawnbroker.otherNightReminder: Wake the Pawnbroker and nod your head if a character they learned was nominated, or shake your head if one wasn't.
oblivion_pawnbroker.flavor: How much is the memory of your objects worth?

oblivion_aupair.ability: Each night, you learn 2 players: either the 1st neighbours a Minion or the 2nd neighbours a Demon.
oblivion_aupair.flavor: Children! I understand you're having fun but we must return to the manor! I can't have you running off into the woods and making dark pacts! Your father already did that, and he'd be very displeased if you followed the same path!

oblivion_dressmaker.ability: Each night, learn the character type of the previously learnt player's clockwise neighbor (skipping Travellers).
oblivion_dressmaker.flavor: I dream in taffeta and chiffon. In them, I wear my own dresses and visit a midnight ball in a glistening emerald, with bodice and ruffle. I meet a man there, and we dance through the night til I return to... this. Where all I am is some formless mannequin. Where the dresses no longer fit or flatter but... examine the faults instead. I do not have a glass slipper, as the glass was already stabbed into me. And all that's coming out is fluff and tacky rhinestones.

oblivion_naturalist.ability: On your 1st & 3rd nights, choose Outsider, Minion or Demon. Each night, learn a player of an unchosen type. [+0 to +1 Outsider]

oblivion_tobacconist.ability: Each night, choose 3 characters (not the Tobacconist, & only once a Demon): learn if exactly 1 is in play.
oblivion_tobacconist.firstNightReminder: Wake the Tobacconist to choose 3 on-script characters (not Tobacconist): they learn 'yes' if exactly 1 is in play, and a 'no' otherwise. If they guess a demon, place the 'Demon Used' token, and they may not guess one again.
oblivion_tobacconist.otherNightReminder: Wake the Tobacconist to choose 3 on-script characters (not Tobacconist(: they learn 'yes' if exactly 1 is in play, and a 'no' otherwise. If they guess a demon, place the 'Demon Used' token, and they may not guess one again.
oblivion_tobacconist.flavor: This world is a harsh, harsh place. Some people just need a vice to take the edge off, and it's just a service I offer. I sometimes take a drag, just to null it all, just for a second.

oblivion_fireprod.ability: Each night, choose a player. You may (once) choose to learn which chosen player is closest to the Demon.
oblivion_fireprod.firstNightReminder: Wake the Fireprod to choose a player, they are marked with a 'Tended' reminder token.
oblivion_fireprod.otherNightReminder: If the Fireprod has used their 'Once per game' ability, do not wake them. Wake the Fireprod to choose a player, they are marked with a 'Tended' reminder token.
oblivion_fireprod.flavor: Oh it’s awfully chilly outside, please, I do ask that you stay in. I shall have the maids prepare some hot tea, we shall find you a novel that best fits your inclinations, and we shall stay close to the fireplace.

oblivion_birdwatcher.ability: Each night, if you did not nominate yesterday, you learn how many Townsfolk did.
oblivion_birdwatcher.flavor: Stay perfectly still…. you don’t want to alert…. the rare and elusive… greenfinch….

oblivion_caroller.ability: Each night, learn a Townsfolk that claimed to be a Caroller today, if you did & another Caroller or Demon didn’t. [+0 to +1 Caroller]
oblivion_caroller.flavor: Tis’ the non-denominational winter festival season to be jolly! Fa-La-La-La La! La-La-La-L- What do you mean it’s October? It’s non-denominational winter festival season in my heart…

oblivion_eulogist.ability: Each night, you learn which player that died since dawn helped your team the most.
oblivion_eulogist.flavor: She was always so funny, kind, generous with her time, and courageous in the face of danger. He was also here. Not anymore though!

oblivion_headliner.ability: Each night, you are drunk if evil was executed yesterday, & learn how many other nominees would have been a good execution for you.
oblivion_headliner.flavor: The peroxide lingers, as all the rumours buzz around like bees to my beehive. I’m a literal bigwig. Look at my scowl. It’s mean, yet seductive, yet repulsed, who could want more?

oblivion_optician.ability: Each night, choose 3 characters of different types: if only 1 is in-play, they die (if good), or you die (if evil).
oblivion_optician.flavor: No no, I have perfect vision. Why else would I become an Optician! Sometimes I drop things, that's normal! That's called having perfect 5/5 star vision. Now where did I leave the chart of various smudges...

oblivion_burglar.ability: Each night, the Demon chooses a unique player: you learn them & their character. If you, you learn this & lose your ability.
oblivion_burglar.flavor: ’Old it, ‘old it! Whaddaya sayin’, we stole a fake idol? But it’s all… shiny! That’s gotta be worth… summin!

oblivion_vaudevillian.ability: Each night, learn if you voted for a Minion yesterday. If you nominated, learn if you voted for the Demon instead.
oblivion_vaudevillian.flavor: Chicken feathers?! I am appalled by such a fowl accusation! This is authentic peacock!

oblivion_bankshot.ability: Each day, you may visit the Storyteller to learn a question with a unique numerical answer.

oblivion_lacerunner.ability: There is a pattern to the bluffs. Each day, you may privately learn a statement about the bluffs.
oblivion_lacerunner.flavor: Oi, Matilda! Stop pokin' me! You'll make me spill red juice all over this fine cloth, then I won't earn my penny for my hard weeks work!

oblivion_ladyinwaiting.ability: Each day, you may privately learn something the opposing team should not.
oblivion_ladyinwaiting.flavor: The ritual of bathing has many luxuries: tiny French pastries, rose bath salts, a notebook detailing the mistress’ scandalous pastimes, and where the press will be so we can rendezvous.

oblivion_quarryman.ability: Each day, privately name a simple event to the Storyteller & learn how likely it is to occur. If impossible, you learn false information.
oblivion_quarryman.flavor: Why is it fair that some people strike gold and win big, whilst others, and others are stuck searching for their entire lives. I sometimes wonder if this was ever worth it. There ain't no gold in my mines, it seems. Only slate.

oblivion_salesman.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a player: learn another whose closest evil neighbour is the same number of steps from them.
oblivion_salesman.flavor: It’s such a pain visiting every city in the country in a single trip without revisiting any of them! And I have to calculate the most efficient way?! What does a man have to do to get a simple job?!

oblivion_countess.ability: Once per game, at night, you may choose to learn who the Demon is. If the Demon nominates, you learn false info until dusk.

oblivion_chanteuse.ability: If the Demon just killed the most important good player, you are woken to learn an evil player.
oblivion_chanteuse.otherNightReminder: If the player you believe to be the most important good player died tonight, wake the Chanteuse. Point at any evil player. Put the Chanteuse to sleep.
oblivion_chanteuse.flavor: Draped in finery and host to the heavenly call of a principality's vocal range, I've sung for kings, barons, cardinals and contessas. I'm like a moth, drawn to organ song and chorus accompaniment. Mesmerised, darling - I'm sure.

oblivion_phantom.ability: On the final night, learn you are a Phantom, even if dead. [Phantoms think they're different bluffs. +0 to +2 Phantoms]
oblivion_phantom.flavor: Do you hear the wailing of the lonely soul, bound by salt diagrams & thrust into the most tortuous midnight? It is I, the most tormented soul in this castle - no ghoul could ever match my pitiful existence, for it is a solitary torture.

oblivion_conservationist.ability: If one of your living neighbours is the Demon & another evil player lives, they swap characters. When you die, learn if this happened.
oblivion_conservationist.flavor: This is our locus amoenus, we must seek to conserve it’s edenesque imag- No, it’s not locust. And no, it’s actually quite nice, not mean in the slightest. I should have just said it’s a nice place. That would have gotten the message across easier.

oblivion_laureate.ability: On the final night, choose & gain an approved off-script “Once per game” ability. If you’re dead, the Storyteller chooses for you.
oblivion_laureate.otherNightReminder: On the final night, wake the Laureate and show them the "Once per game" characters to choose from - they choose 1, which they gain the ability of. If the Laureate is dead, choose for them, then show the Laureate the chosen token.
oblivion_laureate.flavor: In the poem "Harromog and Modos", I analysed the skeletons one has in their closet. Not mine, I have no secrets. No love affairs either, for you see I'm... just a bachelor. I had that confirmed when I consulted the dic-tionary. Also I ask you to stop analysing my particularly named mineral collection, my Adamite, Marcasite and Fergusonite have nothing to do with any of this.

oblivion_mariner.ability: Your Townsfolk neighbours must learn true info. If you're mad about being the Mariner, you become a different Townsfolk tonight.
oblivion_mariner.flavor: Seas are calm tonight. Well, calm compared to the port at least. Port? Did someone say wine?

oblivion_muse.ability: Your most recent nominee is sober, healthy & learns true info. If they’re alive & evil, you might learn this at night.

oblivion_reverend.ability: A Minion starts knowing who you are. If 3 live, they become your alignment & your team wins.

oblivion_wellwisher.ability: Wishes made by the 1st player executed might come true.

oblivion_apparition.ability: You think you're a Townsfolk. Players you nominate become the Apparition instead of you. If they're the Demon, the Storyteller now is.

oblivion_beauty.ability: The 1st evil executee doesn’t die (& you can't die until then).
oblivion_beauty.flavor: In life and death, Beauty is forever. May my grace and poise inspire you through hardship.

oblivion_bedfellow.ability: If you die, good players (not you) mad you're the Bedfellow might become drunk.
oblivion_bedfellow.flavor: We take our secrets - both big and small - with us to the grave. Don't tell anyone how you truly knew me, there'll be so many at the funeral that my family will be bound to ask questions.

oblivion_bellboy.ability: Each night, the Demon chooses a player (you learn them). If they are executed tomorrow, the Demon sees the Grimoire.
oblivion_bellboy.flavor: MA'AM PLEASE SLOW DOWN THESE BAGS ARE... H-HEAVY... WHY ARE THEY FULL OF BRICKS OH GOD

oblivion_cardmaker.ability: If you die, Minions have their abilities whilst dead.
oblivion_cardmaker.flavor: Don't worry about the pattern, it's supposed to be that way.

oblivion_composer.ability: After day 9, evil wins: each time a good player is executed, the end comes 2 days sooner (even if dead).

oblivion_curator.ability: You start knowing a question. If you die, you must correctly answer it tomorrow (once) or your team loses.
oblivion_curator.flavor: I once wished to be a dinosaur. Those dreams were squashed as I placed their bones in see through cases. How free they were, how relentless - now only that harsh, bone-like truth remains.

oblivion_endling.ability: You are the only unique good character. The bluffs are in-play good characters. [Other good characters are duplicates. Odd Outsider Count]
oblivion_endling.flavor: Hello there. My name is Martha. What’s yours?

oblivion_faithhealer.ability: You start knowing the Demon character. Good players mad it’s in play might die at any time, even if dead.
oblivion_faithhealer.flavor: My dearest child, close your eyes and scream to free all those demons held within your brain. Release those ailments and malignancies, and let out the hatred whilst I touch my head to your forehead. Please, release those innocent juvenile tears my dearest of god's flock. They're screams of joy and happiness, tears of salvation... and I move onto the next. My dearest child...

oblivion_fogrover.ability: Evil players might register as good Fog Rovers. Once per game, at night, learn if the Demon has done so since dawn.
oblivion_fogrover.flavor: Hide in the fog with me.... the world can't hurt you now...

oblivion_fraud.ability: You have an in-play Townsfolk’s ability. Each night, until correct, the Demon guesses which: if correct, you turn evil & keep your ability if dead.
oblivion_fraud.flavor: I want her everything. Her style. Her eyes. The Marilyn of it all.

oblivion_mummy.ability: If you die, the Demon may gain up to 3 non-Demon abilities tonight until dusk. If they only gain 1 & it's good, they keep it.
oblivion_mummy.flavor: Not all of us wear bandages. Some of us wear scars. And tears. And tales. And it's all over us.

oblivion_officiant.ability: If 1 of your neighbours (not Travellers) is evil, the other becomes evil too.

oblivion_summerfling.ability: You start knowing an in-play Minion. If an ally is executed, you swap alignments tonight & if evil, have the learned Minion ability.
oblivion_summerfling.flavor: I can do even more with 15 minutes - trust me. Meet me at dawn and you'll then search for me ‘til the deep dusks of winter, but you'll never be anything more to me. Never.

oblivion_angolde.ability: Each night, you may choose a player: they die. Each day, if a player you killed guesses you (once), you die.
oblivion_angolde.otherNightReminder: Wake the Angolde, they may either shake their head or point at a player, then put the Angolde to sleep. If they pointed at a player, mark them with the Angolde's Dead and Divine tokens.
oblivion_angolde.flavor: Heaven’s gate was built for me, in it’s eternal glory - yet so quickly it was shut on my face. My many eyes flickered, my mouths screamed incomprehensibly. I swore revenge on those bastard seraphim and throne. I shall reclaim heaven, and it’s spoils will be MINE!

oblivion_entity.ability: If you die, something good happens for the evil team & you learn it. Suggestions for what happens if you die might become true.
oblivion_entity.flavor: formless dreaming of an unexplainable forever shifting shape trying to fit into a limitless puzzle

oblivion_gizmo.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a Demon: become it, & if you don’t claim Gizmo when nominated you lose if executed.
oblivion_gizmo.flavor: Lets see what happens when I take this cog! Oopsie! I’m sorry Mr Clockwork, it seems like you won’t go tick tock anymore…

oblivion_grandiose.ability: You have every on-script “Once per Game” ability. If you die, choose 1 unused ability to keep (not this).
oblivion_grandiose.flavor: In my manor of catastrophes, many will give their lives to overcome the challenges. Like moths to a gothic fireplace. They have 1 shot in this halls and yet they throw them away… shameful, they don’t see how only their powers combined can find their way to my sanctum.

oblivion_hiredgun.ability: Your most recent good nominee is poisoned & might register as you would, even if you were executed.
oblivion_hiredgun.flavor: I'd rather not know your name. It's not like it'd sway me, I sold my sympathies years ago. I just don't want to give you false hope.

oblivion_impresario.ability: Once per game, at night, choose to become the character executed tomorrow (unless 3 live). Each day, if no-one is executed, evil wins.
oblivion_impresario.firstNightReminder: Wake the Impresario to choose a day.
oblivion_impresario.otherNightReminder: If the Impresario's chosen day was yesterday, wake them to become the executed character.
oblivion_impresario.flavor: Hit those upper operatic tones, Angelique! Raise the heavens! Do I need to put on a mask and chase you through the wings, become some sort of... Phantom of the Operetta? I wish not.

oblivion_malady.ability: You start by seeing the Grimoire, choosing a player & an Outsider: they gain its ability, & another player thinks they do.
oblivion_malady.firstNightReminder: Wake the Malady to show them the Grimoire, & prompt them to choose a player and an Outsider. Send the Malady to sleep. Wake the chosen player and a player of the Storyteller's choice (independently), show them the THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU info token, the Malady's token, and the chosen Outsider
oblivion_malady.flavor: To my dearest sister Stephanie, I am hoping this letter finds you in good health, which I am sadly unable to say I am currently in. I’ve had many bizarre dreams as of late, going from a lady to a butler serving my own family, to a mafia goon, to a mutant screeching they were a mathematician. I have been plagued by these dreams for weeks now. I’ve tried getting a doctor, but he seems to have misunderstood my conundrum. Best wishes, your spiffing sister D. Amsel.

oblivion_maligmaere.ability: If dead, you may (once) publicly guess the character of a good player who executed you or themselves. If correct, your team wins.
oblivion_maligmaere.flavor: Pareidoliac nightmares haunt your waking hours. Bodies hung amidst willow vines, veiled widows throw mirrors that release suffocating fog. You long for the day when your dreams foretell a time that cares, when your tears don't drown your pillow, when you don't scream at midnight so you don't hear that catastrophic bell ring in your head. Doom. Screech. The prophecy foretold your vague loss of self, where the portraits follow you around and your grandfather loses his teeth. Drop down now, heaven doesn't need you.

oblivion_siren.ability: A Townsfolk is poisoned. Once per game, at night, choose that the Demon dies and you become the Demon.
oblivion_siren.otherNightReminder: Wake the Siren and ask if they want to use their ability: if yes, make the Siren the demon and place the 'Dead' reminder token on the Demon.
oblivion_siren.flavor: The mistress of seduction - in a palace by the sea - drop a couple dragons - if you want time with me!

oblivion_sisteroffey.ability: You start knowing the duplicated Townsfolk: 1 is poisoned, & if both die all good players are poisoned until dusk. [2 duplicate Townsfolk]
oblivion_sisteroffey.firstNightReminder: Wake the Sister of Fey to learn which Townsfolk character was duplicated.
oblivion_sisteroffey.otherNightReminder: The 1sr time both of the duplicated Townsfolk are dead, all other good players are poisoned until tomorrow dusk.
oblivion_sisteroffey.flavor: The court disproves of your babbling. I wish you to go mad dancing in a circle of mushrooms. Away!

oblivion_sovereign.ability: You start knowing 2 pairs of Townsfolk characters & choose 1: they are poisoned. [-1 Outsider]

oblivion_tengu.ability: On your 1st night (& only then), on death Outsider abilities occur. Unaffected Outsiders might die at any time. [+1 Outsider]

oblivion_terrorbrim.ability: If a player is executed & doesn't correctly guess you're their living neighbour: a player dies tonight. A good player knows you're in play.
oblivion_terrorbrim.flavor: Darkness manifests the grandest deerstalkers. The light manifests the deer.

oblivion_abscract.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. One on script Townsfolk is marked with ☼, if they die you become Dei Ovid. [+☼]
oblivion_abscract.flavor: The universe is a grand pattern, beings of proportion and thought living in perfect order and paradigm. Crushed. Broken. Infested. You're all bugs with disgusting faces and bodies and repulsive gangly limbs. Slice. Bisect. The warp and weft. Divide. Conquer. It's almost done.

oblivion_deiovid.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. The 1st time an evil playrer (not you) is executed, evil wins. [Not in Bag, must have been Abscract]

oblivion_canonnade.ability: All know how many players are required for each nomination. It increases by 2 per execution, up to all but 1 alive players. After day 6, evil wins.
oblivion_canonnade.flavor: The wicked artillery set by thy father shall fire at midnight. Repent, make anew with thy father; there shan’t be freedom, nor tears of sympathy, nor have reverent willingness to bow, when those who have not bow’d in life shall be lowered to thy father’s eternal battlefield - where the cannonade shall be the final lullaby for sleepless nights.

oblivion_ephera.ability: Each night, choose a player (all learn who): they cannot be chosen or learned by abilities. After day 4, evil wins.
oblivion_ephera.flavor: Surely by “capturing memories” you didn’t think you would be the one keeping them? How naïve mortals are…

oblivion_erosyon.ability: Each night, you or the evil Townsfolk wake to choose a player: learn their character, & choose if they die. [1 Townsfolk is evil]
oblivion_erosyon.flavor: You want passion? The heat of mine surpasses the frigidity of stone. It’s always moving, burning, even if the face has been lost to time.

oblivion_forgeryves.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. The 1st good player you nominate learns false info & might register as an evil Forgeryves.
oblivion_forgeryves.otherNightReminder: Wake the Forgeryves (not their 'Forgery') to choose a player: they die.
oblivion_forgeryves.flavor: The replica always feels better than the real thing.

oblivion_ichorbound.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Players you kill have their vote token be secretly worth 2 votes (not against you).
oblivion_ichorbound.flavor:
When the ink dries
many poets stop writing,
despite a perfect fix being in reach;
an inkwell in their silk-soft fingertips.

oblivion_kores.ability: On your 3rd night, some good players die & you choose if you live but register as dead. After day 4, evil wins.
oblivion_kores.flavor: You have your pampas field & barren trees, nary a pomegranate on the wind. Yet you dare call my domain the land of death? These idols are weak nowadays.

oblivion_maidenofspikes.ability: Each night, choose 2 living players (not yourself). If neither were executed yesterday, choose 2 players tonight: they die.
oblivion_maidenofspikes.flavor: They speculate my sister isn’t real. Well, I can promise you, we are __very__ real. The only reason she’s thought of as a fake is that she hid her spikes inside her.

oblivion_mortdaine.ability: Each dusk, players pair up uniquely (if odd, 1 is alone): the 1st Townsfolk you pair with secretly becomes evil. After day 4, evil wins.
oblivion_mortdaine.otherNightReminder: If a Townsfolk is marked with the Mortdaine's 'Danse Macabre' token, they become evil but does not wake to learn this.

oblivion_nortzar.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. If you’re not in play & a good player in Seat 1 is executed, evil wins. [In Seat 1, +1 Minion]
oblivion_nortzar.otherNightReminder: Wake the Nortzar to choose a player: they die.
oblivion_nortzar.flavor: Do you have your tithings for your guide eternal? I'm preferable to blood, myrrh and caskets of dark red wine. Perhaps some fumes, it's cold up here in space. My child, there's no need to worry, you'll still see me amongst the smoke.

oblivion_nosurfatu.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Once, if you’re executed while most live, a player who voted becomes an evil Nosurfatu.
oblivion_nosurfatu.otherNightReminder: If a Minion has the 'Converted' token, wake them to become Nosurfatu. Wake the living Nosurfatu to choose a player: they die.

oblivion_omniasoph.ability: On day 3, you & a good player are announced. By dusk, the team whoever publicly announces a more correct Grimoire wins (you, if tied).

oblivion_phlegmfatale.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die; then you guess the most recent good executee’s character, & if correct, choose again.
oblivion_phlegmfatale.otherNightReminder: Wake the Phlegm Fatale to choose a player: they die. If a good player is 'Stained', the Phlegm Fatale may guess their character, and if correct, may choose another player to die.
oblivion_phlegmfatale.flavor: If it's not Sanguine, I simply don't want it. You love me because I'm dangerous. Seductive, sultry, ready to plunge my switchblade into your weak pathetic little man heart and use your still pumping blood as blush, now don't you? You obviously want me to plunge the stiletto heel into your eyeball, your smirk tells me everything I need to know. Well, meet me later and I'll make sure to wear my cyanide laced perfume - if you wanna step up to the high roller's table, then now's the chance.

oblivion_psaliphim.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. On the 2nd night, the Storyteller chooses who you & Minions are. [-? to +? Outsiders, no evil characters]
oblivion_psaliphim.otherNightReminder: On the 2nd Night, place 'Communion' reminders on the players who are becoming evil minions and Psaliphim. Tell these players their new characters, alignments and team. On Night 2 and later Nights, wake the Psaliphim to choose a player: they die, place the 'Dead' token on them.
