oblivion_psaliphim.flavor: At midnight you surround the Madonna with mercy, fill the offering bowl with black oil and archaic roman coins like a repentance for your mortal failings. You praise the call of Peter, of Ruth, of Valentine, so claim that holy indifference. You don threadbare garb just to gaze up in awe as the bell strikes. Dongggggggggg. Dongggggggggg. Dongggggggggg.

oblivion_rendmaw.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. If 5 would live, no more die tonight & a good player learns this. If 4 live, evil wins.

oblivion_rexolar.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. If a Minion died by execution yesterday, you gain all on-script Minion abilities until dusk.
oblivion_rexolar.otherNightReminder: Wake the Rex Olar to choose a player: they die. Additionally, wake them for any Minion abilities they currently have.
oblivion_rexolar.flavor: Thus: the litany of the sun. Never snuffed. Never distracted. Never dimmed. Never sundered. Never forgotten.

oblivion_ruma.ability: Each night, evil players silently communicate. Before day 4, players may only speak in public to nominate. After day 4, evil wins.
oblivion_ruma.flavor: There are so many scandalous rumours about the High Hall Terrace, some that I dare not say out loud... but we both trust in your skills as a lipreader.

oblivion_sueseht.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die (you secretly live). A good player registers as the Demon & learns you on the final night.
oblivion_sueseht.flavor: Don’t look into the water. It’ll make you want to dismantle yourself, get rebuilt, and question which versions the real you.

oblivion_undertow.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. The first time you are executed, you survive, and only you can die tonight.
oblivion_undertow.otherNightReminder: Wake the Undertow to choose a player: they die.
oblivion_undertow.flavor: you ever get that sinking feeling. i like it.

oblivion_veirot.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. A good player knows you’re in play & if they die, once you may choose 3 instead.
oblivion_veirot.flavor: I stood at the altar, my gown pearelscent and the veil a mile long. I dreamt about this since I was a little girl. My big day. My moment. My bouquet was full of orchids and daisies, so alabaster, so prim. I was told by the vicar you met some other woman from the west and ran off with her. They laughed at me. THEY LAUGHED AT ME AS I CRIED AND RAN, YET YOU REMAIN IN YOUR INDIFFERENCE LIKE I'M NOTHING? YOU EXPECT ME TO BE YOUR WIFE? WELL I'M SO SORRY. I'LL LAY DOWN NOW SIR. I'LL APOLOGISE. I'LL APOLOGISE FOR MY BIG DAY. SO, I'M SORRY. I'M SO DAMN SORRY.

oblivion_xaoh.ability: Each night, something impossible occurs & you may silently suggest what to the Storyteller. Each night, choose a player: they die.
oblivion_xaoh.otherNightReminder: Wake the Xaoh to choose a player: they die.
oblivion_xaoh.flavor: g E t 0 u T o F t h E m 0 u N T a i N s

oblivion_fascinated.ability: The Stoyteller has 1 vote each day, & declares its use before voting begins: something good might happen to players who also vote.
oblivion_fascinated.flavor: Such a gorgeous melancholy. Laying down next to your grave. Your words, your majesty… your heart. I heard it like a posthumous songbird at my window, departed though time. Your Romantics have gone, their beauty lost to smog filled skies. But I know you. I know all about you. This garden is our Arcadia, your engraving my eclogue, thus I dance and sing around in glee like a child in a play. I shall talk to you forever, my lovely sweet departed poet. My myth.

oblivion_jetsetter.ability: Dead players don't use vote tokens on nominations you make. Players of your alignment you nominate might survive execution.
oblivion_jetsetter.flavor: I'm on my trip around the world and OMG! This town is just soooo forgotten-ghost-town-where-I-am-most-certainly-going-to-get-PTSD-from chic!

oblivion_reverist.ability: Once per game, publicly say a word. The following night, gain an ability which contains it.

oblivion_wiseguy.ability: Each day, ask the Storyteller for anything. If they agree, it occurs. Tonight, a different player learns what you asked for.
oblivion_wiseguy.otherNightReminder: If the Wise Guy asked for something yesterday, a different player learns what they asked for tonight.
oblivion_wiseguy.flavor: Heh! I'm the wise guy! Here's an offer you cannot refuse, meeting my little friend! Tommy Gunn! Pew! Pew! Blam! You're dead!!,, No! I killed you! You're dead! I said "unreversable and undodgeable"! Nuh uh you just didn't hear it! I'll tell Miss you're cheating! Meanie!

oblivion_artcritic.ability: The Storyteller announces the maximum number of Outsiders. If it would exceed that number, the Demon learns an extra bluff.
oblivion_artcritic.flavor: You wanted my sincere opinion darling, so why are you crying? This composition is horrendous, the palette makes me wish I was colour-blind or had forcibly tore out my own eyeballs at the age of 4, and the detailing on the fabric would make one assume that you've been nude and living in a concrete box without seeing the sun. Why are you mad? You asked for honesty.

oblivion_thurifer.ability: At night, if 2 or less players would live, some deaths may be prevented so 3 players live at dawn, & all learn this occurred.

oblivion_mythos.ability: The 1st executed player grants an on-script ability to the Storyteller. The Storyteller's ability can be drunk or poisoned.
oblivion_mythos.flavor: For a man who so despised the cold waves of the world, new passions were found in cosmic horrors. Naught more beautiful than the endless devouring mouths, seemingly coded to surpass the weak mortal mind. The folly of man, to expect that their ignorant species was more than a cog. It's well advised that you give power to these beings - before they're too far gone to even notice you.

oblivion_goddess.ability: After day 2, evil wins. Multiple games are played, & at least 1 player must be the same character as the last game.
oblivion_goddess.flavor: Humans always fall for their same sins. I’ve gotten bored of watching their failures again and again, always expecting more. I guess they got something right: I am certifiably insane.

oblivion_shapeshifter.ability: Each time a game ends, the script is modified & all players agree on how. The Storyteller may veto modifications.
oblivion_shapeshifter.flavor: To dream is to die, to die is to be reborn, to be reborn is to become a rabbit, and to be a rabbit is a joy most mortals will never comprehend.

darkartist_fellowman.ability: Each night, choose a player: if not the Demon, they are drunk until dusk.
darkartist_fellowman.firstNightReminder: The Fellowman chooses a player: if they're not the Demon, they're drunk until dusk.
darkartist_fellowman.otherNightReminder: The Fellowman chooses a player: if they're not the Demon, they're drunk until dusk.
darkartist_fellowman.flavor: Here, 'ave a sip of this. I made it myself!

darkartist_scribe.ability: Each night, if you nominated today, learn how many evil players voted on it.
darkartist_scribe.otherNightReminder: If the Scribe nominated today, wake them up, they learn how many evil players voted on their nomination.
darkartist_scribe.flavor: Yes, I have added your comment to the records of this meeting. Yes, I am aware that you’re gay, you’ve only mentioned it 6 times in the past hour. I have much more pressing matters to attend to at the moment… but meet me in my office after hours and we can discuss this transcript further.

darkartist_dianite.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die if they neighbor an evil player & aren't a Demon.
darkartist_dianite.otherNightReminder: Wake the Dianite: they point to a player, if that player has an evil neighbor, they die, so long as they're not the Demon.
darkartist_dianite.flavor: Come forth beings of darkness and hate and fight me like the beasts you are! The lives of the innocent are at hand.

darkartist_basiliskherder.ability: Each night, the 1st good & 1st evil player nominated by an Outsider are drunk until dusk.
darkartist_basiliskherder.flavor: Ain't gotta worry, they don't bite, just don't look at 'em. Don't worry 'bout 'em statues, been a while since we had any... incident.

darkartist_chantry.ability: Each night, choose a good character: if in-play, they die. Outsiders who die this way might keep their ability.
darkartist_chantry.flavor: May the hall echo my sentiments and my brothers echo the message. To all those who seek to repent be met with sympathy. To all outsiders have a home and place eternal. To all self aggrandising preachers be silent. We have one voice when the choir chants together.

darkartist_serendipitous.ability: Each night, learn if the most impactful good player was executed today. If so, & evil is executed tomorrow, good wins.
darkartist_serendipitous.flavor: Miracles are not simply the splitting of the sea or a legendary plague -- the fact that we were all here, together in this moment, that is a miracle all it's own..

darkartist_theolog.ability: Each day, visit the Storyteller to learn a topic they believe public discussion should veer towards today.
darkartist_theolog.flavor: I've heard a thousand of stories, weaved a thousand of tales, soared over a thousand of mountains & etched a thousand of stones. There's something beyond stardust, nowhere near an indescribable void; the thousand and first story, tale, mountain and stone.

darkartist_righteous.ability: Once per game, at night, choose that the dead ally with the best grasp on the gamestate rises.
darkartist_righteous.otherNightReminder: Wake the Righteous: they nod or shake their head, if they nod, raise the dead good player with the best grasp on the gamestate.
darkartist_righteous.flavor: Fallen soldier of light, may you rise and usher in a new dawn; guide our clouded minds into golden brilliance; coax out the shadows that kept you at bay and banish them to their deepest trenches. RISE.

darkartist_wayfarer.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a player that has nominated: learn if they nominated evil this game.

darkartist_incenseburner.ability: Once per game, at night, choose that the Demon learns some advice & you do too. You learn if they follow it.
darkartist_incenseburner.flavor: Intelligence is the knowledge of how tragedy might occur. Wisdom is the patience to understand why. The latter is what I might teach you, if you are willing to listen.

darkartist_maskbearer.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a player: they can't die at night, even if you're dead. Before this, you can't die at night.
darkartist_maskbearer.otherNightReminder: Wake the Maskbearer, they may choose a player: that player can't die at night, but the Maskbearer can.
darkartist_maskbearer.flavor: Adult souls that hide behind a mask, evil spirits that stalk the night.

darkartist_keysmith.ability: Once per game, during the day, choose a Demon & alter its ability by 1 word, if the Storyteller agrees. You die if chosen by them.
darkartist_keysmith.flavor: Locked out of the basement AGAIN?! You really need to stop giving your keys to your buddies; I swear, it's like you're doin' rituals down there with them!

darkartist_flamestoker.ability: On your 1st day, you may visit the Storyteller to gain an unlisted good ability: most get Townsfolk ones. [Some Townsfolk are Flamestokers]

darkartist_hotelier.ability: On the 1st night, choose a good character: the Demon thinks it's not-in-play & learns it as an additional bluff.
darkartist_hotelier.firstNightReminder: The Hotelier chooses a character: the Demon thinks it's not in play. Show it to them as if it were one of the Not-In-Play Characters they know.
darkartist_hotelier.flavor: Room 206? Yes, just down the hall and on your left, it should be clean and empty.

darkartist_ivypruner.ability: You must die under a specific condition, & can't die otherwise. Once per game, when dead, guess it & learn how accurate you are.
darkartist_ivypruner.flavor: I spend years, gathering fine soil and pure water. I cut exactly where I intend. And when my vision comes alive, I rest.

darkartist_sorrower.ability: If you die at night, publicly choose a good character: you gain that ability.
darkartist_sorrower.flavor: Woe to me, oh woe to me!

darkartist_metagnostic.ability: If you die at night, you learn 1 to 3 good characters the Storyteller believes could solve the game.
darkartist_metagnostic.flavor: To put ones faith into humanity is to put your faith into the hands of those who built our walls, raised our kingdoms and took care of our children. Doing so is putting one's faith in the hands of the only god to ever step foot on this earth.

darkartist_winetaster.ability: If you'd be drunk or poisoned, wake & choose a player: they are instead. You're sober & healthy.
darkartist_winetaster.firstNightReminder: If the Moonshiner would be drunk or poisoned, wake them, they choose a player: that player is now drunk or poisoned.
darkartist_winetaster.otherNightReminder: If the Moonshiner would be drunk or poisoned, wake them, they choose a player: that player is now drunk or poisoned.
darkartist_winetaster.flavor: Mmm. Good, but not for me. I'm sure a draught like this would be better appreciated by that young Trevor - perhaps I'll send him a bottle.

darkartist_queen.ability: If your neighbors are the same alignment, all learn the Queen's in play. You might be executed if you're mad you're the Queen.
darkartist_queen.firstNightReminder: If both of the Queens neighbors are the same alignment, before the day begins, announce the Queen being in play.
darkartist_queen.flavor: Let it be known that her Majesty shall not tolerate slander! Guards, take him!

darkartist_dryad.ability: If at least 1 good player voted on a nomination & more evil players than good players did, all players learn so.
darkartist_dryad.flavor: When you trudged through my forest, I saw you. When you whispered together, I heard you. And when you threw corpses into my grove, you hoped I would forget. I did not.

darkartist_houndsmaster.ability: The 1st time you nominate an evil & don't execute them, an ally rises tonight, even if you're dead.
darkartist_houndsmaster.flavor: The caterwauling will never stop, not even in your sleep. Me and my familiars have been acquainted with you, and we will stay imprinted in your vision, mind, and soul, until we take back... what's... ours.

darkartist_moonshiner.ability: Players who nominate you are drunk until dusk tomorrow.
darkartist_moonshiner.otherNightReminder: If a player nominated the Moonshiner, mark that player with the "Drunk" token.
darkartist_moonshiner.flavor: Whiskey. Amber. Distilled. I do it in the woods so they can't catch me. They never check the woods. Especially at night. Illicit. Bootlegged. 40%. I'm just an enthusiast - you have your hobbies. Mine's just more involved. Undesirable. Fraud. Intoxicated.

darkartist_villein.ability: 1 Minion is drunk, but may, at any time, publicly choose that you die (they know this).

darkartist_mourner.ability: You start knowing a player & their character. If they die by execution, you turn evil tonight (even if dead).
darkartist_mourner.firstNightReminder: Point to a player: the Mourner learns their character.
darkartist_mourner.otherNightReminder: If the player the Mourner knows dies by execution, wake them up: they're now evil.
darkartist_mourner.flavor: You took the sun from me, and now you're surprised my heart's turned cold?

darkartist_bootblack.ability: Each night, choose a player you haven't before: the 1st time they're evil, become evil.
darkartist_bootblack.firstNightReminder: The Bootblack wakes and points at a player: if they're evil, the Bootblack becomes evil.
darkartist_bootblack.otherNightReminder: The Bootblack wakes and points at a player: if they're evil, the Bootblack becomes evil.
darkartist_bootblack.flavor: I wouldn't say I've turned on my friends... more just 'under new management!

darkartist_doorman.ability: Each night, 1 evil player (evil chooses which) may choose a player: they die. You learn who was attacked.
darkartist_doorman.flavor: You live here, sir? Oh, just moving in? Certainly, I'll sign off on those papers; just a bit of water damage here, but I'm sure it's no bother. Cause no trouble, now.

darkartist_cassandra.ability: You have a not-in-play Townsfolk's ability. After day 3, your team loses.
darkartist_cassandra.firstNightReminder: Mark the Cassandra down with the DAY 1 reminder token. If they would wake for their ability, wake them.
darkartist_cassandra.otherNightReminder: Mark the Cassandra down with the following reminder token or declare that evil wins. If they would wake for their ability, wake them.
darkartist_cassandra.flavor:
Apollo, Apollo!
God of all ways, but only Death's to me,
Once and again, O thou, Destroyer named,
Thou hast destroyed me, thou, my love of old!

darkartist_elder.ability: You know 1 Demon player. You learn true, sober & healthy info. [+1 Demon]

darkartist_omen.ability: When the Demon dies (ending the game): you die tonight, they live, register as dead & wake every other night, even if you're dead.
darkartist_omen.otherNightReminder: If the Demon would die by execution, mark them down with the "Living" reminder. At night, if the Omen is still lives, they die.
darkartist_omen.flavor: Ο τροχός τελειώνει αμέσως. Εμείς που κάποτε αναζητούσαμε τα ύψη των θεών, τώρα τρέμουμε σαν μυρμήγκια. Αφήστε τις ψυχές μας να λυπηθούν για ένα δευτερόλεπτο ακόμα.

darkartist_belltoll.ability: If you died yesterday or yesterday night, rise & switch alignment tonight.

darkartist_alebrewer.ability: If you die, from now on, the 1st & 2nd good players to vote each day are drunk until they vote again (at least until tomorrow).

darkartist_dockworker.ability: If the Demon's the 1st executed evil, they don't die. Once, the Demon chooses who you are & you lose this ability. [You don't start in-play]
darkartist_dockworker.flavor: Hooray. Another day makes another dollar, and I must admit, that's decent pay. Alas madam, I'm gettin' a little thin around the edges today. Might I ask if you have a second firepit in a house this nice for a little old me?

darkartist_anthropologist.ability: If no alive player (not yourself or Travellers) claimed their character during nominations, evil wins tonight (even if you died today).
darkartist_anthropologist.flavor: Humanity is the most wonderful species there is -- a shame then that some choose to be more animal than human.

darkartist_childoflir.ability: All know who you are. Half the players (rounded down) may be executed on your 1st day. On your 3rd, evil wins. You can't be executed.
darkartist_childoflir.firstNightReminder: Before the day begins, announce who the Child of Lir is. Mark them down with the DAY 1 reminder.
darkartist_childoflir.otherNightReminder: Mark the Child of Lir with the DAY 2 reminder, or announce that evil wins.
darkartist_childoflir.flavor: I've sailed across a thousand ponds in my dreams. I've plucked many a grape from the vine, and sailed infront of Parisian royalty. The midnight streams and fountains, they're never the same now. This journey shall be our last, and as the palace crashes down... I shall be it's swansong.

darkartist_epigone.ability: The 1st time a player would be drunk, poisoned or get false info, you learn them instead. Tomorrow, all Townsfolk info is arbitrary (even if dead).

darkartist_roifaineant.ability: Minions know which Minion the Demon doesn't know. The Demon thinks they're evil. [+1 Minion, the Demon is good]
darkartist_roifaineant.firstNightReminder: During Minion Info, point to the Minion that the Demon doesn't know and show all the Minions the Roi Fainéant token.
darkartist_roifaineant.flavor: Do you remember the golden age? When we were seen together... a power couple. Oh time has stolen from us... you've dulled... your jewels depress me, they don't shine any more... now you're just metal... oh time...

darkartist_bogdweller.ability: Tonight, if you were nominated today (even if dead), the Demon may choose a player: they're poisoned until dusk.
darkartist_bogdweller.otherNightReminder: If the Bog Dweller was nominated today, wake the Demon: they may choose a player - they're poisoned until dusk.
darkartist_bogdweller.flavor: Swamp don't hurt nobody. WAIT DON'T DO THAT THAT WILL KILL YOU! But everything other than that is perfectly fine out here...

darkartist_faeling.ability: Each night, choose a character: to good abilities, you register as them & their alignment until dusk.
darkartist_faeling.flavor: I almost forgot to introduce myself! My name is Eleanor, and I'd love to have your name, dear.

darkartist_lullaby.ability: Each night, guess a good player's character: if correct, they might register as evil & as a Minion until dusk.
darkartist_lullaby.otherNightReminder: Each night, choose a good player and guess their character: if correct, they might register as evil & as a Minion until dusk.
darkartist_lullaby.flavor:
Quiet little shadow, don't say a word
I'll manifest you a mockingbird
But if your mockingbird falls ill
I'd change the world to fit your will.

darkartist_modiste.ability: Each night, choose a character you haven't before (only 1 Demon): you learn if they are in-play & have their ability until dusk.
darkartist_modiste.firstNightReminder: Mark the Modiste down with the "Is the Modiste" reminder. The Modiste wakes and chooses a character, if they are in-play, nod, if they aren't, shake your head. If that character would wake tonight, wake them when that character would. If they chose a Demon, mark the Modiste with the "1 Demon" reminder. If they chose an in-play character, mark that character with the "Has ability" token, otherwise, change the Modiste's token in the Grimoire to the one they chose.
darkartist_modiste.otherNightReminder: The Modiste wakes and chooses a character, if they are in-play, nod, if they aren't, shake your head. If that character would wake tonight, wake them when that character would. If they chose a Demon, mark the Modiste with the "1 Demon" reminder. If they chose an in-play character, mark that character with the "Has ability" token, otherwise, change the Modiste's token in the Grimoire to the one they chose.
darkartist_modiste.flavor: I am but a humble hat maker, ma'am.

darkartist_cathedral.ability: Each night, choose if today's executee is resurrected (the Demon must be): their team loses if executed again, even if you're dead.
darkartist_cathedral.flavor: For the scriptures hath said, 'The work of our Lord is eternal.' Deus noster fortis est. That which is eternal may never change! Aeternitas bona est. Let he who would forsake eternity forsake all that which is holy and good. Poena sceleri digna est. Amen.

darkartist_viscount.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a player: they die & register as living during the day.

darkartist_haunt.ability: On your 1st night, choose a good player: whatever they're mad is true while alive might become false. The 1st time 1 of you is executed, all learn this.
darkartist_haunt.flavor: Alba was a loving mother, daughter, sister, and friend. She was creative, fun, caring, and loving like no one else. She enjoyed discussing music, art, and various forms of predicting the future. She always carried a wisdom with her, that in retrospect, we all wish we understood better. She will forever be in our hearts, and at times, it feels like she never left. May Alba rest in peace.

darkartist_falseprophet.ability: On the final day, if an alive player is executed, their team wins, even if you're dead.
darkartist_falseprophet.flavor: They sacrificed to demons that were no gods, to gods they had never known, to new gods that had come recently, whom your fathers had never dreaded.

darkartist_songstress.ability: You & a good player know of the other's character: if you guess them while they live (once), your team wins.
darkartist_songstress.firstNightReminder: Wake the Songstress and show them an in-play good character.
darkartist_songstress.otherNightReminder: Wake the Songstress in case they want to guess in private.
darkartist_songstress.flavor: I could never be enough for you to love me... so I swore. I swore to prove I was enough to be your worst nightmare.

darkartist_royalguard.ability: If a player evil would benefit from keeping alive would die, you might instead & they gain this ability.

darkartist_akiryo.ability: If no alive good player claimed to be Akiryo today, your team wins. If you did & are executed, 1 good who did might become an evil Akiryo.
darkartist_akiryo.otherNightReminder: If the Akiryo was executed after claiming to be the Akiryo, wake up an alive good player, tell them that they are now an evil Akiryo.
darkartist_akiryo.flavor:
Festival of flame.
Offer thy flesh as kindling.
The great ash awaits.

darkartist_starspawn.ability: If 5 or more non-Travellers live & 1 evil died, register as & gain an ability based on them: 1 good may visit the Storyteller to learn a hint about it.
darkartist_starspawn.flavor: You were a novel specimen, to be sure. But you were held back by your pathetic 'evolution'. Your assimilation shall create a far superior entity this solar cycle.

darkartist_breathsnatch.ability: The 1st time evil would die, they don't. For each Outsider executed, the next time evil would die, they don't. [+1 Outsider]
darkartist_breathsnatch.flavor: And for every pariah silenced, a new voice on the wind screams for the madness to end.

darkartist_bloodless.ability: The 1st time a Demon dies, see the Grimoire tonight & play for 1 more day: if good or no-one is executed, an evil becomes the Demon.

darkartist_ghoul.ability: The 1st good player to nominate a Ghoul secretly (& immediately) becomes an evil Ghoul. Each night, choose if they learn this.

darkartist_styx.ability: Dead evil players might rise, even if you're dead. The Demon may (once) swap characters with a Styx.
darkartist_styx.firstNightReminder: Wake the Demon, show them the Styx token, if they nod, swap their characters.
darkartist_styx.otherNightReminder: Wake the Demon, show them the Styx token, if they nod, swap their characters. If you deem so, rise any dead evil players you want.
darkartist_styx.flavor: WE WILL NOT GO WILLINGLY. NOT BY YOUR SWORDS NOR CROSSES, STONES OR SHOVELS. YOU WILL DIE DEEPER THAN YOU CAN BURY US.

darkartist_vespertine.ability: 1 good player starts knowing you're 1 of 2 players (you know which). You have an unlisted Minion ability.
darkartist_vespertine.flavor: Forget not my trail of dreams. Understand them, even through the haze of pain.

darkartist_gasanthesheshu.ability: For each good player who's mad that you're in play, 1 good player might die at any time (until 2 nights from now).
darkartist_gasanthesheshu.flavor: Beacon. Bright. Stolen. Light. Humans. Thieves. Humans. Die. Humans. Will. Return. The Beacon. Humans. Will. Return. The Light.

darkartist_folly.ability: 1 Outsider knows you're in-play. Players who are mad an Outsider is an Outsider might be executed. [+0 or +1 Outsider]
darkartist_folly.flavor: Darling, the accounts aren't in order - the Rosehip Estate hasn't paid off their share of the retreat we took last April! Such a shame. Take them off the mailing list, they SHAN'T be receiving the champagne I SPECIFICALLY ordered for them. Awh. Boo-hoo.

darkartist_justice.ability: Nominations you don't vote for fail. If you or the Demon were nominated & you didn't vote, or if they die, lose your ability tonight.
darkartist_justice.flavor: Your hammers build great structures, ships sail vast seas, ploughs grow the tallest grasses and scythes cull them for the finest flours. But the sword was never yours to wield.

darkartist_diabolosexdeus.ability: Each night, you & the Storyteller may each choose a player (they must): both die
darkartist_diabolosexdeus.otherNightReminder: Wake the Diabolos Ex Deus, they may point to a player: they die. You then point at another player: they die.
darkartist_diabolosexdeus.flavor: MY DEAR KING AND COUNTRYMEN! Your new god harks his first command, as he sees the new world created anew from the innocent flicker to the bleating of a lamb born pre-winter. From dedication and resilience we banish the hellish facade of the prior disgusting world and embrace this, perfect utopia. Research your doctrine, ponder the scripture, and sit silently and willingly to the faultless sanctimony. Yes.... yes.... perfect.

darkartist_conspiracy.ability: Each night, choose a player: learn their character. Each night, choose a player: they die.
darkartist_conspiracy.firstNightReminder: The Conspiracy wakes and chooses a player: they learn their character.
darkartist_conspiracy.otherNightReminder: The Conspiracy wakes and chooses a player: they learn their character. If they shake their head yes, the player dies. If they shake their head no, put them to sleep and kill a player.
darkartist_conspiracy.flavor: You live in a broken reality. I offer you a substitute.

darkartist_dreydra.ability: Each night, Dreydras wake & each chooses a player: they die. The 1st Minion to die becomes a Dreydra.
darkartist_dreydra.otherNightReminder: Wake all Dreydra together, each chooses a player: they die. The 1st time a Minion dies, wake them up, show them the Dreydra token and then let them choose. Dreydra may silently coordinate at this point.
darkartist_dreydra.flavor: Hercules clubbed off the monster's nine heads. He burned them. But one head refused to die.

darkartist_donjuan.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Your execution fails if an alive Outsider voted. [+1 Outsider]
darkartist_donjuan.flavor: Así en tardos pasos, todos murmurando, el lúgubre entierro ya cerca llegó, y la blanca dama devota rezando, entrambas rodillas en tierra dobló.

darkartist_hangedblood.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. If an evil player executes you before the final day, you can't die today.
darkartist_hangedblood.flavor: A scholar once taught his students that one is safest in the company of friends. The knife — cough — through his heart proved a succint rebuttal.

darkartist_ivyth.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. If 5 or more players live, 1 good player learns when you die & a Minion becomes Ivyth.
darkartist_ivyth.flavor: A god cannot be killed, merely its idols destroyed.

darkartist_twincyn.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. If 5 or more residents live, the 1st to kill a Twincyn by execution becomes an evil Twincyn.
darkartist_twincyn.flavor: What is in the center of a man: can He ever understand all that He is made of?

darkartist_gestalt.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. If another evil's died, register as dead from now. [If you neighbor evil, become another Demon]

darkartist_aunemoia.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. 1 Outsider's poisoned, if they die, their living Townsfolk neighbors are instead. [+1 Outsider]
darkartist_aunemoia.otherNightReminder: Wake the Aunemoia, they point to a player: they die.
darkartist_aunemoia.flavor: Do you feel it? The neon blues of the sunset? The deep red of the water whilst you lie in the orange grass? It's just like when you were younger, when things were simpler, believe me.

darkartist_plea.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. If an Outsider died today, deaths tonight are arbitrary & you don't wake tomorrow. [+1 Outsider]
darkartist_plea.otherNightReminder: Wake the Plea, they point to a player: they die. Or, if an Outsider died today or tonight, deaths are arbitrary.
darkartist_plea.flavor: Pray, if you feel so inclined. Pray for forgiveness before the altar of the ones you forgot, the pestilence and plague, the lives you destroyed, the riots, the malaise. Pray for comfort in your final moments… and maybe, just maybe, your groveling will mean something for once.

darkartist_vitrichor.ability: Each night, all Vitrichor wake & choose 1 player: they die. If good nominates but doesn't execute a Minion, the Minion becomes Vitrichor.

darkartist_oivasyr.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Once, if executed & a living player claimed their character today, live & register as dead. [-1 Outsider]
darkartist_oivasyr.otherNightReminder: Wake the Oivasyr, they point to a player: they die.
darkartist_oivasyr.flavor:
The way below winds deeper, longer.
Unspeakables it's patterns laid.
The lost forever damned to wander.

darkartist_regentofpride.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die (unless the King died at night). Once the King dies, the team of the 1st alive executee wins. [+ the King]
darkartist_regentofpride.flavor: At last, his loyalists are dead. All is ready for Our coronation. Come forth, peon. Anoint your rightful ruler in blood and be rejoined to Our sacred realm.

darkartist_rancoeur.ability: Each night, choose 2 players: the 1st dies, if the 2nd executes you (before final day), their team loses. If the 2nd changes, the old 1 learns it.
darkartist_rancoeur.otherNightReminder: Wake the Rancoeur, they point to a player: they die. They point to a second: mark them with the RANCOROUS token -- if the RANCOROUS token has moved players, wake the player who used to have it and show them the Rancoeur token.
darkartist_rancoeur.flavor: Forgiveness can only heal so much if the recipient has not forgiven themselves.

darkartist_faurein.ability: You think you're an Outsider. Each night, Minions choose a player: they die - if you would & they're mad you're good, register as dead.
darkartist_faurein.otherNightReminder: Wake the Minions, they point to a player: they die.
darkartist_faurein.flavor: Where does power lie in a Kingdom? Is it the King? The Nobles? The Lords? Non, it is but the commonfolk- nay, Outcasts!- like us: and claim it, I shall.

darkartist_badoch.ability: A player dies each night. You don't know you're the Badoch & might learn it if nominated. Minions don't know you. [+1 Minion]
darkartist_badoch.otherNightReminder: Choose a player: they die. If the Badoch was nominated, you may choose to tell them so.
darkartist_badoch.flavor: Just like everyone else... Human... Just like everyone else... Just like everyone else... Human... Human... Just like... Human...

mistfits_naiad.ability: You start knowing 1 in-play Minion. Once per game, at night, choose that until dusk, you have their ability & they are drunk.
mistfits_naiad.flavor: I never understand mortals. How strange must it be, locked into one form by the whims of chance. Let your body flow like water. Just for tonight, let yourself flow with the waves

mistfits_reeve.ability: You start knowing 3 players: exactly 1 is a Minion. Each night, choose which is drunk & recieves false info. (Demons are safe)
mistfits_reeve.flavor: Causing trouble again, eh? Not in my town! Boys, take em' away!

mistfits_swordfighter.ability: Each night, choose a player. If you chose a Minion, the Damsel learns who they are [+the Damsel]
mistfits_swordfighter.flavor: Come, my love. Stay by my side & none shall harm you

mistfits_trapsmith.ability: Each night, choose 2 players (not yourself). The 1st time the Demon attacks either tonight, they must choose someone else instead.
mistfits_trapsmith.otherNightReminder: The previously protected lose their markers. The Trapper points to two players. The 1st time the Demon chooses one, they are prompted to choose again.
mistfits_trapsmith.flavor: Ok, I remember now! Red tiles are impassable, yellow electrocutes you, and green is the bees with teeth. Or wait, was that purple?

mistfits_aristocrat.ability: Once per game, at night, choose 3 players: the one who is most correct dies.
mistfits_aristocrat.otherNightReminder: The Aristocrat points to three players. The most correct of the three dies.
mistfits_aristocrat.flavor: I don’t think you understand. This wasn’t an act of malice. It was an act of jealousy thinly disguised as malice.

mistfits_mentor.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a player: the Demon learns you both. If they kill you after this, learn who they are.
mistfits_mentor.firstNightReminder: The Mentor either shakes their head no or points to a player. Put the Mentor to sleep. Wake the Demon. Show them the 'This character selcted you' card and the Mentor token. Point to the Mentor and their chosen player, then put the Demon back to sleep. Place the 'Duel' reminder on the Mentor
mistfits_mentor.otherNightReminder: If the Mentor has not yet used their ability: The Mentor either shakes their head no or points to a player. Put the Mentor to sleep. Wake the Demon. Show them the 'This character selcted you' card and the Mentor token. Point to the Mentor and their chosen player, then put the Demon back to sleep. Place the 'Duel' reminder on the Mentor
mistfits_mentor.flavor: Strike me down and a new hope shall rise!

mistfits_brawler.ability: On your 1st night, 1 Minion player may choose to be drunk (you learn this). If they don't & are executed, good wins.
mistfits_brawler.flavor: Pay attention to my fists or you'll be taking a dirt nap real fast!

mistfits_legate.ability: On the final night, alive Minions become good, even if you die.
mistfits_legate.flavor: Look inside yourself. Have you really done the right thing? And, considering what you've done... What will you do now? That... that's something only you can answer

mistfits_pythagorean.ability: On the 3rd night, Minions & Demons each choose a good player to register falsely to you. Then, choose 3 players: learn their characters.
mistfits_pythagorean.otherNightReminder: If it is the 3rd night, wake the Minions & Demon. They each point to a good player. Put them back to sleep. Afterwards, wake the Pythagorean. They point to 3 players. Show those player's character tokens (if unchosen by evil) or any other character token.
mistfits_pythagorean.flavor: And He said, 'Let A^2 plus B^2 equal C^2

mistfits_council.ability: You & 1 Minion know the same alive Townsfolk character.
mistfits_council.flavor: Mister Morozov, I know you and I both have our differences. But you must concede, we both benefit from this arrangement. A world in darkness leaves everyone blind.

mistfits_demigod.ability: You can’t die unless you are the last living Townsfolk. If a good player nominates you, you are drunk.
mistfits_demigod.flavor: Rhythyms of war beat in thy heart. The blood in thy veins hath set ablaze. Let no man or woman, god or titan, stand in our way! May the Fates grant this day… to the strongest!

mistfits_champion.ability: The 1st time the Demon would kill you, choose a player: they die instead. The Demon can’t die this way
mistfits_champion.otherNightReminder: If the Champion would be killed by a Demon for the 1st time,The Champion points to a player. That player dies & the Champion does not
mistfits_champion.flavor: Through my tears, I am transcendent. Through my love, I am overpowering. Through my resolve, I am everlasting.

mistfits_harbormaster.ability: The 1st good player (not yourself) to publicly claim their character is safe from evil.
mistfits_harbormaster.flavor: Will the owner of a cyan caravel please come to the front desk? Three human corpses are hanging from your vessel.

mistfits_inkmaker.ability: 1 of the Demon's bluffs is an in-play evil character instead. You start knowing which character.
mistfits_inkmaker.flavor: Its a lovely shade of blue, but it doesn't compliment your claws. May I suggest scarlet instead?

mistfits_luminary.ability: You have another Townsfolk ability. If Gloom is in play, you’re healthy & they can't choose you

mistfits_vintner.ability: You start knowing 3 players: 1 good player you know is drunk. Minions & Demons choose if you learn them.

mistfits_miser.ability: On your 1st night, choose 3 players. While any of them live, you are evil, even if dead, drunk, or poisoned.

mistfits_fauxdeity.ability: On your 1st night, learn a true statement: all other info about it, from Townsfolk, is false (even if dead).
mistfits_fauxdeity.flavor: Lo and behold! The word of my Scriptures is breathed into perfection! Unmatched by the greatest of mortal tomes! Wait... you say that dinosaur fossils are too old for a 6000 year old planet? Let me fix that real quick.

mistfits_sycophant.ability: You think you are a Townsfolk. Evil characters start knowing you are the Sycophant & the token you saw. 1 good player learns if you die.
mistfits_sycophant.firstNightReminder: Wake all the Minions and the Demons. Show them the 'This character selected you' card token, the Sycophant player, and the Townsfolk token they recieved
mistfits_sycophant.otherNightReminder: If the Sycophant died: wake a good player and show the Sycophant character token.
mistfits_sycophant.flavor: Yes, I agree! No real detective would own a 49-chip magnifying glass. Only a malicious imposter would possess such a thing! Truly, what would we do without your incredible deductive prowess?

mistfits_simulacrum.ability: If the Demon dies & 5 or more players live (not Travellers), they keep their ability, learn you, & you become "the Demon."
mistfits_simulacrum.flavor: My existence is... service... I do not comprehend your... request?

mistfits_rat.ability: The Demon knows who the alive Rats are. Each night, they may choose which becomes the evil Minion they replaced. [+1 Rat, -1 Minion]
mistfits_rat.firstNightReminder: Wake the Demon. Show them the Rat token & point to the alive Rat players. The Demon points to one or shakes their head. Inform the Rat of their new alignment
mistfits_rat.otherNightReminder: Wake the Demon. Show them the Rat token & point to the alive Rat players. The Demon points to one or shakes their head. Inform the Rat of their new alignment
mistfits_rat.flavor: My nose knows all. Does yours?

mistfits_investor.ability: 1 Townsfolk might register as evil & as a Demon, even if you die. If they would die at night, another player might die instead.
mistfits_investor.flavor: I have never once concerned myself with your affairs. Do not concern yourself with my clientele.

mistfits_draugr.ability: Each night, choose a player: they are safe from you. If you haven't chosen an alive Minion when you die, another player dies tonight.

mistfits_tipster.ability: You are evil if (& only if) a Minion lives. If you die, you become good.
mistfits_tipster.flavor: I ain't a fool. In the races, you always stick with the winning horse. Convince me that's you and then we'll talk.

mistfits_cendrillon.ability: You start knowing 5 in-play characters. Each night, choose a player & guess their character. The 1st correct choice dies.
mistfits_cendrillon.flavor: Please do not let the bells sound for midnight. That voice whispers 'Thrust the edge you hold and take away everything.

mistfits_winegremlin.ability: Each day, 1 good chooses 2 alive non-Travellers, or you choose 1 tonight: to Townsfolk, they register as evil Demons until next choice.
mistfits_winegremlin.otherNightReminder: If no good player chose 2 others today, the Wiine Gremlin wakes & points at a player.
mistfits_winegremlin.flavor: Aw, c'mon! You've had such a long day. One more sip won't hurt. One more glass won't hurt. One more bottle won't hurt. Just drown your sorrows out!

mistfits_trader.ability: You know a night & a Minion ability you have. On that night, your ability is replaced & 1 good player learns your old one.
mistfits_trader.flavor: Hmmm… nope this one sucks. NEXT!

mistfits_carmilla.ability: You start by seeing the Grimoire & choose 2 players: the 1st becomes a Demon you wake for, the 2nd thinks it & is drunk, even if dead. [No Demon]
mistfits_carmilla.flavor: She came into my life like a summer storm. Her lips were warm and sweet, yet now I lie sick, like the girls outside. She tells me that it’s not a curse, but a blessing. I… I’m scared that she’s telling the truth

mistfits_titan.ability: If you die at night, you don't & wake to gain all Minion abilities. Otherwise, you know & have a not-in-play Townsfolk's.
mistfits_titan.flavor: You watched me hold the sky alone for all these years. But you never considered what would happen if I let go.

mistfits_eclipse.ability: Only evil players wake while you live. Good wins on your 3rd dawn.
mistfits_eclipse.flavor: No star shined on that night. The dark had swallowed us whole.

mistfits_cataphractos.ability: Each night, choose 2 players: the 1st dies. If the 2nd neighbors an alive Minion, they also die.
mistfits_cataphractos.otherNightReminder: The Cataphractos points to two players. The 1st dies. The 2nd dies if they neighbor an alive Minion
mistfits_cataphractos.flavor: You have done well bringing me here. But I will not allow you to simply hide in the bushes. If you truly wish to earn my favor, you must paint your own hands with blood. You will do this or you will join my victims.

mistfits_switchblame.ability: Each night, you may choose 2 players (all learn which) If both are evil, they swap characters. After Day 4, evil wins
mistfits_switchblame.firstNightReminder: The Switchblame either shows a 'no' head signal, or points to 2 players. If they chose only evil players: Swap the character tokens. Wake each player. Show 'You are', then their new character token.
mistfits_switchblame.otherNightReminder: The Switchblame either shows a 'no' head signal, or points to 2 players. If they chose only evil players: Swap the character tokens. Wake each player. Show 'You are', then their new character token.
mistfits_switchblame.flavor: What a stunning accusation! Excuse me while I sit over here. It's much more relaxing seeing an ax behind someone else.

mistfits_tauxin.ability: Each night, choose a player: if Townsfolk, they are poisoned until dusk. Each night, you may kill who you chose tonight.

mistfits_haerbrake.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. On the 1st night & day, you might register as good & as an Outsider. [-1 Outsider]
mistfits_haerbrake.otherNightReminder: The Haerbrake points to a player. That player dies.
mistfits_haerbrake.flavor: Pardon, but I am new here. Do you know where all the innocents are? Sorry. I meant inn. Where is inn full of sleeping guests? Thank you for direction.

mistfits_bloodwhiff.ability: After 1 day for each expected evil player, evil wins. If you added a Minion, evil wins after day 6. All know you're in-play. [-1 or +1 Minion]
mistfits_bloodwhiff.flavor: If you want to go fast, go alone. If you want to go far, go together.

mistfits_agregore.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. On the final day, votes by Minions secretly don’t count. [+1 Minion]
mistfits_agregore.flavor: You made me in your own image. You did it through sheer terror and who could blame you? But save your prayers. The day of judgement is upon you.

mistfits_gloom.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. 2 Townsfolk are poisoned: you know 1 [+the Luminary]

mistfits_mizacor.ability: On odd days, everyone learns how many Mizacor live. After day 6, evil wins. [+1 Mizacor]
mistfits_mizacor.flavor: In glory, we dance together. Our radiance outshines the empty cosmos. And when your world is frozen over, we will dance forever more.

mistfits_executive.ability: You have 7 vote tokens & may give them to other players. Players may spend your token to vote twice. ﻿Your tokens depart with you.
mistfits_executive.flavor: It has come to my attention that you feel 'underpaid'. and I hear you, I do. So how's about this? From now on, the Employee of the Month will earn a responsibility bonus. Think of that one dollar up for grabs!

mistfits_alderman.ability: Each dawn, you may publicly choose 2 alive players. Until dusk, if both vote, it counts twice - otherwise it doesn’t at all.

mistfits_fleecer.ability: If a player agrees, something good happens to them tonight. If you laugh as you leave, something bad happens to them instead.
mistfits_fleecer.flavor: We put the FUN in no refunds!!

mistfits_gentry.ability: Players may not vote on their own nominations without your permission.
mistfits_gentry.flavor: I'm sorry. Who told you this was a democracy?

brewulation_augurbb.ability: Each night, choose a player: you learn the character the Storyteller believes that player should consider most.
brewulation_augurbb.firstNightReminder: The Augur points to a player. Show 1 character token.
brewulation_augurbb.otherNightReminder: The Augur points to a player. Show 1 character token.
brewulation_augurbb.flavor: Yes, I see a well-dressed man adorned with a monocle and tall hat… he’s smoking a cigar and, yes, laughing. Would you know why?

brewulation_dwarfbb.ability: Each night, you learn a character mad as the Dwarf. For each mad Minion, a Dwarf gets false info. [+0 to +2 Dwarves]
brewulation_dwarfbb.otherNightReminder: Wake the Dwarves one at a time and show them a character token.

jinxes.reason: If there is a spare token, the Boffin can give the Demon the Dwarf ability.
If there is a spare token, the Pit-Hag can create an extra Dwarf.

brewulation_dwarfbb.flavor: To dig and dig makes us free, come on brothers, sing with me!

brewulation_foragerbb.ability: Each night, choose a player: you learn if they are odd in their character’s section of the script sheet.
brewulation_foragerbb.firstNightReminder: The Forager points to a player. Nod or shake your head.
brewulation_foragerbb.otherNightReminder: The Forager points to a player. Nod or shake your head.

brewulation_grazierbb.ability: On your 1st night, choose a player: if good, they are drunk & each night, might die & swap characters with you.
brewulation_grazierbb.otherNightReminder: The Grazier’s chosen player might die. If they do, wake the Grazier & show them the YOU ARE reminder card & token of the chosen player. Put them to sleep. Then wake the Grazier’s chosen player, show them the YOU ARE reminder card & Grazier token. Put them to sleep.
brewulation_grazierbb.flavor: How the winds are laughing. They laugh with all their might. Laugh and laugh the whole day through, and half the summer’s night.

brewulation_historianbb.ability: Each night, if the last public statement you made has changed truth value, you lose your ability & learn this.
brewulation_historianbb.otherNightReminder: If the Historian’s most recent public statement was true & is now false, or vice versa, wake the Historian, show them the THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU info card & the Historian token. Put them to sleep.
brewulation_historianbb.flavor: No, vomitoriums weren’t actually used for purging food, and no, iron maidens weren’t used as a torture device, and yes, the Earth is actually flat, and no, Vikings did not have horns on their helmets!

brewulation_paladinbb.ability: Each night, choose 2 alive players (the Demon knows who): all other players (except you) can’t die tonight.
brewulation_paladinbb.otherNightReminder: The Paladin chooses 2 players. Put them to sleep. Wake the Demon. Show them the Paladin token & point at the 2 players the Paladin chose.

jinxes.reason: Outsiders do not need to be able to die to become a Fang Gu.
If the Leviathan nominates and executes anyone not chosen by the Paladin (or the Paladin themselves), good wins.
Only 1 jinxed character may be in play.
If Riot nominates and executes anyone not chosen by the Paladin (or the Paladin themselves), good wins.
The Vortox learns which players the Paladin chooses.

brewulation_paladinbb.flavor: Those of you who are strong, and brave, and willing to risk your lives for the greatest good... stand alongside me! Alongside my holy hammer! Together, we can protect this town from these demonic forces! United, we can combat this darkness with our holy light!

brewulation_pontiffbb.ability: You start knowing a statement. If it is true & 5 or more players live, you cannot die. (Travellers don’t count)
brewulation_pontiffbb.firstNightReminder: Choose a statement. Wake the Pontiff and show them the statement.
brewulation_pontiffbb.flavor: With knowledge comes faith, and with faith comes resolve.

brewulation_psychopompbb.ability: Each dusk, you may visit the Storyteller to learn a fact. If you do & today’s executee was evil, you are drunk from now on.
brewulation_psychopompbb.flavor: We’ve been waiting for you for a while now. Walk with us. I’m sure you have a lot of questions.

brewulation_shrinemaidenbb.ability: Each night, you learn a player that is sober, healthy, & has not gotten false info since dawn.
brewulation_shrinemaidenbb.firstNightReminder: Show a sober & healthy player that has not gotten false info since dawn.
brewulation_shrinemaidenbb.otherNightReminder: Show a sober & healthy player that has not gotten false info since dawn.
brewulation_shrinemaidenbb.flavor: 世界を守り、光を守り、未来を祈る。

brewulation_stowawaybb.ability: If you die at night, choose a player: they gain a Traveller ability & learn this.
brewulation_stowawaybb.otherNightReminder: If the Stowaway died tonight, they wake to choose a player. Put the Stowaway to sleep. Wake the chosen player and show them which Traveller ability they have gained.

jinxes.reason: Each night, the Leviathan chooses an alive player (different to previous nights): a chosen Stowaway dies & uses their ability.
Each night, Riot chooses an alive player (different to previous nights): a chosen Stowaway dies & uses their ability.
If the Vortox kills the Stowaway, the player chosen by the Stowaway learns which Traveller ability they gained.

brewulation_stowawaybb.flavor: No, no, you are not sharing my barrel! You’re lucky I’m not telling anybody about this, though that’d uh, put me in trouble too. Still! Just, wake me up when we get there at least.

brewulation_valkyriebb.ability: If you nominate & execute a player, dead voters (if all were Townsfolk) rise & at dawn, no matter what, all but 3 players die.
brewulation_valkyriebb.otherNightReminder: If it is Ragnarök, kill all but 3 players at dawn.
brewulation_valkyriebb.flavor: Come with me. Follow me to Valhalla. Ragnarök awaits.

brewulation_architectbb.ability: If more than 1 opposing player was nominated by players of your alignment today, you change alignment tonight.
brewulation_architectbb.otherNightReminder: If more than 1 opposing player was nominated by the Architect’s allies yesterday, they change alignment. Wake them and inform them of their new alignment.

jinxes.reason: The Demon cannot have the Architect ability.
If the Pit-Hag turns an evil player into the Architect, they can’t turn good due to their own ability.

brewulation_architectbb.flavor: Stick to the plan, people! I designed it this way for a reason.

brewulation_crabberbb.ability: Once per game, at night, you & the Demon may choose that it wakes twice (not at all, if you both do) tonight, even if dead.
brewulation_crabberbb.otherNightReminder: Wake the Crabber, they shake or nod their head. Put them to sleep. Wake the Demon and show them the Crabber token, they shake or nod their head. Put them to sleep. If neither choose this, the Demon doesn’t wake twice. If exactly 1 did, the Demon wakes twice. If both chose this, the Demon doesn’t wake.

jinxes.reason: If the Demon would have the Crabber ability, the Storyteller has it instead.
If Legion would wake twice, an extra player dies tonight. If Legion would not wake, no players die to the Legion’s ability tonight.
If the Lil’ Monsta would wake twice, an extra player dies tonight. If the Lil’ Monsta would not wake, no players die to the Lil’ Monsta’s ability tonight.
If the Yaggababble would wake twice, an extra player dies tonight. If the Yaggababble would not wake, no players die to the Yaggababble’s ability tonight.

brewulation_crabberbb.flavor: Legend speaks of a gargantuan crab, lying hidden within the deepest abyss of the sea; a crab that holds unimaginable power ripped from the Devil itself. I will catch it... the crab that they call... the Big Barnacle.

brewulation_harbingerbb.ability: Something bad will happen, even if you are dead. On your 1st day, visit the Storyteller to learn what & how to prevent it.
brewulation_harbingerbb.otherNightReminder: Run the Harbinger’s “something bad” if applicable.
brewulation_harbingerbb.flavor: Please, you have to believe me, all the signs point to it! Something terrible is coming, but I know how to stop it!

brewulation_hooliganbb.ability: Players mad as the same character as another might become a Hooligan (once) or die. [Any Outsiders might be Hooligans]

jinxes.reason: If there is a spare token, the Boffin can give the Demon the Hooligan ability.
If there is a spare token, and no Hooligans have been created after setup, the Pit-Hag can create an extra Hooligan.

brewulation_labratbb.ability: If you died today or tonight, a player becomes a Lab Rat with a not-in-play Outsider ability (they don’t know which).
brewulation_labratbb.otherNightReminder: If a Lab Rat died, wake a player & show them the YOU ARE reminder token & Lab Rat token. Replace their token with a not-in-play Outsider token & put the IS THE LAB RAT reminder token next to them.

jinxes.reason: If a Lab Rat has the Butler ability, the Lab Rat learns this. The Lab Rat might gain an additional not-in-play Outsider ability.
Lab Rats cannot have the Heretic ability.
If a Lab Rat has the Zealot ability, the Lab Rat learns this. The Lab Rat might gain an additional not-in-play Outsider ability.
If a Lab Rat has the Puritan ability, the Lab Rat learns this. The Lab Rat might gain an additional not-in-play Outsider ability.
If no extra Hooligan has been created yet, the Lab Rat can have the Hooligan ability.

brewulation_labratbb.flavor: Don’t worry, the scientists say that my third arm, second nose, fifth eye, and the finger on my forehead aren’t a cause of concern, and that they’re not contagious at all.

brewulation_mimicbb.ability: You think you are a Townsfolk & have that ability. Each night, the last Townsfolk to choose you with their ability, dies.
brewulation_mimicbb.otherNightReminder: The Townsfolk with the “Chosen” reminder token dies.
brewulation_mimicbb.flavor: Never eat a group of clowns. You end up with too many inside jokes.

brewulation_puritanbb.ability: You must nominate an alive player each day. If you are not mad that your alive nominees are evil, you might be executed.

jinxes.reason: If the Cannibal gains the Puritan ability, the Cannibal learns this.

brewulation_puritanbb.flavor: When evil and sorcery manifest to make a mockery of our beliefs, to blind us from the truth, to mold our kin into formless beings of ignorance and blight, it falls to the brave, the just, the righteous to banish all tinder of the flames beneath. That is my duty. That is my verdict.

brewulation_sineaterbb.ability: If the 1st dead player to vote is evil & anyone is executed that day, evil wins.

jinxes.reason: If the Organ Grinder is causing eyes closed voting, the Sin-Eater is drunk.
The Vizier cannot choose to immediately execute a player on the 1st day a vote token is used.
If the 1st dead player to vote is evil, evil cannot win from the Vortox’s ability.

brewulation_sineaterbb.flavor: Greed, envy, disgust. The bitter sins of the rich. I ate them all, for I was starving. From then on, I had no more dreams. No more ambition. All that remained... was sin.

brewulation_chancellorbb.ability: You start knowing which players are Outsiders. To good, Outsiders register as evil & as a Minion or Demon. [-1 to +1 Outsider]

jinxes.reason: The Alsaahir is not affected by the Chancellor.
The Poppy Grower is not affected by the Chancellor.
If the Chancellor is (or has been) in play, the Damsel is poisoned.
The Damsel registers as the Damsel to the Huntsman.
The Architect does not register as evil to themself.

brewulation_chancellorbb.flavor: Your Highness, while I am so overjoyed to see so many visitors and people moving to our land, I know that I certainly wouldn’t rush to blame this uptick in murders on our longest standing citizens.

brewulation_dullahanbb.ability: If no Townsfolk who learned info tonight covered their eyes, you may choose (once) to poison all Townsfolk tomorrow.
brewulation_dullahanbb.firstNightReminder: If no Townsfolk who learned info tonight covered their eyes, wake the Dullahan. They nod or shake their head.
brewulation_dullahanbb.otherNightReminder: If no Townsfolk who learned info tonight covered their eyes, wake the Dullahan. They nod or shake their head.
brewulation_dullahanbb.flavor: If I cannot look into your eyes, why should you be able to look into mine?

brewulation_enchantressbb.ability: Players nominate by pointing & may not speak to each other during the nomination phase, even if you are dead.

jinxes.reason: On the 3rd day, if the Enchantress is in play, the Storyteller gains the Enchantress ability.

brewulation_enchantressbb.flavor: With this final ingredient, tongue of sea-witch slain, I curse this pathetic town with the golden, unbreakable, perfect... SILENCE!

brewulation_merrymanbb.ability: On the final day, dead players lose their vote token (if they have it) or gain one (if they don’t), even if you are dead.

jinxes.reason: If the Storyteller would gain the Merry Man ability, a player becomes the Merry Man.

brewulation_merrymanbb.flavor: As ol’ Robin Hood says, take from the rich, give to the poor — that don’t stop with people in the grave! But, seein’ as you’re dead and all, surely you’ll spare a penny or two… or three…

brewulation_pharaohbb.ability: On your 1st night, choose if the highest or lowest alive Townsfolk by script order is poisoned. You know their character.
brewulation_pharaohbb.firstNightReminder: The Pharaoh points up to poison the highest alive Townsfolk or down to poison the lowest alive Townsfolk. Show them the token of the poisoned Townsfolk.
brewulation_pharaohbb.otherNightReminder: Wake the Pharaoh to show the currently poisoned Townsfolk if it has changed.
brewulation_pharaohbb.flavor: The Tower of Babel was an insult to the gods. Worse, it was an insult to me.

brewulation_remnantbb.ability: The 1st Townsfolk to nominate you is poisoned. If you are dead, players mad the Remnant is in play might be executed.

jinxes.reason: If the Storyteller would gain the Remnant ability, a player becomes the Remnant.

brewulation_remnantbb.flavor: Babylon. Athens. Rome. All fell. But I will not. I am greater than they ever were. I will remain. I will remain.

brewulation_sculptorbb.ability: Each night, you may choose to change the Demon to the next in script order. 1 good player learns when this happens.
brewulation_sculptorbb.firstNightReminder: The Sculptor nods or shakes their head. If they nod, put the Sculptor to sleep then wake the Demon. Show them the YOU ARE reminder card and the Demon they become. Put them to sleep. Then, wake a good player and show them the Sculptor token.
brewulation_sculptorbb.otherNightReminder: The Sculptor nods or shakes their head. If they nod, put the Sculptor to sleep then wake the Demon. Show them the YOU ARE reminder card and the Demon they become. Put them to sleep. Then, wake a good player and show them the Sculptor token.

jinxes.reason: The Sculptor may choose to skip Legion when changing the Demon. If they choose Legion, all evil players become Legion.
The Sculptor may not change the Demon into the Leviathan after Day 5.
If the Demon becomes Lil’ Monsta, they also become the highest not-in-play Minion by script order.

brewulation_sculptorbb.flavor: The critics say I put a little bit of myself into every piece. In reality, it’s more that I put a little bit of them into every piece.

brewulation_vampirebb.ability: You wake for Demon info instead of Minion info. You know which Minion you added. [+1 good Minion who thinks they are evil]
brewulation_vampirebb.firstNightReminder: Do not wake the Vampire during Minion info. Wake the Vampire during Demon info and show 3 not-in-play good character tokens. Put the Demon to sleep, then point the Vampire towards the good Minion.

jinxes.reason: An Alchemist-Vampire has no Vampire ability & the Vampire is in play.
The Engineer cannot create a Vampire.
The Vampire does not wake to change characters using the Hatter. Players cannot choose to become the Vampire using the Hatter.
The Storyteller cannot gain the Vampire ability.
If the Vampire makes a good Evil Twin, they register as evil to their own ability.
If the Vampire makes a good Spy, that player sees themselves as evil in the Grimoire, & the Vampire as good & as a good character. The Vampire learns which character they were seen as.
The Vampire learns which player the Summoner chooses.
If the Vampire makes a good Vizier, they register as evil to their own ability.
If the Vampire makes a good Widow, that player sees themselves as evil in the Grimoire, & the Vampire as good & as a good character. The Vampire learns which character they were seen as.
The Wraith cannot wake during Demon info. The good Minion added by the Vampire registers as evil to the Wraith.
If Kazali makes a Vampire, they choose another player to become one of their Minions. Then, they choose which of the non-Vampire Minions is secretly good.
The Vampire doesn’t wake to choose who babysits Lil’ Monsta.
A Vampire can only be placed at either end of the line & cannot neighbour the Demon. The good Minion is elsewhere in the line.
If the Vampire adds a good Chancellor, they register as evil to their own ability.

brewulation_vampirebb.flavor: I will be welcomed, and you shall be damned.

brewulation_deanaebb.ability: Each night, a player becomes Deanae. Then, an alive neighbor dies. The 1st alive executee’s team loses.
brewulation_deanaebb.otherNightReminder: Wake a player and show them YOU ARE & the Deanae token. Put them to sleep. After, an alive neighbor dies.

jinxes.reason: Good Deanae do not learn the Marionette.

brewulation_deanaebb.flavor: NECESSARY SAMPLES: EXTRACTED. COMMENCING REPLICATION PROCEDURE.

brewulation_matrimurbb.ability: Players who left their seat today might die. Each day, if no alive good players leave their seat, evil wins.
brewulation_matrimurbb.otherNightReminder: For each player that left their seat today, they might die.

brewulation_ricarnisbb.ability: Each night, choose an alive player: they die. If they do not, their neighbors die instead. You cannot die at night.
brewulation_ricarnisbb.otherNightReminder: The Ricarnis points at a player: they die. If that player does not die, their neighbors die.
brewulation_ricarnisbb.flavor: The glory of the hunt beckons — to reject is cowardice. Cowardice begets punishment.

brewulation_rosebridebb.ability: Alive executees duel their nominator to decide your alignment. Your team loses if you die & wins after day 4. [+? evil players]
brewulation_rosebridebb.otherNightReminder: Change the Rose Bride Day reminder for the next day.

jinxes.reason: If the Banshee loses a duel & dies, they gain their ability.
If the Exorcist chooses the Rose Bride, tomorrow the Rose Bride cannot become the Exorcist’s opposing alignment.
If the Farmer loses a duel & dies, they use their ability tonight.
If the Grandchild loses a duel & dies, the Grandmother dies as well.
If the Rose Bride is in play & no execution occurs on day 4, the Mayor’s team wins.
If the Rose Bride is in play and at least 1 player is dead, the King learns an alive character each night.
If the Princess duels on their first day, the Rose Bride becomes the Princess’ alignment even if they lose.
If the Sage loses a duel & dies, they use their ability tonight.
If the Ravenkeeper loses a duel & dies, they use their ability tonight.
If the Hatter dies on or after day 4, the Demon cannot choose Rose Bride.
After Day 4, the Pit-Hag cannot choose Rose Bride.
If the Summoner creates a Rose Bride, some players become evil.
If the Stowaway loses a duel & dies, they use their ability.
The Sculptor may choose to skip the Rose Bride (after Day 4, they must) when changing the Demon. If they choose Rose Bride, some players become evil & the Sculptor loses their ability.
If the Rose Bride nominates and executes anyone not chosen by the Paladin (or the Paladin themselves), the Paladin’s team wins.

brewulation_rosebridebb.flavor: I am the Rose Bride. From this day forward, I belong to you.

brewulation_rotwoodbb.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. If Townsfolk are executed 2 days in a row, all Townsfolk are poisoned. [-1 Outsider]
brewulation_rotwoodbb.otherNightReminder: The Rotwood points at a player: they die.
brewulation_rotwoodbb.flavor: This eternal curse spreads from my roots, into the soil, into the city, into your very veins. From there, you will begin to rot just as I once did, all those years ago.

brewulation_sanctuarybb.ability: Each day, all learn 3 players (at least 1 evil): if 1 isn’t executed today, evil wins. 1st team executed twice loses. [+1 Sanctuary]
brewulation_sanctuarybb.firstNightReminder: Announce 3 players, at least 1 of which is evil.
brewulation_sanctuarybb.otherNightReminder: Announce 3 players, at least 1 of which is evil.

jinxes.reason: Each night, a Sanctuary chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Banshee dies & gains their ability.
If the Exorcist chooses a Sanctuary, they must be announced as one of the three players tomorrow.
Each night, a Sanctuary chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Farmer dies & uses their ability but does not die.
If the Sanctuary is in play and the Grandchild dies by execution, evil wins.
If a Sanctuary nominates and executes an Innkeeper-protected player, good wins.
If the Sanctuary is in play & no execution occurs on the final day, the Mayor’s team wins.
If a Sanctuary nominates and executes the Monk-protected player, good wins.
If the Sanctuary is in play and at least 1 player is dead, the King learns an alive character each night.
If the Princess nominates & executes a player on their first day, they learn that player’s alignment.
Each night, a Sanctuary chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Sage dies & uses their ability but does not die.
Each night, a Sanctuary chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Ravenkeeper dies & uses their ability but does not die.
If a Sanctuary nominates and executes the Soldier, good wins.
If the Goblin is announced as one of the three players, another evil player must be as well.
If the Summoner creates a Sanctuary and a player is executed, their team loses if a player of their team was already executed.
Each night, a Sanctuary chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Stowaway dies & gains their ability.
If the Demon becomes the Sanctuary, and a player is executed tomorrow, their team loses if an ally of theirs has been executed this game.
If a Sanctuary nominates and executes anyone not chosen by the Paladin (or the Paladin themselves), good wins.

brewulation_sanctuarybb.flavor: This, our fountain flowing dark with blood, is what keeps our sanctuary afloat. Do not disturb it. Our sanctuary must not be tarnished.

brewulation_skornbb.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. If you die by execution & no dead player voted, a Minion becomes the Skorn.
brewulation_skornbb.otherNightReminder: If a Skorn was executed yesterday with no vote token spent, replace 1 alive Minion token with a spare Skorn token. Wake the new Skorn. Show them the YOU ARE token, then the Skorn token. The Skorn then chooses a player.
brewulation_skornbb.flavor: Go ahead, punish the wicked all you want! See how little power you fools of the living world have over a being such as I, then await my return so that I may slash you idiots to pieces once more!

brewulation_vertighostbb.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Clockwise Townsfolk get false info until dusk if you kill clockwise, & vice versa.

jinxes.reason: If the Vertighost kills the Banshee, all players learn that the Banshee has died.
The player chosen by the Stowaway learns which Traveller ability they gained.

brewulation_vertighostbb.flavor: Watch it, watch it, watch it spin! Now it stops, but the rest still spins. Spinning, spinning, the world forever. No way to stop, everything spinning until you drop.

brewulation_bokorbb.ability: When nominations are called, your dead neighbors regain their vote token. They may only vote if you do.
brewulation_bokorbb.flavor: Soul departed, but body remains. You’re in my world now, and you do what I say.

brewulation_mimebb.ability: If you vote, players’ votes that do not match your hand signal when a vote is tallied do not count.

brewulation_bankerbb.ability: On the 1st night, if a Minion agrees, the Demon may choose to swap characters with them.
brewulation_bankerbb.flavor: You, Lord Swinnerton of the Albany Estates, would like to transfer all 4.2 million, all 3 Albany Estates, 1.74 more million in liquid assets, and full and complete ownership of them.... to a postal boy named Ricky Longwood? If you say so.

brewulation_conductorbb.ability: Setup modifications might happen at any time.

brewulation_fletcherbb.ability: Each night, all players learn an effect &, when awake, turn this token to the next player up to 3 times to decide who gets it.
brewulation_fletcherbb.flavor: Bundle of arrows, bundle of arrows for ya! Take as many as you need and let’s go Demon huntin’!

brewulation_partypooperbb.ability: When a player learns that they died, they may declare a new rule. (The Storyteller may decline or alter it.)
brewulation_partypooperbb.flavor: Who the hell would actually want to play this? Stupid game. Like, really, terribly, horribly dumb. Also, I hate you.

anthology_archivist.ability: Each day, you may visit the Storyteller & privately ask a yes/no question about the Demon's ability.

jinxes.reason: Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.

anthology_archivist.flavor: Let’s see… Box 34, manuscript number… 209… oh. Oh my. You can’t miss it. I have a terrible feeling we’re going to find exactly what we’re looking for, here.

anthology_astronomer.ability: Once per game, during the day, visit the Storyteller to privately learn why they made a decision, but not what it was.
anthology_astronomer.flavor: All things are hidden in the sway of the stars. Wait. Not like that. N-no, I don’t mean in an astrological way.

anthology_beachcomber.ability: Each day, visit the Storyteller to learn a fact no other on-script Townsfolk could learn with their ability.

jinxes.reason: The Beachcomber can learn information the Savant can learn.
The Beachcomber can learn information the Artist can learn.
The Beachcomber can learn information the Amnesiac can learn. If the Amnesiac is in play, the Beachcomber can not learn what they can with their current ability.

anthology_beachcomber.flavor: You won’t believe the kind of things certain people just throw away! Why, just yesterday I found a golden apple, a fragment of an urn and an only slightly unnerving dollhouse down by the cliffs. Outrageous.

anthology_changeling.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a living player: they die, then you become their character & alignment.
anthology_changeling.otherNightReminder: The Changeling might choose a player

jinxes.reason: The Demon cannot have the Changeling ability.
If the Pit-Hag turns an evil player into the Changeling, they can't turn good due to their own ability.
If there would be two Demons, one of which was the Scarlet Woman, the Scarlet Woman remains the Scarlet Woman.

anthology_changeling.flavor: May my new eyes be as green as my heart.

anthology_falconer.ability: On your 1st night, choose a character. In 1-3 nights, learn who they are, then choose again.
anthology_falconer.firstNightReminder: The Falconer points to a character on their characteer sheet: mark a player with that character with the "Chosen" reminder if the character is in play, or mark the Falconer with "Not in play" if it isn't. Send the Falconer back to sleep.
anthology_falconer.otherNightReminder: Increment the Falconer's number by 1. You may choose to wake the Falconer (if it's 3, you must): show them which player has the character they chose. Remove all Falconer reminders. Then, the Falconer points to a character on their characteer sheet: mark a player with that character with the "Chosen" reminder if the character is in play, or mark the Falconer with "Not in play" if it isn't. Send the Falconer back to sleep.
anthology_falconer.flavor: Hark! Milord, the hunter hath lead me to you! Now, let all perdition let loose its bonds and o’erflow ‘fore I accuse thee, but… I did sets the falcon after the foul witch, not you. Surely my liege hath an explanation?

anthology_fencer.ability: The Demon attacks on the 1st night, but its’ victims die 1 night later. Each night, you learn who the Demon chose.
anthology_fencer.firstNightReminder: The Demon chooses a player tonight, unlike normal: mark that player with "Dies in 1 night". Wake the Fencer. Show them the player marked with the "Dies in 1 night" reminder. Replace that reminder at the end of today; that player dies when the Demon chooses.
anthology_fencer.otherNightReminder: Do not kill the player the Demon chooses; instead, mark them with "Dies in 1 night". Wake the Fencer. Show them the player marked with the "Dies in 1 night" reminder. Replace that reminder at the end of today; that player dies when the Demon chooses.

jinxes.reason: Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
Al-Hadikhia's choices are announced 1 night later.

anthology_fencer.flavor: Your next line is: En grade! [SIC]

anthology_firebrand.ability: If you nominate & execute the first person executed, that night (even if dead), choose a player: learn their character.
anthology_firebrand.otherNightReminder: If the Firebrand's "Incited" reminder is placed, wake them. They choose a player: show them that player's character. Send the Firebrand to sleep. Place the "No ability" reminder by the Firebrand.
anthology_firebrand.flavor: Master Thatcher Is Dead…. But I’m STILL ALIVE! FOR THE UNION!

anthology_grandmaster.ability: Once per game, visit the Storyteller to privately learn who your most important ally is, but not why they're important.
anthology_grandmaster.flavor: 1. Nf3 Nf6 2. c4 g6 3. Nc3 Bg7 4. d4 O-O 5. Bf4 d5 6. Qb3 dxc4 7. Qxc4 c6 8. e4 Nbd7 9. Rd1 Nb6 10. Qc5 Bg4 11. Bg5 Na4 12. Qa3 Nxc3 13. bxc3 Nxe4 14. Bxe7 Qb6 15. Bc4 Nxc3 16. Bc5 Rfe8+ 17. Kf1 Be6 18. Bxb6 Bxc4+ 19. Kg1 Ne2+ 20. Kf1 Nxd4+ 21. Kg1 Ne2+ 22. Kf1 Nc3+ 23. Kg1 axb6 24. Qb4 Ra4 25. Qxb6 Nxd1 26. h3 Rxa2 27. Kh2 Nxf2 28. Re1 Rxe1 29. Qd8+ Bf8 30. Nxe1 Bd5 31. Nf3 Ne4 32. Qb8 b5 33. h4 h5 34. Ne5 Kg7 35. stKg1 Bc5+ 36. Kf1 Ng3+ 37. Ke1 Bb4+ 38 Kd1 Bb3+ 39. Kc1 Ne2+ 40. Kb1 Nc3+ 41. Kc1 Rc2# 0-1

anthology_localhero.ability: You start knowing an in-play opposing character. If an evil ability kills you, that character dies too.
anthology_localhero.firstNightReminder: During the first night, wake the Local Hero and show them the character token marked with “Seen”. Send the Local Hero to sleep.
anthology_localhero.otherNightReminder: If the Local Hero dies at night due to an evil player’s ability, the character marked with "Seen" dies too.

jinxes.reason: Each night, the Leviathan chooses an alive player (different to previous nights): if the Local Hero is chosen, the character they know dies but they do not.
Each night, the Riot chooses an alive player (different to previous nights): if the Local Hero is chosen, the character they know dies but they do not.

anthology_localhero.flavor: Hear me, O foul beast: with Ar-éadbair in hand and thunder in my heart, I shall strike you down. Face me, fiends. Face me.

anthology_prankster.ability: Each night, choose a player: if a Minion, their ability becomes "Each night, choose a player: the Demon learns their character."
anthology_prankster.otherNightReminder: The Prankster points to a player. Put them to sleep.
