If it's a Minion, mark that player with "Pranked", then wake that Minion and show them the "This character affected you" token and the Prankster token. All "Pranked" Minions choose a player; mark that player with "Demon Learns Tonight." Finally, wake the Demon, and point to each player marked "Demon learns tonight" in turn, and show them the corresponding character.

jinxes.reason: If the Vizier loses their ability, they learn this, and cannot die during the day.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.

anthology_silversmith.ability: On the final day, you decide who is executed (everyone learns this). If you die at night, another player might die instead.

jinxes.reason: If Riot is in play, the Silversmith does not use their ability unless only 3 players live on the final day.

anthology_silversmith.flavor: Finest filigree to trap the heart, finest silver to flense its’ mind, the finest weapon for the dispatching of Demons known to mankind. Also, if you hit a human with it, they’ll die too. But I don’t plan to miss.

anthology_spicetrader.ability: Each night, learn how many evil players voted today. If you would learn a 0, you become drunk.
anthology_spicetrader.otherNightReminder: Count the number of "Voted" reminders placed. Show the Spice Trader that number. If you would show them 0, the Spice Trader becomes drunk.

jinxes.reason: If players' eyes were closed during nominations, the Spice Trader learns which player received the most evil votes & how many they received.

anthology_spicetrader.flavor: Calm your mind and try to let a single mote fall from your hand, and you’ll find that… you can’t do it. But check how close you were. You’ll find something very interesting indeed. Don’t ask where I learned this.

anthology_steeplejack.ability: If you die at night, you are woken to choose 2 "You start knowing" characters & get their info.
anthology_steeplejack.otherNightReminder: If the Steeplejack died tonight: the Steeplejack points to two characters with "You start knowing" in their ability's text: show the Steeplejack information those characters could learn.

jinxes.reason: Each night, the Leviathan chooses an alive player (different to previous nights): a chosen Steeplejack uses their ability but does not die.
Each night, the Riot chooses an alive player (different to previous nights): a chosen Steeplejack uses their ability but does not die.
If the Steeplejack dies at night & chooses Yaggababble, they may visit the Storyteller tomorrow to learn a hint towards the Yaggabable’s phrase. If not in play, this info is arbitrary.

anthology_steeplejack.flavor: Oh, for pity’s sake… what did those kids put on top of the chapel this time?

anthology_surgeon.ability: Twice per game, at night, you may choose a living player: they live if they would die, and vice versa. The Demon cannot die this way.
anthology_surgeon.otherNightReminder: The Surgeon either shakes their head no or points to a player: that is their "Patient". Tonight, if they would die, they live, and if they would survive the night, they die. The Surgeon can only do this twice.

anthology_tactician.ability: Each night, choose 2 living players: learn which one the Storyteller thinks it’d be better for the Demon to kill tonight.
anthology_tactician.otherNightReminder: The Tactician points to two players. Indicate which one you think that the Demon should kill tonight, if they had to kill one of those two.

jinxes.reason: The Tactician learns which player is the bigger threat for the Leviathan.
The Tactician learns which player is the bigger threat for the Riot.

anthology_tactician.flavor: Permission to speak, sir? I was simply wondering why, precisely, we’re killing our own troops instead of the enemy. I assume there’s a reason for this.

anthology_warden.ability: Once per game, at night, choose 1 other player for each on-script Demon: they are safe from that Demon.
anthology_warden.otherNightReminder: The Warden either shakes their head no or nods yes. If they use their ability, show them each Demon on the script, one after another: the Warden points to another player for each one. Mark each player "Safe from Nth Demon" as apropriate. Mark the Warden with "No ability". Put the Warden to sleep.

jinxes.reason: If the Leviathan nominates and executes the player protected by the Warden from the Leviathan, good wins.
If Riot nominates the player protected by the Warden from the Riot, good wins.

anthology_warden.flavor: Horseshoe - check. Garlic - check. Silver knife - check. Salt - check.

anthology_weaver.ability: You start knowing 2 players: 1 of them learned something true about the other tonight.
anthology_weaver.firstNightReminder: Point to both players marked as "Woven" in no particular order. Send the Weaver back to sleep.

jinxes.reason: The Chambermaid can detect if the Weaver will wake tonight.

anthology_cardinal.ability: If nominated, tonight, you become the allignment opposite to whoever nominated you.
anthology_cardinal.otherNightReminder: If the Nominator reminder is placed, inform the Cardinal of their new alignment: the opposite of the person who nominated them.

jinxes.reason: The Demon cannot have the Cardinal ability.

anthology_cardinal.flavor: It is writ in the Book of Penumbras, chapter 42, verse 15: “Do not betray lest thou wish to be betrayed, do not accuse lest thou wish to be the subject of accusation.” I advise caution in my flock’s current course of action.”

anthology_deserter.ability: The 1st time a dead player votes, become their alignment tonight.
anthology_deserter.otherNightReminder: If the "Betrays Tonight" reminder is placed, inform the Deserter of their new alignment. Remove the "Betrays Tonight" reminder.

jinxes.reason: The Demon cannot have the Deserter ability.

anthology_deserter.flavor: After all I’ve seen? After all you’ve done? No. Hell is just a place to me now.

anthology_occultist.ability: Once per game, you might learn something. If you aren't mad about learning new info each day, you might be executed.
anthology_occultist.flavor: Flesh is weaker than silver is weaker than rot is weaker than the divine is weaker than rot is weaker than silver is weaker than flesh. It’s a cycle. Get it? I don’t.

anthology_penitent.ability: If you died today or tonight, the Demon may change their ability to "Each night, choose 2 players: they die."
anthology_penitent.otherNightReminder: If the Pentient died today or tonight, wake the Demon. Show them the "This character affected you" token, and then the Penitent token. They shake their head or nod. If they nod, place the "Doubled End" reminder: they kill two players every night from now on.

jinxes.reason: If the babysitter chooses to change their ability, Minions no longer wake to decide the babysitter.
If the Penitent dies & Legion is in play, nothing happens.

anthology_penitent.flavor: I am how it came into this world. And I’m sorry. But do you really think that killing me is going to make it leave?

anthology_perfumer.ability: The 1st time an evil player is nominated & executed by another evil player, their Townsfolk neighbors are poisoned (even if dead).
anthology_perfumer.flavor: Ah, I see you’re a rather… discerning bunch, by the look of those mandibles. Well, we have some new metaphysical scents from Paris, if that’s your heart’s desire. I imagine that betrayal would be a good cologne for you, sir.

anthology_sleepwalker.ability: You think you’re a Townsfolk, but you have a different ability with the same choices. 1 good player knows you’re in play.
anthology_sleepwalker.firstNightReminder: Wake the Sleepwalker, and act as though they had the ability they think they do: secretly run the ability they actually have. Wake 1 Good player, and show them the Sleepwalker token.
anthology_sleepwalker.flavor: …oh no. So I wasn’t dreaming after all.

anthology_cryptid.ability: You only know part of your ability. 1 good player knows the rest of it.
anthology_cryptid.firstNightReminder: Show the Cryptid part of their ability. Show the good player marked as "Knows" the other part of the ability. If appropriate, run the custom ability.
anthology_cryptid.flavor: The moral of our encounter is: I am a relatively median lifeform -- while it is you who are total, extreme madness. A volatile simian nervous system, ominously new to the planet.

anthology_esper.ability: Each night (even when dead), you see the Grimoire, then choose 1 character, 1 reminder & 1 player: the Demon is shown all 3.
anthology_esper.firstNightReminder: Show the Esper the Grimoire. They select a character, a reminder, and a player by placing their Character, Reminder, and Player reminders by them. Wake the Demon; show them the marked character, reminder token, and point to the marked player.
anthology_esper.otherNightReminder: Show the Esper the Grimoire. They select a character, a reminder, and a player by placing their Character, Reminder, and Player reminders by them. Wake the Demon; show them the marked character, reminder token, and point to the marked player.

jinxes.reason: If the Esper is (or has been) in play, the Damsel is poisoned.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.

An Alchemist-Esper has no Esper ability & a Esper is in play. After each execution, a living Alchemist-Esper may publicly guess a living player as the Esper. If correct, the Demon must choose the Esper tonight.
When the Esper sees the Grimoire, the Demon and Magician’s character tokens are removed.
If the Poppy Grower has their ability, the Esper does not see the Grimoire.
If the Storyteller would gain the Esper ability, a Minion gains it, and learns this.

anthology_esper.flavor: I knew you were going to read this.

anthology_executioner.ability: Once per game, at night, choose 0, 1, or 2: exactly that many players will die tonight (the Storyteller decides who).
anthology_executioner.otherNightReminder: The Executioner shakes their head no or indicates a number from 0 to 2. If they indicate a number, mark that many players with "Dead". No-one else dies tonight.

anthology_hulijing.ability: You start knowing 5 out-of-play characters. Each night, choose 1 of them: until dusk, gain its’ ability & you might register as it would.
anthology_hulijing.firstNightReminder: Show the Huli Jing 5 out-of-play characters: note which ones using a notes app. Then, the Huli Jing chooses one of them: mark that as their "Current Form". Until dusk, run the Huli Jing as though they were that character, and you may have them register as though they were that character & alignment.
anthology_hulijing.otherNightReminder: The Huli Jing chooses one of the 5 characters they were shown at the start of the game: mark that as their "Current Form". Until dusk, run the Huli Jing as though they were that character, and you may have them register as though they were that character & alignment.

jinxes.reason: The Huli Jing can not gain the Heretic ability.
The Huli Jing can not gain the Politician ability.
If the Huli Jing gains the Cult Leader ability, they can not turn Good due to their own ability.
If the Huli Jing gains the Goon ability, they can not turn Good due to their own ability.

anthology_hulijing.flavor: For shame! How dare you accuse me of being some sort of mischievous fox spirit, when I have been nothing but loyal as your… uhm, baker? Wait, no, I misspoke. I’m a fisherwoman.

anthology_miasma.ability: Once per game, at night, choose that all Townsfolk are poisoned & get false information until dusk.
anthology_miasma.firstNightReminder: Each night, wake the Miasma. They either shake their head no or nod yes. If they shake their head, put the Miasma to sleep. If they nod, place the “Shrouded” reminder in the Grimoire, and mark the Miasma with “No ability”. While the “Shrouded” reminder is placed, all Townsfolk are poisoned, and additionally must receive false information if they get any information.
anthology_miasma.otherNightReminder: Each night, wake the Miasma. They either shake their head no or nod yes. If they shake their head, put the Miasma to sleep. If they nod, place the “Shrouded” reminder in the Grimoire, and mark the Miasma with “No ability”. While the “Shrouded” reminder is placed, all Townsfolk are poisoned, and additionally must receive false information if they get any information.

jinxes.reason: If the Alchemist has the Miasma ability, they are safe from themselves.

anthology_mouldwarp.ability: On your 1st night, become a not-in-play Demon. From now on, Demons can't wake to kill two nights in a row.
anthology_mouldwarp.firstNightReminder: Wake the Mouldwarp, and show them their new character. Mark 1 of the Mouldwarp-Demon and the original Demon with the "Woke Last Night" reminder.
anthology_mouldwarp.otherNightReminder: Do not wake any Demon marked with the "Woke Last Night" reminder. Place the "Woke Last Night" reminder by any Demons that did wake.

jinxes.reason: The Mouldwarp Demon registers as Mouldwarp to the Engineer.
The Mouldwarp Demon registers as Mouldwarp to the Pit-Hag.
If the Alchemist has the Mouldwarp ability, they lose it when they die. The Alchemist can not kill the evil Demon.
If the Mouldwarp would become Lil' Monsta, they immediately babysit instead.
If the Hatter dies, the Mouldwarp Demon can choose to become either a Demon or Minion. If a Demon, they keep the Mouldwarp ability.

anthology_mouldwarp.flavor: When Hempe is spunne, England’s done.

anthology_visionary.ability: You & a good player start knowing a question. Once per game, publicly answer it: if correct, your team wins.
anthology_visionary.firstNightReminder: Wake the Visionary and show them a piece of paper with a question written on it. Put them to sleep. Wake a good player and show them the same piece of paper. Put them to sleep.

jinxes.reason: Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
If the Storyteller would gain the Visionary ability, a Minion gains it, and learns this.

anthology_wight.ability: The 1st player you nominated while alive and voted for while dead are poisoned (even when dead).

jinxes.reason: If the Storyteller would gain the Wight ability, a Minion gains it, and learns this.

anthology_wight.flavor: Syððan ærest wearð feasceaft funden, he þæs frofre gebad, weox under wolcnum, weorðmyndum þah, oðþæt him æghwylc þara ymbsittendra ofer hronrade hyran scolde, gomban gyldan. þæt wæs god cyning!

anthology_auwre.ability: Each night, guess your Minions: learn which are correct. If all are, good learns this, and must kill evil today or lose. [Evil don’t learn each other]
anthology_auwre.firstNightReminder: Do not inform the Demon or their Minions who each other are.
anthology_auwre.otherNightReminder: Wake the Au’Wre. They point to a number of players equal to the number of in-play Minions: indicate which of the people they chose are Minions. If all of them are, place the "Found Minions" reminder.

jinxes.reason: If Au’Wre guesses the Ravenkeeper, they use their ability.
If Au’Wre guesses the Sage, they use their ability.
If Au’Wre guesses the Farmer, they use their ability.
If Au’Wre guesses the Local Hero, their known character dies.
Each time Au’Wre guesses a Minion for the first time, the King learns 1 alive character. If Au’Wre guesses the King, they lose their ability.
If Au’Wre guesses the King and the Choirboy is alive, they use their ability.
The first time Au’Wre guesses the Magician, they learn the Magician is a Minion.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play. Evil starts knowing if Au’Wre is in play.
If Au’Wre correctly guesses the Minions, then nobody is executed & a Mayor is alive, the Mayor's team wins.
Au’Wre only learns the Marionette after the Marionette is guessed.
If Au’Wre is executed and the Mastermind ability activates, it is announced Au’Wre guessed their Minions.
The Pit-Hag can not create an Au’Wre.
If Au’Wre is in play, the Spy only sees half of the Grimoire.
If Au’Wre is in play, the Widow only sees half of the Grimoire.
The Psychopath learns when Au’Wre guesses them and can only kill after this. Once Au’Wre guesses their Minions, the Psychopath dies regardless of Roshambo result if executed.
The Vizier's existence is not announced until after they are guessed. They can not execute until they are revealed.
If the Hatter dies & Au’Wre chooses to become another Demon, Minions & Demons learn each other. The Demon can’t choose to become Au’Wre when the Hatter dies.
If the Au'Wre nominates and executes the Monk-protected player, good wins.
If the Au'Wre nominates and executes an Innkeeper-protected player, good wins.
If Au'Wre nominates and executes the Soldier, good wins.

anthology_auwre.flavor: 𒇻 𒌨 𒉈 𒇷 𒂵 𒀉

anthology_cawthane.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. [+0 or +1 Outsiders, Minions choose who you are.]
anthology_cawthane.firstNightReminder: During the Minion info step, inform the Minions the Cawthane is in play. They point to players: move the "Coronation" reminder besides the player who got the most votes. Replace their token with the Cawthane's, and inform them they are now the evil Cawthane.
anthology_cawthane.otherNightReminder: The Cawthane points to a player. That player dies.

jinxes.reason: When Minions choose who Cawthane is, they also choose the Marionette. If there are no other Minions, the Storyteller chooses Cawthane and the Marionette.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
The Lunatic may draw a good character from the bag, and be told they became Cawthane on the first night.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
If the Balloonist was chosen to be Cawthane, an Outsider might have been added during setup.
If the Huntsman was chosen to be Cawthane, the Damsel was added during setup. If the Damsel is chosen to be the Cawthane & a Huntsman is in play, a good player becomes the Damsel.
If the Bounty Hunter was chosent to be Cawthane, an evil Townsfolk is not created.
If the Choirboy is in play, the King can not be chosen to be the Cawthane.

anthology_cawthane.flavor: A toast, my friends. To the last syllable of recorded time, to the dagger in my speckled hand, and to the future of glorious dust that awaits us.

anthology_despoina.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Once you've killed or removed an Outsider, deaths at night can’t be prevented. [+1 or -1 Outsider]
anthology_despoina.otherNightReminder: The Despoina points to a player: that player dies. If they killed an Outsider, add the "Outsider Killed" reminder. Deaths at night can't be prevented if the "Outsider Killed" reminder is in the Grimoire.

jinxes.reason: Despoina counts as having "killed an Outsider" during setup if and only if Xaan made the Outsider count lower than usual.

anthology_despoina.flavor: I have brought you thirteen seeds, guest-friend. Gorge upon them, darling. Feast upon the incipience, and I shall see it done. You will wish for blood, and I am to grant that wish.

anthology_inysyns.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. During the day after you kill your 1st Minion, whoever wins loses & vice versa.
anthology_inysyns.firstNightReminder: Wake the Inysyns and show them a number: note that number. On the night before that day, mark the Inysnys with "Judgement Day": if they would lose today, they win instead.
anthology_inysyns.otherNightReminder: The Insyns points to a player: that player dies.

jinxes.reason: During the Day of Judgement, the Inysyns is safe from the Witch.
During the Day of Judgement, the Inysyns is safe from the Psychopath.
During the Day of Judgement, the Vizier cannot execute the Inysyns.

anthology_inysyns.flavor: There is a weakness in the air today. All an “apocalypse” is, truly, is a revelation. Why not simply accept the revelation of the new saint of all realities?

anthology_ketos.ability: After the 5th day, evil wins. Each night, guess which Townsfolk a player is: if right, the end comes one day sooner. [-1 Outsider]
anthology_ketos.otherNightReminder: The Ketos points to a player and a Townsfolk character on their character sheet; if they're correct, replace the number reminder token in the Grimoire with one less, or "The End" if it's 1.

jinxes.reason: The 1st time Ketos guesses the Ravenkeeper’s character, the Ravenkeeper uses their ability
The 1st time Ketos guesses the Sage’s character, the Sage uses their ability
The 1st time Ketos guesses the Farmer’s character, the Farmer uses their ability
If Ketos guesses the Local Hero’s character, the Local Hero’s known character dies.
If Ketos correctly guesses a Monk-protected-player, the end does not come sooner.
If Ketos correctly guesses an Innkeeper-protected-player, the end does not come sooner.
If Ketos is in play, then on the 3rd night onwards, the King learns 1 alive character. If Ketos correctly guesses the King, the King loses their ability.
If Ketos correctly guesses the King & the Choirboy is alive, the Choirboy learns the Demon.
On the day before the end, if nobody is executed while the Mayor is alive, the Mayor’s team wins.
If the Hatter dies on or after Day 5, the Demon can not become Ketos.
If Ketos is in play, the Spy learns all in-play characters instead of seeing the Grimoire.
If Ketos is in play, the Widow learns all in-play characters instead of seeing the Grimoire. The Widow chooses a character to poison instead of a player.
Ketos learns who the Good Twin is and can not guess their character if they're a Townsfolk.

anthology_ketos.flavor: Ever wondered what happens to every piece of you that you throw away? They say there’s a vessel at the bottom of the ocean made of it. And they say it’s rising, every day.

anthology_obscrul.ability: Only you know what your ability is. Once per game, the Archivist may publicly guess it: if right, you die. [+the Archivist]
anthology_obscrul.firstNightReminder: Show the Obscrul their secret ability. Run that secret ability, if appropriate.

jinxes.reason: If the Pit-Hag creates an Obscrul, an Archivist is also created (if not in play).
If the Hatter dies & the Demon becomes an Obscrul, an Archivist is created (if not in play).

anthology_obscrul.flavor: NOTICE: Any and all information about the entity known as “Obscrul” must be reported to the Department of Infernal Affairs within 24 hours of discovery. Failure to comply may lead to prosecution and/or certain death

anthology_terminus.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. On the final day, the nominee with the least votes is executed instead.
anthology_terminus.otherNightReminder: The Terminus points to a player. That player dies.

jinxes.reason: The Vizier can't execute themselves or a dead player if 3 players live and Terminus is in play. If the Vizier executes a living player (not themselves), the other living player is executed instead.

anthology_terminus.flavor: Nothingness lies coiled at the heart of being.

anthology_major.ability: As you leave, view the Grimoire and write a short message to be read on the final day. It must not feature any names.
anthology_major.flavor: If you are reading this, I am dead. Circumstances permit me to say only this to you, those I have loved: to the woman in the bathroom, I bequeath sanguine death. That is all.

astra_plumeherald.ability: You start knowing the farthest evil character from you.

astra_phoenixwing.ability: Each night, starting from Demon, learn the alignment of the next clockwise player.
astra_phoenixwing.flavor: On the wind, I catch the scent of the one beside the Demon.

astra_catlegion.ability: Each night, you learn if either alive neighbor of the next clockwise alive Cat Legion is evil. [+0~2 Cat Legion]
astra_catlegion.flavor: There is strength in our numbers. Even our shadows travel together.

astra_phrenologist.ability: Each night, choose a character type (different to the previous 2 nights) & a player (not yourself): you register to good players as a character & alignment of that type, then learn if you share a type.
astra_phrenologist.flavor: Skulls do not lie. Those who read them do.

astra_navigator.ability: Each night, with the last executed player as south, you learn a direction with evil. If they are evil, they count as north.
astra_navigator.flavor: Lost among clouds and dreams, point ever south; knowing neither east nor west, we sail the night together." From the ancient art of steering by the stars to dominion over the seas in the late Age of Sail, compass and sextant guided the course of turning gears and roaring steam engines, and with them, the course of an age of glory.

astra_elevatoroperator.ability: Each day, invite a unique alive player to secretly choose a script row: tonight, learn how many characters in it are in play.
astra_elevatoroperator.flavor: Every invitation begins a secret journey. The floor you choose will determine tonight's view. The elevator doors are open. Step inside.

astra_anubis.ability: Once per game, at night, choose 2 players: the player higher on the character sheet dies.
astra_anubis.flavor: Come, let us weigh your soul!

astra_diplomat.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a player: players of the opposing alignment can't die until dusk.
astra_diplomat.flavor: He raised his glass, candlelight flickering in the emerald liquid. "If you wish," he said, "we may call a truce this very moment, until dawn cleaves the darkness once more." And so the blades hung still, and none dared cross the line.

astra_warpriest.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a unique alive player (not yourself), then repeat until the last 2 choices are the same character type. [+1 Outsider]
astra_warpriest.flavor: My turn. My turn. Still my turn.

astra_boxcat.ability: If you die, you become a not-in-play character of the same character type instead & keep your ability, even if dead. [The Storyteller chooses your type (non-Demon)]
astra_boxcat.flavor: My eyes flew open. A blue cat had appeared on the purple box on my desk, only to vanish the instant I saw it. Nothing remained but the empty box, standing silently there. Yet every detail of that cat was etched into my mind: it was brimming with life, with something of the otherworldly grace of ice and snow.

astra_mourner.ability: If 1 of your alive neighbors dies, that night you learn the other alive neighbor's character.
astra_mourner.flavor: Surely your name will be etched into history, a light to guide my way.

astra_cryptographer.ability: Minions & Demons don't know each other. They start knowing the same keyword, then you learn a related clue.
astra_cryptographer.flavor: They claimed they did not know one another. I saw the same mark upon them all.

astra_keykeeper.ability: 1 Demon is drunk. Each night, the 1st player they choose dies.
astra_keykeeper.flavor: A key opens a door. But what opens a key?

astra_archaeologist.ability: Find the clues left by the Storyteller in the room. You gain a reward.
astra_archaeologist.flavor: Beneath the dust lie the Storyteller's secrets.

astra_hydromancer.ability: 1 Townsfolk is drunk. Each night, learn an evil player if their ability worked abnormally (since dawn), or you learn a good player.
astra_hydromancer.flavor: Water is a language. Every ripple is the answer to a question. But which question?

astra_timetraveler.ability: You have a non-listed character's ability. If a living Minion publicly guesses you (once), your team loses. [+0~1 Outsider]
astra_timetraveler.flavor: I no longer know how many years have passed. Through all that time, I have waited for that one person to appear.

astra_goodo.ability: You have an unknown way to become the winning alignment when the game ends, even if dead. Each day, you may visit the Storyteller for a clue.
astra_goodo.flavor: Mr. Goodo asked me to tell you he will not be coming tonight. But tomorrow, without fail.

astra_claplight.ability: You might die if silent, or be resurrected if you speak, even if dead.
astra_claplight.flavor: (Rong) God said, 'Let there be light,' and I appeared. (Rong) God fell silent, and I vanished. The faithful longed for revelation, so I flickered through the night. Even should rebels slay their god, through me he shall appear again.

astra_pessimist.ability: When you learn that you died, publicly claim a Demon: if not in play, the Demon has that ability for 1 day & 1 night.
astra_pessimist.flavor: Honestly, there's nothing I can do." — The episode with the most honesty and the fewest options.

astra_flatearther.ability: [A split is between 2 neighboring players. The Demon knows where & may move it.]
astra_flatearther.flavor: They laugh: Magellan circled the world; Cook's logs prove it round. A century of Victorian voyages was a fraud to fool the masses! All things end. At the world's edge stands an ice wall, the Creator's barrier no mortal should cross. You preach orthodoxy and drink around this table. But who knows what cracks split the round table, what rifts divide your hearts? No circle is unbreakable. It is only a lie stitched shut.

astra_pupa.ability: Each night, choose a character you become (if not in play). If your character type changes, 1 player of that type dies. [All Minions are Pupas]
astra_pupa.flavor:
Bind the form to preserve its essence; still the breath and await the hour.
It is the vessel of transformation, the silent crossing from mortal flesh to something beyond.
When the shell splits, a new form is born. Such is the ordained order of transfiguration.

astra_jalapeno.ability: On your 1st night, look at the Grimoire & choose a script column: all non-Minion in it are poisoned & yield false info.
astra_jalapeno.flavor: Taste my fire, and all you speak shall be falsehood, all you see illusion.

astra_scepterfather.ability: You're jinxed with each Demon: they get a unique boon.

jinxes.reason: If the Scepter Father is or has been in play, on the Imp's first night, the first player to choose the Imp is drunk until dusk.
If the Scepter Father is the only dead evil player, the Zombuul's team wins after day 4.
If a player poisoned by the Pukka is executed, that night the Scepter Father wakes to choose 2 players: they die.
The Shabaloth chooses when to regurgitate and who to regurgitate. If the game ends and they have not regurgitated anyone, their team loses.
When the Po wakes due to their ability, they may choose to kill 3 players and not wake due to their ability the following night.
If the number of Outsiders is the same as setup, Outsiders do not count towards evil's win condition.
A Townsfolk thinks they are an Outsider. Until the Scepter Father loses their ability, the Scepter Father acts and receives information in their place.
Once per game, at night, if the Scepter Father has their ability, the No Dashii may look at the Grimoire, then may choose to swap characters with a Minion.
Only the abilities of players with the same alive/dead status as the Scepter Father yield false info due to the Vortox’s ability.
If the Scepter Father has their ability, the Ojo may choose 2 characters. If either is not in play, no players die due to the Ojo’s ability tonight.
When the Scepter Father becomes Riot, 1 of their good neighbors also becomes evil Riot.
1 Minion starts as the player furthest from the Lord of Typhon, instead of neighboring an evil player.
The Al-Hadikhia may choose any number of players.
If the Scepter Father is on the script, 1 Legion is replaced with a Minion during setup.
If the Kazali & Scepter Father are on the script, before the game begins, the Storyteller announces 2 abilities. A Scepter Father created by the Kazali has 1 of these abilities.
If the Scepter Father has their ability, the Leviathan wins 1 day earlier.
If the Scepter Father is alive, the Lleech can’t die.
If the Scepter Father is the only player who has babysat Lil’ Monsta, they choose which players Lil’ Monsta kills.
The 1st Minion to say the Yaggababble’s phrase is executed.
At dusk on day 4, if all Townsfolk have been poisoned, evil wins.
The Minion who loses their ability due to Gravity must be the Scepter Father. Gravity may prevent all deaths tonight & become another Demon.
Each Townsfolk’s ability yields false info the first time they learn info.

The Abyss immediately gains 2 Minion abilities, but can’t kill their neighbors. If the Abyss would gain the Scepter Father’s ability, they gain the ability of the 1st Minion on the script instead, even if it is in play.
If the Scepter Father has their ability, the Phantom’s good neighbors register as evil.

astra_scepterfather.flavor: Yes, you! You are my finest master!

astra_princeofsequence.ability: You start by choosing X. Each night, the Xth player to wake due to their ability is poisoned tonight.
astra_princeofsequence.flavor: Numbers are my incantations. Those chosen by fate shall taste my poison tonight.

astra_agitator.ability: If you are alive/dead, Townsfolk info is reversed. [+0/+1 Outsider]
astra_agitator.flavor: Everyone, come and see! There's a note inside this fish!

astra_mothmother.ability: The last dead evil player keeps their ability & becomes a not-in-play character of the same type; you are "that character", but this doesn't activate on the final day.
astra_mothmother.flavor:
Scaled wings shroud the night; a shadowed door opens a sliver.
She is the whisper of the woods, the first cry of longing, the first mark of a mortal form shedding its skin.

astra_fetusinajar.ability: Each dusk, the player executed today may publicly choose 2 other Minion abilities for you: you have them until the following dusk. If no-one chooses, choose secretly.
astra_fetusinajar.flavor: High in the sky, above the barren earth.

astra_mishpat.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Townsfolk’s ability can’t yield info with the same truth value as their previous info.

astra_abyss.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Each time one of your neighbors dies, you gain a not-in-play Minion ability.
astra_abyss.flavor: I devour the souls that perish near me. Each neighbor who falls grants me a new power. The abyss gazes upon you, and there is nowhere to flee.

astra_gravity.ability: Each night, choose 2 players: they die. If not in play, the Demon can prevent all deaths tonight & become Gravity. [1 Minion loses their ability]
astra_gravity.flavor: Now, all the stars fall toward me.

astra_commandment.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. The 1st time a character type (except Travellers) has no alive players, all Townsfolk are poisoned until tomorrow dusk. [+1/-1 Outsider]
astra_commandment.flavor: Therefore I tell you: every sin and blasphemy may be forgiven, but blasphemy against the Holy Spirit shall never be forgiven.

astra_phantom.ability: Executed evil players keep their abilities. Each night, choose a player: they die. If a dead player is executed, their team loses. Until then, evil cannot lose.
astra_phantom.flavor: Evil is immortal. I am immortality.

astra_mindcontroller.ability: You may decide what "might" does. The Storyteller may say it was your instruction, even the game ends.
astra_mindcontroller.flavor: The dice are written before they fall; both sides of the coin bear his face. Others call it free will. Only the Storyteller knows whose nod to seek. The Mind Controller sits in shadow, letting "chance" announce his outcomes. When a coincidence seems too neat, a turn too smooth, you look back: an empty chair, an untouched glass, its surface trembling as though someone laughs in its depths.

astra_tarotreader.ability: Once per player, choose a Tarot card to guide a visiting player.
astra_tarotreader.flavor: The tarot cottage welcomes humble tailors, cooks and barons beguiled by poppies. Each brings a private burden. The Tarot Reader draws from the Wheel of Fortune: a warning, a taunt, or a passing whim. Her cards hold countless meanings; her intentions remain unspoken. She bears none of your consequences. The card is revealed. Though it holds her purpose, its interpretation is yours.

astra_musician.ability: You may play the BGM that best fits the situation.
astra_musician.flavor: The tavern gramophone never stops; its silent tuner moves the needle at just the right moment. Drunken sailors hum old love songs; assassins approach their targets under cover of a waltz. As plots grow, the double bass mourns. When a lie is exposed, the brass shrieks. As a player finally resolves to act, the strings reach their climax. After all, music is a kind of intuition, is it not?

astra_treasurehunters.ability: Online: At setup, claim any non-listed characters & clues. Assign each a matching phrase. The 1st player to say one gains its ability.

astra_treasurehunters2.ability: Offline: At setup, claim any non-listed characters & hide their tokens in the room. The 1st player to find one may visit you by day & gain its ability.

astra_paralleltimeline.ability: When a non-Townsfolk dies, the living Demon becomes the next Demon on the script (looping).

circus_conspiracistcircusmusic.ability: Each night, learn an evil player or Outsider. If a (non-Traveller) neighbor is evil, you get false info.
circus_conspiracistcircusmusic.firstNightReminder: Point to an evil player or an Outsider. Recall that if the Conspiracist has the FALSE INFO reminder token, that you must show them a player which is neither.
circus_conspiracistcircusmusic.otherNightReminder: Point to an evil player or an Outsider. Recall that if the Conspircacist has the FALSE INFO reminder token, that you must show them a player which is neither.
circus_conspiracistcircusmusic.flavor: Yes, if everyone were telling the truth, I am wrong. All the evidence provided by our alleged peers points to the opposite of my conclusions...however-

circus_quoricircusmusic.ability: You know 2 players & if their characters are in my column.
circus_quoricircusmusic.firstNightReminder: Show the Quori the 2 players with the KNOWN reminder token. After pointing to each one, nod if they are in the Quori's column, or shake or your head if they aren't.
circus_quoricircusmusic.flavor: Watcha dreaming about? can I join?

circus_sericulturistcircusmusic.ability: Each night, choose a player: you learn if the closest Minion from them is 1) clockwise, 2) anti-clockwise, or 3) neither.
circus_sericulturistcircusmusic.firstNightReminder: The Sericulturist points at any player. If the closest Minion from this player is clockwise, show fingers for 1. If the closest Minion from this player anti-clockwise, show fingers for 2. If the closest Minion from this player is neither clockwise, nor anti-clockwise, show fingers for 3.
circus_sericulturistcircusmusic.otherNightReminder: The Sericulturist points at any player. If the closest Minion from this player is clockwise, show fingers for 1. If the closest Minion from this player anti-clockwise, show fingers for 2. If the closest Minion from this player is neither clockwise, nor anti-clockwise, show fingers for 3.
circus_sericulturistcircusmusic.flavor: Don't let the things that keep you safe go to waste.

circus_trixtercircusmusic.ability: Each night, learn an alive good player who's mad that you're evil.
circus_trixtercircusmusic.otherNightReminder: If a player is marked with the Trixter's MAD reminder token, wake the Trixter & point to that player.

circus_carpentercircusmusic.ability: Each night, learn if 1 of the Demon’s 2 alive neighbors died tonight.
circus_carpentercircusmusic.otherNightReminder: If the Carpenter has the BETRAYAL reminder token, nod your head yes. Otherwise, shake your head no.
circus_carpentercircusmusic.flavor: כדי לבנות בית, כל פיסת עץ חייבת לסמוך זה על זה. לא הצלחתי לבנות כבר זמן מה...יש בוגד בתוכנו.

circus_kenkucircusmusic.ability: Each night, choose a player: if they’d die tonight, you learn 2 good players who die instead.
circus_kenkucircusmusic.otherNightReminder: The Kenku points to player -- Mark them with the SHINY reminder token. If that player would die tonight, they don't, & 2 good players die instead -- mark them with the Kenku's DEAD reminder tokens. Then, wake the Kenku & point to these 2 players.

jinxes.reason: Each night, the Leviathan chooses a player. If this player is protected by the Kenku, then the Kenku learns 2 other good players who die.
Each night, the Riot chooses a player. If this player is protected by the Kenku, then the Kenku learns 2 other good players who die.

circus_kenkucircusmusic.flavor: Guys, be murderer on the loose! There is a very very careful.

circus_imamcircusmusic.ability: Each day, you may publicly advise your team: that night, learn how useful your advice was.
circus_imamcircusmusic.otherNightReminder: Give a thumb signal which relates to how useful the Imam's adivce was yesterday.
circus_imamcircusmusic.flavor: گود سے لے کر قبر تک علم حاصل کرو

circus_mediumcircusmusic.ability: Once per game, at night, choose to learn which dead players are evil.
circus_mediumcircusmusic.otherNightReminder: The Medium will either nod or shake their head. If they nod, point to every dead player that is evil. If there are no dead evil players, show fingers for 0 instead.
circus_mediumcircusmusic.flavor: I like to be honest with my clients. Your grandfather is a real حمار.

circus_prophetcircusmusic.ability: Once per game, you may give the Storyteller a statement & they'll give you 1 they agree with as much.
circus_prophetcircusmusic.flavor: Things beyond my vision...Can you accept me as your own?

circus_candlemakercircusmusic.ability: Once per game, publicly choose a player: if alive & not the Demon, they win if (& only if) you do, even if you died.

jinxes.reason: The Lleech & their host register as “the Demon” to the Candlemaker
If the Evil Twin has been chosen by the Candlemaker, evil does not win when the good twin is executed.

circus_candlemakercircusmusic.flavor: The light forward isn’t always clear, but I will make sure it is there.

circus_groomcircusmusic.ability: On your 1st day, publicly choose a player (not yourself): if they agree, you both can't die until both would.
circus_groomcircusmusic.flavor: Please, can you make me the happiest man in the world?

circus_squirecircusmusic.ability: You have an in-play Townsfolk’s ability, but don't know which.

jinxes.reason: If the Squire uses the Candlemaker ability, they learn this tonight.

circus_squirecircusmusic.flavor: Indeed. It’s been a lovely few weeks, but time calls! Bye-bye for now!

circus_sistercircusmusic.ability: When you die, learn a player & their character tonight. [All Townsfolk are Workers]
circus_sistercircusmusic.otherNightReminder: Wake a Worker with a DEAD or DIED TODAY reminder token. Point to any player and show the Worker that player’s character token. Put this Worker to sleep. Repeat this until all of them have woken.
circus_sistercircusmusic.flavor: Divided, we only beg. United, we bargain instead.

circus_bugcollectorcircusmusic.ability: The Storyteller has a picture. Each day, you may see it & briefly discuss its meaning.
circus_bugcollectorcircusmusic.flavor: ...Eat daily, just like humans! Spiders also like to eat their mates, just like mantises. Though mantises, unlike ants, don't live in colonies. Ant colonies are so cool! They have a graveyard area, and if an ant produces a certain pheromone, they'll think they're dead, when they're actually alive! Comparing and contrasting the role of ant queens and bee queens, you actually find that…

circus_clericcircusmusic.ability: From the 2nd day onward, Demons you nominate die. If an evil player is dead, you are drunk.

jinxes.reason: If the Cleric is sober and nominates the Lleech host, the Lleech host dies.

circus_clericcircusmusic.flavor: A voice from beyond booms in my lungs. In searing light, I will reduce thee to ash. Ash that blows away in the same spectacle.

circus_torchbearercircusmusic.ability: During evil info, you register as the Demon instead of them. If you're nominated & all evil players vote, they win.

jinxes.reason: If the Pit Hag creates a Torchbearer, then any alive player becomes a Torchbearer & learns true Demon Info.
If there was ever a Summoner, the Torchbearer loses if they're executed & all evil players voted.
The Demon can't gain the Torchbearer ability.
If the Spy and Torchbearer are both in-play, the Torchbearer has no ability during the day.
If the Widow and Torchbearer are both in-play, the Torchbearer has no ability during the day.
Minions would think the Torchbearer is the Seer (instead of the real Seer).

circus_torchbearercircusmusic.flavor: At the edge of the light, the darkness follows.

circus_malumcircusmusic.ability: You start knowing the in-play Minions. They might change if a good player is "mad" this info is false, even if you're dead.
circus_malumcircusmusic.firstNightReminder: Show the Malum the character token of every in-play Minion character.
circus_malumcircusmusic.otherNightReminder: If any player is marked with the Malum's MAD reminder token, you may change a Minion's character to a different Minion character. If you do, wake this Minion and show them the "YOU ARE" info token and then their new Minion character. Put this Minion to sleep.

jinxes.reason: If the Malum would remove the Summoner before they use their ability, they use it immediately. The Summoner cannot create an in-play Demon. Deaths are arbitrary tonight if the Summoner used their ability.
If the Malum would remove the Caliban before the Demon uses their ability, they use it immediately.

circus_malumcircusmusic.flavor: Discipuli edunt malum donec aegrotant. Aspirare debemus similes esse, charissime.

circus_prodigycircusmusic.ability: You start knowing everyone with a trait & guess it each day, even if dead. If you haven't guessed true, executed Demons win.
circus_prodigycircusmusic.firstNightReminder: Point to every player marked with a night order token. Put the Prodigy to sleep.

jinxes.reason: The Chambermaid learns if the Prodigy wakes tonight or not, even though the Chambermaid wakes first.
The Mathematician learns if the Prodigy's ability will malfunction tonight, even though the Mathematician wakes first.
The Pit-Hag cannot make a Prodigy.
The Spy does not see the “Enlightened” reminder token when looking into the Grimoire.

circus_prodigycircusmusic.flavor: The other children kicked the ball amongst each other, playing in reality. I kicked the ball alone, playing with reality.

circus_shadecircusmusic.ability: Once per game, a player you vote for might die tonight (& learn this), but appear alive until executed.
circus_shadecircusmusic.otherNightReminder: Wake the player marked DEAD. Show them the THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU info token, and then the Shade character token. Put them to sleep. They die, but do not announce this tomorrow morning.

jinxes.reason: The player killed by the Shade registers as alive to the Chambermaid ability.
The professor may choose alive players.

circus_shadecircusmusic.flavor: I worry that when I'm not looking, people I love are dying, and they aren't around to tell me.

circus_dragonkillercircusmusic.ability: Only the Demon can register as an evil player or character to Townsfolk, even if you die.

jinxes.reason: If there is a Dragon Killer in play, there is a player who (in spite of the Dragon Killer ability) registers as an in-play Minion character to the Investigator.
If there is a Dragon Killer in play, the neighbors of Minions might register as Minions to the Clockmaker (in spite of the Dragon Killer ability).

circus_dragonkillercircusmusic.flavor: I can die 1000 times, and still get up. But you, you only need to die once.

circus_shepherdcircusmusic.ability: If only 3 players live (not Travellers), your team loses at dawn.

jinxes.reason: If the Pit Hag makes a player into the Shepherd, deaths tonight are arbitrary.
If the Shepherd is alive on the final day, their team loses.
If the Shepherd is alive on the final day, their team loses.

circus_shepherdcircusmusic.flavor: Look, my mamma didn't raise no quitter, ok!? She passed when I was young.

circus_sinnercircusmusic.ability: If 2 players live, even if you don't, the most recently killed executee's team wins. Dead Townsfolk are evil.

jinxes.reason: Only 1 jinxed character can be in-play.
The Pit-Hag cannot create a Sinner, or change a Sinner's character.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in-play.
If the Sinner exits play, Townsfolk they made evil become good.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in-play.
The Mastermind ability is prioritized over the Sinner ability.
The Demon cannot have the Sinner ability.
If the Sinner exits play, Townsfolk they made evil turn good.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in-play.
If a Sinner is in play, the team of the player executed on the 5th day wins (even if 1 good player has already been executed).
On the 3rd dawn, if a Riot is in play, the Sinner is drunk from then onwards.
If the Sinner exits play, Townsfolk they made evil become good.

circus_sinnercircusmusic.flavor: The best medicine in the world is someone to blame.

circus_showmancircusmusic.ability: Players who don’t applaud your (& only your) death might die at any time.
circus_showmancircusmusic.flavor: Thank you, thank you. I feel I just gave the performance of a lifetime! I said, I just gave the performance of a lifetime.

circus_gentlemancircusmusic.ability: You start knowing 1 good player, & once per game, may publicly order them. They follow, or might be executed.
circus_gentlemancircusmusic.firstNightReminder: Point to the player marked ADMIRER.
circus_gentlemancircusmusic.flavor: If looks could kill, we’d both be dead. Let’s keep our beautiful eyes closed.

circus_shankaarcircusmusic.ability: Each night, Evil players secretly communicate for 1 minute. [A good neighbor is an evil Shankaar]
circus_shankaarcircusmusic.firstNightReminder: Wake all evil players. Show them the THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU info token and then the Shankaar character token. Give them a silent countdown of "3, 2, 1…". They can then secretly communicate for 1 minute. When the minute ends, put all evil players to sleep.
circus_shankaarcircusmusic.otherNightReminder: Wake all evil players. Show them the THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU info token and then the Shankaar character token. Give them a silent countdown of "3, 2, 1…". They can then secretly communicate for 1 minute. When the minute ends, put all evil players to sleep.

jinxes.reason: If the Alchemist has the Shankaar ability, the new Shankaar does not become evil.
The King registers as evil to the Shankaar setup ability if there is a Choiroy.
The Cult Leader does not wake for secret communication.
If the Engineer creates a Shankaar, one of their good neighbors becomes an evil Shankaar. If they remove the Shankaar, one becomes a chosen Minion, the other loses their ability.
If the Damsel becomes a Shankaar, another good player becomes the Damsel.
If the Shankaar is in play, the Minions will secretly communicate, and they can choose 1 extra player to communicate with them.
If the Poppy Grower is in play, Evil players don't wake to secretly communicate until the Poppy Grower dies.
The Ogre does not wake for secret communication.
Evil Townsfolk don’t wake for evil communication.
The Marionette does not wake for secret communication.
The Kazali may choose 2 neighboring players to be Shankaars.

circus_shankaarcircusmusic.flavor: In fire we’re born…In unity we live…

circus_alpheracircusmusic.ability: Each day you may publicly guess every player's character: if all are correct, your team wins.

jinxes.reason: If the Storyteller would gain the Alphera ability, the Demon does instead.
The widow does not see the Grimoire if an Alphera is alive.
The Spy does not see the Grimoire if an Alphera is alive.

circus_calibancircusmusic.ability: Once per game, at night, the Demon chooses which alive player is an evil Caliban. [No one is Caliban, +1 Outsider]
circus_calibancircusmusic.firstNightReminder: If the demon has the HAS CALIBAN reminder token, wake them & show them the Caliban Token. They shake their had or point to a player. Change the chosen player's character token to the Caliban's, and put the demon to sleep. If a player is Caliban, remove the demon's HAS CALIBAN reminder token.
circus_calibancircusmusic.otherNightReminder: If the demon has the HAS CALIBAN reminder token, wake them & show them the Caliban Token. They shake their had or point to a player. Change the chosen player's character token to the Caliban's, and put the demon to sleep. If a player is Caliban, remove the demon's HAS CALIBAN reminder token.

jinxes.reason: If the alchemist would gain the Caliban ability, they register as the demon to it.
If no players are Minions, the Clockmaker won't receive their information until one is.
The Demon can’t turn the King into Caliban.
If the Demon hasn't chosen who Caliban is yet, and the Engineer removes it from play, then one of the demon's alive neighbors becomes the evil minion they chose.
If the Demon makes the Damsel into Caliban, and there is an alive Huntsman, a different living player becomes the Damsel and the Huntsman learns this.
If the Caliban is in play, the Investigator might not receive their information until a Caliban is created. If this happens, the Investigator must learn about the Caliban.
If there is a Magician in play, the Demon might think that 1 of their minions is Caliban instead of the Magician.
If the Poppy Grower is alive when the Demon chooses who Caliban will be, the Storyteller chooses who becomes Caliban.
The Summoner registers as the Demon to Caliban, until a demon is made.
The Vizier knows who Caliban is.
If the Kazali chooses to make a Caliban using their ability, then Caliban is one of their minions, and nothing happens to the chosen player.

circus_calibancircusmusic.flavor: Caliban: A plague upon that tyrant I serve! I won't get him any more sticks! I'll follow you, you wondrous man.

circus_arielcircusmusic.ability: Once per game, while dead, publicly choose a player: if they're executed, their team loses.

jinxes.reason: The Vizier ability cannot execute the player cursed by Ariel.

circus_curionistcircusmusic.ability: On your 1st night, choose 2 players: they're poisoned. The Storyteller may prompt you to choose differently.
circus_curionistcircusmusic.firstNightReminder: The Curionist points to 2 players: they're poisoned -- Mark them with the Curionist's POISONED reminder. You may ask them to choose differently by shaking your head, pointing at the Curionist ability text on the character sheet, and waiting for the Curionist to choose again.
circus_curionistcircusmusic.flavor: Be calm and collected as you're calmly collected.

circus_cordycepscircusmusic.ability: Dead Townsfolk, Outsiders, & Minions regain their ability. Alive Townsfolk are poisoned.

jinxes.reason: The Professor can't choose themself.
If the Snake Charmer is dead, the Demon would instead swap character & alignment with any alive Townsfolk.
If the Alchemist would gain the Cordyceps ability, the Storyteller has it instead & the Alchemist learns this.
The Huntsman can choose dead players.
When a dead Torchbearer regains their ability, they learn true Demon Info.
The Zealot loses their ability when they die.
A dead Shepherd has no ability.
If the Devil's Advocate is dead, they can't choose the Demon.
A dead Mezepheles does not get a new word.

circus_cordycepscircusmusic.flavor: Subject is suffering delusions of animacy. Please investigate further.

circus_tiresiascircusmusic.ability: Each night, see the Grimoire, & then, choose a player: they die. Minions steal 1 bluff & only know you. You don't know them.
circus_tiresiascircusmusic.firstNightReminder: Instead of Minion info, wake each Minion one by one. Show this Minion the THESE CHARACTERS ARE NOT IN PLAY info token, and then one of the Demon’s bluffs. Then show them the THIS IS YOUR DEMON info token, and point to the Seer. Put them to sleep. During the Demon Info step, don't show the Seer their Minions or any bluffs they learned. Show the Seer the adjusted Grimoire. Put the Seer back to sleep. Readjust the characters and reminder tokens in your Grimoire until it is accurate.
circus_tiresiascircusmusic.otherNightReminder: Show the Seer the adjusted Grimoire. They will take a Shroud token and place it on a player’s character token — That player dies, you may mark them with the DEAD reminder token. Put the Seer back to sleep. Readjust the characters and reminder tokens in your Grimoire until it is accurate.

jinxes.reason: The Seer doesn’t learn their team when the Poppy Grower dies, & Minions don't learn each other.
Minions learn both the Seer & the Magician. The Seer doesn't think the Magician is a Minion.
The Seer thinks the Snake Charmer is a different good character which isn’t in play.
When the Seer chooses that a player is Caliban, the Storyteller chooses which player.
The Seer knows the Marionette is in-play, but not who they are. The Marionette does not steal a bluff.
The Seer does not wake for secret communication. Only 1 Shankaar steals a bluff.

circus_tiresiascircusmusic.flavor: You seek a homecoming sweet as honey, but a god will make it bitter.

circus_comediarchcircusmusic.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. If the last executee isn't a Townsfolk, evil wins when you're executed.
circus_comediarchcircusmusic.otherNightReminder: The Comediarch points at any player -- mark them with the Comediarch's DEAD reminder token.
circus_comediarchcircusmusic.flavor: I shall live as I die, and die as I live: laughing along the way.

circus_prosperorcircusmusic.ability: Each night, all players may silently choose to die. Only evil players see their choice, & they win if no one dies tonight.
circus_prosperorcircusmusic.otherNightReminder: Ask all players for silence. Players who wish to die tonight raise their hand. They die — mark them with one of the Prosperor’s DEAD reminder tokens. Wake evil players either together or one by one. After an evil player wakes, they may choose to die, just like other players.

jinxes.reason: If the Exorcist chooses the Prosperor, only 1 player dies tonight. If no one would die that night, the Exorcist dies.
The Storyteller might wake the Lunatic to see which players choose to die.
Evil Townsfolk don't wake to see which players choose to die.
The Ogre always wakes (separately) to see which players choose to die, regardless of their alignment.
If the Prosperor dies by execution, and the Mastermind is alive, the Prosperor keeps their ability until dawn. The 1st player to die that night doesn’t, and the good team wins the next day.
The Marionette does not wake to see which players choose to die. Evil players may choose to wake one of their neighbors during the Prosperor ability.

circus_prosperorcircusmusic.flavor: Siamo fatti della stessa materia di cui sono fatti i sogni e la nostra breve vita è circondata dal sonno.

circus_eclypsocircusmusic.ability: If a player died today, or no one has in 2 days, choose 3 players tonight: they all die.
circus_eclypsocircusmusic.otherNightReminder: If a player is marked with the DIED TODAY reminder token, wake the Eclypso. They point to any 3 players. Those players die -- mark them with the Eclypo's DEAD reminder tokens.
circus_eclypsocircusmusic.flavor: If you look way up, you’ll see the northern lights, the shooting stars, and the sky falling.

circus_maskmakercircusmusic.ability: Name any character. There might be 1 or more of that character in-play.
circus_maskmakercircusmusic.flavor: Following the crowd is really popular nowadays.

manors_carpenteromnm.ability: Each night, choose a player: you learn if they are a Townsfolk or a Demon.
manors_carpenteromnm.flavor: How can you say to your brother, ‘Brother, let me take the speck out of your eye,’ when you yourself fail to see the plank in your own eye? You hypocrite, first take the plank out of your eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brother’s eye.

manors_clerkomnm.ability: Each night, choose 2 players (not yourself): you learn whose character is later in the script order.
manors_clerkomnm.flavor: Hello, Mr. Morozov, let me just bring up your documents... hmmm, you should be between Mr. Minstrel and Ms. Nightwatchman, but I'm afraid there's no file present. Let me check again before I call my supervisor.

manors_janitoromnm.ability: Each night, you learn 2 players: the 2nd neighbors a non-Townsfolk if (& only if) the 1st is a Townsfolk.
manors_janitoromnm.firstNightReminder: Wake the Janitor and point to 2 players.
manors_janitoromnm.otherNightReminder: Wake the Janitor and point to 2 players.
manors_janitoromnm.flavor: Oh dear. Look at the mess. No doubt some troublemaker's causing a ruckus in the quadrangle again. In a respectable establishment such as this one? To think of it! And right next to where I had to mop up the bloodstains yesterday.

manors_surgeonomnm.ability: Each night, you learn a dead character.
manors_surgeonomnm.flavor: Note #133: Patient arrived dead on site with large lacerations across upper abdominal and severe bleeding. Cause of death unknown but likely related to large pitchfork found protruding from patient's chest. More testing required.

manors_trapper.ability: Each night, choose a player & guess a Minion: if correct, they die.
manors_trapper.otherNightReminder: Wake the Trapper. Get them to choose a player and make a guess. If they are correct, mark the Minion with the:DEAD: reminder token. That Minion dies. Put the Trapper to sleep.
manors_trapper.flavor: Bear traps? Didn't know bears could do that.

manors_pawnbrokeromnm.ability: Each day, you may visit the Storyteller to answer a numerical question: you learn if you're correct.
manors_pawnbrokeromnm.flavor: You think I'm giving you 500 for that lousy old trident thing you've got? No buyer is looking for oversized red Halloween decorations in the middle of March. My friend, I'll give you 40 and a firm handshake and we can call it a deal. Shake on it.

manors_oratoromnm.ability: Each day, visit the Storyteller & make a (non-ambiguous) statement: they reply with something equally true.
manors_oratoromnm.flavor: Reality is exactly what you call it. I speak, and the universe listens.

manors_croupieromnm.ability: If a Minion nominates, executes, & kills the Demon (ending the game), they change alignment, even if you are dead.
manors_croupieromnm.flavor: Ladies and gentlemen, all bets are off. All on black I see Mister... hm, I'm sorry, I don't think I've seen you here before. Thank you very much for choosing to sit at our table today, I wish you the best of luck.

manors_boxeromnm.ability: Minions you nominate die. If you nominate a good player, you are drunk.

manors_priestomnm.ability: Outsiders start knowing you are the Priest. [-1 to +? Outsiders]
manors_priestomnm.flavor: Speak thy Shibboleth, and all who do shall be welcomed with open arms to the land of plenty.

manors_diva.ability: Each night, you learn a player: their info is reversed. If they were evil, lose (or regain) this ability.
manors_diva.firstNightReminder: Wake the Diva. Do the ability.
manors_diva.otherNightReminder: Wake the Diva. Do the ability.
manors_diva.flavor: Honey, that colour doesn't match your face shape at all, you need to fix your outfit. Didn't you hear? Blue is just so yesterday.

manors_faeomnm.ability: Each night, if you were mad as a Townsfolk today, you might become it. [+? Fae]
manors_faeomnm.flavor: Oft fire is without smoke, / And perill without show.

manors_wirewalker.ability: You think you are an in-play Townsfolk, but your info is reversed. You might (once) swap characters with them at dusk.
manors_wirewalker.flavor: On one side, the mass of a mountain. A life I know. On the other, the universe of the clouds, so full of unknown that it seems empty to us. Too much space.

manors_skunkomnm.ability: When you die, your good neighbors might die at any point from now on.
manors_skunkomnm.flavor: You know what they say about he who smelt it...

manors_vigilanteomnm.ability: The 1st time an evil player dies, they don't.
manors_vigilanteomnm.flavor: Don't worry, I'm here to save you!

manors_mystic1omnm.ability: Minions who die after you do keep their ability.
manors_mystic1omnm.flavor: Truth is not a solid thing, there nothing at which to point the suggestion of an abstract understanding. Wisdom and magick are but two equally ethereal sides of the same coin.

manors_rogueomnm.ability: 1 good player is drunk. Each night, guess who: if correct, you die.
manors_rogueomnm.flavor: If you think this is bad, you should've seen the other guy.

manors_gambitomnm.ability: Once per game, while dead & before nominations, publicly choose a player: they win if (& only if) you do.
manors_gambitomnm.flavor: Heavy is the hand that crowns the head.

manors_sidewinderomnm.ability: On your 1st night, choose a direction: Townsfolk between you & the Demon in that direction receive reversed info.
manors_sidewinderomnm.firstNightReminder: Wake the Sidewinder & prompt them for a direction.
manors_sidewinderomnm.flavor: In the cold and ssilent night, torchlight and candlewick can give no ssolace againsst the quiet encroach of sshadow everlassting.

manors_camarilloomnm.ability: The 1st time the Demon dies at night, they don't & register as dead, waking every 2nd night.

manors_czaromnm.ability: Players can't nominate & may point to vote for who is executed at dusk, even if you are dead.
manors_czaromnm.flavor: The ignorance of the many gives way for the tyranny of the few.

manors_metalhead.ability: Executions might kill an alive neighbor of the executee too. Each night, choose in which direction.
manors_metalhead.firstNightReminder: Wake the Metalhead and get a direction.
manors_metalhead.otherNightReminder: Wake the Metalhead and get a direction.
manors_metalhead.flavor: In any real city, you walk, you brush past people, and people bump into you. In L.A., nobody touches you. We’re always behind this metal and glass. I think we miss that touch so much, that we crash into each other just so we can feel something.

manors_haze.ability: Townsfolk who neighbor Outsiders get false info. Outsiders may publicly dispel this: if all do, none did. [-1 or +1 Outsider].
manors_haze.flavor: Upon you, a plague of dust, incense, and noxious powder descends. By day, there will be salt on the scars of the earth, and an unmoving miasma into which all light plunges headlong.

manors_paranoia.ability: Each night, a player might die. Minions you nominate become Paranoia that night.

manors_hororkkaomnm.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Townsfolk who nominate are poisoned. [-1 Outsider]
manors_hororkkaomnm.otherNightReminder: Wake the Hororkka. Mark the player they chose as DEAD. Put the Hororkka to sleep.
manors_hororkkaomnm.flavor: He who pricks his thumb, and thereby bears witness to his own blood for the first time, shall carry with him two axioms of reality forevermore. First, that he is human, and second, that he is mortal.

manors_fabularumomnm.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Evil players may call for & look inside the Grimoire at any time.
manors_fabularumomnm.flavor: My apologies teknon, but sometimes the threads of life condemn us all. It is as the Fates commanded.

manors_qandichi.ability: Each night, put your token in the Storyteller's hand & choose 3 players: they each guess where it is & if wrong, die.
manors_qandichi.otherNightReminder: Wake the Qandichi and put their token in your hand. Get their 3 choices. Put them to sleep. Then wake the chosen players to get their choices. Reveal which hand it was in. Put them to sleep.
manors_qandichi.flavor: Let me tell you the story of Right Hand, Left Hand. It's a tale of good and evil. Hate: it was with this hand that Cain iced his brother. Love: these five fingers, they go straight to the soul of man. The right hand: the hand of love. The story of life is this: static.

manors_proteon.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Each dusk, all players vote on which of 2 modifications to this ability you get.
manors_proteon.otherNightReminder: Wake the Proteon. Run the ability.
manors_proteon.flavor: I will not sleep there when this night comes. A shut door of a silent tower entombing their blind bodies, the panthersahib and his pointer. Call: no answer.

manors_katastrophomnm.ability: On night 2, choose 1 good player to learn who you are, & 2 players to learn falsely. After day 2, evil wins.
manors_katastrophomnm.flavor: Through me you go into a city of weeping; through me you go into eternal pain; through me you go amongst the lost people.

manors_chimneysweepomnm.ability: Once per game, you may publicly choose a player: they are immediately resurrected as a Chimneysweep of their alignment.

manors_steeplechaseomnm.ability: Nominators must 'tag' their nominees before you count down from 10, or the nomination immediately fails.
manors_steeplechaseomnm.flavor: And coming up on the left its Seabiscuit hitting on the rear of Secretariat, Seabiscuit on the move, oh it's close, very very close, Marengo closing the gap but Seabiscuit is now a nose ahead but oh OH OH OH! ITS SECRETARIAT!

manors_xanaduomnm.ability: There might be 1 unlisted Minion & Townsfolk in play. They start knowing each other's characters.
manors_xanaduomnm.firstNightReminder: Wake the unlisted Townsfolk & inform them of which unlisted Minion is in play. Put them to sleep. Wake the unlisted Minion & inform them of which unlisted Townsfolk is in play. Put them to sleep.
manors_xanaduomnm.flavor: Where Alph the sacred river ran, / Through caverns measureless to man / Down to a sunless sea.

pandora_pioneer.ability: You start knowing 1 character of each type, 1 of which you neighbor & the rest are not in play.
pandora_pioneer.firstNightReminder: Show the Pioneer 1 character of each type, 1 of which they neighbour & the rest are not in play.
pandora_pioneer.flavor: You can never cross the ocean unless you have the courage to lose sight of the shore.

pandora_taxidermist.ability: Each night, choose a player: chosen Outsiders become Townsfolk & chosen Minions become Outsiders.

jinxes.reason: A starting evil player that becomes a Cult Leader can't turn good due to their own ability.
A starting evil player that becomes a Goon can't turn good due to their own ability.
A starting evil player that becomes an Ogre can't turn good due to their own ability.
A starting evil player that becomes a Politician can't turn good due to their own ability.

pandora_taxidermist.flavor: I appreciate the elk carcass, ma'am, truly. You've kept me well stocked. I'd prefer you not lose the eyes next time, though beggars shan't be choosers, I suppose.

pandora_paparazzo.ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): tomorrow night, learn something they said privately that day.
pandora_paparazzo.firstNightReminder: The Paparazzo chooses a player. Mark them with the EAVESDROP reminder.
pandora_paparazzo.otherNightReminder: Tell the Paparazzo something the player marked with the EAVESDROP reminder said yesterday. Then, they choose a player. Mark them with the EAVESDROP reminder.
pandora_paparazzo.flavor: Read The Exclusive Scoop: Our Gracious and Everloving Monarch Spotted Eating Cake Messily While Donning Garbs Sown Of Two (2) Different Fabrics. Read More On Page 5.

pandora_monarch.ability: Each night, learn 2 characters that are both in play or both not in play. 1 Minion knows you are the Monarch.
pandora_monarch.firstNightReminder: Wake a Minion and show them who the Monarch is. Wake the Monarch and show them two players.
pandora_monarch.otherNightReminder: Wake the Monarch and show them two players.
pandora_monarch.flavor: You've all read the news, no doubt. Those bastard columnists are quick at their work, I'll give them that. I trust that you all know what to do.

pandora_lamplighter.ability: Each night, choose a player: a Lamplighter (or you) might learn that player's character. [+0 to +2 Lamplighters]
pandora_lamplighter.firstNightReminder: Each Lamplighter chooses a player. For each, you may wake a Lamplighter to learn that player's character.
pandora_lamplighter.otherNightReminder: Each Lamplighter chooses a player. For each, you may wake a Lamplighter to learn that player's character.
pandora_lamplighter.flavor: Did any of yous see 'oo that was?

pandora_royalist.ability: Each night, if the Monarch died at night, you learn 1 evil player. [+the Monarch]
pandora_royalist.otherNightReminder: If a Monarch died at night, show the Royalist an evil player.

jinxes.reason: The Kazali can't choose the Monarch to become a Minion if a Royalist is in play.

pandora_royalist.flavor: Yes, sire. Of course, sire. At once, sire... sire? Sire!

pandora_varulv.ability: You think you are a Demon, but are not & have its ability. The Demon is drunk. When you would kill an evil player, you die instead.
pandora_varulv.flavor: De får inte se mig så här. De kan inte hitta dig, inte nu. Jag ber, förlåt mig.

pandora_bequeather.ability: If the Demon kills you, choose an alive player: by dawn, exactly 3 players live, including who you chose.
pandora_bequeather.otherNightReminder: If the Demon killed the Bequeather tonight, wake them to choose a player. Before tomorrow day, choose which three players are alive., which must include the Bequeather's choice.
pandora_bequeather.flavor: It's what your old man would've wanted.

pandora_coblyn.ability: Characters you are mad as are sober, healthy, and get true info, even if you are dead.
pandora_coblyn.flavor: Yn curo ar greigiau! Mae'n swnio fel aur gwag.

pandora_hunter.ability: A Minion gets the Demon's bluffs instead. [-0 to -1 Outsiders. You are equidistant to 2 evil players]
pandora_hunter.firstNightReminder: During Minion info, wake one Minion and show them the Demon's bluffs. During Demon info, do not give the Demon their bluffs.
pandora_hunter.flavor: I'ont care what form these beings've made themselves out to be, no self respecting spawn of Hell can resist a bacon sarnie. Just watch. An' be quiet.

pandora_initiate.ability: Each night, if there is an evil Initiate (including you) or no living Mouthpiece, you change character.
pandora_initiate.otherNightReminder: If there is an evil Initiate or no living Mouthpiece, change the Initiate's character and wake them to inform them.

jinxes.reason: Initiates don't change characters when a Vigormortis-killed Mouthpiece keeps their ability.

pandora_initiate.flavor: The leaflet said there'd be free drinks.

pandora_scab.ability: You must vote if neither of your neighbours do. The 1st time you vote on a tie, 1 voter turns evil.
pandora_scab.flavor: Right to work! Right! To! Work!

pandora_apostle.ability: When you die, until tomorrow night, whoever wins, loses & whoever loses, wins.

jinxes.reason: The Demon cannot have the Apostle ability.
If a Pit-Hag creates an Apostle, the Storyteller chooses which player it is.
If an evil player has seen the Grimoire, the Apostle is poisoned.
If an evil player has seen the Grimoire, the Apostle is poisoned.
A Lleech-poisoned Apostle remains poisoned when the Lleech dies.

pandora_apostle.flavor: See to the return of this coin. Please. I regret it all. Oh Lord, forgive me.

pandora_captain.ability: When you nominate an evil player, you are both executed. Demons swap characters with a Minion before dying, even if you are dead.
pandora_captain.otherNightReminder: If a Demon was killed, they swap characters with an alive evil (& then count as having died.)

jinxes.reason: While the Mastermind has their ability, the Demon doesn't swap characters with a Minion when executed.
If the player holding the Lil' Monsta token dies, they swap characters with a Minion, and that Minion is given the Lil' Monsta token tonight.
If the Fang Gu dies by jumping to an Outsider, they don't swap characters with a Minion.

pandora_captain.flavor: What is it, what nameless, inscrutable, unearthly thing is it; what cozening, hidden lord and master, and cruel, remorseless emperor commands me; Is it I, God, or who, that lifts this arm?

pandora_butterfingers.ability: If all Outsiders dying would cause your team to lose, they die.
pandora_butterfingers.flavor: You're supposed to pass sharp objects with the handle pointing to the other person. It's polite.

pandora_yodeller.ability: If a Minion guesses you (once), your team loses. Each day, the Storyteller announces something they believe you think.
pandora_yodeller.otherNightReminder: At some point today, announce something you believe the Yodeller thinks.

jinxes.reason: If a Pit-Hag creates a Yodeller, the Storyteller chooses which player it is.

pandora_amalgamate.ability: Amalgamates think they are the same not in play character. [-1 to +1 Outsiders. All Outsiders are Amalgamates]

jinxes.reason: The Demon cannot have the Amalgamate ability.
A Damsel added by the Huntsman's setup ability can't be removed by the Amalgamate's setup ability.

pandora_amalgamate.flavor: Hello,      ! Take care?      , huh. It's fantastic, isn't      ! Ha      Ha Ha.

pandora_masquerade.ability: Masquerade are a team against all others. If the Storyteller dies, Masquerade loses. Anything goes. [Some players join the Masquerade]
pandora_masquerade.firstNightReminder: Tell the Masquerade who they are (including each other, if you so choose) and else anything you would like to tell them.
pandora_masquerade.flavor: Do they know that we love them? That the universe is kind?

pandora_mouthpiece.ability: You start knowing all Initiates & how to turn 1 evil. [+1 to +? Initiates]
pandora_mouthpiece.firstNightReminder: Wake the Mouthpiece and tell them how they can turn an Initiate evil, then point to each Initiate.
pandora_mouthpiece.flavor: Sacrifice is only the start. Hold this dagger, please. Our magick Lord needs utter devotion. Stand still. Only then will He be able to reach your soul through your sins.

pandora_mindflayer.ability: Each night, choose a player & 2 characters: tomorrow, if they're mad the 1st is in play, or the 2nd isn't, they might be executed or become either.
pandora_mindflayer.firstNightReminder: Wake the Mind Flayer to choose a player and two characters.
pandora_mindflayer.otherNightReminder: Wake the Mind Flayer to choose a player and two characters.
pandora_mindflayer.flavor: Qrwn ih! / Deja vu? / Lrf. / No. / Guvf unf arire unccrarq orsber. / This has happened before. / Jurer qb V fgneg naq lbh ortva? / You will ask tomorrow as well.

pandora_dhampir.ability: Each night, learn a dead character: you might register as them until dawn. [+1 Outsider. Your furthest Outsider is evil]
pandora_dhampir.otherNightReminder: Mark a dead player with the NEW BLOOD reminder. Show that player's character to the Dhampir.

jinxes.reason: An Alchemist-Dhampir's setup ability doesn't turn an Outsider evil.
If both setup abilities would turn a player evil, only the Dhampir's does instead.
If the Dhampir's setup ability turns an Ogre evil, the Ogre loses their ability and learns who the Dhampir is.
If the Dhampir's setup ability turns a Lunatic evil, the Dhampir must be in their Demon info.

pandora_dhampir.flavor: Run far from here, tenderfoot. Leave but nothing in thy stead. Zoti të bekoftë, i huaj.

pandora_hobgoblin.ability: Each day, if you were mad that you are an Outsider before you were 'about to die', evil wins when you're executed.
pandora_hobgoblin.flavor: Ah'm but frail, lad. These're men who've lost their sense. Lookit me. D'you think I could've eaten a person whole? Barely a person whole meself, tsk.

pandora_cleaner.ability: If no-one died tonight, choose a player: they die, even if they couldn't.
pandora_cleaner.otherNightReminder: If no-one died tonight, wake the Cleaner to choose a player.

pandora_sawbones.ability: Dead players register as alive until the dawn after you die.
pandora_sawbones.flavor: No patient has died under my watch. Feel free to check the records. They're a brisk read.

pandora_static.ability: At any point, players might have an ability they had last game. Good players cannot kill Demons this way.
