pandora_static.flavor: Don't you remember, <username>? We can Paint and Browser just like we used to. Insert Device. Please Insert Device.

pandora_tradixionale.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. [All Minions & some good player's characters are non-listed, from a shared base script.]

jinxes.reason: The Storyteller can gain Minion abilities from the Tradixionale's base script.
The Alchemist can have Minion abilities from the Tradixionale's base script.
The Boffin can give the Tradixionale a not-in-play good character's ability from the Tradixionale's base script.

pandora_tradixionale.flavor: There's Trumpets; in Heaven!/ 6 ft. Underground./ MIGHTY & Muddy./ <<they Faintly resound.

pandora_nisangoroshi.ability: On your 1st night, choose 2 players: they're poisoned & get false info. After day 3, evil wins, delayed by 1 per alive poisoned player.
pandora_nisangoroshi.firstNightReminder: Wake the Nisangoroshi to choose 2 players.
pandora_nisangoroshi.flavor: ふた・つ! Thank you for getting in contact with our institution. みっ・つ! To access the mind, please press your finger into the palm of your hand. いつ・つ! To access the body, please coil your finger around the cord. むっ・つ! To access the soul, please hang up and exit the room. よっ・つ!

pandora_kukekua.ability: If you publicly guess an alive Captain (once), their team loses. Each night, a non-Captain dies. [+1 Outsider. 1 Outsider is the Captain]
pandora_kukekua.otherNightReminder: Kill a player other than the Captain.

jinxes.reason: Evil players that see the Grimoire don't see the characters of good players, or any reminder tokens on them.
Evil players that see the Grimoire don't see the characters of good players, or any reminder tokens on them.

pandora_kukekua.flavor: KNEEL AHAB. KNEEL AND GROVEL AND SPIT UP YOUR LAST. I AM THE HOLY GRAIL.

pandora_bard.ability: Your rhyming nominations that would fail, succeed & vice versa. If your exile isn't called in rhyme, the caller dies.
pandora_bard.flavor: Oh, who am I? Em(maj9) A nobody to an urbanite like yourself, monsieur, I'm sure. Abdim7 But to the dwellers of this humble town... Gadd9...I am... A7...Magnus Magnifique XI! short but nonetheless heartfelt lute solo

pandora_crab.ability: When your exile is called or 1 of your neighbors is nominated, you may nominate 1 more player simultaneously.
pandora_crab.flavor: BORN TO DIE / WORLD IS A FUCK / Kill Em All 1787 / I am crab man / 410,757,864,530 DEAD IMPS

pandora_ashore.ability: Particular non-listed characters register as being listed & vice-versa, to particular characters (all know which).
pandora_ashore.firstNightReminder: If you haven't already, make sure players are aware of how Ashore is affecting this script.
pandora_ashore.flavor: The light spins. The light forcing the blood through tangled veins and the air to rotted lungs. It hasn't stopped for the past sixty years. I fear my heart will give its last and I'll still be here.

pandora_numismat.ability: The Storyteller may give or retrieve tokens & players may exchange them. Sober & healthy players holding a token have its ability.
pandora_numismat.flavor: Forty real for the crossbow. My final offer.

templefair_waiter.ability: You start knowing 2 good players: 1 is drunk, even if you are dead.
templefair_waiter.flavor: Welcome back, sir! The usual, I assume?

templefair_yinyangdiviner.ability: You start knowing 2 good & 2 evil characters, exactly 2 of which are in play.
templefair_yinyangdiviner.firstNightReminder: Show the Yinyang Diviner the 4 character tokens.
templefair_yinyangdiviner.flavor: The great Xuanwu is before us. Gods return to their temples, ghosts return to their graves, monsters return to the mountains and forests!

templefair_stargazer.ability: You start knowing if your closest evil player is clockwise, anti-clockwise or equal. If they neighbor you, this info is false.
templefair_stargazer.firstNightReminder: Point clockwise or anticlockwise, or down if equidistant.
templefair_stargazer.flavor: Strange phenomena in the heavens. Something wicked approaches.

templefair_rascal.ability: Each night, choose a Townsfolk character: their ability yields false info until dusk.
templefair_rascal.firstNightReminder: The Rascal points to any Townsfolk character on their character sheet.
templefair_rascal.otherNightReminder: The Rascal points to any Townsfolk character on their character sheet.
templefair_rascal.flavor: This one's mine! This one, too!

templefair_herbdoctor.ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): you learn a word related to their ability.
templefair_herbdoctor.firstNightReminder: The Herb Doctor points to a player. Write down a word relating to that player’s ability and show it to the Herb Doctor.
templefair_herbdoctor.otherNightReminder: The Herb Doctor points to a player. Write down a word relating to that player’s ability and show it to the Herb Doctor.
templefair_herbdoctor.flavor: Increased heart rate. Your qi is weak, dispersing.

templefair_abbot.ability: Each night, the 1st time an evil ability begins affecting one of your alive neighbors, it fails: you learn when this happens.

jinxes.reason: If the Leviathan nominates and executes one of the Abbot’s alive neighbors, that player does not die. That night, the Abbot learns that their ability has activated, and their ability cannot activate again tonight.

If the Riot nominates and executes one of the Abbot’s alive neighbors, that player does not die. That night, the Abbot learns that their ability has activated, and their ability cannot activate again tonight.

templefair_abbot.flavor: Always polish the mirror of the mind, so that no dust can collect.

templefair_brocadier.ability: Each night, choose a player: until dusk, if they die, you die instead.
templefair_brocadier.otherNightReminder: The Brocadier points to a player.
templefair_brocadier.flavor: Come hell or high water, I will protect you, my liege!

templefair_firewatcher.ability: Each night, guess your number of steps to the 1st player to die tonight: if correct, you might die tonight, but no one else can.
templefair_firewatcher.otherNightReminder: The Firewatcher holds up a number of fingers (0, 1, 2 etc.).

jinxes.reason: If the Leviathan is in play, the Firewatcher-protected players are safe from all evil abilities.
If the Riot is in play, the Firewatcher-protected players are safe from all evil abilities.

templefair_firewatcher.flavor: Have you not heard of the prohibition on candles? This could burn the village down in this weather!

templefair_singer.ability: Once per game, during the day, publicly choose any volunteers. If a Demon is chosen, you die tonight.
templefair_singer.otherNightReminder: If the Singer is marked with the DEAD reminder, they die.
templefair_singer.flavor: A singsong girl, unaware of the sorrow of a conquered state, is singing Backyard Flowers on the river’s other shore.

templefair_enlightenedone.ability: You think you are an Outsider. If affected by an evil player’s ability, you first become a not-in-play Townsfolk.

jinxes.reason: The Mathematician learns if the Enlightened One’s ability yielded false info or failed to work properly.
If there is a spare token, the Enlightened One can become an extra Village Idiot. If so, the drunk Village Idiot might change.
The Demon cannot have the Enlightened One ability.

templefair_enlightenedone.flavor: The Six Paths are trees obscuring the forest; in truth, all beings are equal.

templefair_banxian.ability: If you are chosen by a character’s ability at night, an evil player will be targeted instead.

jinxes.reason: If a Riot player nominates the Ban Xian on day 3, another evil player dies instead of the Ban Xian, and nominates next. If the nominator is the only living evil player, the Ban Xian dies as normal.
The Lleech’s poisoning or host choice cannot be redirected.

templefair_banxian.flavor: That man is always covered in grime or rambling incoherently. I can’t get a grip on him.

templefair_facechanger.ability: If you are mad that you are a good character: tonight, you might gain their ability until dusk (once per character).
templefair_facechanger.flavor: One minute of glory on stage, ten years of hard work off stage.

templefair_actortf.ability: All Actors know each other and jointly reverse the victory conditions, even if dead. [All good characters are Actors]

jinxes.reason: Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
At any time, a Legion player can tell the Storyteller that they would like to die. Tonight, the Storyteller wakes all Legion players: if all agree, all die.
At any time, the Demon can tell the Storyteller that they would like to die. The Storyteller kills that player tonight.
At any time, the Demon can tell the Storyteller that they would like to die. The Storyteller kills that player tonight.
At any time, the Demon can tell the Storyteller that they would like to die. The Storyteller kills that player tonight.

At any time, the Demon can tell the Storyteller that they would like to die. The Storyteller kills that player tonight.

Both characters cannot be in play at the start of the game. If an ability turns a good player into the Actor on the first night, the Minions are selected before this happens.
Both characters cannot be in play at the start of the game. If an ability turns a good player into the Actor on the first night, the Minions are selected before this happens.
The Actor cannot reverse the victory conditions due to the Goblin’s ability.
The Actor cannot reverse the victory conditions due to the Fearmonger’s ability.

templefair_actortf.flavor: If we shadows have offended, think but this and all is mended, that you have but slumber’d here, while these visions did appear.

templefair_turncoat.ability: On your 1st night, choose another player. The 1st time one of you dies by execution, the other turns evil that night.
templefair_turncoat.firstNightReminder: The Turncoat points to another player. Mark that player with the RIVAL reminder token.
templefair_turncoat.otherNightReminder: The first time the Turncoat or the player marked RIVAL dies by execution, wake the other one, show them the YOU ARE info token and show a thumbs down for evil.
templefair_turncoat.flavor: I fear his hesitation will cost the general this unique opportunity. A pity.

templefair_ambassador.ability: When an evil player is chosen by an ability at night, you might be targeted instead (once per night), even if dead.

jinxes.reason: The Lleech’s poisoning or host choice cannot be redirected.

templefair_ambassador.flavor: The only thing worse than travelling alone in the wilderness is the company one might find there.

templefair_lummox.ability: If you die, 1 alive neighbor might die tonight.
templefair_lummox.otherNightReminder: If the Lummox died today, one of their living neighbors might die.
templefair_lummox.flavor: Born under an unlucky star? Nonsense! I can't be faulted for the misfortunes of people around me!

templefair_pedant.ability: The Demon knows you are in play. If they privately guess you (once, even if you are dead), tonight, they may choose a player: they die.
templefair_pedant.firstNightReminder: Show the Demon the Pedant character token.
templefair_pedant.otherNightReminder: If the Demon guessed the Pedant player correctly, wake the Demon and show them the Pedant token. They may point to any player: that player DIES.
templefair_pedant.flavor: I accept my fate, but first tell me: at whose hands am I dying?

templefair_bugkeeper.ability: Each night, if you were alive when nominated today, your nominator dies, even if you die first.
templefair_bugkeeper.otherNightReminder: Any player who nominated the alive Bug Keeper dies.

jinxes.reason: If the Storyteller would gain the Bug Keeper ability, a living Minion gains the Bug Keeper ability in addition to their own ability, and learns this.

templefair_bugkeeper.flavor: The venom of the centipede, who ate the spider, who ate the scorpion, who ate the snake… No, it's not enough!

templefair_vixen.ability: On your 1st night, choose a player: they learn the Vixen is in play. If you die by execution, they become evil tonight.
templefair_vixen.firstNightReminder: The Vixen points to a player. Put the Vixen to sleep and wake the chosen player. Show them the THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU info token and the Vixen character token. Put them to sleep.
templefair_vixen.otherNightReminder: If the Vixen died by execution today, turn the character token marked CHARMED upside-down. Wake that player, show them the YOU ARE info token, and thumbs down for evil.

jinxes.reason: Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
If the Storyteller would gain the Vixen ability, a living Minion gains the Vixen ability in addition to their own ability, and learns this.

templefair_vixen.flavor: Your Majesty, the concubine had two sisters. They send their condolences and have requested an audience.

templefair_corpsewalker.ability: The 1st time each of your Townsfolk neighbors die, they register as alive. [−1 Outsider]

jinxes.reason: If the Storyteller would gain the Corpse Walker ability, a living Minion gains the Corpse Walker ability in addition to their own ability, and learns this.

templefair_corpsewalker.flavor: Only journey under the cover of darkness, and never let them find out that your stomach is full of straw.

templefair_imperialist.ability: Players who are mad that they want to live or die (you start by choosing which) might be immediately executed.
templefair_imperialist.firstNightReminder: Show the Imperialist the LIVE and DIE reminder tokens: they point to one. Put the chosen token in the Grimoire.
templefair_imperialist.flavor: He deserved to be beheaded! Yes, he broke curfew, my lord!

templefair_taotie.ability: Each night, choose up to 4 players (or 1 Traveller): if all are different character types, they die. [+1 Outsider]
templefair_taotie.otherNightReminder: The Tao Tie shakes their head no, or points to up to 4 players.
templefair_taotie.flavor: The beast looks like a ram with the face of a human, eyes under its armpits, tiger teeth and a baby's voice. It devours people, and its name is Tao Tie.

templefair_taowu.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. If you die, an alive Minion instead loses their ability. You learn no Demon info.
templefair_taowu.firstNightReminder: Do not wake the Tao Wu to give Demon info.
templefair_taowu.otherNightReminder: The Tao Wu points to a player. That player DIES.

jinxes.reason: The Scarlet Woman registers as having no ability to the Tao Wu.
The Evil Twin registers as having no ability to the Tao Wu.
The Mastermind registers as having no ability to the Tao Wu.
If the Tao Wu is about to be executed and the alive Organ Grinder has their ability, the Storyteller announces that no one is executed.
The Tao Wu does not learn who the Marionette is. If the Marionette has no ability due to the Tao Wu’s ability, the Tao Wu learns who the Marionette is, but the Marionette learns nothing.
If the Tao Wu player changes character, any Minion that lost their ability due to the Tao Wu ability dies immediately.
If the Tao Wu player changes character, any Minion that lost their ability due to the Tao Wu ability dies immediately.
If the Tao Wu player changes character, any Minion that lost their ability due to the Tao Wu ability dies immediately.
If the Tao Wu swaps characters with another player, Minions that lost their ability due to the Tao Wu ability do not get their abilities back.
If the Tao Wu swaps characters with another player, Minions that lost their ability due to the Tao Wu ability do not get their abilities back.

templefair_taowu.flavor: The beast looks like a tiger with a human face, a mouth full of fangs and a tail of 18 foot. It destroys the land in its wake, and it is named Tao Wu.

templefair_hundun.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. If a Townsfolk neighbor dies this way, good non-Travellers are poisoned until dusk.
templefair_hundun.otherNightReminder: The Hun Dun points to a player. That player dies. If they are a Townsfolk neighbor of the Hun Dun, all good players (except Travellers) are poisoned until dusk.
templefair_hundun.flavor: The beast is a four-winged bird, red as cinnabar fire and with six legs but no face. It can sing and dance, and it is known as Hun Dun.

templefair_qiongqi.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die and, if an Outsider died today, register as alive, and another player dies. [+1 Outsider]
templefair_qiongqi.otherNightReminder: The Qiong Qi points to a player. That player dies. If an Outsider died today, the chosen player registers as alive & you choose another player who dies.
templefair_qiongqi.flavor: The beast resembles a winged ox, with spines like a hedgehog and bark like a hound. It eats humans, and it bears the name Qiong Qi.

templefair_pauper.ability: Each day, you may publicly choose a player (not yourself) to pick a non-Demon ability: you might gain it until dawn.
templefair_pauper.flavor: I've had a rough spell, but I can still work. Give me the opportunity to prove myself, and you won't be disappointed!

templefair_qilin.ability: On the final day, something good might happen to the most engaged player.
templefair_qilin.flavor: 麟之趾，振振公子，于嗟麟兮！ 麟之定，振振公姓，于嗟麟兮！ 麟之角，振振公族，于嗟麟兮！

storm_guide.ability: Each night, choose 1 to 3 players: you learn if any of them were chosen or affected by evil abilities tonight.
storm_guide.firstNightReminder: The Guide chooses 1 to 3 players. Nod or shake your head.
storm_guide.otherNightReminder: The Guide chooses 1 to 3 players. Nod or shake your head.

jinxes.reason: The Chambermaid can detect if the Guide will wake tonight.
The Guide learns if the Mathematician is affected or not, even though the Guide wakes first.

storm_guide.flavor: The boat is slow and difficult to steer. It is weighed down by the stench of evil.

storm_broker.ability: Each night, choose 2 alive players: if they are the same alignment, abilities targeting one will instead target the other tonight.
storm_broker.firstNightReminder: The Broker chooses 2 living players. If they are the same alignment, mark both CLIENT.
storm_broker.otherNightReminder: The Broker chooses 2 living players. If they are the same alignment, mark both CLIENT.

jinxes.reason: The Broker cannot redirect the Lleech’s choice of host or the associated poisoning.

storm_broker.flavor: Deals may fail, but loyalty remains.

storm_prefect.ability: Each night, you learn if a non-Townsfolk (& non-Traveller) died since dawn.
storm_prefect.otherNightReminder: Either nod or shake your head.

storm_cleric.ability: Each night, choose a player: if you choose the Demon, you die & they are drunk until dawn.
storm_cleric.otherNightReminder: The Cleric chooses a player. If a Demon is chosen, the Cleric dies and the Demon becomes drunk.
storm_cleric.flavor: The way that can be spoken is not the true Way.

storm_patrol.ability: Each night, choose 2 good characters (different to last night): if both are alive, they can’t die tonight.

jinxes.reason: If the Leviathan is in play, the Patrol-protected player is safe from all evil abilities.
If the Riot is in play, the Patrol-protected player is safe from all evil abilities.

storm_patrol.flavor: Lay the world’s injustices to rest, and bring peace to uneasy hearts.

storm_tabby.ability: Each night, choose a player: if they are a good character & die to an evil character tonight, you swap characters.

jinxes.reason: If the Professor has already used their ability when swapping characters with the Tabby, the new Professor has no ability.
If the Tabby swaps characters with the Banshee, the Storyteller does not announce that the Banshee died.
If the Demon has the Tabby ability and successfully activates it, the targeted player becomes the Tabby, and the Demon instead gains the ability of the targeted player's previous character.
Each night, the Leviathan chooses an alive player (different to previous nights): if they choose the same player as the Tabby, the Tabby’s ability activates, but the chosen player does not die.
Each night, Riot chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): if they choose the same player as the Tabby, the Tabby’s ability activates, but the chosen player does not die.

storm_tabby.flavor: How could my beloved consort give birth to such a freak!

storm_courier.ability: Each day, publicly name a character: tonight, you learn if they are in play. If you learn both “yes” and “no”, you then lose this ability.
storm_courier.otherNightReminder: Either nod or shake your head.
storm_courier.flavor: Make way, make way! I carry urgent news!

storm_zhen.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a Townsfolk character: if they are in play, they become poisoned and die.
storm_zhen.otherNightReminder: The Zhen might choose a Townsfolk character.

jinxes.reason: The Poppy Grower cannot be poisoned by the Zhen’s ability.

storm_zhen.flavor: Sweet as wine, poisonous as arsenic.

storm_consort.ability: Once per game, the Storyteller will break the rules for you. You privately learn what they did.
storm_consort.flavor: Nights of spring were short and the sun arose too soon, and the Emperor, from that time forth, forsook his early hearings.

storm_thaumaturge.ability: On your 1st night, choose a number. On the night of that number, learn that number of in-play characters.
storm_thaumaturge.firstNightReminder: The Thaumaturge chooses a number. If the number chosen is 1, show the Thaumaturge the token of 1 in-play character.
storm_thaumaturge.otherNightReminder: If it is the night corresponding to the number of LEARN reminders in the Grimoire, wake the Thaumaturge and show them all character tokens marked LEARN.
storm_thaumaturge.flavor: We watch the stars to catch a glimpse of heaven.

storm_brushholder.ability: If you die during the day, you learn a good player tonight. If you die at night, you learn an evil player.
storm_brushholder.otherNightReminder: If the Brush Holder died today or tonight, point to a player.
storm_brushholder.flavor: The red review is done. Double-check everything.

storm_prosecutor.ability: After your first nomination, learn your nominee’s character that night. Demons register as good characters to you.
storm_prosecutor.otherNightReminder: If the Prosecutor made their first nomination today, show the character token marked NOMINEE. If a Demon is marked NOMINEE, show a good character token.
storm_prosecutor.flavor: With a clear vision, one can see ten thousand miles, illuminating even the most hidden of wickedness.

storm_actor.ability: Good characters are good, drunk & know each other. Whoever wins, loses & whoever loses, wins. You cannot lose this ability.
storm_actor.firstNightReminder: Wake all Townsfolk and Outsiders together.

jinxes.reason: Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.

At any time, the Leviathan can tell the Storyteller that they would like to die. The Storyteller kills that player tonight.
At any time, the player holding Lil’ Monsta can tell the Storyteller that they would like to die. The Storyteller kills that player tonight.
At any time, the Pukka can tell the Storyteller that they would like to die. The Storyteller kills that player tonight.

storm_actor.flavor: It feels like a mirage, a dream within a play. But all who dream must eventually wake up.

storm_server.ability: One of your good neighbors (not a Traveller) is drunk, even if you die by execution.

storm_embalmer.ability: If 5 or more players live and you nominate, execute & kill the Demon, you become the evil Demon. (Travellers do not count)
storm_embalmer.otherNightReminder: If the Embalmer became the Demon today, show them the YOU ARE & Demon tokens. Give a thumbs down.

jinxes.reason: If the Embalmer executes and becomes the Demon, the Scarlet Woman does not become a Demon.
If there are two living Al-Hadikhias, the Embalmer Al-Hadikhia becomes the Embalmer again, but does not turn good.
If there are 5 or more players alive and the player holding Lil’ Monsta dies from the Embalmer’s nomination, the Embalmer turns evil and is given Lil’ Monsta tonight.
If there are 5 or more players alive and the Lleech host dies by the Embalmer’s nomination, the old Lleech dies tonight, and the Embalmer becomes the evil Lleech but does not kill tonight.

storm_embalmer.flavor: Unable to quell the hatred in my heart, I have lost the one I held so dear.

storm_vintner.ability: Each night, choose a Townsfolk character: their ability yields info of your choice next time.
storm_vintner.firstNightReminder: The Vintner chooses a Townsfolk character and a piece of info.
storm_vintner.otherNightReminder: The Vintner chooses a Townsfolk character and a piece of info.
storm_vintner.flavor: It’s just drunken ramblings; nothing to take seriously.

storm_gudiao.ability: Each night, learn the next clockwise Townsfolk: they are poisoned & might register as evil Gu Diao until dusk. Once per game, at night, change directions.
storm_gudiao.firstNightReminder: The Gu Diao chooses a living good neighbor. Show the Gu Diao that player’s character token.
storm_gudiao.otherNightReminder: The Gu Diao chooses a living good neighbor. Show the Gu Diao that player’s character token.

jinxes.reason: An Alchemist-Gu Diao has no Gu Diao ability & a Gu Diao is in play. After each execution, a living Alchemist-Gu Diao may publicly guess a living player as the Gu Diao. If correct, the Demon must choose the Gu Diao tonight.
Gu Diao skips the Magician.
If the Gu Diao-poisoned player registers as evil to the Ogre, the Ogre learns that they are evil.
If the Storyteller would gain the Gu Diao ability, a Minion gains it, and learns this.

storm_mengpo.ability: Each night, you may choose a player: if they are alive, they choose to 1) permanently lose their ability, or 2) die & keep their ability until dusk.
storm_mengpo.otherNightReminder: The Meng Po chooses a player. Wake that player and show them THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU and the Meng Po character token. They give a finger signal.

jinxes.reason: If the Meng Po targets the Poppy Grower, the Poppy Grower learns that they were chosen by the Meng Po and dies.

storm_mengpo.flavor: Everyone knows the River of Oblivion, but nobody remembers the drinking the soup.

storm_huapi.ability: On your 1st night, choose an alive player: they die but register as alive. If they die again, they live & you regain this ability.
storm_huapi.firstNightReminder: The Huapi points to a player.
storm_huapi.otherNightReminder: If the previously chosen player was revived by the Huapi, the Huapi points to a player.
storm_huapi.flavor: How foolish are the people! Clearly demonic, yet regarded as beautiful. How deluded are the fools! Clearly loyal, yet regarded as false.

storm_warden.ability: Each night, choose 1 to 3 players. 1 player you chose last night dies: if any of them died by execution today, all die tonight.
storm_warden.firstNightReminder: The Warden chooses up to 3 players.
storm_warden.otherNightReminder: 1 or 2 chosen players die. The Warden chooses up to 3 players.

jinxes.reason: The Summoner may summon a Warden on the 2nd night instead of the 3rd.

storm_warden.flavor: When a prisoner is brought to justice, their family will be detained as well.

storm_conspirator.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. If a Minion died today or tonight, they choose a player: if good, they die.
storm_conspirator.otherNightReminder: The Conspirator chooses a player. If the Conspirator did not vote today, they choose an additional player.
storm_conspirator.flavor: The Emperor has agreed to have him killed, on the condition that I turn you in, as well. That is a compromise I am willing to make.

storm_guhuo.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Once per game, when a Minion dies by execution, you might gain their ability.
storm_guhuo.otherNightReminder: The Guhuo chooses a player. The Guhuo might wake due to their Minion ability.

jinxes.reason: If the Guhuo has gained a Minion ability and is chosen by the Exorcist, the Guhuo can still wake due to their Minion ability.
A Guhuo that has the Mastermind ability keeps it if they die.
If the Guhuo gains the Evil Twin ability, the new Good Twin learns that the Guhuo is in play, but not which player it is.
The Guhuo cannot have the Goblin ability.
If the Guhuo has the Psychopath ability, they die when executed.
The Guhuo cannot have the Marionette ability.
The Guhuo cannot have the Vizier ability.
If a Guhuo is summoned, the Summoner becomes a not-in-play Minion.
If the Guhuo would gain the Wraith ability, the Wraith instead keeps their ability.

storm_guhuo.flavor: At night, they feast on the souls of the dead, and steal the children to raise as their own.

storm_tyrant.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. If this killed a Minion’s neighbor last night, instead choose up to 2 players: they die.
storm_tyrant.flavor: What is the peasant’s wrath to the Emperor’s, which may kill hundreds upon thousands and bathe the land in blood.

storm_messenger.ability: There are no restrictions on abilities that require players to make a choice.
storm_messenger.flavor: By the grace of heaven, the Emperor decrees: A general amnesty is granted throughout the land.

starlight_fae.ability: You start knowing your setup modifier. [???]
starlight_fae.firstNightReminder: Show the Fae their setup modifier.

jinxes.reason: If the Philosopher gains the Fae ability, they learn information about the starting bag.
If the Pixie gains the Fae ability, they learn information about the starting bag.
If the Marionette thinks they are the Fae, the Fae's setup modifier applies.
If the Pit-Hag creates a Fae, the Fae learns information about the starting bag.
If the Kazali turns the Fae into a Minion, the Fae's setup modifier applies.
If the Lord of Typhon turns the Fae into a Minion, the Fae's setup modifier applies.

starlight_fae.flavor: Well, hello there! Did you just move here? Well, let me introduce you to my good ol' pal, Greg! He's also a new face around town, and I'm sure you'll get along fantastic! Well, at least, I'm sure he'll enjoy a good feas- I mean friend! Yes, friend! Anyways, this is his cavern, try to get along, and try not to scream too loud!

starlight_herbalist.ability: Once per game, at night, you may choose to gain the ability of a non-listed character that will benefit the losing alignment. You learn which.
starlight_herbalist.firstNightReminder: The Herbalist nods or shakes their head. If they nod, they gain an ability and learn which.
starlight_herbalist.otherNightReminder: The Herbalist nods or shakes their head. If they nod, they gain an ability and learn which.

jinxes.reason: If the Herbalist gains the Bounty Hunter ability, a Townsfolk might turn evil.
If the Herbalist gains the Boffin ability, the Herbalist does not learn what ability the Demon has.

starlight_herbalist.flavor: Don’t worry, a pinch of salt mixed with the mushrooms from the hills down south will do the trick. You’ll be fine in no time! I just need to remember if this is salt or sugar…

starlight_katari.ability: You start holding the Katari token. If a Minion guesses where it is (once), you become an Outsider. You are sober & healthy.
starlight_katari.firstNightReminder: Give the Katari their token. Wake all Minions. If they guess where the Katari token is, the Katari becomes an Outsider.
starlight_katari.otherNightReminder: Wake all Minions. If they guess where the Katari token is, the Katari becomes an Outsider.

jinxes.reason: If the Cannibal gains the Katari ability & a Katari is in play, the Cannibal doesn't get a 2nd Katari token.
If the Philosopher gains the Katari ability & a Katari is in play, the Katari doesn't get a 2nd Katari token.
If the Katari becomes the Damsel, Minions don't learn a Damsel is now in play.
The Drunk cannot think that they are the Katari.
The Marionette cannot think that they are the Katari.

starlight_queer.ability: If the Demon kills you, choose a player: if they are the same alignment as you, all players learn this.
starlight_queer.otherNightReminder: If the Queer was killed by a Demon, they point to a player. If they are the same alignment as them, announce that both players are the same alignment.

jinxes.reason: Each night, the Leviathan chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Queer uses their ability but does not die.
Each night, Riot chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Queer uses their ability but does not die.
All players learn true information about the Queer & their chosen player.
If the Lycanthrope kills a good player at night, the Demon can’t kill tonight.
If the Mayor dies at night, a different player might die instead.
If the Princess nominated and executed a player on their 1st day, the Demon doesn’t kill tonight.
The 1st good player (not the Transmuter) the Devil's Advocate chooses registers as a Minion to the Transmuter.
If the Transmuter and Vizier are both in-play, the existence of the Vizier is not announced by the Storyteller.
Legion who die still die, but the Transmuter might learn they are Legion.
If a Minion is holding Lil’ Monsta, they can still die even if a Transmuter is in-play.
The Lleech can’t die if their host is alive. A Minion host can still die.

starlight_transmuter.flavor: The Master Work is sought by many, but discovered only by a few. / The secret must be guarded carefully, for power corrupts; absolute power corrupts absolutely.

starlight_axiom.ability: Once per game, at night, you learn a statement. If you are not mad it is true, you must prove it false, or might be executed.
starlight_axiom.firstNightReminder: You may show the Axiom their statement.
starlight_axiom.otherNightReminder: You may show the Axiom their statement.
starlight_axiom.flavor: User Input: “How can the net amount of entropy of the universe be massively decreased?” / Critical error: INSUFFICIENT DATA FOR MEANINGFUL ANSWER / Initiating data collection: success. / Terminating process by demonstration. / Returning following output: Let there be light.

starlight_facade.ability: If you are dead, good might think they win at any time (once). Then, unless most good players agree to return to play, evil wins.
starlight_facade.flavor: Hmm, it appears that our show has concluded finally at last. Well, in case I don't see ya, good afternoon, good evening, and good night!

starlight_moonjay.ability: Each day, even if dead, privately learn & answer a question: if answered incorrectly twice, your team loses.
starlight_moonjay.flavor: Oh, Moonjay, dear Moonjay, What a game of questions we play. Your time’s come, carry my words today: Deliver this letter to the one I adore, if you may.

starlight_mutineer.ability: On your 1st night, choose an alive player (not yourself): you become opposite their alignment. If they died today or tonight, choose again.
starlight_mutineer.firstNightReminder: The Mutineer chooses a player: show the Mutineer their new alignment.
starlight_mutineer.otherNightReminder: The Mutineer might choose a player: show the Mutineer their new alignment.

jinxes.reason: The Demon cannot have the Mutineer ability.
If the Pit-Hag turns an evil player into the Mutineer, they can’t turn good due to their own ability.
The Mutineer cannot choose the Vizier.

starlight_mutineer.flavor: Cap'n, with all due respect, you've forced my hand.

starlight_templeguard.ability: The 1st good player to rise becomes evil. If no-one has risen, you may choose to rise.
starlight_templeguard.otherNightReminder: If a player rose, they become evil. If not, the dead Temple Guard either nods or shakes their head. If they nod their head, they rise and become evil.
starlight_templeguard.flavor: Halt! State your business in this sacred city of Moxdor. You must, of course, pay the appropriate toll fee. Oh! and do fill out this entrance form, taxed at five gold. Yes, yes, thank you. The pen will be two gold, by the way. If you cannot provide your own ink, there is an extra fee of ten gold.

starlight_myconid.ability: On your 1st night, Minions & Demons wake together & see the Grimoire.
starlight_myconid.firstNightReminder: Wake all Minions and Demons, and show them the Grimoire.

jinxes.reason: If the Magician is in play, Minions & Demons wake separately, and the Magician's and evil character's tokens are removed when they see the grimoire.
If the Poppy Grower is in play, Minions & Demons don't wake together to see the grimoire until the Poppy Grower dies.
If the Myconid is (or has been) in play, the Damsel is poisoned.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.

starlight_myconid.flavor: Thank you Mario! But our princess is in another castle!

starlight_warlock.ability: If all alive good Townsfolk voted for today's executee (except them, at least one), their team loses. [-1 or +1 Outsider]

jinxes.reason: The Lycanthrope’s “Faux Paw” player has to vote to trigger the Warlock’s ability.
The Warlock’s ability does not activate on the dead Evil Twin.
If the Warlock's ability would activate on the Goblin & the Goblin has claimed to be the Goblin, evil wins.
The Warlock's ability does not activate on the Psychopath if the Psychopath has used their ability or was executed.
The Warlock’s ability does not activate on the Vizier.

starlight_wyvern.ability: Each night, a good player who voted for you today might die, even if you are dead.
starlight_wyvern.otherNightReminder: A player who voted for the Wyvern today might die.

jinxes.reason: If the Storyteller would gain the Wyvern ability, a Minion gains it, and learns this.

starlight_wyvern.flavor: Wyvern fly, / Soar so high. / Roar a cry, / Split the sky.

starlight_samurai.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. If no marked characters are in play, whoever wins, loses, & whoever loses, wins. [-1 or +1 Outsider]
starlight_samurai.firstNightReminder: If no marked characters are in play, put the DIE WITH HONOR reminder in the center of the grimoire.
starlight_samurai.otherNightReminder: The Samurai points at a player: they die.
starlight_samurai.flavor: My poor Glacia... I will avenge those who dared harm my family. And once my duty is done, I will die a warrior.

starlight_veil.ability: Each night, if no-one died today, a player dies. Only your neighbors register as evil characters to Townsfolk. [+1 Minion. Your seat is hidden]
starlight_veil.otherNightReminder: If no-one died today, a player dies.

jinxes.reason: The Veil's misregisteration does not affect the Alsaahir ability. The Alsaahir may guess a gap as the Demon.
Evil players register as evil to the Cannibal.
If the Engineer creates a not-in-play Veil, the Demon becomes a not-in-play Minion neighboring the Veil & learns where the Veil sits. If in-play, vice versa.
If a Veil is in play, Minions think the Magician is a Minion.
If the Snake Charmer is in play, the Veil must always neighbor a Minion. Only that Minion registers as the Demon to the Snake Charmer.
The Soldier is not safe from the Veil's misregistration.
If the Barber dies & the Veil is in play, the Storyteller chooses for the Veil.
If the Demon chooses to become the Veil, they become a not-in-play Minion neighboring the Veil & learns where the Veil sits.
If a Veil is in play, the Boffin gives themselves a good character's ability instead.
When the Boomdandy explodes, the Storyteller announces the gap where the Veil sits (if a Veil is in play) or an arbitrary gap (if the Veil is not in play). Players may point to this gap to die.
If the Pit-Hag creates a Veil, they must choose a gap between two players. If a Veil is in play and the Pit-Hag creates a Demon, the Storyteller may choose that the Veil is out-of-play.
If there are 5 or more players alive & the Veil dies, a gap neighboring the Scarlet Woman becomes the new Veil & the Scarlet Woman learns where.
If the Summoner creates a Veil, the chosen player becomes a not-in-play evil Minion neighboring the Veil instead & learns where the Veil sits.

starlight_veil.flavor: Remember, traveller: do not dare gaze between the lights, for it is there which one finds the darkest night.

starlight_zuggtmoy.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. You get an extra bluff & start by choosing 1: an evil player gains its ability.
starlight_zuggtmoy.firstNightReminder: Show the Zuggtmoy 1 extra bluff during the DEMON INFO step: they choose 1. Wake an evil player: show them the THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU info token, followed by the Zuggtmoy character token and then the character token they chose.
starlight_zuggtmoy.otherNightReminder: The Zuggtmoy chooses a player: they die.

jinxes.reason: If the Zuggtmoy chooses the Cult Leader, the evil player that gains the Cult Leader ability cannot turn good due to this ability.
If the Zuggtmoy chooses the Damsel, the Storyteller chooses a good player to become the Damsel instead.
If the Zuggtmoy chooses the Drunk, the evil player that would gain this ability chooses a Townsfolk player to have this ability instead.
If the Zuggtmoy chooses the Goon, the evil player that gains the Goon ability cannot turn good due to this ability.
The Zuggtmoy cannot choose that an evil player gains the Heretic ability.
The Zuggtmoy cannot choose that an evil player gains the Ogre ability.
The Zuggtmoy cannot choose that an evil player gains the Politician ability.

starlight_zuggtmoy.flavor: Corrupt. Death. Decay. Rot. Rebirth. Rise. Spores. Spread. Undeath.

starlight_aurora.ability: You do not know your alignment. Each night, you learn if your alignment is winning. You might wake when other players do.
starlight_aurora.firstNightReminder: Show the Aurora a head signal (nod 'yes', shake 'no') for if their team is winning.
starlight_aurora.otherNightReminder: Show the Aurora a head signal (nod 'yes', shake 'no') for if their team is winning.
starlight_aurora.flavor: I heard there was like a demon guy around here or something, can I see him? I'm a biiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiig fan. Well, I think, anyways.

starlight_cartomancer.ability: Each day, publicly choose an info token: the Storyteller must use it tonight & might break rules to do so.
starlight_cartomancer.otherNightReminder: Use the chosen info token in any way.
starlight_cartomancer.flavor: The cards, the cards, the cards will tell... / Your past, your present, and your future as well.

starlight_marathon.ability: You may move your seat during nominations. Voting always starts & ends at you.
starlight_marathon.flavor: Hyponatremia (n): the condition of having an abnormally low level of sodium in the blood that is typically marked by nausea, vomiting, headache, confusion, fatigue, and muscle cramps and that when severe may be life-threatening if untreated.

starlight_collective.ability: Multiple players occupy the same seat. Only 1 may vote, nominate, & use their ability.
starlight_collective.flavor: Hello there! We're the Hopehills, nice to meet you! We don't think we've seen you around town before, but we sure hope us neighbors can get along!

starlight_xcard.ability: Anyone may request that the game is on hold & the Storyteller may ask for silence.
starlight_xcard.flavor: Everyone, calm down - we all know cereal goes in before milk, but it doesn't need to get this heated over someone who doesn't have such common sense.

starlight_yggdrasil.ability: The Storyteller assigns multiple bags. Players secretly vote on which 1 to play.
starlight_yggdrasil.flavor: From the glories of Æsir, Asgard, to the pride of the Fae, Alfheim, to the realm of the dead, Helheim... I connect all. Seek me, if you dare. Find my roots, which journey everywhere. But know this, mortals of Midguard; beyond the borders of your realm - you, who chase wonder, are already here.

starlight_confectioner.ability: Today marks a special occasion. Players involved may choose to receive a gift & all players learn what.
starlight_confectioner.flavor: Happy birthday to you, happy birthday to you. Happy birthday dear Stella, happy birthday to you.

starlight_cookie.ability: Players might not learn other in-play NPCs until the game starts. [+? NPCs]
starlight_cookie.firstNightReminder: Announce which NPCs are in play.
starlight_cookie.flavor: We use cookies to customize your experience. There is no decline button.

starlight_themoon.ability: Players who the Storyteller believes roleplayed the best this game might gain a blessing & all players learn how.
starlight_themoon.flavor: The Moon shrouds itself into the receding night sky as the morning dew glistens bright in the greeneries of the fae-blessed forest... / On the beach shines droplets of Aether, the stuff of magic, the water of life, the secret to immortality and power. / The Moon glows bright one last time before giving way to the vast blues of the morning sun.

starlight_zodiac.ability: The Demon may privately make public announcements.
starlight_zodiac.firstNightReminder: The Demon may write a statement. Publicly reveal it at dawn.
starlight_zodiac.otherNightReminder: The Demon may write a statement. Publicly reveal it at dawn.

academy_cheerleader.ability: For every 2 players you high-five, you may privately learn a true statement. If you high-five all evil players, evil wins at dusk.

jinxes.reason: The Cheerleader must high-five the Vizier in order to receive their 2nd piece of info.

academy_cheerleader.flavor: Give me an I! Give me an N! Give me an F! Give me an O! What's that spell? Doom for us all!

academy_flittermouse.ability: Each night, you learn your closest living evil player's character. If they are a Demon, learn a not-in-play character instead.

academy_mystic.ability: Demons who nominate, execute, & kill their last living ally become good tonight. They can't die at night, even if you're dead.

jinxes.reason: If the Mystic ability is active & the Leviathan nominates & executes an ally on day 4, they turn good that night.
If the Mystic turns the Lleech good, the host can't die at night.
If the Mystic ability is active & the Riot nominates & executes an ally on day 2, they turn good that night.

academy_mystic.flavor: A little bit of well-placed fairy dust will solve all your problems, simple as that. We just don't have a way to get any... hmm, that's a problem.

academy_subtractor.ability: Each night, choose a character: learn 3 players they aren't.
academy_subtractor.flavor: The missile knows where it is at all times because it knows where it isn't.

academy_surveyor.ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): learn a character they neighbor. If they are evil, this info is arbitrary.
academy_surveyor.flavor: No, the guy next to you--of COURSE I'm talking to you! Move over so I can take a picture of the guy next to you.

academy_babbler.ability: You have a Townsfolk ability. True things you are mad about might become false.

jinxes.reason: If the Babbler has the Village Idiot ability and a Village Idiot is in play, the Babbler's Village Idiot ability might be drunk instead of a Village Idiot.

academy_babbler.flavor: All roses are red, violet comes before blue. This line is false, and this line's not true.

academy_beanspiller.ability: Each night, if you are dead, evil players wake together & see the Grimoire.

jinxes.reason: An evil Cult Leader is not woken with the evil team to see the Grimoire.
If the Bean Spiller is (or has been) dead, the Damsel is poisoned.
An evil Goon is not woken with the evil team to see the Grimoire.
Outsiders' character tokens might be removed while the evil team sees the Grimoire.
The Marionette is not woken with the evil team to see the Grimoire.

academy_beanspiller.flavor: First the milk, then the tea. How could this day get any worse?

academy_doomprophet.ability: Each day, something bad happens. You may visit the Storyteller to learn it is 1 of 2 things.
academy_doomprophet.flavor: I'm studying the manmade horrors so that they are no longer beyond my comprehension. Ignore Larry, he's the flesh-eating void monster behind me tearing down houses. He tends to do that sometimes, but I need to stay focused on my studies.

academy_alasa.ability: If you publicly guess (once) who the alive evil Townsfolk is, 2 players die tonight, even if you die today. [1 Townsfolk is evil]

jinxes.reason: If the Plague Doctor dies & gives the Storyteller the Alasa ability, a living Minion gains the Alasa ability in addition to their own ability & registers as a Townsfolk to it, and learns this.

academy_alasa.flavor: mi monsuta ala. mi en sina li wile e ijo sama. o toki tawa mi. o alasa e mi.

academy_cadenza.ability: If you have been executed, the Storyteller might follow your public commands from now on.

jinxes.reason: If the Plague Doctor is executed & Storyteller gains the Cadenza ability, a Minion gains it instead & learns this.

academy_cadenza.flavor: Nemmeno Dio può resistere alla melodia della mia musica! Also, you're flat.

academy_shrike.ability: If a good Outsider was executed yesterday & a player you oppose is executed today, your team wins. [+1 Outsider]

jinxes.reason: The Politician registers as evil to the Shrike.
The Drunk registers as evil to the Shrike.

academy_shrike.flavor: It's not malicious, I promise! I'm only saving my food for later. Just... ignore the blood stains.

academy_sollos.ability: The Demon & a good player (you know who) might register as the other's character & know this. If the good player is executed, evil wins.
academy_sollos.flavor: When mortals look into the sun, they are blinded. But when the sun looks into the eyes of a mortal, it is everyone else that is blinded.

academy_timeeater.ability: If you are executed, a good player learns this & your team wins each dusk unless a living evil player is executed. [-1 Outsider]

jinxes.reason: If the Alchemist has the Time Eater's ability, an Outsider is not removed.
If the Plague Doctor is executed & Storyteller gains the Time Eater ability, it activates immediately as if a Time Eater had been executed.

academy_timeeater.flavor: Time is money. Money is power. Power is pizza. And pizza is delicious.

academy_barrkoad.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Every 2nd Townsfolk neighbor to your left yields reversed info. [Even Townsfolk count]

jinxes.reason: If the Barrkoad is in play and the Demon kills the Banshee, the players still learn that the Banshee has died.
If the Spy registers as a Townsfolk to the Barrkoad, they must do so for the entire night & until dusk.

academy_barrkoad.flavor: Black is White. White 1s Bl4ck. B14cK 15 WH!73 I5 8I@(K!S VV#Y+E!5 &/_@{I< ^Z VV//|||||Gonzales what h@ve you done.

academy_bistella.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. If you die by execution, your team loses. [1 Minion is Bistella]

jinxes.reason: If the Engineer chooses Bistella, a Minion also becomes Bistella.
If the Demon chooses to become a Bistella, 1 Minion may do so as well. If a Bistella chooses another Demon, the other Bistella must choose a Minion instead.
If the Summoner chooses Bistella, the Summoner also becomes Bistella.

academy_bistella.flavor: To protect the world from devastation! To unite all peoples within our nation! To denounce the evils of truth and love! To extend our reach to the stars above!

academy_escapod.ability: Each night, you may choose a living player: swap characters. If it is after your 3rd day & after day 4, evil wins.

jinxes.reason: Each night, the Escapod chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Banshee dies & gains their ability.
Each night, the Escapod chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Farmer uses their ability but does not die.
If Escapod is in play and the Grandchild dies by execution, evil wins.
If the Escapod is in play, the Innkeeper-protected-players are safe from all evil abilities.
If Escapod is in play & the Mayor's ability is active and the Escapod would cause evil to win on the first day that no execution occurs, good wins instead.
If the Escapod is in play, the Monk-protected-player is safe from all evil abilities.
If the Princess nominates & executes a player on their 1st day, the Escapod can't swap characters with anyone tonight.
Each night, the Escapod chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Ravenkeeper uses their ability but does not die.
Each night, the Escapod chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Sage uses their ability but does not die.
If the Escapod is in play, the Soldier is safe from all evil abilities.

academy_escapod.flavor: Another word to sell, another story to tell, another timepiece ringing the bell. Do you hear the clock stop when you reach the end?

academy_majorix.ability: If 2 allied players die by execution, their team loses. Your vote secretly doesn't count. After day 3, evil wins. [+1 Majorix]

jinxes.reason: Each night, a Majorix chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Banshee dies & gains their ability.
If the Engineer successfully makes a Majorix on or before day 3, they also become an evil Majorix.
Evil does not win by lasting past day 3, if the Exorcist is alive and has ever successfully chosen a Majorix.
Each night, a Majorix chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Farmer uses their ability but does not die.
If Majorix is in play and the Grandchild dies by execution, evil wins.
If the Hatter dies on or after day 3, the Demon cannot choose Majorix.
If the Majorix is in play, the Innkeeper-protected-players are safe from all evil abilities.
If the Majorix is in play, and at least 1 player is dead, the King learns an alive character each night.
If the Majorix is in play & no execution occurs on day 3 & the Mayor's ability is active, good wins.
If the Majorix is in play, the Monk-protected-player is safe from all evil abilities.
After day 3, the Pit-Hag cannot choose Majorix.
If the Princess nominates & executes a good player on their 1st day, the Majorix does not detect this.
Each night, a Majorix chooses an good alive player (different to previous nights): a chosen Ravenkeeper uses their ability but does not die.
Each night, a Majorix chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Sage uses their ability but does not die.
If the Majorix is in play, the Soldier is safe from all evil abilities.
If the Summoner makes a Majorix, they do so on night 2 & choose 2 players. Day 1's execution counts towards the Majorix win conditions.

academy_majorix.flavor: Any good competition is decided by a best of three. Come forward. Let's play.

academy_wielder.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. You have a not-in-play Minion ability on your 1st night & day.

jinxes.reason: If the Wielder gains the Assassin ability, they have it on night 2 as well.
If the Wielder gains the Boomdandy ability, a Minion gains it instead & learns this.
If the Wielder gains the Marionette ability, they draw a good character's token from the bag and neighbor a Minion. They receive their full set of Demon info on night 2 instead of night 1.
If the Wielder gains the Mastermind ability & dies by execution while they have it, they do not lose it.
If the Wielder gains the Mezepheles ability, they have it on night 2 as well.
If the Wielder gains the Pit-Hag ability, they have it on night 2 as well.
If the Wielder gains the Scarlet Woman ability, a Minion gains it instead & learns this.
If the Wielder gains the Summoner ability, a Minion gains it instead & must make a Wielder & learns this. It lasts until the end of night 3 & the new Wielder does not gain an ability.

academy_wielder.flavor: I am merely the hilt; my true power is derived from whatever blade I find in my possession.

academy_horde.ability: People may travel in as Hordes on your team. Other Hordes die with you & get no vote token. You don't count for exile vote majority.

academy_sorcerer.ability: Each day, you may publicly make a wish. If granted, it might have a side effect & lasting effects end when you die.

academy_highroller.ability: Each night, if at least 2 good players live, each evil player may choose to die.

academy_unifier.ability: Something good might happen to players who most prioritize interactions with players new to the group.
academy_unifier.flavor: Okay, this is Crazy. Crazy, this is Okay. Now that you two have met, would you like to meet my other friends, Woah and Insane?

academy_mirorim.ability: Name some characters. Their abilities only work while they are dead.
academy_mirorim.flavor: Does my reflection look back at me? Does it feel the same things I do? Does it know my deepest darkest secrets? I'd die to know.

cog_confessor.ability: You know the 1st time an Outsider nominates a Minion. [+0 or +1 Outsider]
cog_confessor.otherNightReminder: Give the Confessor a thumbs up.
cog_confessor.flavor: Forgive me father. It has been… too long since my last confession. I have been in the company of wickedness. Stood by and watched as they tied the noose around his neck. Tell me, father… could even silence be a sin?

cog_convoy.ability: You & the Demon start knowing another player: they can't die at night. If only they & the Demon live, good wins, even if you die.
cog_convoy.firstNightReminder: Wake the Convoy and the Demon separately to show them both the VIP player.

cog_hitman.ability: You start knowing an evil player: if they are executed, their team loses. [You might replace an Outsider & get false info]
cog_hitman.firstNightReminder: Wake the Hitman. Point to a good player if you removed an Outsider. Otherwise, point to an evil player.
cog_hitman.flavor: This will surely be a blow to the syndicate.

cog_jeweler.ability: If you die at night, choose a living player: their ability is altered in a way to help your team & they learn how.
cog_jeweler.otherNightReminder: If the Jeweler dies, they choose a player. Put the Jeweler to sleep. Write down that players' new ability on a phone or paper. Show the chosen player the THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU info token, the Jeweler, and then their new ability.
cog_jeweler.flavor: It was my mother’s before me, and her mother’s before her. Now, for the small price of $39.99, it can be yours! Taxes not included.

cog_landlord.ability: On your 1st night, a Townsfolk becomes a not in-play Outsider.
cog_landlord.firstNightReminder: Turn a Townsfolk into an Outsider.
cog_landlord.flavor: I need you out by the first. I’ve already changed the locks.

cog_snoop.ability: Each night, learn a character the Demon killed tonight. If no-one, learn a not in-play character instead.
cog_snoop.otherNightReminder: Show the Snoop a character token.
cog_snoop.flavor: You goin' to the search party this friday? It's gonna be lit!

cog_surrealist.ability: Once per game, you may visit the Storyteller to learn about the most unusual thing that happened this game.
cog_surrealist.flavor: We live inside a dream. But who is the dreamer?

cog_kleptomaniac.ability: A Townsfolk has an Outsider ability you wake for, even if you die. If they die, you learn & gain it.

jinxes.reason: If the Kleptomaniac would grant a player the Klutz ability, they do not. When the Kleptomaniac learns they have gained the Klutz ability, the next day, they must make a choice for the Klutz ability as if they learned they had died, and cannot choose themselves.

If the Kleptomaniac would grant a player the Moonchild ability, they do not. When the Kleptomaniac learns they have gained the Moonchild ability, the next day, they must make a choice for the Moonchild ability as if they learned they had died, and cannot choose themselves.

If the Kleptomaniac would grant a player the Butler ability, the Kleptomaniac instead learns this & cannot vote while the Townsfolk who would gain it has a vote token. When they die, the Kleptomaniac learns who they are.
If the Kleptomaniac would grant a player the Drunk ability, the player is drunk instead.
If the Kleptomaniac would grant a player the Lunatic ability, they do not, & instead a Lunatic is in-play. If the Lunatic dies, the Kleptomaniac learns this.

If the Kleptomaniac would grant a player the Zealot ability, the Kleptomaniac instead learns this & must vote until the Townsfolk who would gain it uses their vote token (or if less than 5 players live). When they die, the Kleptomaniac learns who they are.

If the Kleptomaniac would grant a player the Ogre ability, the Kleptomaniac chooses a player other than themselves. The player with the Ogre ability becomes the chosen player's alignment & learns this. Only 1 player may turn evil this way.
If the Kleptomaniac grants a Townsfolk player the Golem ability, the Kleptomaniac learns when that player nominates, & can no longer nominate once they do.

cog_mason.ability: You have a Townsfolk ability (you know which). If another Mason is dead, you are drunk. [+0 to +2 Masons]
cog_mason.firstNightReminder: Show each Mason the Townsfolk ability they have.

jinxes.reason: If at least 2 players have Village Idiot abilities, a Mason with the ability can be the drunk Village Idiot.

cog_mason.flavor: United front! Together we are stronger!

cog_poltergeist.ability: If you're the 1st dead player the Demon chooses, a Demon must be executed tomorrow or your team loses.

jinxes.reason: Before the final day, at night, the Leviathan may guess who the Poltergeist is (once). If correct, evil wins 1 day sooner. The Poltergeist learns when the Leviathan guesses.
On the 2nd night, the Riot may guess who the Poltergeist is. If correct, the Riot begins 1 day sooner.
Once per game, at night, the Yaggababble may guess a dead player is the Poltergeist instead of killing. The Poltergeist learns when this happens.
Once per game, at night, a Minion holding Lil Monsta may guess a dead player is the Poltergeist instead of killing. The Poltergeist learns when this happens.
Once per game, at night, the Al-Hadikhia may guess a dead player is the Poltergeist instead of choosing 3 players. The Poltergeist learns when this happens.
If the Pukka poisons the Poltergeist, the Poltergeist's ability activates once they are healthy.

cog_tempestarius.ability: You & the Demon start knowing 1 of 2 nights on which Townsfolk abilities yield reversed info, even if you die.
cog_tempestarius.firstNightReminder: Wake the Tempestarius and the Demon separately, and show them the same 2 numbers.
cog_tempestarius.flavor: I control the thunder, watch. Flash—one mississippi, two missi—BOOM! See?

cog_backmasker.ability: Each night, if the Demon does not kill a good player, Townsfolk info is reversed until tomorrow night (even if they killed you).
cog_backmasker.firstNightReminder: All Townsfolk info is false until tomorrow night.
cog_backmasker.otherNightReminder: If the Demon did not kill a good player, all Townsfolk info is false until tomorrow night.

cog_barbarian.ability: You start by choosing 3 players: all learn who. Night deaths are arbitrary if a chosen good player is executed, even if you then die.
cog_barbarian.firstNightReminder: The Barbarian picks 3 players. Publicly announce which.
cog_barbarian.flavor: THE COUNCIL HAS FALLEN! WE STRIKE AT DAWN! RAAAAHHH!!!

cog_rusalka.ability: Players that die by execution are mad as fresh characters from then on, or they might be executed again.
cog_rusalka.otherNightReminder: Tell the executed player that the Rusalka is in-play.
cog_rusalka.flavor: Вы не узнаёте тела в воде.

cog_serpent.ability: Each night, you may choose a player & learn something true: if they are mad it is false, they might die.
cog_serpent.firstNightReminder: The serpent might point to a player. Write out a true statement and show it to the Serpent. Put the Serpent to sleep, and mark the chosen player with the TEMPTED reminder.
cog_serpent.otherNightReminder: The serpent might point to a player. Write out a true statement and show it to the Serpent. Put the Serpent to sleep, and mark the chosen player with the TEMPTED reminder.
cog_serpent.flavor: Ssssso sssssweet… the tassssste of sssssecretssss...

cog_equinox.ability: A Townsfolk is drunk. Each night, if you aren't their alive neighbor, choose a player: they die. The 2nd time they are, evil wins. [-1 Outsider]
cog_equinox.otherNightReminder: If the Equinox is not the drunk players' living neighbor, they choose a player. Otherwise, the Equinox is marked with ECLIPSE, or evil wins if they already have been marked.
cog_equinox.flavor: Once in a blue moon… or so they say.

cog_ironmaiden.ability: You might register as the character & alignment of the 1st executed player. After day 5, evil wins.
cog_ironmaiden.firstNightReminder: Change the Iron Maiden token to the relevant day.
cog_ironmaiden.otherNightReminder: Change the Iron Maiden token to the relevant day.

jinxes.reason: On the 1st day, if the Princess executes a player, their death does not count as the 1st execution for the Iron Maiden ability.
If the Iron Maiden is in play, and at least 1 player is dead, the King learns an alive character each night.
If the Iron Maiden and the Mayor are alive on day 5 & no execution occurs, good wins.
If the Iron Maiden nominates and executes the Monk-protected player, good wins.
The Iron Maiden cannot enter play after Day 5.
If the Iron Maiden nominates and executes the Soldier, good wins.
If the Iron Maiden nominates and executes an Innkeeper-protected player, good wins.
The Iron Maiden cannot enter play after Day 5.
If the Iron Maiden is in-play and the Grandchild is the 1st to die by execution, evil wins.
Each night, the Iron Maiden chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Banshee dies & gains their ability.
If the Iron Maiden nominates and executes the Exorcist-chosen player, good wins.
Each night, the Iron Maiden chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Farmer uses their ability but does not die.
Each night, the Iron Maiden chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Sage uses their ability but does not die.
Each night, the Iron Maiden chooses an alive player (different to previous nights): a chosen Ravenkeeper uses their ability but does not die.

cog_ironmaiden.flavor: As I draw my final breath, each spike drives deeper still. The blood pools at my feet, but even yet, I bear the pain. What fear is left to face but what she will do with mine?

cog_kandah.ability: All know the ability the Kandah would have. The 1st time a Minion declares this, the Demon becomes it. [Not in-play]
cog_kandah.firstNightReminder: Announce to everyone what the Kandah's ability is.
cog_kandah.flavor: It is January 24th in the year of our Lord, 1923. And I, Father Marcus Littleton, shall now commence reading aloud the first of the spiritual resurrection passages...

cog_lich.ability: Each night, if no-one evil died today, choose a player: they die. Evil players keep their abilities if dead, & good can't win if 1 lives.
cog_lich.otherNightReminder: If no evil players died today, the Lich chooses a player.
cog_lich.flavor: You may bury me a hundred times, for I have buried thousands.

cog_mycelium.ability: Each night, choose 2 players: If both live, they swap characters. The previous chosen players die.
cog_mycelium.firstNightReminder: The Mycelium chooses 2 players to swap characters.
cog_mycelium.otherNightReminder: The Mycelium chooses 2 players to swap characters. The previously chosen players die.
cog_mycelium.flavor: Out there in the marsh grows a ring of pale caps. Rest a while, weary travelers... the fae do so love your company.

cog_photographer.ability: Players may privately ask the Storyteller for reminders on forgotten information.

cog_chancellor.ability: At the end of the day, if a player is "about to die", they choose who is executed instead (once per player).
cog_chancellor.flavor: Twenty five years in the hole!

megalomania_logician.ability: You start knowing a number & a hint. Each day, you may privately guess what it means, learn how accurate you are & learn another if correct.
megalomania_logician.flavor: When intuition and logic agree, you are always right.

megalomania_mercenary.ability: Once per game, publicly choose a Minion character: they die tonight.
megalomania_mercenary.otherNightReminder: If a Minion was chosen by the Mercenary, they die.
megalomania_mercenary.flavor: I wandered the earth, daring the gods to kill me but surviving because part of me was already dead.

megalomania_middleman.ability: Each day, you may visit the Storyteller to learn a statement you should make to another player to help your team win (you don't know who).
megalomania_middleman.flavor: So looking at it bro, we gotta go ahead and get at least 10,000.

megalomania_purifier.ability: Once per game, you may publicly choose a Demon character. If it is in play, 1 good player learns this tonight.
megalomania_purifier.flavor: The most professional curse ever snarled or croaked or thundered can have no effect on a pure heart.

megalomania_soulkeeper.ability: Each night, learn an in-play character. If there are any dead evil players, you learn an out-of-play character instead.
megalomania_soulkeeper.otherNightReminder: The Soulkeeper learns an in-play character. If an evil player is dead, they learn an out-of-play character instead.
megalomania_soulkeeper.flavor: Interlopers aren't welcome. Only a little girl made it out alive.

megalomania_warlock.ability: Each night, the Demon chooses a unique Townsfolk character (not yours): you have their ability & they are drunk until dusk.
megalomania_warlock.firstNightReminder: Wake the Demon. They choose a unique Townsfolk character. The Warlock gains their ability.
megalomania_warlock.otherNightReminder: Wake the Demon. They choose a unique Townsfolk character. The Warlock gains their ability.

jinxes.reason: If the Warlock has the Balloonist ability, they learn 2 players with different character types.
The Demon can only choose the Magician on the 1st night.

megalomania_duokro.ability: If a Minion dies at night, you become their character and alignment.
megalomania_duokro.flavor: Tomorrow when the farm boys find this freak of nature, they will wrap his body in newspaper and carry him to the museum. But tonight he is alive and in the north field with his mother. It is a perfect summer evening: the moon rising over the orchard, the wind in the grass. And as he stares into the sky, there are twice as many stars as usual.

megalomania_gloof.ability: When you learn that you died, publicly guess a not-in-play Demon: if wrong, your team loses.

megalomania_phantom.ability: You think you are another Outsider. If you died today or tonight, 1 of your living neighbors might die.
megalomania_phantom.flavor: For I do not exist: there exist but the thousands of mirrors that reflect me.

megalomania_enchantress.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a player: they are poisoned & might think anything.
megalomania_enchantress.firstNightReminder: The Enchantress might choose a player.
megalomania_enchantress.otherNightReminder: The Enchantress might choose a player.

jinxes.reason: Minions can register as the Demon to the Sage.

megalomania_falsegiant.flavor: All warfare is based on deception.

megalomania_illusionistmegalomania.ability: Outsiders might think they are a Townsfolk. Each night, choose if they learn their character tonight or when you die. [+1 Outsider]
megalomania_illusionistmegalomania.flavor: In the beginning there was faith - which is childish; trust - which is vain; and illusion - which is dangerous.

megalomania_shrew.ability: Players that are mad about being an Outsider might die. [+1 Outsider]
megalomania_shrew.flavor: You shall rue the day you messed with me!!!

megalomania_bakunawa.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. If an Outsider dies this way, you may choose another Demon character to be. [+1 Outsider]
megalomania_bakunawa.otherNightReminder: The Bakunawa chooses a player. If this kills an Outsider, the Bakunawa may choose to become a different Demon.
megalomania_bakunawa.flavor: I know how the birds fly, how the fishes swim, how animals run. But there is the Dragon. I cannot tell how it mounts on the winds through the clouds and flies through heaven. Today I have seen the Dragon.

megalomania_lifeblood.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. If your last choice was your living neighbor, choose 2 players tonight.
megalomania_lifeblood.flavor: The world may know my words, but it has no such privileges with my heart.

megalomania_prisoner.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. You start knowing a good player. If they are executed, you choose twice from now on.
megalomania_prisoner.flavor: If we kill them all... does that mean... we'll be free?

megalomania_confidant.ability: All players know a player of your alignment. You wake when they do.
megalomania_confidant.flavor: There is no such thing as truth in this world. That is our reality. Anyone can become a God or a Devil. All it takes is for someone to claim that to be the truth.

megalomania_jewelcollector.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a player (not Travellers): they choose a different character of their character type to be.
megalomania_jewelcollector.flavor: I adore wearing gems, but not because they are mine. You can't possess radiance, you can only admire it.

bazaar_bellringer.ability: If the number of living evils outnumbers the number of living goods, you are resurrected.
bazaar_bellringer.otherNightReminder: If the number of living evils outnumbers the number of living goods, you are resurrected.
bazaar_bellringer.flavor: One if by land... thirteen by midnight... though it cost ye yer lives, the town must know! Pull in the ropes lads and hang on the bell!

bazaar_emissary.ability: You start knowing 1 of the Demon's bluffs & an in-play good character.

jinxes.reason: The Emissary receives an out-of-play good character instead of a Demon bluff.

bazaar_emissary.flavor: There is a corpse on the road. I could barely recognise them. No papers, no clothing, no face... I fear the worst.

bazaar_bandwagon.ability: Once per game, during the day, publicly choose to become the alignment the Storyteller believes is winning.
bazaar_bandwagon.flavor: Oh, I was always a fan of... What was it again? Demon worship?

bazaar_josser.ability: The Demon learns which character they chose & may choose to target you (once) instead, even if you are dead.
bazaar_josser.flavor: …and if I recall, my opponent even said that they could ‘read me like a book’, I have no idea what they mean by that. A book? Anyway, if I were a book… I hope I would be a hard back. For in the end, are we not all…

bazaar_skeptic.ability: There is a non-listed character in-play. [1 evil player is that character]
bazaar_skeptic.flavor: Oh, sure, it's all a nice, simple conspiracy! All your troubles are caused by a handful of people working in predictable ways! And pigs can fly!

bazaar_sloth.ability: If you are the only good player alive, you become evil.

bazaar_worrywart.ability: Public and private announcements might be false, even if dead.
bazaar_worrywart.flavor: ...Yes. I have read “The Boy Who Cried Wolf”. Why do you ask?

bazaar_arburri.ability: Each night, choose an up-to 3-word phrase: a player is "mad" about that tomorrow, or they might be executed.
bazaar_arburri.firstNightReminder: Arburri chooses a player and a phrase.
bazaar_arburri.otherNightReminder: Arburri chooses a player and a phrase.
bazaar_arburri.flavor: The woods whisper their secrets to the chosen few. Pray you are not chosen.

bazaar_bilgerat.ability: Outsiders poison Townsfolk they nominate until dawn. [Exactly 3 Outsiders]

bazaar_gargoyle.ability: If you died by execution this game, you may choose to die or be resurrected at any time.
bazaar_gargoyle.otherNightReminder: If the Gargoyle has the HAS ABILITY reminder token, wake the Gargoyle. Wait for the THUMBS UP (to live) or THUMBS DOWN (to die) signal. Put the Gargoyle to sleep.

jinxes.reason: If the Plague Doctor dies, a Minion who died by execution gains the Gargoyle ability in addition to their own ability, and learns this.

bazaar_midnight.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. After good nominations exceed players, evil wins. All players learn when 3 remain.

bazaar_schai.ability: On your 1st night, look at the Grimoire & choose all players. Each night, the 1st chosen player who can die does so.

jinxes.reason: On the 1st night Schai makes their choices without seeing the Grimoire. When the Poppy Grower dies, the Schai sees the Grimoire and may choose again.
If the Schai is (or has been) in play, the Damsel is poisoned.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.

bazaar_schai.flavor: Your fate is sealed and your death nears. Give in.

bazaar_fly.ability: You secretly join the game. All players learn this when you first vote.

arcanum_curator.ability: You start knowing 3 players who are not Minions.
arcanum_curator.firstNightReminder: Wake the Curator. Point to 3 players. Put the Curator to sleep.
arcanum_curator.flavor: Over here is our newest collection: 'Demons Through the Ages'. They had their help, of course, but it is only their legacy that remains to this day. Their Minions simply haven't the potential to belong here.

arcanum_howl.ability: If you are "mad" you are a not-in-play character, you might become it.
arcanum_howl.flavor: Look, I know I’ve been lying a lot recently, so I’ll come clean. I am Legion. I am evil and I am Legion, and I don’t know who the other Legion are. Please! You have to believe me!

arcanum_coffeeman.ability: When you learn that you died, tonight, evil players' abilities work twice until dusk.
arcanum_coffeeman.otherNightReminder: If the "Caffeinated Tonight" token is in the Grimoire, wake each evil player, show them the "This character selected you" info card, then the Coffeeman token, then put the player to sleep.

arcanum_corsair.ability: You start knowing a clue to the Treasure. If the Demon finds it, evil wins, even if you die. [Treasure is hidden]
arcanum_corsair.firstNightReminder: Wake the Corsair. Give a clue. Put the Corsair to sleep.
arcanum_corsair.flavor: Avast, It be the Isle of Ravenswood! We made it, laddies! Prepare yer shovels an’ get diggin’!

arcanum_bladesinger.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a player: they are poisoned. Once per game, at night, choose a character: they die.
arcanum_bladesinger.firstNightReminder: Wake the Bladesinger. If they choose a player, mark the player with the "Poisoned" reminder and the Bladesinger with the "Sorcery" reminder. Put the Bladesinger to sleep.
arcanum_bladesinger.otherNightReminder: If the Bladesinger is not marked with the SORCERY reminder, Wake the Bladesinger. If they choose a player, mark the player with the "Poisoned" reminder and the Bladesinger with the "Sorcery" reminder. Put the Bladesinger to sleep. If the player is not marked with the "Sword" reminder, wake the Bladesinger. If they choose a character, mark the player with a shroud and the "Dead" reminder and the Bladesinger with the "Sword" reminder. Put the Bladesinger to sleep.
arcanum_bladesinger.flavor: With the celerity of the Great Wyrm, I dispel thy magick. With the elegance of the Iktomi, I strike thee down.

arcanum_llongjawn.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. If you publicly guess which player has the Treasure (once), evil wins. [+the Corsair]
arcanum_llongjawn.otherNightReminder: Wake the Llongjawn. The Llongjawn chooses a player. Put a "Dead" reminder and a shroud on the chosen player. Put the Llongjawn to sleep.
