arcanum_llongjawn.flavor: Damnation seize my soul if I give you quarters, or take any from you.

arcanum_metyore.ability: All know Townsfolk abilities work twice. The 1st player about to die may visit the Storyteller & learn the Demon. After day 1, evil wins.
arcanum_metyore.firstNightReminder: Announce that the Metyore is in play.
arcanum_metyore.flavor: Yes, it's you I welcome death with. As the world caves in.

arcanum_needlestick.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. 1 player is poisoned (you know who). Their good nominator or nominee is poisoned instead.
arcanum_needlestick.firstNightReminder: Wake the Needlestick. Point to the player marked with the "Poisoned" reminder token.
arcanum_needlestick.otherNightReminder: Wake the Needlestick. If the "Poisoned" reminder token moved, point to the player marked with the "Poisoned" reminder token. Then, the Needlestick chooses a player. Mark them with a "Dead" reminder.
arcanum_needlestick.flavor: Let he who hath virtue tend to the roses, lest thorns grow in the garden of sin.

arcanum_catch.ability: Once per game, a player might die.

ravenswood_jackal.ability: Each day, you may publicly choose a player: they die tonight unless another player objects.
ravenswood_jackal.flavor: You see, Brother Lion, if I should get lost or killed the world would not miss me, but you, Brother Lion—you——!”

ravenswood_polaris.ability: Each night, learn a word: the Storyteller then points in a direction related to that word.

ravenswood_acolyte.ability: Each day, privately ask a yes/no question. All but 1 Acolyte are drunk till dusk. [Acolytes might replace info characters]

jinxes.reason: If there is a spare token, the Pit-Hag can create an extra Acolyte.
If there is a spare token, the Boffin can give the Demon the Village Idiot ability.

ravenswood_acolyte.flavor: Another day another bender! No retreat and no surrender!

ravenswood_martyr.ability: When you die, if the next player to die is the Demon, your team loses. (Not on the last day.)
ravenswood_martyr.flavor: I fear no lion, no Roman, nor any beast from the pit. For my God is awesome, and he is with me even now.

ravenswood_pozzo.ability: Evil players & the Storyteller may make wishes. Once per game (or if you die by execution), privately learn them & grant 1.
ravenswood_pozzo.flavor: Wishing well, oh wishing well, there’s magic in the air. Wishing well, dear wishing well, do you have a coin to spare?

ravenswood_jack.ability: Each night, you may choose a player: they die. If they do, all players learn a clue to your identity at dawn.
ravenswood_jack.otherNightReminder: Wake the Jack. They either shake their head no or point at any player. Put the Jack to sleep.

ravenswood_hemomagus.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Chosen Minions swap characters with you if an Outsider lives, who then dies. [+1 Outsider]

jinxes.reason: If the Widow is (or has been) in play, the Cloak & the Cloaked player become poisoned at the start of the 1st night.
If the Spy is (or has been) in play, the Cloak & the Cloaked player become poisoned at the start of the 1st night.
If the Klutz is Cloaked, they learn they are the Klutz.
If the Zealot is Cloaked, they learn they are the Zealot.
If the Butler is Cloaked, they learn they are the Butler.

ravenswood_hemomagus.flavor: Town is full. Blood is fuel.

ravenswood_monomyth.ability: Each night, choose 2 players: they die. 1 good player knows a quest. When achieved, they learn you are 1 of 3 players.
ravenswood_monomyth.firstNightReminder: Wake a good player & show them a quest you have written down beforehand.
ravenswood_monomyth.otherNightReminder: Wake the Monomyth: they choose 2 players, who then die.

contest_ringleader.ability: Each night, you learn how correct the Mutant is. [+The Mutant]
contest_ringleader.flavor: And now... The amazing abomination, the mythical monster, the one and only Ogorbpf, cursed to only speak lies!

contest_finalsymphony.ability: Once per game, you may publicly claim to be the Final Symphony. If all in-play once per game abilities have been used, your team wins.

jinxes.reason: If the Amnesiac has a once per game ability, the Final Symphony learns this
The Final Symphony cannot win if the Puzzlemaster has not guessed yet
Juggler - If the Juggler chooses not to Juggle on their first day, the Final Symphony is poisoned.

contest_finalsymphony.flavor: Crescendo! Fortissimo! I will not go out with a whimper!

cute_armorer.ability: Once per game, at night, choose to learn 2 players that aren't the Demon.
cute_armorer.firstNightReminder: The Armorer might nod their head. If they do, point to 2 players.
cute_armorer.otherNightReminder: The Armorer might nod their head. If they do, point to 2 players.
cute_armorer.flavor: A good suit of armor tells everyone who is inside. If you're a hero, it should be polished and clean. If you're a villain, it should be dark and spiky. Fashion doesn't lie!

cute_bookbinder.ability: Once per game, at night, choose to learn how many living Outsiders there are. If a living neighbor is evil, learn a false number.
cute_bookbinder.firstNightReminder: The Bookbinder might nod their head. Show them a number.
cute_bookbinder.otherNightReminder: The Bookbinder might nod their head. Show them a number.
cute_bookbinder.flavor: When you make books, you get to know all of the people who only leave their house to buy more books.

cute_privateeye.ability: Once per game, at night, choose "alive" or "dead": Learn a Minion that fits that description. (Or 0 if there are none.)
cute_privateeye.firstNightReminder: The Private Eye might give a thumbs up or thumbs down. If they do, show them an appropriate token.
cute_privateeye.otherNightReminder: The Private Eye might give a thumbs up or thumbs down. If they do, show them an appropriate token.

cute_seneschal.ability: Once per game, at night, choose to learn a living good player.
cute_seneschal.firstNightReminder: The Seneschal might nod their head. If they do, point to a player.
cute_seneschal.otherNightReminder: The Seneschal might nod their head. If they do, point to a player.
cute_seneschal.flavor: Of course I snoop through the guests' stuff! How else is the head of the house going to know what's going on?

cute_sorcerer.ability: The Demon has a second Demon ability fused with the one they drew. Both of you learn the new ability.
cute_sorcerer.firstNightReminder: Show the Demon and the Sorcerer the Demon's new ability.
cute_sorcerer.flavor: Maybe they’re born with it, Maybe it’s sorcery.

cute_xenophobe.ability: Outsiders think they are a different Outsider. [-1 or +1 Outsider]

jinxes.reason: If the Storyteller gains the Xenophobe ability, all Outsiders become other Outsiders but do not learn this.

cute_xenophobe.flavor: You don't know what they're capable of! THEY don't even know what they're capable of!

cute_lolthnea.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Good players who choose you are poisoned.

kerfuffle_plumber.ability: Each night, learn either how many Outsiders are in play or how many players are evil. You do not know which.
kerfuffle_plumber.otherNightReminder: Count either how many Outsiders or how many evil players there are. Wake the Plumber. Show them fingers (0, 1, 2, etc.) equalling the number. Put the Plumber to sleep.
kerfuffle_plumber.flavor: Ah. Here's your problem. You have a doohickey in your granglesnorb where your thingymajonkler is supposed to be. I can get the new parts, let's say, by the end of the year. Now, about payment...

kerfuffle_windowwasher.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a player (not yourself). That night, learn what they learned due to their own ability. If you choose the Demon, you are drunk.
kerfuffle_windowwasher.otherNightReminder: The Window Washer may choose a player. If they choose the Demon, mark them as [[DRUNK]]. If they did not choose the Demon, mark the chosen player with [[PEEK]]. Show any information that the [[PEEK]] player sees to the Window Washer.

kerfuffle_edenspython.ability: You and a Townsfolk player think you are each others' characters & cannot change characters, even if dead, drunk, or poisoned.
kerfuffle_edenspython.firstNightReminder: Swap the Eden's Python character token with a Townsfolk character token. Add the TEMPTED reminder token to the Townsfolk that was swapped.
kerfuffle_edenspython.flavor: Please, allow me to tempt you. Just a bite, is all I ask. Of the fruit. What is it, you ask? Nothing more than fruit, I say.

kerfuffle_incubus.ability: You start knowing a good player. If this player nominates and executes you, they turn evil each night.

jinxes.reason: The Incubus starts knowing a good player.

kerfuffle_incubus.flavor: You will be mine. Before you know it, it will be you and me, forever.

kerfuffle_pyromaniac.ability: When you nominate yourself, all players you have nominated die. You do not know the evil team, but 1 good player knows you. Minions wake separately, even if not-in-play.
kerfuffle_pyromaniac.otherNightReminder: Wake the player marked [[KNOW]]. Show them [[THIS PLAYER IS]], the Pyromaniac character token, then point to the Pyromaniac. Put them to sleep.

jinxes.reason: The Pyromaniac cannot learn the Minions or Demon due to the Poppy Grower.
The Pyromaniac does not choose who babysits the Lil' Monsta.

kerfuffle_pyromaniac.flavor: Yeah, that was me. I did it. It wasn't the left or the right, it wasn't the rich or the poor, it wasn't the legal or the criminal. I torched the country myself.

kerfuffle_thebeast.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. You wake with other The Beast of your alignment. [-1 to +1 Outsiders, -1 Minion, +1 The Beast, you neighbour The Beast]
kerfuffle_thebeast.otherNightReminder: Wake both The Beast. They may choose one player each (it may be the same player). Put The Beast to sleep. Mark the chosen players with the [[DEAD]] reminder token.

jinxes.reason: If The Beast is summoned, they must neighbor a Minion, who also becomes The Beast.

If The Beast is created, one of The Beast's neighbours becomes an evil The Beast and a Minion might lose their ability and learn this. If The Beast is removed from play from the Engineer, The Beast becomes a minion and a demon.

If The Beast is created, one of The Beast's neighbours becomes an evil The Beast and a Minion might lose their ability and learn this. If The Beast is removed from play from the Engineer, The Beast becomes the chosen demon or an out-of-play minion.
The Beast may register as a Minion to the Snitch.
The Beast may register as a Minion to the Damsel.
The Beast may register as a Minion to the Clockmaker.
The Beast do not wake together and choose to kill separately while the Poppy Grower is alive.
The Magician is not put in the bag, and a Townsfolk may be replaced with the Magician during setup.

kerfuffle_thebeast.flavor: Then, suddenly, the sky above cracked open, and a white beam of light reached down into the Earth, smiting the Mother of Harlots asunder and setting the blood lake to a boil.

kerfuffle_saviour.ability: Once per game, at day, before nominations, you may publicly choose to restore all ''Once per game'' abilities to all players (not Travellers), then you die, even if you normally couldn't.
kerfuffle_saviour.flavor: Judas bet that I would come back after three days. Easiest thirty silver of my life.

kerfuffle_lordship.ability: At any time, name a player. Only they may speak, & they must at a reasonable volume. You may declare that anyone can speak.
kerfuffle_lordship.flavor: You do not refer to His Lordship by name. You do not speak when His Lordship speaks. You do not leave until His Lordship allows you. And if you make His Lordship angry, we don't want to see you again.

kerfuffle_physiognomist.ability: The Heretic may not turn evil. If they would, they learn this. Abilities that would turn the Heretic evil are still ''used''.
kerfuffle_physiognomist.flavor: That right there, that tall fellow. You see him, with the small nose, the bushy eyebrows, the eyes in the right place in the head. That right there is a good man... He did WHAT?

coda_grammarian.ability: Each night, learn a good character’s incorrect information.
coda_grammarian.otherNightReminder: Give a good character’s false information.
coda_grammarian.flavor: Alan Jay Lerner’s ‘I’d be equally as willing for a dentist to be drilling / than to ever let a woman in my life’ from My Fair Lady is a calamity of musical theatre lyric writing. Not just the ‘equally as’—that ‘than’ should invariably be an ‘as’. Needless to say, I am more snickety than Henry Higgins.

coda_collarkin.ability: You start by choosing a player. When they die, learn why & choose a new player.
coda_collarkin.otherNightReminder: If the Collerkin's owner dies, they learn info and choose a player.

jinxes.reason: The Collarkin's owner, if good, cannot die and their execution does not contribute to the Leviathan's count.
If Riot nominates the Collarkin's owner and the Collarkin is alive, they don't die, but still nominate.

coda_collarkin.flavor: My favorite hello is my hardest goodbye.

coda_tsundere.ability: You & another good character know the other is in play. They are drunk. If they die, gain their ability.
coda_tsundere.firstNightReminder: Show the good character token marked DRUNK. Put the Tsundere to sleep. Wake the player marked DRUNK. Show the THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU info token & the Tsundere token.
coda_tsundere.flavor: It's not that I don't like you, stupid! It's that I don't like you!

coda_wirehide.ability: Evil players can’t die. Each night, choose whether you are drunk until dusk.
coda_wirehide.firstNightReminder: The Wirehide either nods their head yes to be drunk, or shakes their head no to be sober.
coda_wirehide.otherNightReminder: The Wirehide either nods their head yes to be drunk, or shakes their head no to be sober.
coda_wirehide.flavor: Unfortunate, yes. It appears that I couldn't stop you in time from wrongly acquiring the Orb That Makes You Immortal®. Yeah, it sucks to be me, all right. And yes, I do suppose that this has gone in such a way where no one will ever believe that you made such an intricately evil scheme. Of course, of course, you win... anyway, we're being broadcast live. Say hello!

coda_pollyanna.ability: Minions don’t get Minion info. When you die (not by execution), 🙒 Minions become good. You are sober & healthy. [+🙒 Minions]

jinxes.reason: If the Pollyanna is in play, Minions do not learn that the Magician is the Demon.
If the Pollyanna is in play and the Poppygrower dies, Minions do not learn the Demon or each other.
Only 1 of the Pollyanna and Pit-Hag can be in play.
The Summoner learns the other Minions. The Summoner cannot be turned good.
If the Pollyanna is in play, the Spy does not see the Grimoire. Each night, the Spy might learn some in-play characters.
If the Pollyanna is in play, the Widow does not have the Widow ability. On the 1st night, they start knowing a poisoned player. Each night, the Widow might learn some in-play characters.
If the Pollyanna is in play, the Wraith does not have the Widow ability. Each night, they might wake with another player.
The Kazali chooses an additional 🙒 Minions.
If the Pollyanna is in play, the Storyteller chooses which Minion babysits Lil' Monsta.
why am i writing jinxes for interactions that definitely are just script issues
Good Minions do not become Riot.

coda_pollyanna.flavor: I believe in roses kissed with dew! Why shouldn’t I believe the same in you?

coda_girlnextdoor.ability: You start knowing if both of your neighbours are Townsfolk. [1 Townsfolk neighbour is evil]

jinxes.reason: If the Kazali turns the Girl Next Door into a Minion, the evil Townsfolk is not made.

coda_girlnextdoor.flavor: Yes, it's Act I Scene III. Wanna dredge up some romantic tension anyway? It’s either you or that weird guy down the street...

coda_redonder.ability: On your 1st day, you must publicly make a wish. It might have a price. When you die, your wish backfires.
coda_redonder.otherNightReminder: Do whatever needs to be done to satisfy the Wizard's ability.
coda_redonder.flavor: Why, we’re going to be rich, famous, and happy. Wish to be an emperor, father, to begin with; then you can’t be henpecked.

coda_sinkhole.ability: If an alive player votes, the next can't, even if you are dead. A majority isn't required.

jinxes.reason: If the Voudon ability is active, the Sinkhole considers dead players and the Voudon as alive players instead.

coda_frie.ability: Each night, choose a player: they are æſhīþed until dusk, learn this, & may privately guess what æſhīþement means during the day.
coda_frie.flavor: Adyleide, iſn’t þe æons paſt a ſhame? Þe humans call us “færie” now. What was wrong wiþ þe word fairy? Laſt time I checked, we were þe Fair Folk. So, we ſhould clearly be fairy...

coda_yandere.ability: Each night, choose 2 players: a particular good player chooses who dies.
coda_yandere.firstNightReminder: Mark a good player with MINE!
coda_yandere.otherNightReminder: The Yandere chooses two players. Put the Yandere to sleep. The player marked MINE! chooses between the two players, mark them with a shroud and the DEAD reminder.

coda_errorist.ability: Players may additionally learn incorrect information
coda_errorist.flavor: they say i need to start usinggood grammar,. but lowkirkenuinely i don’t fckni g care 💀

coda_leukocyte.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Minions may choose to die at any time.
coda_leukocyte.firstNightReminder: Wake the Minions that do not wake later. They might choose to die.
coda_leukocyte.otherNightReminder: The Leukocyte chooses a player. Put the Leukocyte to sleep. Wake the Minions that do not wake later. They might choose to die.
coda_leukocyte.flavor: Cause I, I, I, got the SARS tonight...

coda_manhattanite.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Players who die tonight might register as alive till any point tomorrow day.
coda_manhattanite.flavor: I wanna wake up in a city that never sleeps. And find I'm king of the hill; top of the heap...

coda_hostage.ability: If a player (not Travellers) leaves before the session ends, the group kidnaps a person to take their place.
coda_hostage.flavor: You know, this is the second-best thing I've eaten during a kidnapping. You’re, like, really good at cooking.

coda_enviousraven.ability: Characters might wake in a different order. All players know the details.

jinxes.reason: The Chambermaid still detects if other characters that wake after them will wake tonight.

coda_enviousraven.flavor: So he left his home in the woods and fields and flew down to live on the lakes and in the marshes.

coda_brandstuck.ability: Something silly might happen to those who use non-official terms around new players.
coda_brandstuck.flavor: Ow! Aw, I got hurt. But not to worry— Band-Aid® brand will save me!

coda_countrymouse.ability: At most 2 characters that can change the Outsider count during set-up are allowed to be in the bag.

jinxes.reason: If the Hermit removes itself, it still counts towards Country Mouse.
The Sentinel counts as being in the Bag.

coda_countrymouse.flavor: You may have luxuries and dainties that I have not,” she said as she hurried away, “but I prefer my plain food and simple life in the country with the peace and security that go with it.

coda_idiotball.ability: Your ability works improperly. When you learn that you died, choose an alive player: they get the Idiot Ball. [I am an object]
coda_idiotball.flavor: Wait a minute, how did this happen? The Storyteller should be smarter than this!

coda_satyr.ability: There is a publicly known win/loss condition in play.
coda_satyr.firstNightReminder: Announce the additional win condition that is in play.

jinxes.reason: If the Satyr makes a team win or lose, the Heretic still reverses the win or loss.

coda_satyr.flavor: I've seen enough. A fellow that blows hot and cold in the same breath cannot be friends with me!

coda_abberation.ability: The premise of this script is inherently defective, but the script writer tries anyway. [-? hours of playing this script]

coda_sealost.ability: Players do not know the script or edition.
coda_sealost.flavor: I have no landmarks! I’m helpless! I could sail the oceans for weeks and still be nowhere! I’d be lost, I am lost, we’re all lost— We’re lost! And we’re going to die.

coda_knitter.ability: Each player chooses their own task. If you can’t complete yours by day 5, everyone loses. You can get help.
coda_knitter.flavor: Alright, to be clear: we need to solve this Rubik's Cube, set this killer sudoku, beat Hastybot, get 90 or higher in Yacht Dice, and complete Celeste 9D?

conduct_pietaster.ability: You think you are every character. You have multiple unknown characters, & might register as them. Each night, choose a character: you think you aren't that character, unless you have it.
conduct_pietaster.firstNightReminder: The Pie Taster chooses a character. Do not

jinxes.reason: A Pie Taster who has the Lil' Monsta character is treated as currently babysitting the Lil' Monsta. If they actually have said character, Minions may meet to choose a different player to babysit.
If playing in-person, the Pie Taster does not think they are the Wraith, nor may they have the Wraith character.

conduct_pietaster.flavor: Oh my god... is that a rich, blueberry filling? Fresh lemon tart with rich pistachios as a complement? Holy moly... I think I'm in heaven... I'm never, ever, ever, ever, ever leaving this place!

conduct_awesomefuckingpolycule.ability: Good players might have drunk Demon characters and might die. Each night, Minions choose one to be "the Demon", sober, and evil, until dusk. Minions get 3 bluffs and are safe from Demons, until the last Demon alive gets a boon.
conduct_awesomefuckingpolycule.firstNightReminder: Wake up all Minions. They point to a player. Show them 3 characters: they are not in play.
conduct_awesomefuckingpolycule.otherNightReminder: Wake up all Minions. They point to a player.

jinxes.reason: The Engineer chooses which Demons are not in play instead of which Demons are in play.
If the Poppy Grower is alive, Minions wake one by one to choose a player. If Minions tie, or if no Minions chose a Demon, the Storyteller decides the Minions' choice.
The Heretic is poisoned if they die as the sober Demon.
The Snitch has a drunk Demon character.
The Politician is poisoned if they die as the sober Demon.
The Marionette enters play after the 1st Demon is chosen, and starts as their neighbor.
Minions may not choose a sober Demon until Night 3. On Night 3, the Summoner chooses an additional person to gain a drunk Demon character.
Minions learn the 1 player who has a Legion character. If they are chosen by the Minions, most players become a Legion, including all Minions. The Awesome Fucking Polycule is poisoned.
On Night 1, the Kazali makes their choice no matter what. They choose which Minions are in play, but not which player.
If the Leviathan becomes for the first time during or after Day 5, the game continues for 1 more day, and players learn this.

The player with the Lil' Monsta character does not babysit the Lil' Monsta. There is an extra Minion, and if the Minions choose a player with the Lil' Monsta character, the Minions may choose who to babysit.
The Lleech host is chosen even if the Lleech is drunk. The Lleech is able to die normally when drunk, and only poisons and survives death when they are sober.
Minions and Demon players are in a line, with the Typhon in the middle. If the Typhon is drunk, a Minion is poisoned, and learns this.
If the Riot is not "the Demon" on Day 3, a Riot night does not happen.
The Lunatic may think they are another character with a drunk Demon character.
Minions are not safe from the Vigormortis.
If the Imp kills themself, Minions are not safe from the Imp.
The Magician may be chosen by Minions. If they are chosen to be "the Demon", sober, and evil, tonight, the Storyteller decides kills.
A Zombuul "registering as dead" counts as an alive player when determining if a Demon is the "last Demon alive". The Zombuul continues to "register as dead" when drunk.

conduct_awesomefuckingpolycule.flavor: Crassus, even if it'd take you eons to cross the hostile seas for you to give a big fat smooch with that cute little beak of yours, I'd level the entire Alps and slaughter a thousand men for a little peck. - Yours truly, Hannibal. (I am also here! -Fortinbras)

conduct_jesterpink.ability: Yahaha! You lose! Grab again! Have me, be pink! I go on head! Yoinkers keepers! I say how pink win: shhhh or void. Or, lynch me to win (we) and kaboom, "Silliest jiggy" learns! [In bag.]
conduct_jesterpink.flavor: My name is pink, and I'd really like to meet you!

faketier_tailor.ability: You start knowing 3 characters of different types, only 1 of which is in-play.
faketier_tailor.firstNightReminder: Show them 3 characters of different types, only 1 of which is in-play.
faketier_tailor.flavor: Sir Armun has ordered for such exquisite outfits to the circus. Such eccentric ones too. Is he the main event, a spectator or someone who wishes to disrupt the show?

faketier_focus.ability: You start knowing the answer to a question. Each day, privately guess what it is: you learn how accurate you are.

faketier_cynic.ability: Each night, choose a player: learn the evil character they are, or could be.
faketier_cynic.firstNightReminder: The Cynic chooses a player. Show them the evil character or could be (if they aren't an evil character).
faketier_cynic.otherNightReminder: The Cynic chooses a player. Show them the evil character that player is or any evil character (if they aren't one).
faketier_cynic.flavor: That's what a Demon would say.

faketier_pastor.ability: Each night, learn the character type of the previously learnt player's clockwise neighbor (skipping Travellers).
faketier_pastor.firstNightReminder: Show the character type token of the LEARNT player.
faketier_pastor.otherNightReminder: Show the character type token of the LEARNT player.
faketier_pastor.flavor: Speak child, and all shall be forgiven.

faketier_interceptor.ability: Each night, choose a good character (not yours): learn that it is between 2 players. If not-in-play, learn false info.
faketier_interceptor.firstNightReminder: The Interceptor chooses a character. Point to 2 players, 1 of which is that character (if it in-play).
faketier_interceptor.otherNightReminder: The Interceptor chooses a character. Point to 2 players, 1 of which is that character (if it in-play).

faketier_mercenary.ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): they can't die tonight. If they are evil, you are drunk.

jinxes.reason: If the Leviathan is in-play, the Fortify-protected player is safe from all evil abilities.
If Riot is in-play, the Fortify-protected player is safe from all evil abilities.

faketier_mercenary.flavor: Another round on me boys! Courtesy of the bighead up north!

faketier_templar.ability: Each night, choose 2 alive players (not yourself): if the Demon kills the 1st, the 2nd, if not the Demon, dies instead.

jinxes.reason: If the Leviathan is in-play, the Templar-protected player is safe from all evil abilities.
If Riot is in-play, the Templar-protected player is safe from all evil abilities.

faketier_templar.flavor: The Lord is with me always. In hardship, in times of distress, times of celebration and times of success.

faketier_nihilist.ability: Each day, you may visit the Storyteller to learn what your ability is tonight & tomorrow.

jinxes.reason: The Nihilist when learning their next ability will always receive true information.
The Nihilist when learning their next ability will always receive true information.

faketier_nihilist.flavor: The wind blows while we point our fingers. The sun shines as we behead our fellows. The moon glows as we die in our slumber. Less and less of us wake but nothing ever changes. We can never matter.

faketier_manager.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a non-Traveller player: you learn their character. Chosen Townsfolk are drunk, even if you die.
faketier_manager.firstNightReminder: The Overdrive might choose a player. Show them that player's character.
faketier_manager.otherNightReminder: The Overdrive might choose a player. Show them that player's character.
faketier_manager.flavor: I'll withhold a thousand wages before I give up my bonuses!

faketier_optimist.ability: Once per game, during the day, privately ask the Storyteller any question & learn some answers (only 1 is correct).
faketier_optimist.flavor: We don't matter in the eyes of nature but what about the eyes of those we fight for? Even in the worst of times there is still hope, some answers. Something.

faketier_spirit.ability: If the Demon kills you, from now on you know the in-play evil characters.
faketier_spirit.otherNightReminder: If the Demon killed the Spirit, wake the Spirit and show them all evil characters in-play.

jinxes.reason: Each night, the Leviathan chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Spirit uses their ability but does not die.
Each night, Riot chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Spirit uses their ability but does not die.

faketier_spirit.flavor: I must go, I must ascend. To the Realm Beyond.

faketier_executioner.ability: Only players of your alignment can die, even if for some reason they cannot. Each night, you may choose to be drunk until dusk.
faketier_executioner.otherNightReminder: The Ammo Blast either nods their head yes to be drunk or shakes their head no to stay sober.
faketier_executioner.flavor: Perhaps Lady Justice need not know that her trusty guillotine got caught on a little nail. Or if that nail were to be removed...

faketier_escapist.ability: The 1st time an evil player chooses you with their ability at night, an evil player is chosen instead.

jinxes.reason: The Escapist does not trigger when chosen to host the Lleech.

faketier_whisperer.ability: You start knowing up to 2 players: what happens to them might happen to you & vice versa, even if dead, drunk or poisoned.
faketier_whisperer.firstNightReminder: Point to all players marked LINKED.
faketier_whisperer.flavor: Hear the song of the damned, and perhaps they shall speak to you. Through only death shall we be free.

faketier_warden.ability: Each night, if you died, a Minion's ability might work twice until dusk. You & they learn this.
faketier_warden.otherNightReminder: You may choose a Minion. Wake the Warden and nod. Put them to sleep. Wake the Minion and show the THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU token then the Warden token. Run their ability twice.

jinxes.reason: The Marionette does not learn they are affected by the Warden's ability.
A Warden boosted Mezepheles cannot create 2 evil players.
If the Summoner's ability works twice due to the Warden, the second Demon they create retains their alignment. If the Summoner creates 2 evil Demons, deaths tonight are arbitrary.

faketier_warden.flavor: Times up ladies! Back to your cells!

faketier_hobo.ability: Each night, learn a player: you are mad they are evil tomorrow or 1 of you might be executed. Once, you learn they are a Minion.
faketier_hobo.firstNightReminder: Show any player. If they are a Minion, you may show the Hobo the MINION token.
faketier_hobo.otherNightReminder: Show any player. If they are a Minion & you haven't shown the Hobo the MINION token, you may show them the MINION token.
faketier_hobo.flavor: I hear them talk in my ear! The shadow people don't know but I hear their plans! I know what they did! Hear me out please!

faketier_shacklemeat.ability: When you die, the Demon gains a Minion ability & learns which.
faketier_shacklemeat.otherNightReminder: If the Shacklemeat died, the Demon gained a Minion Ability. If you have not told them this yet, do so now. If necessary, swap Shacklemeat's character token.

jinxes.reason: If the Demon gains the Baron's ability, up to 2 players become not-in-play Outsiders.
If the Shacklemeat is executed and the Demon would gain the Boomdandy's ability, it instead triggers immediately.
If the Shacklemeat dies and would give the False Idol's ability, a Minion gains it instead and learns so.

Up to 3 extra players learn that the Hunter is in-play. If the Hunter's ability is created midgame, those are its targets. If no possible targets, the Hunter's ability cannot be put into play. A Minion gains the Hunter's ability from the Shacklemeat instead of the Demon.
If the Demon has a neighbor who can be a Marionette and the Shacklemeat would give the Marionette ability, they become an evil Marionette. This cannot happen if there is already an extra evil player.
If the Shacklemeat dies and would give the Masterminds's ability, a Minion gains it instead and learns so.
If the Shacklemeat dies and would give the Scarlet Woman's ability, a Minion gains it alongside their own instead and learns so.
The Demon cannot create an in-play Demon. If they create an out of play Demon, deaths tonight are arbitrary.
If the Shacklemeat dies and would give the Vizier's ability, a living Minion gains it alongside their own.

faketier_shacklemeat.flavor: I serve thee. And only thee.

faketier_plaguerat.ability: When you die, learn your character then a Townsfolk becomes a Plague Rat, thinks they are a Townsfolk & learns false info.
faketier_plaguerat.otherNightReminder: If a Plague Rat died, they have learnt their character and a new Plague Rat has been made. If you haven't done this yet, do so now.

jinxes.reason: Players turned into a Plague Rat through its ability learn only true info if the Vortox is alive, sober and healthy.

faketier_plaguerat.flavor: Wha' ya' mean ah smell? Jus' me cows'nall. 'ose rats 'ways been 'ere, ah tellya.

faketier_celebrity.ability: If you die & 5 or more non-Travellers live, choose an alive player: if they are not executed tomorrow, your team loses.

jinxes.reason: If the Celebrity chooses the same player as the Hagumoth, the Celebrity is poisoned.

faketier_celebrity.flavor: Marvelous photos darling just marvelous. Now go away, I have a show to star!

faketier_biter.ability: You start knowing which Outsiders are in-play. Dead Outsiders poison 1 Townsfolk neighbor. [-1 to +1 Outsider]
faketier_biter.firstNightReminder: Show each of the Outsider tokens in-play.

jinxes.reason: The Heretic starts knowing an out-of-play Outsider & registers as that Outsider to Biter.

faketier_hunter.ability: You start knowing up to 3 in-play good characters (they learn this). If they are all dead and you are then executed, your team wins.
faketier_hunter.firstNightReminder: Point to all players marked TARGET. Put the Hunter to sleep. Wake each of these players 1 by 1 and show them the Hunter token until they have all seen it.

jinxes.reason: The Hunter cannot have a Exorcist as their target.
The Hunter cannot have a Heretic as their target.
The Hunter cannot have a King as their target.
The Hunter cannot have a Lunatic as their target.

Up to 3 extra players learn that the Hunter is in-play. If the Hunter's ability is created midgame, those are its targets. If no possible targets, the Hunter's ability cannot be put into play. A Minion gains the Hunter's ability from the Plague Doctor instead of the Storyteller.
Up to 3 extra players learn that the Hunter is in-play. If the Hunter's ability is created midgame, those are its targets. If no possible targets, the Hunter's ability cannot be put into play.
The Spy may choose to not see the Grimoire. If they do see the Grimoire, evil does not win from the Hunter's ability.

On the Widow's first night, they may choose to not see the Grimoire. Instead all in-play character tokens are shown to them. They choose 1 of those to poison. If they chose to see the Grimoire, evil does not win from the Hunter's ability.

faketier_hunter.flavor: If you're not willing to obey, then only the end awaits you.

faketier_hagumoth.ability: Each night, you may choose a player: they learn this & if they are executed tomorrow, their team loses.
faketier_hagumoth.firstNightReminder: The Hagumoth might choose a player. Put the Hagumoth to sleep. Wake the target. Show the THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU token then the Hagumoth token.
faketier_hagumoth.otherNightReminder: The Hagumoth might choose a player. Put the Hagumoth to sleep. Wake the target. Show the THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU token then the Hagumoth token.

jinxes.reason: If the Plague Doctor dies, a living Minion gains the Hagumoth ability in addition to their own and learns this.
The Vizier wakes with the Hagumoth, learns who they choose and cannot choose to immediately execute that player tomorrow.

faketier_hagumoth.flavor: Through the path of Umalaaq, I stand upon thy grave. Through the will of the One Beyond, I break thy spirit. Through the ends of Heaven and Hell, I cut thy heart.

faketier_tyrant.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. The Demon wakes every other night, even if you are dead, drunk or poisoned.
faketier_tyrant.otherNightReminder: The Tyrant chooses a player. If the Demon woke for their ability the previous night, they do not wake tonight.

jinxes.reason: The Tyrant registers as the Demon to the Banshee.
The Lil' Monsta's ability does not kill every other day/night cycle.
The Tyrant registers as the Demon to the Monk.
If the Tyrant kills the Sage, the Sage learns the Demon is 1 of 2 players.
If the Tyrant kills the Spirit, from now on the Spirit knows the in-play evil characters.
The Yaggababble's ability does not kill every other day/night cycle.
If the Tyrant is in-play, the Zombuul instead wakes every other night that no player died that day.

faketier_corrupted.ability: Twice per game, at night, choose 2 players: all vote for who lives & dies. The 1st time the Demon dies, play for 1 more night.
faketier_corrupted.otherNightReminder: The Corrupted might choose 2 players. Say "The Corrupted has chosen", then both players' names, then start the silent vote. Afterwards, add and remove shrouds from both players accordingly.

jinxes.reason: If a Demon is resurrected, deaths tonight are arbitrary. If a Demon dies and the game continues anyway, it does not count.

faketier_corrupted.flavor: Do not worry, your death will be swift and painless.

jinxes.reason: If the Kazali chooses to make a Cultist, they choose 2 players to become Cultists.
If the Engineer creates a Cultist, 1 good player becomes an evil Cultist.

faketier_cultist.flavor: Awaken, sister. It is time to serve once more.

faketier_marusok.ability: You have a not-in-play Demon ability & register as them too. Evil players might not wake. [All Minions are Marusok]
faketier_marusok.firstNightReminder: Wake each Marusok and show them their ability. Swap each of their tokens as needed.

jinxes.reason: Corr. Sylphy's ability only checks the last night they woke.
If the Engineer successfully creates Marusok, all Minions become Marusok.
Marusok can be invited alongside a Demon. If it is, all Minions become Marusok except the Invitee, who becomes the invited Demon.
The Kazali may choose Marusok's Demon abilities. If they made a Marusok, all Minions become Marusok.
If Marusok has the Legion ability, other Marusok might have it as well. The Demon might be Legion too.
Demons may choose to not attack when they wake. If the Po wakes and the last Demon to wake chose to not attack, they choose 3 players.
The Summoner may choose to create Marusok as well as their Demon. If they do, all Minions become Marusok and the Summoner-chosen player becomes the chosen Demon.

faketier_marusok.flavor: I am the Infinite Spiral, the herald of The One Beyond. What are you?

faketier_grave.ability: You may ask a question that, if good wins, all players learn (even if dead). If most good players are wrong, evil wins instead.
faketier_grave.firstNightReminder: You may wake the Grave if needed.
faketier_grave.otherNightReminder: You may wake the Grave if needed.

faketier_falseidol.ability: After day 6, evil wins. Unless just you, the Demon & another player live, good can't win by killing the Demon.
faketier_falseidol.firstNightReminder: Mark the False Idol with the DAY 1 token.

jinxes.reason: A dead False Idol cannot stop good from winning through killing the Demon.
A dead False Idol cannot stop good from winning through killing the Demon.
A dead False Idol cannot stop good from winning through killing the Demon.

faketier_falseidol.flavor: LISTEN TO ME, WATCH ME, LOVE ME!

faketier_afonoplexia.ability: On the final day, good only wins if a Minion is executed. If you die, keep this ability.
faketier_afonoplexia.flavor: I am the box and He is the key. Unshuffle and the truth you too shall see.

faketier_enra.ability: On the final day, before nominations & even if you die, the Demon may publicly choose a player: they are "the Demon" instead.
faketier_enra.flavor: ... And it shall be our duty to slay the children of the wretched witch as our only way to reply to her sins.

faketier_invitationletter.ability: Each night, Minions choose who holds the Invitation Letter. On night 3, the Invitee chooses a Demon to become. [+1 Minion]
faketier_invitationletter.firstNightReminder: Wake all Minions, allow them to choose an invitee. then place the NIGHT 1 token in the center of the Grimoire.
faketier_invitationletter.otherNightReminder: Wake all Minions, allow them to choose an invitee. then place the relevent night token in the center of the Grimoire. If it is night 3, the invitee chooses a Demon. Show them the YOU ARE token and the chosen Demon token.

jinxes.reason: If the Invitation Letter is in-play, the Clockmaker does not receive their info until a Demon is successfully invited.

If the Engineer removes the Invitation Letter from play, the Invitee becomes the chosen Demon. If the Engineer creates the Invitation Letter before night 4, the Demon becomes a not-in-play Minion Invitee. Otherwise nothing happens.
If the Hatter dies, the Invitee can choose a Demon to become. If the Demon chooses Invitation Letter, they also choose a Minion to become and are the Invitee.
If Legion is invited, most players (including all evil players) become evil Legion.
If a Minion invites Lord of Typhon, they choose 1 of their neighbors to become an evil Lord of Typhon instead.
Each night, the Magician chooses a Minion: if that Minion & the Invitation Letter are alive, that Minion is the Invitee.
The Marionette neighbors a Minion, not the Demon. The Marionette is not woken to choose who takes the Invitation Letter's token. The other Minions know the Marionette.
If the Poppy Grower is in-play, Minions don't wake together. They are woken one by one, until one of them chooses to be the Invitee.
The Invitee may choose to invite Pukka on night 2.
On night 3, if a dead player becomes the Invitee, they may choose to invite Zombuul. If they do, they become a Zombuul that has died once.

faketier_invitationletter.flavor: You must play with at least 1 friend." Requirements: - A room with an open roof - An alive, human (recommended) sacrifice - Surgical equipment - An item representing the horror you wish to unleash - A new moon Preparations: The rest of the letter is missing

faketier_handoffate.ability: Each night, choose a number: gain that ability (all players know what they could be). Each night, choose a player: they die.
faketier_handoffate.firstNightReminder: The Hand of Fate gives a number. Show them the ability.
faketier_handoffate.otherNightReminder: The Hand of Fate gives a number. Show them the ability. They choose a player.
faketier_handoffate.flavor: The time has come for you to return where you belong.

faketier_estelle.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Minions you kill keep their ability and choose a player: they die.
faketier_estelle.otherNightReminder: Estelle chooses a player. If that player is a Minion, they choose a player.
faketier_estelle.flavor: No... Please stop. I don't want to hurt you.

faketier_corrsylphy.ability: Each night, choose 1 more player than last time (up to 5): they die. If a Minion died today, choose 1 instead.
faketier_corrsylphy.otherNightReminder: Signal how many players Corr. Sylphy can choose. They then choose that many players.
faketier_corrsylphy.flavor: Traitor Traitor Traitor Traitor Traitor Traitor Traitor Traitor Traitor Traitor Traitor Traitor...

faketier_zhobazhbu.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Minions you kill keep their ability & reverse Townsfolk info. [-1 Outsider]
faketier_zhobazhbu.otherNightReminder: The Zhobazhbu chooses a player.. If that player is a Minion, reverse Townsfolk info.

jinxes.reason: If the Demon kills the Banshee, players still learn that they have died.

faketier_zhobazhbu.flavor: Bathe within the flames, such that they purify thee of thy sin of weakness and frailty. Through atonement for thy mortality thou shalt be embraced by The One Beyond.

faketier_sabnock.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Outsiders you kill poison the closest Townsfolk neighbor to you. [+1 Outsider]
faketier_sabnock.otherNightReminder: The Sabnock chooses a player. If that player is an Outsider, poison a neighboring Townsfolk.

jinxes.reason: Plague Rats created by their own ability do not register as Outsiders to the Sabnock.

forgetful_vajrayana.ability: You start knowing which half of the Grimoire from you has more evil players. If equal, this is arbitrary.
forgetful_vajrayana.firstNightReminder: Point clockwise or anti-clockwise around the circle.
forgetful_vajrayana.flavor: これは真。それも真。すべて 真です。

forgetful_melancholic.ability: The 1st time you nominate, execute, and kill an Outsider, learn an evil player tonight. [+0 or +1 Outsider]
forgetful_melancholic.otherNightReminder: If the Melancholic nominated the player who was executed today, and that player was an Outsider, point to an evil player.

jinxes.reason: If the Melancholic nominates the Mutant, and they are executed by their ability, The Melancholic ability does not trigger.

forgetful_melancholic.flavor: I fear too early, for my mind misgives.

forgetful_mineralogist.ability: If you die at night, learn 1 or 2 good players: they are sober, healthy & get true info from now on, even if you are drunk or poisoned.
forgetful_mineralogist.flavor: Here- before it's too late! take my healing crystal! yes I am serious. Just take it!

forgetful_greeter.ability: Each night, choose a player. The 1st time you choose an Outsider, their ability is modified to help your alignment, & they learn this. [+0 or +1 Outsider]
forgetful_greeter.firstNightReminder: The Greeter chooses a player. If this is their first time choosing an outsider: Put the Greeter to sleep. Wake the target. Show the YOU ARE info token & their new ability text.
forgetful_greeter.otherNightReminder: The Greeter chooses a player. If this is their first time choosing an outsider: Put the Greeter to sleep. Wake the target. Show the YOU ARE info token & their new ability text.

forgetful_deliverer.ability: The 1st time a good Townsfolk nominates you, they becomes evil tonight, even if you are dead.
forgetful_deliverer.otherNightReminder: If a Good Townsfolk nominated the Deliverer yesterday, wake the player. Show the YOU ARE info token & give a thumbs down.
forgetful_deliverer.flavor: I shall deliver you from justice, poor child, into the night.

forgetful_prestidigitator.ability: You start knowing a good player & what they are. On your 1st night, you may poison them & choose what they register as.
forgetful_prestidigitator.firstNightReminder: Wake the Prestidigitator. They point to a player and a character token on the sheet. If that player is evil, shake your head, point at the Prestidigitator ability text on the character sheet, and wait for the Prestidigitator to choose again. Otherwise, mark them with the [[REGISTERS FALSELY]] reminder. They now register as that character. Put the Prestidigitator to sleep.
forgetful_prestidigitator.flavor: Frog's Eye, Frog's Leg, Frog's Slime... This is shaping up to be a nice breakfast.

trouble_actress.ability: Each night, you learn the number of alive players who were publicly mad about false game-related info today.
trouble_actress.otherNightReminder: Count the alive players who publicly believed, were convinced or tried to make others believe false game-related information. Show this number to the Actor at night.
trouble_actress.flavor: They are just acting, I know how this works.

trouble_adulterator.ability: Each night, choose 1 or 2 players (incl. yourself): they can't die tonight, 1 is drunk. 1 is deranged and can't die until dusk.
trouble_adulterator.otherNightReminder: Remove the "Protected" s, "Drunk" s and "Deranged" s of the Adulterator. The Adulterator points to 1 or 2 players and may choose themself as well. Add the "Protected" to both. Add the "Drunk" to one of both. Add the "Deranged" to the same player or the other one. Players with "Protected" reminder don't die tonight (if they have the "Drunk" reminder) and don't die until next dusk (if they have the "Deranged" reminder). Players with "Drunk" reminder are drunk tonight. Players with "Deranged" reminder are deranged until next dusk.

trouble_adventurer.ability: Each night, learn the Demon's kill targets of tonight.
trouble_adventurer.otherNightReminder: Wake the Adventurer and point at each player who has the "dead" of any Demon (or otherwise a "Demon" ) which signifies being chosen by the Demon. "Demon" s are removed on dawn.

jinxes.reason: The Fang Gu only jumps to the next chosen Outsider when the Adventurer is dead.
The Fang Shu only jumps to the next chosen Outsider when the Adventurer is dead.

trouble_antifascist.ability: You start knowing the character of 1 Demon player. Each night, you learn the number of alive minions.
trouble_antifascist.firstNightReminder: Show the character of 1 demon player to the Antifascist. Rest: See Other Night Reminder.
trouble_antifascist.otherNightReminder: Show the number of alive good plus evil players who register as being of Minion type to the Antifascist.

trouble_arrester.ability: Once per game, anytime, you may choose 1 player. The next time you are executed or attacked, it hits them instead.
trouble_arrester.otherNightReminder: If there is no "used", the Arrester may call their ability before execution, before dawn or choose at night. If they do so (privately or publicly), mark them with "used". Mark the chosen player with "target" (don't remove it). If the Arrester would be executed or killed, the player with "target" reminder does instead and the Arrester accounts for it. If the Arrester is resurrected or removed, remove the "used".

trouble_attorney.ability: Each night, choose 1 player: they gain 1 life. 1 other loses it but keeps evil abilities. Life states stay integers even if the Attorney vanishes.
trouble_attorney.otherNightReminder: The Attorney chooses after the demon/minions chose & chooses 1 player (possibly themself). Add a "life" to them. Another player loses a "life" (if they have ≥ 2 lives), else dies. Evil characters that die this way are marked "has evil abilities". When they are killed (again) by another ability or event, remove their "has evil abilities". Remove a "life" from anyone who would die, else they die. Attorney reminders remain even when the Attorney vanishes & only vanish from lethal events/attacks.

trouble_balloonatic.ability: Each night, choose 1 player who dies from the Demon if no-one did. The Demon knows who. You see the character type of each (≥ 1) Demon-killed OR are drunk tonight.
trouble_balloonatic.otherNightReminder: Before the Demon the Balloonatic chooses 1 player (dead or alive). Add the "ballooned" to this player. Inform the Demon that the Balloonatic chose the player with "ballooned" reminder. During the night, add a "Demon-killed" to each player who the Demon killed. If the Demon ends their ability without "Demon-killed" reminders, the player with "ballooned" reminder is attacked automatically. Add the "Demon-killed" if this killed the player. If still no-one got a "Demon-killed" reminder, the Balloonatic is drunk for the whole night (and gets false info). Add the "balloon-drunk" to the Balloonatic. Before dawn, wake the Balloonatic again and show them a list of character types. 1 character type for each player with "Demon-killed" reminder (in random order). If the Balloonatic is drunk, show at least one random character type. Do not tell the Balloonatic which player has which character type! Remove the "ballooned", "balloon-drunk" and "Demon-killed" s at the end of the night.
trouble_balloonatic.flavor: Such a good sight for entertaining myself in the Demon spectacle. The horizon is amazing. The people are so small, I cannot exactly see who they are but what they do.

trouble_biologist.ability: Each night, choose 1 player: You learn whether their character is either not in the Minion section, not in the Demon section, "left" or "right" in the script.
trouble_biologist.otherNightReminder: Let the Biologist choose 1 player (you may allow them to choose themself). If the player has a character in the Demon section of the script, you may give a "not minion" answer. If the character is from the minion section, you may give a "not demon" answer. Otherwise, the answer is arbitrary. Alternatively, you may answer "left" (if in the left column) or "right" (if in the right column).

trouble_blabber.ability: Each day, you may make a public game-related statement. Tonight, if it was true by registration, a player dies.
trouble_blabber.otherNightReminder: If the Blabber’s public statement is completely true about the game state with regards to the Blabber character put the "dead" in the center. At night, if it is there, choose a player not protected from dying tonight. That player dies.
trouble_blabber.flavor: Saying the Truth is not easy. And nevertheless, saying the Falsehood is more powerful.

trouble_bodyguard.ability: You start knowing the actually good VIP. You learn the Demon – who knows VIP+character – if they kill the VIP. VIP's character is declared if they die, even if you died.
trouble_bodyguard.firstNightReminder: Determine a valuable actually good Townsfolk (not the Bodyguard) or dangerous Outsider and add the "VIP" reminder to them. I.e. the VIP's actual alignment is good even if they misregister. they win Wake up the Demon. Show them the Bodyguard chose them, point at the player with "VIP" reminder and show the VIP's character. At the end of the night, wake up the Bodyguard and point to the VIP player.
trouble_bodyguard.otherNightReminder: If a new player got a Demon ability, show that the Bodyguard chose them, point at the VIP player and the VIP's character. If the player with VIP reminder was killed by the Demon, wake up the Bodyguard and point to the Demon player. After dawn, if the VIP died tonight, declare the character in addition to the VIP having died.

trouble_brainwasher.ability: Each night, choose 1 player who is drunk. You account for & remote-control their unknown abilities secretly until dusk. Evil character abilities get you poisoned.
trouble_brainwasher.otherNightReminder: Remove the current "controlled" and "control-drunk" reminder. Before other players, wake up the Brainwasher and let them point to 1 player. Prompt to choose again when the player cannot be drunk. If chosen, the player is marked with "controlled". If the player has ≥ 1 evil character ability, add the "control-drunk" reminder to the Brainwasher player. Later this night, when a player with "controlled" reminder uses their abilities, they behave as drunk except if the Brainwasher is drunk. Directly afterwards, wake up the Brainwasher and play the abilities like you would have for the controlled player (only provide the Brainwasher with input instructions, nothing else). If the Brainwasher is drunk/poisoned, it won't be effective. Sleep.

trouble_carnivalreveller.ability: Each night, choose 1 non-traveller: this character/ability swaps with their good character, else it becomes a not-in-play good character/ability.
trouble_carnivalreveller.otherNightReminder: Early at night, the Carnival Reveller points at 1 player (no public traveller). If they play a Demon or Minion character, the Carnival Reveller learns that the Carnival character (else ability) turns into a not-in-play good one, otherwise turns into the one of the chosen player who then learns to become the Carnival Reveller character. The former Carnival Reveller plays their new ability tonight if applicable.

trouble_cartographer.ability: You start knowing 1 player of the longest Townsfolk player row (ignoring Travellers).
trouble_cartographer.firstNightReminder: Add the "know" to 1 Townsfolk player from the biggest row of successive Townsfolk players. Show the Cartographer this player.

trouble_champion.ability: Once per game, publicly at day, choose 1 player: if they don't achieve (3 tries) what you show (1 try), they are drunk for the next 2 cycles.
trouble_champion.otherNightReminder: Remove any "drunk 2", replace the "drunk 1" reminder with "drunk 2". Add the "drunk 1" to a player who could not replicate in 3 attempts what the champion showed the past day. Players marked "drunk 1" or "drunk 2" are drunk.

trouble_clairvoyant.ability: Each night°, choose 1 player to disable their Jinxes until next choice. Each night, you see the number of active jinxes. You only win if the good wins. [≥ 1 active jinx]
trouble_clairvoyant.firstNightReminder: From all supported jinxes in your script, show each to the Clairvoyant whose characters and conditions the current game satisfies. If the Clairvoyant player becomes evil, indicate it with the "fake-evil". They win with the good team but are evil if they have the "fake-evil" reminder.
trouble_clairvoyant.otherNightReminder: Let the Clairvoyant choose 1 player and move the "unjinxed" to them. All jinxes whose source is a player with "unjinxed" reminder are inactive (blocked). See First Night Reminder.

trouble_clerk.ability: Each night, you learn if an alive neighbor lied about this game yesterday. Once per game, learn it for a chosen neighbour.
trouble_clerk.otherNightReminder: If you noticed that 1 alive neighbor (not a Traveller) of the Clerk has lied about the current game yesterday (not night), mark them with "Liar". If a neighbour has the "Liar" reminder, nod the head to the Clerk, otherwise shake it. Ignore a neighbour's reminder if the Clerk has no "Used" reminder & points at the other neighbour: then mark the Clerk with "Used". Remove the "Liar".

trouble_clown.ability: You start knowing 1 not-in-play evil character. If you joke about being a minion you register as evil until dawn. If you are funny today, learn 1 player next night.
trouble_clown.firstNightReminder: Out of all evil characters (demons or minion characters) who are not in play, pick one and show it to the Clown.
trouble_clown.otherNightReminder: As soon as the Clown jokes about being a minion, mark them "goofy", they register as evil even if they are actually good. On dawn, remove the "goofy". If the Clown put in effort to be funny, hilarious or joky today and has been funny to some extent, for ≥ 1 player, wake them tonight. Point to any 1 dead or alive player and show an alignment+character they have. You might show a player that the Clown already saw earlier.
trouble_clown.flavor: Wouldn't it be funny to be a psychopath?! This is my axe!

trouble_copycat.ability: A player clones state+abilities of 1 team member you choose, if you remove their last ability. They might register as dead & act on your account.
trouble_copycat.otherNightReminder: When the Copycat accounts for a death, do not add a shroud to the dead player but a "clone target" reminder. You choose whether and when the player registers and is declared as dead (they must however register as dead when they become dead). When the Copycat accounts for the loss of abilities of a player (drunkness, poisoning, death, …), add a "clone target" reminder to that player and wake up the Copycat before dawn. When you add a new "clone target" reminder, (re)move the old one. If a player turns dead when the "clone target" is removed, add a shroud. When the Copycat wakes up, point to the player and let them choose another player (including the Copycat themself). If this player has different alignment, remove any "clone target" and "clone source" reminders, adding a shroud to the previous "clone target" when they die, and sleep. Otherwise, remove any existing "clone source" reminder and add the "clone source" reminder to the chosen player. If the clone source player is dead at cloning time, the cloned target player also will die and copy the shroud (but gets the cloned character), else continues living until the clone relation ends (even if they would be dead). Sleep. (You might do all of this multiple times for multiple players in the same night, enumerating every pair of target & source.) When the "clone target" or "clone source" has changed, copy all "clone source" player state to the "clone target" player and show the new character to the clone target player. If the clone relation ends, wake up the former clone target player and show the original character.

trouble_crusader.ability: If you are mad about false game info (once), the Demon learns you & chooses your suicide. You are safe from the Demon. (You might have an outsider ability.)
trouble_crusader.firstNightReminder: You can choose any outsider ability for the Crusader, even in-play or not on the script. If applicable, wake the Crusader and tell them the outsider ability.
trouble_crusader.otherNightReminder: If the Crusader deliberately (or unknowingly) spread false game information in a convincing way, add the "liar" reminder to the Crusader player (remove the reminder when the Crusader debunked it or acknowledged the mistake sincerely). At dawn, if the Crusader has the "liar" reminder, wake up the Demon. Point to the Crusader, show the Crusador character, and let them choose "yes" or "no". If the demon chooses "yes", the Crusader commits suicide and everybody learns their additional death at dawn.

trouble_demographer.ability: Each day, you learn 1 personal info (e.g. age, birth, preference) of 1 evil player OR the sum for alive evil players. (Evil players might know you are in play.)
trouble_demographer.otherNightReminder: At day, tell the Demographer a personal info (.e.g. gender, birthday season, a quote or reaction to an utterance) of 1 alive/dead evil player with a text note, else the sum of ages or another detail of alive evil players. It includes travellers. (You may ask the evil player(s) before or at the night.)

trouble_detective.ability: Each night, choose 1 other alive player. Each time after they woke, you wake to learn all info or signals they learnt.
trouble_detective.otherNightReminder: Before other characters, the Detective wakes up. They choose one player which can be marked with "tailed". Sleep. Everytime, a player wakes up who is marked with "tailed", do not immediately send out the ability signals. Memorize what you show. After you put them to sleep. Immediately wake up the Detective and replay the info and signals that you showed before. Don't show any actions or choices that the tailed player made. If the night action does not contain story teller info or signals, just make them sleep again after waking them up. Sleep.

trouble_dowser.ability: Each night, choose 1 alive player: learn whether they are the [left or right] end of a good player row or opposite end of an evil player row.
trouble_dowser.firstNightReminder: When starting the game, choose which end of the good player row to indicate, as either clockwise (add the "CW" ) or counterclockwise (add the "CCW":reminder.). This does not change over the game. Rest: See Other Night Reminder.
trouble_dowser.otherNightReminder: Let the Dowser point at 1 alive player (including themself) and nod the head (yes) or shake the head (no).

trouble_drugpusher.ability: Each night, choose 1 player who: becomes drugged until next dusk & earns +1 vote token if dead.
trouble_drugpusher.otherNightReminder: Remove the current "drugged" reminder. Wake up the Drug Pusher and let them point at 1 player. Mark this player with "drugged" in the grimoire. If this player is dead, give them one more vote token. Sleep. You either wake the chosen player to tell them about the update or declare their new Vote Token publicly. During the entire next day, any player marked with "drugged" will be ignored in the count when they vote.
trouble_drugpusher.flavor: Your highness, see what this plant can do? This is what should have been called extended reality. It augments your spirit.

trouble_faustian.ability: Each night, you guess character and/or good alignment of 1 alive player. If right, their death – else your death – replaces 1 Demon choice & you account for it.
trouble_faustian.otherNightReminder: The Faustian points to 1 player and a character on their sheet and/or gives a "good" signal (no "evil" signal). If correct, add the "Kill" to the player. If wrong, add the "Kill" to the Faustian. Later, show the Demon: the Faustian chose the player(s) with "Kill" reminder. Then, if the Demon chooses the Faustian with their ability, the Demon ability bypasses the Faustian. Otherwise, if the player with "Kill" reminder would die by the Demon's choice, this player automatically gets 1 choice of the Demon and the Faustian accounts for choosing this player (no Demon-kill effects). Before dawn, remove the "Kill" s. The Faustian affects themself if they also have a Demon ability.

jinxes.reason: If the Demon gets the Faustian ability due to the Boffin, a Minion becomes the Demon if the Faustian ability leads to a self-kill.
The Faustian acts on both Twin Demons independently.
The Faustian overrides 1 target of the Maniac if that target would not die this way.

trouble_faustian.flavor: Here, Mephistophilis, receive this scroll, A deed of gift of body and of soul: But yet conditionally that thou perform All articles prescrib'd between us both. (Goethe's Faust)

trouble_forensic.ability: Each night, learn the characters of lethal nominators & choose 1 player to learn what character attacks them tonight. Only the character type of your info is correct.
trouble_forensic.otherNightReminder: The Forensic learns characters which are false except for the character type. At dawn, remove any "killed by"/"executer" reminders. At day, add the "executer" to the player(s) whose nomination led to a deadly execution. At night, add "attacked by" s to all attacked/killed players. Before dawn, the Forensic gets to know all characters of players with "executer" reminder. Remove the "executer" s. Also let the Forensic choose 1 player. If the chosen player has an "attacked by" reminder, show the accountable player's character to the Forensic.

trouble_frankenstein.ability: Each second day & night, you covertly register as dead to all characters. This ability is sober+healthy.
trouble_frankenstein.firstNightReminder: Choose whether the Frankenstein registers as alive or dead at night 1. If they register as dead, add the "dead" reminder to the player in the grimoire.
trouble_frankenstein.otherNightReminder: If Frankenstein registered as alive last night, they register as dead this night (add the "dead" reminder to the player), else they register as alive (remove the "dead" reminder from the player).

trouble_genie.ability: Once per game, you can make a public wish (≤ 2 predicates, no "AND" connectives, no grimoire, no public confirmability). It might have arbitrary trade offs.
trouble_genie.otherNightReminder: At day, if the Genie has no "used" reminder and makes a public wish, add the "used" reminder to the Genie. Examine if the wish is wellformed. It must have ≤ 2 predicates, no AND-connection, no recursion, no grimoire interaction, no public revealations, no extra wishes. Any foreign witnesses should be(come) evil. The story teller may deceive the public (temporarily) to allow for bluffing. All (excpet 1) alternatives of an "OR" connection are discared. Reflect which trade offs are needed, in order to restrict the power as appropriate for a good ability.

trouble_gourmet.ability: Each night, choose 1 player and learn whether their actual ability is good+well-functioning or evil+abnormally working. You are sober.
trouble_gourmet.otherNightReminder: Let the Gourmet point at 1 player. If that player has a good well-functioning ability or an evil abnormally-working ability, then show a "yes". Else show a "no". The Gourmet ignores false registration.

trouble_hairdresser.ability: You start knowing 2 counts: (fe)male & not (fe)male evil non-travellers. 1 of both is false. (Other nights, choose 1 character: learn a sex not of them.)
trouble_hairdresser.firstNightReminder: Define the players' publicly known in-game gender/sex before night 1. Choose male or female or none. (Don't change during game!) Count the number of evil-registering players with and without 1 gender. Ignore travellers. Add a little non-zero integer to one of the counts. Wake up the Hairdresser: show the two numbers + the gender. 1st the positive, 2nd the negative criterion.
trouble_hairdresser.otherNightReminder: Let the Hairdresser choose a character: show "not male" or "not female" for this character (or any if not in play).

trouble_imbecile.ability: You are a Townsfolk that wakes at night. You learn your character on death. [? Imbeciles]
trouble_imbecile.firstNightReminder: For any imbecile player, choose a townsfolk character from your prepared setup and put it next to the "imbecile" character token. Later, let them use their character's ability at night, if applicable. You may give instructions how to act (what to choose, if anything). If a once-per-game ability, ask whether they want to use it now and give instructions if yes.
trouble_imbecile.otherNightReminder: Let the Imbecile use their ability at night when they can or have to. You may also give instructions how to act (what to choose, if anything). When their character changes, remove the imbecile character and show them the new character.

jinxes.reason: The Imbecile might have the Atheist ability.

trouble_instigator.ability: On night/day X, your X-th neighbour (clockwise AND counterclockwise) is deranged.
trouble_instigator.firstNightReminder: Add the "instigated" reminder to the (dead or alive) player to the left and to the right of the Instigator. From now on, the instigated players are deranged until next dusk. Optional: only make one player deranged. Add the reminder "CW" (clockwise only) or "CCW" (counterclockwise only) reminder.
trouble_instigator.otherNightReminder: At dusk, move the "instigated" reminder to the X-th clockwise and counterclockwise (dead or alive) neighbour of the Instigator. The instigated players are deranged until next dusk. Optional: only make one player deranged, clockwise if "CW" reminder is set, counterclockwise if "CCW" is set.

trouble_kindergardener.ability: Each night, choose someone: if they die in this cycle, the next night's 2nd, 3rd,… victim doesn't die & get sick with you. Get 1 info for each of them, even if sick.
trouble_kindergardener.otherNightReminder: At dusk, if the Kindergardener has no "protection" reminder, remove all "Kinder-sick" s. If the Kindergardener has the "protection" reminder tonight, add the "Kinder-sick" reminder to each player who otherwise would have died tonight after the first dying player. If a "Kinder-sick" reminder is added to a player, the player does not die & 1 "Kinder-sick" is added to the Kindergardener (if not already present). Players with "Kinder-sick" reminder have the sick state (they don't wake up for their abilities and cannot nominate). Now, if the Kindergardener has no "Kinder-sick" reminder, let them choose 1 player. Add the "child" to that player. If the player with "child" reminder has died or dies tonight or the next day, then add the "protection" to the Kindergardener. If the Kindergardener has the "Kinder-sick" reminder, give them 1 info signal (character, character type, alignment, player or player state) for each other player with "Kinder-sick" reminder. Don't tell which signal is associated to which player (except when the signal is the player). Remove the "protection" afterwards.

trouble_logician.ability: Each night, you see 1 player different from last night. All seen players have something in common at the time of seeing them.
trouble_logician.firstNightReminder: Find a common game-related property that at least 2 players should have in this game. Show the first player to the Logician tonight.
trouble_logician.otherNightReminder: Show another player to the Logician who satisfies the same game state condition as the previously seen players at their corresponding night.

trouble_maniac.ability: You think to be a Demon, register as Demon & have a deranged Demon ability. The Demon knows your character & who you choose.
trouble_maniac.firstNightReminder: Choose a demon character for the Maniac and put it into the bag for the Maniac to draw. The Maniac gets Demon info. All info of the Maniac is strictly false. During the Demon info of the real Demon, show them what Demon character the Maniac has. (Don't show the player!!)
trouble_maniac.otherNightReminder: Play the deranged Demon ability of the Maniac. Add a "maniac-ed" to each player the Maniac chooses. A deranged ability changes player states in the opposite way. E.g. instead of killing players, the Maniac might protect them from 1 kill, add 1 life, resurrect 1, etc. Instead of poisoning players, they would be protected against 1 source of poisoning for some time. Inform the Demon about the players with "maniac-ed" reminder. Later tonight, remove all "maniac-ed" s.

trouble_mentalist.ability: Each night, learn 1 player. If you answer a statement/question about them right, get their ability, if wrong, a drunk ability. (They might know you are in play.)
trouble_mentalist.firstNightReminder: Select question(s) and statement(s) that you want to use during the game, as well as answer options. See Almanac for ideas. Mark 1 player with "minded", wake the Mentalist, point to this player. At day, ask the player marked "minded" about a question/statement, find additional answer options and a drunk ability in case of a false guess. Mark them with "answered".
trouble_mentalist.otherNightReminder: Show the Mentalist the player with "answered" reminder. Move the "minded" to a new player. Tonight (or today, if visiting you), if the Mentalist guesses the right answer, they get & learn the ability of the seen player. Else they get & learn an arbitrary drunk ability. Remove the "answered" and move the "guessed" to the obtained ability's character token. Turn "guessed" upside down for a wrong answer. Decorate a character with the "drunk" to denote the Mentalist's drunk ability.

trouble_model.ability: If you are paralyzed until you guess all Townsfolk players' characters, your team wins or until you die at night (before guessing), choose a Townsfolk to become.
trouble_model.firstNightReminder: Add the "paralyzed" reminder to the Model player.
trouble_model.otherNightReminder: When the Model violated the paralyzed condition in the last day, remove the paralyzed reminder. At day, if the Model guesses the characters of all Townsfolk, mark them with "guess". If the "paralyzed" reminder is still set AND the model guessed all players correctly, end the game: declare that good wins. If the "paralyzed" but no "guess" reminder is set and if the Model dies tonight, wake them and let them choose any Townsfolk character from the script or any official Townsfolk character. They may choose their character at day, if they like.

trouble_muezzin.ability: At most 1 player of your team (not yourself) can have drunk or poisoned abilities per night or day.
trouble_muezzin.otherNightReminder: If a 2nd player of the Muezzin's team would have or use a drunk or poisoned ability while already 1 player has one, break the rules in favour of the disadvantaged team or the team of the Muezzin (ideally using the smallest change) such that only 1 player of the Muezzin's team has or uses drunk or poisoned abilities during the whole day or whole night. The Muezzin cannot get drunk (but poisoned).

trouble_mummer.ability: Each night, if you were muted yesterday, you may choose 1 character & learn whether it is in play. If not in play, the demon learns who you are.
trouble_mummer.firstNightReminder: Let the Mummer choose 1 character and give them "yes" if it is in play, else a "no". Sleep. At the same night, when you showed a "no", wake up the demon and tell that this player is the Mummer.
trouble_mummer.otherNightReminder: When the Mummer is marked as "muted", allow them to evaluate one character (see First Night Reminder). At dawn, add the "muted" reminder. At day, remove the "muted" reminder when the player violates the muted condition.

trouble_murderer.ability: You start knowing a game-related condition. Once per game, anytime, if you attempt to satisfy this condition towards 1 player & succeed, they or you are assasinated.
trouble_murderer.firstNightReminder: Invent a kill condition towards 1 player for the Murderer that fits to your setup. Tell the Murderer this condition before the game or in their first night. Note down the condition in your Grimoire.
trouble_murderer.otherNightReminder: Anytime at day or night, during the game, the Murderer may attempt to satisfy their murder condition by acting towards 1 player according to it. If this happened and the targeted player satisfies the murder condition, the targeted player OR the Murderer is assassinated (i.e. they die even if protected). If assassination is not possible, the attempt is ignored. If this happens at night, the death is only declared at dawn with all the other deaths. If it happens too late in the night, other abilities who get information from deaths might not benefit from the effects of your kill.

trouble_mute.ability: If you are muted until the final day or until half the alive players are evil, once, you learn 1 alive evil player & the demon character.
trouble_mute.firstNightReminder: Mark the Mute with "muted". If the game starts with a greater-equal number of evil players, trigger the reward of the Mute unless the Mute is not alive at dawn.
trouble_mute.otherNightReminder: Observe the Mute player at day in semi- or public situations. If they violate the muted condition, remove "muted". (You might penalize this event additionally.) Later, at dawn, if the Mute lives AND there is the "muted" reminder AND it's the night before the final day or the greater-equal half of alive players is evil, wake the Mute, point to 1 alive evil player, show the player's character and then show the demon's character.

trouble_necrophage.ability: Each night, choose 1 player. You learn if their public AND covert life state registers correctly.
trouble_necrophage.otherNightReminder: Let the Necrophage choose a player (including themself). If this player's life state may or might register differently in different contexts/game rules, give a "no" answer, else a "yes" answer.

trouble_paranoid.ability: You start knowing whether a poison ability is in play. At night ≥ 2, you become drunk/poisoned/sober/healthy only at dawn and learn this in the night.
trouble_paranoid.firstNightReminder: (Optional: Wake the Paranoid and show them that their info concerns a specific player state. Add a reminder "knows ‹player state›" to the Paranoid. They only get info regarding this player state, not poisoning/drunkness.) Before dawn, show them "yes" or "no" regarding any poisoning (≠ drunkness) ability to be in play. If the paranoid is not poisoned/drunk by now, they may get false info.
