trouble_neurex.firstNightReminder: Wake each minion and show them, that the Neurex chose them and the 3 bluffs that the Neurex will see tonight. Rest: See Other Night Reminder.
trouble_neurex.otherNightReminder: If a player has the "neuro stroke" reminder, they die. In this case, remove the "neuro stroke". Before the Minions wake, let the Neurex choose 1 player and optionally a question that should be transmitted. Add the "neuro stroke" to that player. Inform the Minions that the player with "neuro stroke" reminder was chosen by the Neurex. Now ask the player this question. If the player answered correctly, remove the "neuro stroke". Then, wake the Neurex and replay the given answer. Next, let the Neurex choose 1 player again and record the message of the Neurex (or use it from the previous day). Add the "neuro transfer" reminder to them. Inform all Minions that the Neurex chose the player with "neuro transfer" reminder. When the player with "neuro transfer" wakes, replace ability-related info or signals with corresponding or converted message signals. You may adjust the message such that it fits to the ability. It completely overwrites the ability's info. If the player with "neuro transfer" reminder would not wake, they do so at some point, possibly before the night ends. If the message receiving player goes to sleep, remove the "neuro transfer".

trouble_ouroboros.ability: Each night, choose 2 players. The 1st player (if good) gets registered properties & state of the 2nd ("Demon kill"), else gets it as extra character until dusk. [+1 Outsider]
trouble_ouroboros.otherNightReminder: Let Ouroboros choose 2 players. If the first player registers as good: Copy the character of the 2nd player (as they register to the Ouroboros) to the 1st player. If the 2nd player is dead, they register as Farmer. Then trigger a demon kill on the 1st player. Finally, copy the registering state of the 2nd player to the 1st player. (I.e. if and only if the 2nd player registers as alive, dead, drunk, poisoned, etc. so the 1st player turns into it, indefinitely.) You may add "‹state›" s to the 1st player. Else if the 1st player registers as evil: the registering character of the 2nd player is added to the 1st player until dusk. You may add a "‹character›" or 2nd character token to the 1st player.

trouble_pandemon.ability: Each night, choose a player to kill & learn 1 character detecting you. Has all poisoned minion characters (arbitrarily registers as minion/demon). You can't be good. [poisoned minions; only townsfolk bluffs]
trouble_pandemon.firstNightReminder: Remember: all minion characters are poisoned & Pandemon has all poisoned minion characters as well. Give Pandemon only townsfolk bluffs, no outsiders. Immediately after a poisoned minion ability has been used, wake Pandemon, show the Minion ability (character token) and let them act accordingly or give them info. Pandemon registers as any of the characters they have to evade detection and death due to other abilities.
trouble_pandemon.otherNightReminder: Wake Pandemon to kill. Sleep. At night, whenever a poisoned (not just drunk) minion has used or would use their ability (but cannot because of their state), wake Pandemon, show the minion ability (character token) and let them act according to it or give info. Sleep. Pandemon has all poisoned minion characters, i.e. Pandemon registers as any of their characters to any ability/rule (arbitrarily) such that it helps Pandemon's longevity (each time at night and day, you analyse and decide what helps them more to not die! It's about life, not winning!) See, if any good character was affected or detected by Pandemon's evil alignment, character(s) or character type(s) (even partially, like an Empath getting a 1). If so, before ending the night, wake Pandemon and tell them 1 good character, not the player! Pandemon cannot be, become or register as good, no matter what.
trouble_pandemon.flavor: I am all evil, even to the evil.

trouble_satan.ability: Each night, choose 2 players: seeing the other as evil, they betray or trust. Betraying kills & gets the seen character to be in-play. Trusting shows a good character. ≥1 good dies on equal choice.
trouble_satan.otherNightReminder: Let the Satan choose 2 players. Each player wakes, sees that Satan chose them, sees the other player and an evil character. Now, they choose "betray" or "trust". If they choose "trust", they see a good character which is the other player's character if they have a good character. If they choose "betray", the other player will die tonight. If the shown evil character is not yet in play, 1 player turns into it and gets evil alignment. This should be the betraying player except if +2 evil (and dead) players are already in play. If both players choose "trust", 1 good player dies (one among the chosen players if applicable). If both chosen players are evil, the demon-killed good player should have no benefit for the evil team.

trouble_shredder.ability: Minions also are Samurai. Each night, choose 1 player to kill with your Samurai. If your Samurai don't kill tonight, your chosen player is assassinated. [+1 Outsider]
trouble_shredder.firstNightReminder: Add the "Samurai" reminder to each minion player. (Remove the reminder when they lose their minion ability, e.g. on death.) Replace 1 Townsfolk with 1 Outsider in the setup.
trouble_shredder.otherNightReminder: Wake up the Shredder and let them choose 1 player who would be a valid choice for an Assassin player. Add the "Shredder kill" reminder to that player. After that, wake up all evil players with Samurai reminder. Let each choose 1 player. If the chosen player registers as Outsider to the choosing player, increase the chosen player's count (which is initialized to 0 each dusk). Finally, if there is exactly one player with highest count greater zero, this player dies (add a shroud, etc.). If no chosen player would die (either because no-one is attacked or the target is protected), the player with "Shredder kill" reminder dies as if an Assassin is used. After that, reset all the counts to zero and wake up all good Samurai and repeat the process for them.

trouble_steelfzkin.ability: Each night, choose 1 player to kill. Ballots ignore the deads. Good players only kill you if they agree to guess you as Demon today making dusk follow. You register as other Demon.
trouble_steelfzkin.otherNightReminder: Let the Steelfzkin choose 1 player to kill. No dead player (except for an anti Bipartisan) can participate in any ballots. This might include exile ballots. Any good players' actions that would kill the Steelfzkin do not succeed. During nominations, players may call for guessing 1 player as Demon (if that call was not made already today). Even though dead players cannot vote for it, they might call for a guess or you might reject the call. After a valid call, let them discuss. Cast a ballot if everyone is ready. The guess is accepted only if the ballot succeeds which happens if: the majority of (good or evil) participants or all good participants expressed support AND ≥ 1 good alive player supported the ballot. If no good players can participate anymore in ballots for Demon guesses, the game ends. If a guess is accepted for the Steelfzkin player, then Steelfzkin must die. The guess can only be accepted, if it doesn't target the Steelfzkin player while they cannot die at day. If the target player of an accepted guess is the Steelfzkin, they die and are declared to die. No execution happens after an accepted guess. The day phase ends after an accepted guess without any more nominations and executions.

trouble_titan.ability: On your 1st night, choose a Demon. Each night, choose 1 player to kill with minions. If good loses majority, you & alive Townsfolk choose a Demon & you choose Minions for evil players. The team whose (≥ 1) Demons died, loses. [+1 outsider]
trouble_titan.firstNightReminder: Let the Titan choose a Demon character that is added. You may add a "‹Demon›" to the Titan player in the Grimoire. This (new) public character determines the Titan's registration but does not suppress the Titan ability.
trouble_titan.otherNightReminder: Wake each minion to choose at most 1 player (individually). Then wake the Titan and choose 1 player. Among the most chosen players, you choose the 1 that is killed (you may help the evil team). At dusk, if the number of alive good players has become less or equal to the number of alive evil players, wake all Townsfolk players, inform them that the Titan chose them, and let them choose a Demon character to turn into. The Demon character may only kill by pointing to players or automatically AND may not be able to see characters of alive players. If the constraints are not satisfied, prompt them to choose again. Then wake the Titan and let them choose a final Demon character as public character to become. Also let the Titan point at players and a Minion character. If the pointed player is evil and no player has this Minion character at the moment, the pointed player (dead or alive) turns into the chosen Minion character (even if this player chose a Demon shortly before). If both teams have at least 1 Demon, the game ends, if all Demons of one team are dead. The winner is the team who has ≥ 1 Demon left alive. In all other cases, the regular winning rules apply (evil wins if ≥ 1 Demon of any alignment is alive at game end).

trouble_tormon.ability: Each night, choose 2 alive characters & 1 other person who: chooses to kill 1 of those characters else is killed with 1 of them.
trouble_tormon.otherNightReminder: Wake this demon and show them a list of registered characters of which alive-registering players. Let them choose 2 different ones and choose 1 dead or alive player to be tormented (not themself). Sleep. Wake the tormented player (if applicable), signal to them that they were chosen by the Tormon and what 2 characters (possibly their own included) which they need to choose between. Then count down your fingers from 4 to 0 (at least 4 seconds). When the tormented player chooses before 0, the player of the chosen character is attacked and the tormented player accounts for it. Else when 0 is reached, the tormented player is attacked and the story teller chooses what character player also dies (the better choice for the good team). Tormon accounts for both kills (counting as Demon kills). Sleep.

trouble_twindemon.ability: Each night, choose 1 player who dies else resurrects. Your abilities don't kill you. If you are executed deadly, your team must lose. [+1 Twin Demon]
trouble_twindemon.firstNightReminder: Choose a good character player to get the Twin Demon ability and a good or evil alignment (both of which they get to know). This additional player wakes up directly before or after the original Twin Demon and acts simultaneously with the original Twin Demon player.
trouble_twindemon.otherNightReminder: Let both Twin Demons choose 1 player (but not themself). If they choose the same player (even if both choose the same Twin Demon), nothing happens. Each of them kills the chosen player if the player is alive or resurrects the player if the player is dead. Each Twin Demon cannot kill themself using any of their abilities (including a Boffin ability). At day, if you are executed deadly, your team loses (even if the other Demon lives, even if the other team would have won). If both demons have died without execution, good wins.

trouble_warmonger.ability: On night ≥ 3, choose 1 player. From this player to inclusively the closest alive evil player, all players die. You cannot kill yourself.
trouble_warmonger.firstNightReminder: You might use the Loric Gardener to balance the game.
trouble_warmonger.otherNightReminder: Let the Warmonger choose 1 player (dead or alive). Determine the closest evil player (considering only alive players). Start by killing the chosen player then continue to kill the next player towards the next alive evil player until finally the next alive evil player is killed. Ignore all dead players (they are not killed again). If the alive evil player is the Warmonger themself, then they do not die and only good players do.

trouble_ambivalent.ability: You use 2 distinct characters: one at day, one at night. You know which. Your alignment is of the night character. At day, you register as your day character. [You are of any 1 character type]
trouble_ambivalent.firstNightReminder: Choose a day character and a night character for the Ambivalent. The night character's alignment must fit to the alignment of the Traveller. Rest: See Other Night Reminder.
trouble_ambivalent.otherNightReminder: Play the night ability of the Ambivalent at the correct night order time of their ability, if applicable.

trouble_careworker.ability: Each night, you get 1 answer about the most passive (if good) or most active (if evil) alive player and prevent (if good) or cause (if evil) ability malfunction to them.
trouble_careworker.otherNightReminder: If the Careworker is good, move the "patient" to the most passive alive player yesterday (or during last nominations). Else, if evil, move the "patient" to the most active alive player. At dusk, wake the Care Worker to show their request or prompt (using text message or arranged gestures) for 1 info signal about the player with "patient" reminder. Only respond with either 1 signal, 1 character token or 1 pointed player. At night, the patient player is protected from added impairments if the Care Worker is good. Else if evil, ≥ 1 thing about the patient's ability works falsely (different from normally).

trouble_censor.ability: Each night, choose 1 player. If they violate the muted condition during next day, they get unconscious from then on.
trouble_censor.otherNightReminder: Remove the "muted". Let the Censor choose 1 player. Add the "muted" to this player. Next day, inform this player that they were chosen by the Censor (getting unconscious when they violate the muted condition). If this player communicates publicly about game-related things including saying commands to others, calls for ballots or using their ability, then this player gets unconscious from now on. Add an "unconscious" to this player. The communication is public when everyone has officially gathered around (even if not listening) or when it happens outside of talks of 2 or 3 players.

trouble_crackjack.ability: Each day, choose a player: a different player changes character (but not character type) tonight.
trouble_crackjack.otherNightReminder: At day, let Cacklejack choose a player. Add the NOT ME to them. Tonight, replace any 1 player’s character token with a different character token of the same type. Show the player the YOU ARE info token & their new character. If a traveller, you might declare the character next day.

trouble_doubleagent.ability: You are hidden & have a principal of opposite alignment. You get captive when they want. If you are most responsible for their team to lose, you lose with them, even if dead. [You might be Townsfolk/Minion]
trouble_doubleagent.firstNightReminder: Secretly add the Double Agent to the setup (counting as Townsfolk, Traveller or rarely Minion). Choose a principal player of the opposite team & add the "principal" to them. Give the good Double Agent a not-in-play Townsfolk, the evil Double Agent a not-in-play Minion. Wake the Double Agent and show their principal player. Wake the principal player and show that a player is their Double Agent. Both might wake up to see each other. Rest: See Other NIght Reminder.
trouble_doubleagent.otherNightReminder: If the Double Agent has an ability, let them use this ability at the proper time. If you notice that the principal wishes to make the Double Agent captive, immediately do that. If you are notified or notice that the Double Agent is mainly responsible for the lose of the principal's team, make the Double Agent lose, no matter their alignment or player state.

trouble_guardian.ability: Once per game, at night ≥ 2, choose a player. Any events or state effects that others inflict on them, happen to you instead. Their execution turns into your exile.
trouble_guardian.otherNightReminder: If there is no player with "guarded" reminder, let the Guardian choose 1 player. If they do, add the "guarded" to that player. Any events or effects, such as being poisoned, drugged, getting deranged, cursed (by a wish), protected, getting exiled or killed, changing properties (such as character or alignment), etc. happen to you but not to them. If the player with "guarded" reminder would be executed, the Guardian is exiled instead.

trouble_juror.ability: Once per day, you may decide 1 nomination's penalty with a duel minigame. If the nominator loses, the nominee would not die but suspend the game 1 cycle.
trouble_juror.otherNightReminder: Remove any "suspend" at dusk. If the nominator of the executee yesterday lost the Juror's duel minigame, add the "suspend" to the executee. Players marked "suspend" have their abilities but cannot act & cannot change state.

trouble_petrifier.ability: Each night, choose 1 player. If they violate the paralyzed condition during next day, they get unconscious from then on.
trouble_petrifier.otherNightReminder: Remove the "paralyzed". Let the Petrifier choose 1 player. Add the "paralyzed" to this player. Next day, inform the player about being chosen by the Petrifier (getting unconscious when not satisfying the paralyzed condition). If this player communicates outside of public spaces about game-related things (including calls for ballots and using the ability), they get unconscious until the end of the game. Add an "unconscious" to this player. (You explain whether this might involve attending private talks even when only listening.) Getting private story teller help is allowed for the paralyzed condition.

trouble_prevaricator.ability: You globally invert the success of specific player state transitions. You know which. All players know which when you die. You might be hidden + a Townsfolk/Minion.
trouble_prevaricator.firstNightReminder: Choose a player state transition for the Traveller. Wake the Traveller and show them the player state transition whose success is inverted. Note down the transition in the grimoire. The states at setup time or at the first dusk are not affected. If you want to protect the Traveller from being killed early, give them a Townsfolk ability (if good) or a Minion ability (if evil) and treat the Prevaricator as a Townsfolk or Minion for various game aspects as you see fit (e.g. you might declare the Traveller character but not the player or replace a setup townsfolk or minion with the Traveller and give them true Minion info). Rest: See Other Night Reminder.
trouble_prevaricator.otherNightReminder: If the Prevaricator has an ability, let them use this ability at the proper time. Whenever a player state transition would happen during the game that coincides with the transition of a Prevaricator, this transition is suppressed, if it would have succeeded, and the transition succeeds, if it would have been suppressed. The Prevaricator has no effect on player state while no transition is triggered. The Prevaricator is always exiled, not executed. When the Prevaricator dies, declare the player state transitions which have been inverted by this Traveller, if it was not declared already.

trouble_putschist.ability: The Story Teller chooses 1 player. If they die, they quit from now on & displace the Story Teller who chooses again. New Story Tellers can be exiled. Then your team loses.
trouble_putschist.firstNightReminder: Choose 1 suitable player (no Traveller) whose alignment is difficult to confirm and often of the same team as the Putschist. Add the "ruler" reminder to the chosen player. Rest: See Other Night Reminder.
trouble_putschist.otherNightReminder: When the player with "ruler" reminder dies, remove the "ruler" reminder and that player also quits the game (remove the token, they get no Vote Token) and becomes the new Story Teller. Displaced Story Tellers don't revert to players and may not disclose any game info until they are players again. The replacement happens at dawn. Before that, choose another player (like the first time). If the Putschist dies, the original and current Story Teller decide who continues or let the remaining players have a ballot for continuing with the original Story Teller (like an exile ballot). New Story Tellers can be nominated for exile (like a Traveller), but 1 member of each team must support it. If the Story Teller is exiled, the team of the exiled Story Teller loses. Replaced Story Tellers lose Alignment. If a ballot succeeds for a former Story Teller they may receive the penality as specified by the nominator and if exiled, they lose alone and the game continues.

trouble_sleepwalker.ability: Once per game at night ≥ 2, get to know which players wake up until dawn. You learn if you see ± 1 players.
trouble_sleepwalker.otherNightReminder: At the start of the night, wake up the Sleepwalker if they don't have the "used" reminder. If they nod "yes", add a "wakeup" reminder to any player who wakes up during the night. Before ending the night, wake up the Sleepwalker, show all players who have the "wakeup" reminder. Then remove all "wakup" reminders and add the "used" reminder to the Sleepwalker.

trouble_spellcaster.ability: Each night (not the last), you (might) specify state, property or action effects on nominators, nominees or all non-travellers of every nomination until next dawn.
trouble_spellcaster.otherNightReminder: Get the Spellcaster's wish (in text at night or orally at day). The wish takes effect after the ballot of every valid nomination on the next day. The wish may only concern all nominators, all nominees or all non-travellers (and optionally: all nominees or nominators with successful ballots or failed ones) The wish lasts until the dawn after the nominations. Then all triggered effects by the Spellcaster's wish are rolled back. You might declare the wish at dawn before nominations. You might declare effects explicitly that happen after each nomination. You should declare the wish or the effects, if the wish needs balancing, may affect the end or winning condition (e.g. when players are killed or change alignment) or is dangerous. Invalid nomination/ballots don't trigger spell effects. Wishes cannot directly change ending/winning/losing the game, They cannot alter/break/suppress nominating, executing, ballot success and default effects of these events. The wish cannot reveal private knowledge (i.e. cannot be conditional to properties/state). The wish becomes effectless as soon as it is exploited and violates the constraints. The wish can be reinterpreted to only affect registration towards certain rules/abilities. Ignore wishes that cannot be balanced.

trouble_suppressor.ability: Each night, choose 2 players. The first nomination of any of them fails the ballot.
trouble_suppressor.otherNightReminder: Let the Suppressor choose 2 players. Add the "suppressed" to each of these. At day, if any player with "suppressed" reminder nominates, remove the "suppressed" s and let the ballot fail even if the ballot would succeed. At dusk, remove any "suppressed" s again.

trouble_timeeater.ability: Each night, at dusk you might decide to skip the night, or at dawn you might decide to skip the day.
trouble_timeeater.otherNightReminder: If the Time Eater may eat this night, immediately after you start the night, wake the Time Eater and let them say "yes" or "no". If the Time Eater says "yes", the night suppresses all its effects. End the night without playing any ability. If the Time Eater says "no", continue regularly. If the Time Eater may eat this day, wake them directly before the night ends (at dawn).

trouble_travelagent.ability: Each night, choose 1 player (even Travellers): they quit the game until the next dusk where ≥ 5 non-Travellers live. You can quit ≤ 1 person at the same time.
trouble_travelagent.otherNightReminder: If no person has the "travel" reminder, let them choose a player (even themself or Travellers). This person quits the game. Add the "travel" reminder to the quit person's token. If quitting would end the game, the game continues and all quit persons rejoin. You might declare the quitting at dawn. They don't count as player anymore. They rejoin at dusk if they are ready and if there are at least 5 other alive non-traveller players. Then remove the "travel" reminder.

trouble_vice.ability: At least once each night, you choose in place of the story teller. You are hidden. You register as being a Townsfolk or Minion.
trouble_vice.firstNightReminder: Secretly add the Vice Traveller to the setup. (When declaring the numbers, you might treat the Vice as Townsfolk, Minion or Traveller.) Treat the Vice as a Traveller regarding Minion/Demon info (i.e. the evil Vice only gets to know the Demon but evil players don't know the Vice). Rest: See Other Night Reminder
trouble_vice.otherNightReminder: If the Vice has an ability, let them use this ability at the proper time. If this is the last choice that you as story teller will decide by yourself and the Vice player has no reminder "chose", then wake up the Vice player and make them choose for you. You might wake up the Vice earlier in the night to choose for you or if they have the "chose" reminder already. At dawn, remove the "chose" reminder.

trouble_alien.ability: The character of a Traveller might not be declared.

trouble_apatheist.ability: Players (not outsiders) can choose without constraint. The story teller does the rest to fit the selection to the game's requirements.

trouble_collaborator.ability: On wakeup, players with minion or demon abilities might get a hint on request (also if drunk) showing ≥ 1 balanced choice. Players still decide on their own.

trouble_croupier.ability: Each story teller choice is decided by a dice. The story teller balances the game by deciding probabilities for each ability and moment.
trouble_croupier.firstNightReminder: It is strongly recommended to think about which probabilities you want to use for which ability in the game before you add the Fabled Croupier. Otherwise, it can quickly lead to horribly unbalanced game that is mainly decided by luck.

trouble_fairplayer.ability: Players die who insult, harass or libel others. Players lose who maliciously hurt or make others cry or disobey game rules. Nominations or kills may not have personal reasons.

trouble_fantasist.ability: ≤ 3 non-script non-demon characters might turn up during the game.
trouble_fantasist.firstNightReminder: You may only add non-script evil characters to the setup, if an ability learns this character at night.

trouble_illusionist.ability: All players (& only those players) who raise their hands at dusk – when everyone sleeps – wake at night. Players may have unknown night abilities.
trouble_illusionist.firstNightReminder: Add the "hidden ‹character›" to players who (should) have a hidden night ability that they don't start knowing. See Other Night Reminder.
trouble_illusionist.otherNightReminder: At dusk (before abilities are played), ask everyone to raise their hands who wants to wake at night. Add a "wake" to every player who raises their hands. Ask them to lower their hands again. Now, wake players if and only if they have a "wake" reminder in the Grimoire. When you finished playing all abilities of a player (which happens iff. they have a "wake" reminder), remove the "wake" from them. Players who would normally wake but don't wake tonight, skip their ability this night. Players who would normally not wake but wake tonight, wake at a random point & get or see random stuff at night (without meaning). Only players who raised their hand register as waking up tonight (to any abilities). (Optionally: You may remove the "wake" every time of waking a player and ask again later who wants to wake up, possibly again.) If you cannot use the Grimoire, you may ask players repeatedly to raise their hands for waking up.

trouble_platitudinarian.ability: Whenever a player says a platitude (commonplace phrase) something bad might happen at this/next day/night.
trouble_platitudinarian.otherNightReminder: Count the platitudes that you have witnessed. For each platitude you might choose a consequence to happen. See Almanac for ideas.
trouble_platitudinarian.flavor: Merry Christmas, Happy Easter and New Year too!

trouble_probationer.ability: 1 evil townsfolk/outsider turns good when someone else turns evil.
trouble_probationer.otherNightReminder: If a player turns evil (e.g. when the old Fang Gu is killed and a new Fang Gu is transfered to an outsider), change the alignment of an evil townsfolk or outsider into good alignment and inform them.

trouble_repairman.ability: Evils only see each other if ≥ 4 good Townsfolk are in play. ≤ 40% of players can be evil. Social reading & meta gaming is welcome. You don't lie about the game or rules.

trouble_showmaster.ability: Whenever an outsider effect mentions their team to lose/win, the effect might instead turn the outsider into a Heretic and at least the would-be winners learn this.

trouble_spoiler.ability: The story teller restricts the script to at most normal size, giving hints about dis- or enabled characters/abilities before the game session. No Story Teller nomination with excluded Atheist.

trouble_superhero.ability: One cycle per game, a person gets a Traveller ability with the alignment of the team who needs help.

trouble_dazzler.ability: Townsfolk and Outsiders think they are Townsfolk or Outsider. Minions and Demons think they are Minion or Demon.
trouble_dazzler.firstNightReminder: During the setup, for each character in the setup, find another character of equal alignment but different character type. Mark demon player(s) with "demon", outsider players with "outsider". See other night reminder.
trouble_dazzler.otherNightReminder: For each player, play the abilities of both players. If marked "outsider", the outsider ability is not drunkened. If marked "demon" the demon ability is not drunkened. Otherwise, the townsfolk or minion ability is not drunkened.

jinxes.reason: Drunk Abilities which see the Grimoire don't see Dazzler reminder tokens.
Drunk Abilities which see the Grimoire don't see Dazzler reminder tokens.

trouble_fascist.ability: Each night, alive minions choose 1 player: if good they die+quit, else the Demon kills. Good players are exiled, not executed. You cannot die if minions live. Good wins if & only if you die. [+1 evil arbitrary player]
trouble_fascist.firstNightReminder: Declare that the Fascist is in play. Instead of a Demon, you may add an evil player of any character type to the setup, e.g. an Outsider. If no Demon character is added to the setup, each Minion Info also yields the same 3 character bluffs.
trouble_fascist.otherNightReminder: Let each alive minion choose ≤ 1 player (individually). Among the most chosen players, you decide the final choice. This player dies (if unprotected). Add the "quit" to this player. Players with "quit" reminder cannot interact or act anymore within the game, only communicate, sleep and walk. Only when the game ended, quit persons revert back to players with their most recent state & properties. Only if no minion is alive, wake alive Demon players to act tonight. At day, good players are nominated like normally but the condition for a successful ballot changes: ≥ 1 good+alive player must vote AND the votes are ≥ 50% of alive players or all alive good players have voted. Else, the ballot for a good player fails. Any executions of good players become exiles. Dead players regain their vote token when the nominee is exiled. Nothing changes with nominations of red players. When quit persons nominate, the ballot fails even if the success condition is satisfied. If the Fascist would die while ≥ 1 player of minion type is alive, the Dictator doesn't die. The good team only wins if they kill the Dictator. The game ends if 1 regular player is left alive (not 2). The red team (also) may win if ≥ 50% of the alive regular players are minions (except if red players don't know each other).

jinxes.reason: The Anarchist might register as good to Dictator.

trouble_fascist.flavor: I could stand in the middle of 5th Avenue and shoot somebody, and I wouldn't lose voters.

trouble_gingerbread.ability: Edible cookies represent life tokens. Dying players eat 1 cookie. Players start with vote token & only spent it when dead. Players can (& deadly executees must) give their cookies to others.

trouble_immortalrole.ability: Nominations are not regulated. Invalid nominations fail covertly. ≤ 1 good player is Immortal: Only your character dies, not the player. If it died, deads can nominate & each of your dead votes gives another 1 dead evil player +1 vote token next night.
trouble_immortalrole.flavor: The 1st time, my train derailed into an icy river but I managed to swim to the riverside.The 2nd time, I survived a plane crash at landing, being suck out of the door but cushioned by hay, while everyone else died.The 3rd time, my bus skidded into a river, I could swim to the riverside but some others could not do it.The 4th time, my car took fire while I was driving it. It exploded but I could crawl out of it.3 years later the same even happened again.The 6th time, …(Frane Selak)

trouble_inspectorrole.ability: ≤1 player is Inspector: Deadly executions turn into arrest. At night, arrested players might choose+learn you. "yes" reveals their character to you & re-enables nominating+abilities. Evil players always choose on their first arrest. A "no" or 2nd arrest leads to permanent abilities loss.

trouble_introvert.ability: You are an impartial player with a not-in-play character (no demon, no traveller). Each day, certain players may privately ask about or guess it once. Who names your ability gets to know what you did or saw last night.
trouble_introvert.firstNightReminder: Find a not-in-play character (which also is not a bluff) that you can use as a player. It should be useful or interesting for others to guess and which might let you talk about hypothetical things that you do or experience with this character.
trouble_introvert.otherNightReminder: At days, allow players to ask a "yes"/"no"-question about your character or ability or else allow them to guess. You may impose an arbitrary (known or unknown) condition or limit of who or how many you allow to guess. Each of them may ask OR guess only once per day. Each day when they guess your character right, you tell about what happened to you as player or what you did.

trouble_nightmare.ability: Non-Demon players think to be 1 good or 1 minion character. The Demon chooses (covertly) which players are Minions. No minion info. [? equal Minions,? Outsiders]
trouble_nightmare.firstNightReminder: The player with "demon" reminder has the Demon character, other players (who are not publicly known to be a Traveller) draw a good character and a minion character. When giving Demon Info, the Demon chooses Minions instead of learning them. Mark each with "minion". Players with "minion" reminder have the good character drunkened, others the minion character. As a result, multiple players with equal minion character or a different number of outsiders may be in play. Rest: See Other Night Reminder.
trouble_nightmare.otherNightReminder: For each non-Demon player, wake them when their minion ability would wake at night, show them the Minion character and let them play the ability. The ability is drunk if the player has a "drunk ‹minion›" reminder. Do the same for the good character ability of each player whose ability is drunk if they have a "drunk ‹townsfolk›" reminder or "drunk ‹outsider›" reminder.

trouble_pardoner.ability: Until next dusk, winners of nominations give their character to an unknown player. Afterwards, nomination supporters vote to execute the winner or not.

trouble_plotterrole.ability: ≤ 1 minion is the Plotter: If you live or Story Teller is executed, winning Townsfolk/Demons don't win, else winning Outsiders/Minions. Night 1 has alignment-separated Plotter info for minions and outsider. You choose your registration. If guessed publicly, the Demon kills you. On night X, Townsfolk & Demons are deranged until dusk. [X Outsiders]
trouble_plotterrole.firstNightReminder: If you want, turn 1 minion into the Plotter, add the Plotter token in the Grimoire, otherwise ignore the Plotter's night steps. Count all outsider tokens in the setup. You can add or remove outsiders arbitrarily. Fabled are ignored which restrict outsiders. This number of outsiders is X. Wake the Plotter to choose a character+alignment to register as tonight (regarding abilties AND the game rules). This may affect the minion + demon info step that happens afterwards. First show the minion and demon info. After demon info: Wake the Plotter and show them 1 not-in-play townsfolk and 1 not-in-play outsider (no demon bluffs). Afterwards, let the Plotter choose any players (no Demons & no Travellers) to get a minion character they wish (give no feedback if a wish fails e.g. when the character is already in play or because of your regulation). Wake all outsiders (except the Plotter), let them know the other outsiders and show who is the Plotter. Sleep. For each alignment, wake all minions (except the Plotter), let them know the other minions of equal alignment and show them the Plotter. Sleep. Wake the Plotter, show all final minions (no demons). Sleep. Rest: see Other Night Reminder.
trouble_plotterrole.otherNightReminder: At day, if someone validly guesses the Plotter player, the Demon has to choose the Plotter next night. Each Townsfolk & Demons can make 1 valid guess per game. After a valid guess is made, no other guess is valid at the day. There are no wasted guessing attempts. On night X (= setup number of outsiders), first make every townsfolk and demon deranged. If X = 0, it never triggers. Even when the Plotter died, the Plotter chooses to (mis)register their character+alignment after dusk AND before dawn. When the game ends, outsiders, minions and Plotter abilities win, if any Plotter lives OR if the Story Teller was executed. Else, Townsfolk & Demons win. Players lose if their alignment loses. Everyone else has a draw.
trouble_plotterrole.flavor: I am having a goal! The town of Ravenswood Bluff... WILL BE MINE!!! You shall be fearing me! I HAVE FURY!!

trouble_polymathrole.ability: On night 1, ≤1 good Townsfolk becomes outsider+Polymath: On night/day X, play ≤1 bluffable townsfolk/minion. Any chosen ability after X choices might overdrive. You register as evil. The evil might know your character. [1 evil Townsfolk/Outsider]
trouble_polymathrole.firstNightReminder: If you want, you can add 1 extra outsider who is Polymath. If you don't, ignore the Polymath night steps. Inform them to be the Polymath. The polymath must be good at setup time. You might change and inform 1 good character player to be evil, preferably an outsider. Choose a fairly compensating not-in-play outsider for the polymath from the script. Show it to the Polymath and put them to sleep. If you think, it's fair for the evil to know, wake the demon and possibly evil players with weak evil value and tell them that the polymath is that outsider. Poisoned minions may get false info. Rest: see Other Night Reminder
trouble_polymathrole.otherNightReminder: Present the polymath a script to choose a character from (townsfolk or minion) early in the night. You may disallow choices and prompt to choose again. Disallow any choices that (would) confirm the Polymath player or cannot be bluffed by good/evil players. (For this, remember any Polymath ability choices that you arranged privately at day if applicable.) Sleep. When the Polymath has chosen the N-th ability – where N > current day+night cycle – you might add the "overdriven" (= drunk + deranged) to the Polymath player. An overdriven player is either drunk or deranged, whatever helps the opposite team more. Else remove the overdriven of the Polymath if applicable. Later in the night, play the chosen character (directly after an equal in-play character would play). Do not allow the Polymath to change the demon character or person and show no grimoire. If the Polymath plays a once-per-game ability, add the "special night". If this reminder is already set, don't allow it. Sleep. Finally after dawn, they might choose an ability sometime at the day, directly in a private talk or indirectly via public claim, which is decided the same way as the choice of the night ability. It might work or not. If the Polymath plays a once-per-game ability, add the "special day". If this reminder is already set, don't allow it.

jinxes.reason: If the Polymath is a Lunatic, the demons and Polymath don't know who is Lunatic and who is a real demon. Genuine demons have a drunk polymath ability and don't know that they are really the demon. The polymath has a drunk Demon ability who learns fake Lunatic choices from the story teller.

trouble_quine.ability: Each night, a new player sees 1 player. The seen players have something in common at the time of seeing them. Players can cast a ballot to decide who gets the next info.
trouble_quine.firstNightReminder: Find a common game-related property that multiple players (at least 2) share. Wake the first player who sees one of those players.
trouble_quine.otherNightReminder: At day, allow players to volunteer or use a ballot to determine who should be next. Each player can receive this info only once per game. At night, wake this player or choose one by yourself if no-one was determined. Show 1 player who currently shares a common property with the other players when they were pointed at. At least 2 different players are shown until the game ends.

trouble_redeemerrole.ability: ≤ 1 good player is Redeemer: if you are healthy+sober+alive after a death, good wins. You resurrect after X nights (X = #good-alive-votes, else #alive-evil). Evil players also know you. If sober/healthy, you only die from execution if "#good-votes – #evil-votes" is either ≤ 1 or passes the nomination limit.
trouble_redeemerrole.flavor: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever.

trouble_shopkeeper.ability: Players can earn coins for each game-related quest, achievement or minigame they win. They can spend coins for immediate item effects from you.
trouble_shopkeeper.firstNightReminder: Define the items that you want to offer during the game (up to 4 for each alignment is sufficient). Choose achievements, quests and minigames such as with the Zenomancer and their reward in coins. Decide about item prices based on the player number of an alignment and the available rewards. Of course, you also may use physical coins.
trouble_shopkeeper.otherNightReminder: You may declare all shop offers (for good and evil) at the beginning or only when people ask you (only show them the offer for their character type!). People may accomplish achievements at any day or night. When people purchase an item/upgrade from you, add its reminder to the player in the grimoire (and possibly the day number when they purchased it). The item/upgrade is effective from now on. If you figure out that someone illegitimately got the coins for the purchase, you remove their reminder again.

trouble_townplanner.ability: Players successively learn their start character when they wake on night 1. The Story Teller or prior night abilities may alter them beforehand. Lorics can be declared on dawn 1.
trouble_townplanner.firstNightReminder: You may declare (and explain) some Lorics when players wake up instead of before the first night. When your setup is finished, randomly assign your setup characters to available players. Then you may carry out a sequence of character swaps such that certain players get the character that you want them to have. Now, start waking players according to the night sheet. Wake players first whose ability alters other players' start characters. Wake all players to inform them about their character, even if they would not wake up with their character.

trouble_trustmaker.ability: Anyone who declares trust for a player: your vote doesn't register for their nomination. While alive at their deadly execution (not supported by you), you: learn their private character+alignment & get – or (if evil) misregister as – unconscious from now on.
trouble_trustmaker.otherNightReminder: Check that you updated who trusts who during the day by adding the "trusted by" reminder to the trustee player. Do not use "trusted by X" or "treason by X" reminders when the player X has a "trust used" reminder. There is only one "trusted by" and "treason by" reminder per player. If the truster supported the execution for their trustee, e.g. a void vote for the executed trustee, indicate the treason by adding the "treason by X" reminder to the trustee player or remember it. With a "treason" reminder, trusters don't get character+alignment info. But if they get it, add the "trust used" reminder to the receiving player until the end of the game. A player with "trust used" reminder is unconscious except for evil players, i.e. their nomination fails, their vote fails and don't wake up except for seeing their character/alignment change). When the truster actively defends a trustee against execution, remove a treason reminder if applicable.
trouble_trustmaker.flavor: My good friend, as we are forced to leave this dire world, I trust you my secret, I am actually your father.

syncret_actress.ability: Each night, you learn the number of alive players who were publicly mad about false game-related info today.
syncret_actress.otherNightReminder: Count the alive players who publicly believed, were convinced or tried to make others believe false game-related information. Show this number to the Actor at night.
syncret_actress.flavor: They are just acting, I know how this works.

syncret_adventurer.ability: Each night, learn the Demon's kill targets of tonight.
syncret_adventurer.otherNightReminder: Wake the Adventurer and point at each player who has the "dead" of any Demon (or otherwise a "Demon" ) which signifies being chosen by the Demon. "Demon" s are removed on dawn.

jinxes.reason: The Fang Gu only jumps to the next chosen Outsider when the Adventurer is dead.
The Adventurer learns the former Demon player who chose the next alive Demon, not the chosen player.

syncret_attorney.ability: Each night, choose 1 player: they gain 1 life. 1 other loses it but keeps evil abilities. Life states stay integers even if the Attorney vanishes.
syncret_attorney.otherNightReminder: The Attorney chooses after the demon/minions chose & chooses 1 player (possibly themself). Add a "life" to them. Another player loses a "life" (if they have ≥ 2 lives), else dies. Evil characters that die this way are marked "has evil abilities". When they are killed (again) by another ability or event, remove their "has evil abilities". Remove a "life" from anyone who would die, else they die. Attorney reminders remain even when the Attorney vanishes & only vanish from lethal events/attacks.

syncret_biologist.ability: Each night, choose 1 player: You learn whether their character is either not in the Minion section, not in the Demon section, "left" or "right" in the script.
syncret_biologist.otherNightReminder: Let the Biologist choose 1 player (you may allow them to choose themself). If the player has a character in the Demon section of the script, you may give a "not minion" answer. If the character is from the minion section, you may give a "not demon" answer. Otherwise, the answer is arbitrary. Alternatively, you may answer "left" (if in the left column) or "right" (if in the right column).

syncret_carnivalreveller.ability: Each night, choose 1 non-traveller: this character/ability swaps with their good character, else it becomes a not-in-play good character/ability.
syncret_carnivalreveller.otherNightReminder: Early at night, the Carnival Reveller points at 1 player (no public traveller). If they play a Demon or Minion character, the Carnival Reveller learns that the Carnival character (else ability) turns into a not-in-play good one, otherwise turns into the one of the chosen player who then learns to become the Carnival Reveller character. The former Carnival Reveller plays their new ability tonight if applicable.

syncret_cartographer.ability: You start knowing 1 player of the longest Townsfolk player row (ignoring Travellers).
syncret_cartographer.firstNightReminder: Add the "know" to 1 Townsfolk player from the biggest row of successive Townsfolk players. Show the Cartographer this player.

syncret_champion.ability: Once per game, publicly at day, choose 1 player: if they don't achieve (3 tries) what you show (1 try), they are drunk for the next 2 cycles.
syncret_champion.otherNightReminder: Remove any "drunk 2", replace the "drunk 1" reminder with "drunk 2". Add the "drunk 1" to a player who could not replicate in 3 attempts what the champion showed the past day. Players marked "drunk 1" or "drunk 2" are drunk.

syncret_clerk.ability: Each night, you learn if an alive neighbor lied about this game yesterday. Once per game, learn it for a chosen neighbour.
syncret_clerk.otherNightReminder: If you noticed that 1 alive neighbor (not a Traveller) of the Clerk has lied about the current game yesterday (not night), mark them with "Liar". If a neighbour has the "Liar" reminder, nod the head to the Clerk, otherwise shake it. Ignore a neighbour's reminder if the Clerk has no "Used" reminder & points at the other neighbour: then mark the Clerk with "Used". Remove the "Liar".

syncret_clown.ability: You start knowing 1 not-in-play evil character. If you joke about being a minion you register as evil until dawn. If you are funny today, learn 1 player next night.
syncret_clown.firstNightReminder: Out of all evil characters (demons or minion characters) who are not in play, pick one and show it to the Clown.
syncret_clown.otherNightReminder: As soon as the Clown jokes about being a minion, mark them "goofy", they register as evil even if they are actually good. On dawn, remove the "goofy". If the Clown put in effort to be funny, hilarious or joky today and has been funny to some extent, for ≥ 1 player, wake them tonight. Point to any 1 dead or alive player and show an alignment+character they have. You might show a player that the Clown already saw earlier.
syncret_clown.flavor: Wouldn't it be funny to be a psychopath?! This is my axe!

syncret_copycat.ability: A player clones state+abilities of 1 team member you choose, if you remove their last ability. They might register as dead & act on your account.
syncret_copycat.otherNightReminder: When the Copycat accounts for a death, do not add a shroud to the dead player but a "clone target" reminder. You choose whether and when the player registers and is declared as dead (they must however register as dead when they become dead). When the Copycat accounts for the loss of abilities of a player (drunkness, poisoning, death, …), add a "clone target" reminder to that player and wake up the Copycat before dawn. When you add a new "clone target" reminder, (re)move the old one. If a player turns dead when the "clone target" is removed, add a shroud. When the Copycat wakes up, point to the player and let them choose another player (including the Copycat themself). If this player has different alignment, remove any "clone target" and "clone source" reminders, adding a shroud to the previous "clone target" when they die, and sleep. Otherwise, remove any existing "clone source" reminder and add the "clone source" reminder to the chosen player. If the clone source player is dead at cloning time, the cloned target player also will die and copy the shroud (but gets the cloned character), else continues living until the clone relation ends (even if they would be dead). Sleep. (You might do all of this multiple times for multiple players in the same night, enumerating every pair of target & source.) When the "clone target" or "clone source" has changed, copy all "clone source" player state to the "clone target" player and show the new character to the clone target player. If the clone relation ends, wake up the former clone target player and show the original character.

syncret_darling.ability: Each evil player who chooses you via ability is drunk this & next cycle, even if you died. After that, you die.
syncret_darling.otherNightReminder: Add the "drunk 1" instantly to evil players who choose the dead/alive Darling player with their ability. Next dusk, remove "drunk 2" s (the Darling dies if this happens) & replace "drunk 1" with the "drunk 2". Players marked "drunk X" are drunk the entire cycle (no kill/effects).

syncret_demonologist.ability: Each night, you learn whether a Demon ability or player changed yesterday or tonight.
syncret_demonologist.otherNightReminder: Wake the Demonologist. If a player got or lost the Demon character or if a player's Demon ability changed, since last dawn, show a "yes", else a "no".

syncret_doppelganger.ability: You get the character of the last player you killed. If it is an evil character, it is poisoned. (You might get another character at setup time.)
syncret_doppelganger.firstNightReminder: The Doppelgänger might get another character token at the start whose ability they already start having. This might be an in-play character as well.
syncret_doppelganger.otherNightReminder: Early at night, if the Doppelgänger killed a player with any ability or by nomination and execution, show they are the Doppelgänger and they are the character their victim registers as. Play the ability's first night effect tonight if applicable. If the character is evil, this (& only this) evil character is poisoned.

syncret_double.ability: Once per game, anytime, you may wish to die instead of some player today/tonight.
syncret_double.otherNightReminder: At night or day, if there is no "predicted" reminder and the Double expresses silently or privately or publicly calls for dying instead of someone else, mark them with the "predicted". Then, only if anyone is dying before next dusk/dawn, the Double dies instead of 1 player.

syncret_dowser.ability: Each night, choose 1 alive player: learn whether they are the [left or right] end of a good player row or opposite end of an evil player row.
syncret_dowser.firstNightReminder: When starting the game, choose which end of the good player row to indicate, as either clockwise (add the "CW" ) or counterclockwise (add the "CCW":reminder.). This does not change over the game. Rest: See Other Night Reminder.
syncret_dowser.otherNightReminder: Let the Dowser point at 1 alive player (including themself) and nod the head (yes) or shake the head (no).

syncret_esoteric.ability: Each night, you learn how many alive players register their alignment or character unnaturally.
syncret_esoteric.otherNightReminder: Late at night, wake the Esoteric and show a number. This number corresponds to the number of alive players who registers as an alignment or character that does not match any of their foreground characters to any other player or game rule. E.g. neutral players count into it, evil Townsfolk, good Demons, but also a Recluse or a Spy.

syncret_fighter.ability: Players who kill you are drunk the next 2 cycles.
syncret_fighter.otherNightReminder: At dusk, the player who killed (or executed) the fighter is marked "drunk 1". A player with that reminder replaces it against "drunk 2". A player with that reminder loses it. Abilities of players with "drunk 1" or "drunk 2" reminder are drunk.
syncret_fighter.flavor: You are messing with the wrong one. Taste my fist!

syncret_genie.ability: Once per game, you can make a public wish (≤ 2 predicates, no "AND" connectives, no grimoire, no public confirmability). It might have arbitrary trade offs.
syncret_genie.otherNightReminder: At day, if the Genie has no "used" reminder and makes a public wish, add the "used" reminder to the Genie. Examine if the wish is wellformed. It must have ≤ 2 predicates, no AND-connection, no recursion, no grimoire interaction, no public revealations, no extra wishes. Any foreign witnesses should be(come) evil. The story teller may deceive the public (temporarily) to allow for bluffing. All (excpet 1) alternatives of an "OR" connection are discared. Reflect which trade offs are needed, in order to restrict the power as appropriate for a good ability.

syncret_gourmet.ability: Each night, choose 1 player and learn whether their actual ability is good+well-functioning or evil+abnormally working. You are sober.
syncret_gourmet.otherNightReminder: Let the Gourmet point at 1 player. If that player has a good well-functioning ability or an evil abnormally-working ability, then show a "yes". Else show a "no". The Gourmet ignores false registration.

syncret_hairdresser.ability: You start knowing 2 counts: (fe)male & not (fe)male evil non-travellers. 1 of both is false. (Other nights, choose 1 character: learn a sex not of them.)
syncret_hairdresser.firstNightReminder: Define the players' publicly known in-game gender/sex before night 1. Choose male or female or none. (Don't change during game!) Count the number of evil-registering players with and without 1 gender. Ignore travellers. Add a little non-zero integer to one of the counts. Wake up the Hairdresser: show the two numbers + the gender. 1st the positive, 2nd the negative criterion.
syncret_hairdresser.otherNightReminder: Let the Hairdresser choose a character: show "not male" or "not female" for this character (or any if not in play).

syncret_hero.ability: If you would die tonight, you die instead of another team member on a later night.
syncret_hero.otherNightReminder: If deadly attacked tonight, the Hero does not die. Add the "sacrifize" to them (if not already). Else if marked "sacrifize", the Hero dies instead of another player of their team.

syncret_janitor.ability: Each night, learn whether you have an alive evil neighbor.
syncret_janitor.otherNightReminder: Wake the Janitor. If at least one alive neighbour is evil, nod the head, otherwise shake it.

syncret_joker.ability: Wish to become any good character (not publicly confirmable, it might be altered).
syncret_joker.firstNightReminder: Let the Joker tell you what good character they want to be before night 1. No-one else changes. They might invent an ability. It can be duplicate. Their wish stays secret. Refuse/alter wishes that can be confirmed publicly (are unbluffable), can end the game quickly (e.g. killing chosen players) or easily identify evil players (too unbalanced). Rest: See Other Reminder.
syncret_joker.otherNightReminder: If the Joker turns into a character whose token you don't have or who might be unknown, they register as the Joker.

syncret_luckydevil.ability: At dawn, if 3 death events failed on you & the game would not end, your team wins.
syncret_luckydevil.otherNightReminder: When the Lucky Devil was targeted by a lethal event but did not die, mark them "survived 1", else replace "survived 1" with "survived 2", else replace "survived 2" with "survived 3". Remove the if the Lucky Devil dies. At dawn, if marked "survived 3" and no-one wins, the team of the Lucky Devil wins.

syncret_masker.ability: One dusk, choose a dead player: play their ability this cycle if it is a good character.
syncret_masker.otherNightReminder: If there is no "played" yet, wake the Masker at the beginning of the night. Let them point at a dead player who becomes marked with "played" and whose good character ability is directly played by the Masker in its first night (if applicable).

syncret_model.ability: If you are paralyzed until you guess all Townsfolk players' characters, your team wins or until you die at night (before guessing), choose a Townsfolk to become.
syncret_model.firstNightReminder: Add the "paralyzed" reminder to the Model player.
syncret_model.otherNightReminder: When the Model violated the paralyzed condition in the last day, remove the paralyzed reminder. At day, if the Model guesses the characters of all Townsfolk, mark them with "guess". If the "paralyzed" reminder is still set AND the model guessed all players correctly, end the game: declare that good wins. If the "paralyzed" but no "guess" reminder is set and if the Model dies tonight, wake them and let them choose any Townsfolk character from the script or any official Townsfolk character. They may choose their character at day, if they like.

syncret_mummer.ability: Each night, if you were muted yesterday, you may choose 1 character & learn whether it is in play. If not in play, the demon learns who you are.
syncret_mummer.firstNightReminder: Let the Mummer choose 1 character and give them "yes" if it is in play, else a "no". Sleep. At the same night, when you showed a "no", wake up the demon and tell that this player is the Mummer.
syncret_mummer.otherNightReminder: When the Mummer is marked as "muted", allow them to evaluate one character (see First Night Reminder). At dawn, add the "muted" reminder. At day, remove the "muted" reminder when the player violates the muted condition.

syncret_mute.ability: If you are muted until the final day or until half the alive players are evil, once, you learn 1 alive evil player & the demon character.
syncret_mute.firstNightReminder: Mark the Mute with "muted". If the game starts with a greater-equal number of evil players, trigger the reward of the Mute unless the Mute is not alive at dawn.
syncret_mute.otherNightReminder: Observe the Mute player at day in semi- or public situations. If they violate the muted condition, remove "muted". (You might penalize this event additionally.) Later, at dawn, if the Mute lives AND there is the "muted" reminder AND it's the night before the final day or the greater-equal half of alive players is evil, wake the Mute, point to 1 alive evil player, show the player's character and then show the demon's character.

syncret_nerd.ability: You have 3 not-in-play Townsfolk characters, 1 of which is drunk.
syncret_nerd.firstNightReminder: Show the Nerd which non-Nerd characters they have (not which one is drunk). Mark the drunk character with "is drunk". See Other Night Reminder.
syncret_nerd.otherNightReminder: Play all of the characters of the Nerd individually (showing which is played when waked).

syncret_officer.ability: One night, choose 1 player: when they die, you & a minion/demon learn their character. Then choose again.
syncret_officer.firstNightReminder: If there is no "observed", wake the Officer, let them choose 1 player (themself included). If they do, mark the chosen player with "observed".
syncret_officer.otherNightReminder: If a player with "observed" reminder has died, their character is shown to the Officer and to a Minion or Demon (learning to be chosen by the Officer). Then remove the "observed". See First Night Reminder.

syncret_physician.ability: Each night, choose 1 player to cure persistent action, ability, property defects and protect against new ones this cycle.
syncret_physician.otherNightReminder: Remove the "treated". Early at night, the Physician chooses 1 player (even themself). Mark them with "treated". Persistent action, ability and property defects are removed (remove its reminders, else add a "cured" if necessary). Obtaining new such defects is prevented this cycle.

syncret_ponerologist.ability: Each night, you learn how many players changed their registered (player or character) alignment yesterday & tonight.
syncret_ponerologist.otherNightReminder: At night and day, count the number of players whose registered alignment has changed since last dawn. You may add a "+1" to each of these players (if they don't have already one). At down, reset the count, remove any "+1" s. Now, wake the Ponerologist. Show your count of players with changed alignment, the number of "+1" reminders.

syncret_prodigy.ability: You have +N ≥ 2 Townsfolk (of which ≥ 1 queries no properties) & +N/2 Outsider characters. Evils get +((N-1)/2) Minion characters.
syncret_prodigy.firstNightReminder: Decide which Townsfolk and Outsider abilities the prodigy obtains. At least one Townsfolk ability gets and infers no information. Compute the compensatory number of evil characters and assign these characters to already evil players. Evil Townsfolk or outsider who get a minion ability become a minion and are going to get minion info. Minion abilities can be distributed among multiple evil players. Wake up the Prodigy and show them that they are the Prodigy followed by the sequence of all characters that they have. Put all these characters to the Prodigy player in the Grimoire. Rest: See Other Night Reminder.
syncret_prodigy.otherNightReminder: Play the abilities of the Prodigy in the correct night order. When an ability would be used, wake up the Prodigy show them the character token (for the ability) and play the ability. Sleep. Whenever any ability queries or refers to the character of the Prodigy, this is not the Prodigy character but the story teller must choose one of the characters that helps the Prodigy's team most.

jinxes.reason: The Spy does not see the extra characters of the Prodigy.
The Widow does not see the Prodigy, only 1 extra character they have.

syncret_profiler.ability: Each night, choose 1 player & 1 evil character: if you guess right, repeat. If you choose a Demon character, the Demon learns who you are.
syncret_profiler.otherNightReminder: Let the Profiler choose 1 player + 1 evil character. If the player has this character, repeat this ability. If a demon character was chosen, mark the Profiler with the "Chose Demon". Later, inform the Demon that the Profiler player selected them & remove the "Chose Demon".

syncret_psychatrist.ability: Each night, choose 1 player to cure their persistent social, perceptional and behavioral impairments & prevent new ones this cycle.
syncret_psychatrist.otherNightReminder: Remove the "treated". Early at night, the Psychatrist chooses 1 player (even themself). Mark them with "treated". Their persistent social conditions and ability manipuatlions are removed (remove its reminders, else add a "cured" if necessary). Obtaining new such impairments is prevented this cycle.

syncret_psychologist.ability: Each night, choose 1 player: Learn two character types of them, one is correct.
syncret_psychologist.otherNightReminder: Let the Psychologist choose 1 player. Show the character type of the chosen player plus another character type.

syncret_quizmaster.ability: Each day, publicly choose ≤ 1 alive player to give an answer to your question. If factually wrong, they die tonight. (You might be a Fabled.)
syncret_quizmaster.otherNightReminder: If the Quizmaster chose a player last day who gave a definitely (factually) wrong answer to their question, this player dies tonight. (They can refuse to answer.)

syncret_scientist.ability: Each night, learn 2 other players: an ability of only 1 of them worked differently due to other abilities since dawn. Else learn no-one.
syncret_scientist.otherNightReminder: Mark 1 player with "interfered" if their ability worked differently due to another player ability. Mark one player with "not interfered" whom that didn't happen. Else, mark no-one. The Scientist learns the players marked "interfered" and "not interfered". Remove both s.

syncret_shaman.ability: Each night, the Demon can have 1 target. If you guess all demon targets, you learn all alive characters and bluffs. (The Demon might know you are in play.)
syncret_shaman.otherNightReminder: The Shaman ability allows the Demon to choose 0 or 1 player if they had no target tonight. At dawn, let the Shaman guess ≥ 0 players, mark them with "guessed". If all guessed players are the ones with Demonic target reminder, nod your head "yes". Then at dawn, show all characters and your given bluffs that all alive players use. Else shake your head "no". Remove the "guess" s.

syncret_soulkeeper.ability: Each night, choose ≤ 1 player who, if dead, takes+adds your abilities+life, or, if alive, returns all abilities to you when they die. Meanwhile you cannot act/wake.
syncret_soulkeeper.firstNightReminder: Mark the Soulkeeper player with the "soulkeeper" reminder. Rest: see Other Night Reminder.
syncret_soulkeeper.otherNightReminder: When a player with "soulchosen" reminder exists in the Grimoire don't wake up the Soulkeeper. Otherwise, let the Soulkeeper choose a player. When they choose themself, let them use their Soulkeeper abilities. They can use abilities of all players marked with "soulcaught" in the grimoire. Whenever the character would take effect at night, also wake the Soulkeeper then, play the ability and sleep. If the Soulkeeper chooses no player, do not wake them anymore this night. If the Soulkeeper chooses a dead player, move a "soulkeeper" reminder to the new person and move their shroud to the previous soulkeeper. Only one player may have the "soulkeeper" reminder. This player must be declared to be be resurrected at dawn. If the Soulkeeper chooses an alive player, mark them with the "soulchosen" reminder. Whenever a Soulkeeper character would be created mid-game, move the "soulchosen" reminder to that player if a "soulkeeper" marked player exists otherwise use a "soulkeeper" reminder for the player. Whenever a soulchosen player dies, replace their "soulchosen" reminder with the "soulcaught" reminder. When the Soulkeeper really dies, remove all soulchosen, soulcaught and soulkeeper reminders from the grimoire.

syncret_theist.ability: Players can cheat rules. Players win if not caught cheating. Heretics & Atheists don't work. Everyone loses If you execute the story teller. Only executions kill you.

syncret_villagegargoyle.ability: On night ≥ 2, when your team has majority, you are demon-killed & become not-in-play Townsfolk. Give it to 1 chosen player, once your team loses majority. Your character lives even if dead.
syncret_villagegargoyle.firstNightReminder: Choose a not-in-play Townsfolk for the Gargoyle or let a dedicated Gargoyle player choose one before the game. In night 1, the Gargoyle only has the Gargoyle character.
syncret_villagegargoyle.otherNightReminder: Even if the Village Gargoyle player is dead, the Village Gargoyle character still lives (and their Townsfolk character might as well). The first time on night ≥ 2, if the team of the Village Gargoyle has more alive players than the other team(s), the Village Gargoyle dies at night, publicly(!), and the Demon skips their action of that night. Additionally: add a Townsfolk character by adding its token to the Village Gargoyle token in the Grimoire. The first time on night ≥ 2 when the Village Gargoyle is not part of the majority team anymore, wake them to choose 1 other (dead or alive) player. The Village Gargoyle's Townsfolk character moves to the chosen player whose previous character is replaced. If it is a Demon player with active ability, yet another alive player becomes the evil Demon of equal charater instead.

syncret_activist.ability: Each dawn, you change your alignment if the other alive players of your alignment are more than the alive players of the opposite alignment, even if dead.
syncret_activist.otherNightReminder: At the end of the night, if the number of alive members of the Activist's team is greater than the number of alive members of the opposite team, the Activist changes to the opposite alignment. If this happens, inform the Activist about their new alignment. (Flip the character token in the Grimoire to indicate evil ailgnment.) The alignment change fails if no additional players of the target alignment are allowed.

syncret_amoralist.ability: Alive players win only if they would lose. The Demon sees the Grimoire & chooses 1 player to become the evil Demon if killed by a good player. You don't die.
syncret_amoralist.otherNightReminder: If a good player killed (or executes) the Demon, let the Demon choose 1 player to become the new evil Demon. The Demon may see the Grimoire.

syncret_aristocrat.ability: Once per game, when ≥ 7 players are alive, choose 1 other player. You & then this player get the neutral alignment. The event might be declared at dawn.
syncret_aristocrat.otherNightReminder: If the Aristocrat has no "used" reminder and ≥ 7 players are alive, wake the Aristocrat and allow them to choose 1 player. If they choose 1 player, add a "neutral" to the Aristocrat and a "neutral" to the pointed player. Also add the "used" to the Aristocrat. If a player with "neutral" reminder changes their alignment, remove the "neutral" reminder. Players with "neutral" reminder have the neutral alignment (they register as opposite to the alignment of their actual character), see neutral alignment.

syncret_bigshot.ability: Good players who killed you (or challenged your protection) are assassinated next night.
syncret_bigshot.otherNightReminder: Add the "rat" to good player(s) who kill the Big Shot (or would have if unprotected). (If Big Shot wins nominations, good voters might be marked "rat" too.) Tonight, players with "rat" reminder die (even if they couldn't). At dawn, remove "rat" s.

syncret_buddha.ability: Once per game, even dead, if you correctly guess to be a given character, you are sober & will win (independently). If false, you are drunk. You might: be evil or register as Buddha. [+1 arbitary player]
syncret_buddha.firstNightReminder: Choose any non-script or in-script ability for the Buddha or one that is fake or manipulated (which does not exist). Choose the ability's character or a character that allows for confusion with the Buddha's ability and show this character to the Buddha in this night. (The Buddha must know this character.) The Buddha player may register as or replace a player in the setup if and only if their alignment and character/ability is equal to those that the player would have. The Buddha may be a secret Traveller. Give them an alignment that fits their character. If the Buddha registers as their character, put the character token next to the Buddha token in the grimoire. Rest: See Other Night Reminder.
syncret_buddha.otherNightReminder: The Buddha may guess any time but does not guess at night. If the Buddha guessed correctly, add the "enlightened" to the Buddha player. If the Buddha guessed falsely, add the "benighted" to the Buddha player. The "benighted" reminder is equal to being "drunk". The "enlightened" reminder means, the Buddha player and ability cannot get drunk anymore. When the game ends and the Buddha has the "enlightened" reminder, they win regardless of who else wins.

syncret_conspiratorr.ability: Once per game, if you are mad about true game info, at night, the demon learns your outsider ability & decides your suicide. You are a Magician.
syncret_conspiratorr.firstNightReminder: Perform the first night steps for a Magician. (Evil minions see the Conspirator as 2nd demon, the demon sees the Conspirator as additional minion.)
syncret_conspiratorr.otherNightReminder: If the Crusader deliberately (or unknowingly) spread correct game information in a convincing way, add the "whistleblower" reminder to the Conspirator player (remove the reminder when the Conspirator credibly retracted it by themself). At dusk, if the Conspirator has the "whistleblower" reminder, wake up the Demon. Point to the Conspirator, show the Conspirator character, and let them choose "yes" or "no". If the demon chooses "yes", the Conspirator commits suicide and everybody learns their additional death at dawn.

syncret_impersonator.ability: You start knowing a character nobody knows is not in play. If you convince someone to be it until the end, you win independently. The Story Teller might help you. You might be an evil Minion.
syncret_impersonator.firstNightReminder: Add the character to the Impersonator that they are tasked to perform. The Impersonator registers as the alignment from this character.
syncret_impersonator.otherNightReminder: At the end of the game, let players guess the character of the Impersonator. If at least 1 player guesses right (and is certain), the Impersonator wins even if they would not. The Impersonator can let the story teller send signals, messages to invidividual players or declarations to everyone. Either, they arrange these messages in a private talk at day with you, or uses a prepared message or gestures for you at night.

syncret_jackass.ability: In the night before the final day, you turn evil & learn the demon player.
syncret_jackass.otherNightReminder: If the final day might be tomorrow, turn the Jackass evil. Show that they are evil and which player the Demon is.

syncret_masterhora.ability: Each extra execution swaps the next night with its following day, ≤ current outsider number of times. The game can end only at dusk or dawn.
syncret_masterhora.otherNightReminder: Count the number of players "N" who register as outsiders at dusk and add a "‹N› outsiders" to Master Hora. At day, when someone is executed, add a "skip ‹X›" to Master Hora where X is the execution's ordinal number (the first execution has X = 0). If X = N, also force the day to end. At dawn, if Master Hora has a "skip ‹X›" reminder where X ≥ 1, replace the "skip ‹X›" reminder with a "skip ‹X-1›" and repeat the whole night phase again in correct night phase order. Else, end the night. You might end the night (but not the day) at a dusk (before the next night) if a team has won.

jinxes.reason: Master Hora shifts a night only when a good player is executed. If Leviathan chooses Master Hora at night, they die.

syncret_pinocchio.ability: At nominations, if you lie about the game, the demon acts twice tonight. If executed: choose 1 alive neighbor to become Pinocchio, you (& another neighbor might) become a Vagrant.
syncret_pinocchio.otherNightReminder: At dawn, if Pinocchio convincingly spread misinformation during any nomination, add the "liar" reminder to the Pinocchio player (remove the reminder when the Pinocchio debunked it or acknowledged the mistake sincerely), otherwise remove it. When a Demon player acted and the living Pinocchio player has a "liar" reminder, let the Demon act again (consecutively). At night after their execution, let Pinocchio choose 1 neighbour among the alive-registering players but not Travellers (it skips any dead neighbours). If they did not choose a valid player, shake the head and let them choose again. E.g. they might have chosen a Traveller Vagrant or the Frankenstein who covertly registers as dead. The Pinocchio player changes to a Vagrant. Inform them. Sleep. The chosen player changes their Character to Pinocchio. Wake up this player and inform them. The other alive neighbour might transform into a Vagrant. If they do, wake them and inform them and sleep. Avoid this if it would end the game.

syncret_prosecutorr.ability: Each day, you may claim the execution. If the executee aligns like you, they don't die & you are drunk from now on. You might be an Ogre or evil.
syncret_prosecutorr.firstNightReminder: The Prosecutor might use an Ogre ability or start evil. (If an Ogre, let them choose one player who is marked with "friend" (they align equally). Inform the Prosecutor about their alignment. Rest: See Other Night Reminder.
syncret_prosecutorr.otherNightReminder: At day, before executions, take a short pause. During that, the Prosecutor may call their ability to take responsibility for the execution. If the Prosecutor's alignment is equal to the one of the executee, the executee does not die. In this case, add the "drunk" to the Prosecutor.
