While the Prosecutor has the "drunk" reminder, their ability is drunk (which does not prevent the Ogre effect). Remove the "drunk" when the Prosecutor loses their ability.

syncret_punk.ability: You play a drunk not-in-play ability (no Outsider). You are or register as its character type. If you are "checked" by a good ability, + ≤1 player dies at night.
syncret_punk.firstNightReminder: If the Punk plays a drunk Demon, the Demon might learn the Punk player. (Like Lunatic.) See Other Night Reminder.
syncret_punk.otherNightReminder: Play the Punk's drunk ability. At day or night, if a good ability "checks" the Punk – i.e. chooses them for an effect which is conditional w.r.t. player properties – add the "checked" to the center. If the "checked" reminder exists, choose a player to die. Allow for false conclusions with the kill. If the Punk has a drunk Demon ability, the Demon might learn who the Punk chooses tonight before the Demon chooses. (Like Lunatic.) Remove the "checked"

syncret_rookie.ability: Nominate only once. If you nominate the Demon, they are executed & assassinated & another alive player becomes the evil Demon.
syncret_rookie.otherNightReminder: If the Rookie is not marked "nominated" and nominates the Demon, the Demon is executed (before or after the ballot) and dies (even if they could not). If the Rookie nominates, add the "nominated" to them. Add the "Demon" to 1 alive player, they register as evil Demon. At night, inform the player with "Demon" reminder to be the new evil Demon. Penalize additional nominations: help the opposite team with a tip or decision.

syncret_siamesetwin.ability: You & your Twin know each other. You both share player state, properties & registration but act independently, even if dead.
syncret_siamesetwin.firstNightReminder: Early at night 1, choose 1 player as the Twin of the Siamese Twin. Mark the chosen player with "Siamese Twin". Show player, character and alignment of their Twin player to the Siamese Twin. The player marked "Siamese Twin" learns to be the twin of the Siamese Twin. (Don't make eye contact.) After the Twin acted at night, wake the Siamese if applicable and let them act too.
syncret_siamesetwin.otherNightReminder: Replay property signals or abilities of the player with "Siamese Twin" reminder for the Siamese. Both Siamese Twin players both have the union of their single player states.

syncret_sickener.ability: 1 player is sick since dawn 1. You start knowing their character & learn when they die. You might be a Townsfolk. [+1 arbitrary character+alignment]
syncret_sickener.firstNightReminder: Prepare the setup by replacing any 1 other character (and their alignment), not the Demon, with any character and any alignment. At dawn 1 (after the first night), add the "sickened" reminder to the affected player and show the sick character to the Sickener. Wake up the Sickener and show them the sickened player's character.
syncret_sickener.otherNightReminder: If the Sickener has their ability, don't wake up the player with "sickened" reminder, treat their day actions like a bluff and let their nominations fail covertly or overtly after the ballot with no reason. When the sickened player dies, wake up the Sickener at night. (You may show a death signal.)

syncret_solipsist.ability: If the game ends, you win & all others lose (if you live) else you lose individually (if you are dead). You have arbitrary alignment + character type (except Demon), even if dead. [-1 Outsider]

jinxes.reason: The Solipsist appears as a Minion.
The Solipsist appears as a Minion.
The Solipsist is not in play with Demons where killed players don't lose their ability.

syncret_brainformer.ability: If you or an evil character dies, choose ≤1 non-traveller: you become their character & they outsider. -1 other Outsider if you save a demon. [+1 outsider]
syncret_brainformer.firstNightReminder: Replace 1 Townsfolk in the setup with 1 outsider.
syncret_brainformer.otherNightReminder: If any Minions or Demons have been dying (yesterday or tonight), even the Brainformer themself, wake the Brainformer, show the dying player & allow them to optionally choose 1 player (incl. themself) retrospectively. The Brainformer becomes that player's (registered) character, then that player a not-in-play outsider (if applicable). This might happen before the death counts. If a demon is saved from a dying player, 1 other outsider becomes a not-in-play townsfolk.

syncret_clanboss.ability: Players who account for your death die tonight. You might be an Outsider. If you are, the demon learns the Outsider players.

jinxes.reason: When the Story Teller turns into the Clan Boss, executions of the Story Teller turn into executions of the nominator. The Atheist ability turns into the Heretic ability.
The Clan Boss additionally registers as Outsider to the Fang Gu.

syncret_crimsonboy.ability: You have a not-in-play Townsfolk ability. You register as its character towards = 1 good character (once).
syncret_crimsonboy.firstNightReminder: Choose a not-in-play Townsfolk ability (no bluffs) for the Crimson Boy. Use the Character Token as a reminder. Show the Crimson Boy their ability. Play the Townsfolk ability tonight.
syncret_crimsonboy.otherNightReminder: Play the Crimson Boy's Townsfolk ability at the proper time tonight or next day. If the Crimson Boy has no "misregistered" reminder AND any interaction of a good character uses the Crimson Boy's properties this cycle (= night+day), these properties are taken from the Crimson Boy's ability, exactly 1 time. If this happens, add the "misregistered" to the Crimson Boy.

syncret_cynic.ability: "good" is interpreted as "evil" within all ability texts.
syncret_cynic.otherNightReminder: For each rule that directly concerns ability text: read "good" as "evil". It does not affect words such as "Townsfolk" or "Minion" which can be both good and evil or which are neither of both.

syncret_diabolo.ability: Each night, choose 2 players: they are covertly swapped as targets & (if you like) swap ability control, until dusk.
syncret_diabolo.otherNightReminder: Remove the "retarget" or "control" s. Let Diabolo choose 2 players, mark both either with "retarget" s or "control" s. (Diabolo may signal or tell you which ones.) Any player with "retarget" is swapped for the other player with "retarget" for queries & choices & effects. Players with "control" reminder additionally switch control over the character/abilities with the other player with "control" reminder (don't explicitly tell them).

syncret_favourite.ability: The Story Teller tries to answer all your game facts questions truely & obeys you within the rules.
syncret_favourite.otherNightReminder: The Favourite might wake for questions, for the Grimoire or to make a story teller decision. Anytime, they may request any game-related info + certain story telling and interpretation of rules. You obey them as long as their ability works. Illegal requests have no effect. The ability may be used publicly.

syncret_frustrator.ability: Each night, choose 1 player: if executed, they don't die but are poisoned next cycle & the Story Teller controls the Demon next night.
syncret_frustrator.otherNightReminder: Remove any "saved". Let the Frustrator point at one player and add the "saved" to them in the Grimoire. At night or at day, if anyone would kill a player with the Frustrator's "saved" reminder, flip the "saved" reminder upside-down. A player with upside-down "saved" reminder is poisoned. When a player has the upside-down "saved" reminder while the Demon acts at night, ignore the Demon's attack targets and change the attack targets after the Demon chose.

syncret_gnostic.ability: Even if you died: Demons & alive players win if evil wins. The others win if good wins & learn 1 demon player. No resurrections. The game ends if all alive players support it.
syncret_gnostic.otherNightReminder: When a player has died, wake them at night, show them "this is the Demon" and point to the Demon player. You might inform dead players about being informed by the Gnostic character (don't show the Gnostic player). At day or night, if a player would resurrect, they don't. The game also ends if a player calls for an end where 100% of alive players support it as long as the Gnostic is in the script. Dead players might be allowed to call for it. When the game ends, alive players win if evil would win, dead players win if good would win and Demons (evil and good) only win if evil wins.

syncret_identitythief.ability: Once per game, choose 1 other player: learn their character. Until they die or the game ends: You both play their player & they might register as you.
syncret_identitythief.otherNightReminder: If no victim exists, the Identity Thief may point at a player (even travellers) or makes a choice at day. Mark them with "victim". The Identity Thief learns their character. While the game has not ended and the victim is alive, the Identity Thief & victim share the victim's abilities, properties and (ability) states. The victim might register as the Identity Thief's ones. The Identity Thief wakes just after the victim. Once-per-game-actions are used by who uses them first. Later choices overwrite former ones. Info is yielded independently. The Idendity Thief forwards actions, effects & interactions to the victim.

syncret_medusa.ability: Players, being mad about your evilness or this cycle's true insights on you, become "unconscious" & lose abilities from then on.
syncret_medusa.otherNightReminder: If a player has been mad about the (actual) Medusa player being evil, minion or demon: add a "incapacitated" to them. If a player shares true insights on the Medusa's properties based on any ability of this cycle, mark them with "incapacitated" if not already. Players marked "incapacitated" don't wake, can't act anymore in the game and have no abilities.

jinxes.reason: If the Storyteller would gain the Medusa ability, a player becomes the Medusa.

syncret_neurohacker.ability: Each night, choose 1 to become dysinformed, then 1 to become dyseffective. Until dusk. Learn how many of both were impacted.
syncret_neurohacker.otherNightReminder: At dusk, remove any "dysinformed" and "dyseffective" reminders. Let the Neurohacker choose 1 player (including themself and dead players). Add the "dysinformed" reminder to them. Afterwards, let them choose 1 player (including the same one as before). Add the "dyseffective" reminder to them. Sleep. If you play the night ability of a player with "dysinformed" reminder and gave false info, add the "effective" reminder. If you play the night ability for a player with "dyseffective" reminder and caused false state changes, add the "effective" reminder (if not already). At dawn, wake up the Neurohacker and show them the number of players with "effective" reminder. Sleep. Remove the "effective" reminders.

syncret_populist.ability: Even if you died: Good players get each info in a pair with false info. They don't know which is true. Minion & Demon info additionally show character info.
syncret_populist.firstNightReminder: When you give Minion or Demon info (or a replacement info), you also show the evil character to each pointed player (if all pointed players have an evil character) or you show a list of evil characters that are in play. (In case of a Poppy Grower, you show them that a Populist is in play but not which player.) Rest: See Other Night Reminder.
syncret_populist.otherNightReminder: For each good player at night (or day), whenever you would show an info signal (e.g. a thumb, a number, a player, a character…), you show it simultaneously with 1 additional false info signal. Use your own general sorting order between signals to show a set of signals always in the same way such that players cannot see which hand shows the false signal.

syncret_tyrantt.ability: All Townsfolk additionally have 1 outsider character. Everyone or nobody knows which one.
syncret_tyrantt.firstNightReminder: Choose an outsider ability for the Tyrant that every Townsfolk should get. Add a "tyrant" with the character in the Grimoire center. Everyone who registers as Townsfolk to the Tyrant player (possibly even minionss) has its ability and might register as it. After dawn, you might declare that a Tyrant with this outsider ability is in play (for balancing reasons).
syncret_tyrantt.otherNightReminder: Take care of the outsider ability of everyone who registers as Townsfolk.

jinxes.reason: If the Alchemist has the Tyrant ability, the Alchemist is an Outsider, not a Townsfolk.

syncret_epidemon.ability: Each night, choose 1 player. If not yourself: you swap character + alignment & die & win only if evil wins until Epidemon moves again.
syncret_epidemon.otherNightReminder: After the last evil killing ability, wake Epidemon to choose 1 player. If the player is dead by now, inform Epidemon about that (e.g. using a "dead" gesture). Let them confirm or choose someone else. If Epidemon chooses themself, nothing happens. If another player is chosen, then swap (only) character AND alignment between the choosing and chosen players. Move (or add) the "evil" to the choosing player who dies. Inform all affected players (up to 3) of alignment+character changes. Once a player lost the Epidemon character, the die and (if it succeeds) the Demon-kill is triggered on their new ability in this night. Any player with "evil" reminder has the evil alignment (which – for the time being – masks the other alignment that they got from the new Epidemon player).

syncret_lleedh.ability: Each night, choose 1 player to kill. You start knowing a Townsfolk: they are poisoned & their ability works abnormally - you die only if they die.
syncret_lleedh.firstNightReminder: Choose 1 townsfolk player as the Lleedh host. Add the "Poisoned" to them. This player is chosen such that their poisoned ability is distinguishable from their healthy ability. Inform the Lleedh about this player as their host.
syncret_lleedh.otherNightReminder: The player with Lleedh's "Poisoned" reminder has an ability which generally works abnormally by a rule, condition or just gets only false info. This must be a subset of a poisoned ability. Now, let the Lleedh choose 1 player. If unprotected, that player dies and gets the "Dead". If Lleedh is assassinated or slayed, the host dies with them.

syncret_monstro.ability: Each night, alive evil Minions choose 1 non-traveller who gets Monstro (covertly) & is poisoned (if good). 1 alive Monstro neighbour dies each night. [+1 Minion]
syncret_monstro.firstNightReminder: No Demon info! Wake all evil Minions together, allow alive ones to vote by pointing at 1 player (no Traveller) who might register as the Monstro. If good, this player is also poisoned. Move the Monstro token to this player. Without votes/consent, don't move Monstro.
syncret_monstro.otherNightReminder: See First Night Reminder. Also, 1 alive neighbour of the Monstro player dies. (You may ask evil players which but your choice.)

syncret_nimp.ability: On night 1, choose 1 player to get neutral with you. Each night, choose 1 player to kill. When you get neutral, you only swap characters with your killer (or 1 player) at death.
syncret_nimp.firstNightReminder: After the Demon Info, let the Nimp point at 1 player (including themself). Add the "neutral" to the Nimp, then a "neutral" to the pointed player. You may only add a "neutral" reminder if < 3 other players are already neutral.
syncret_nimp.otherNightReminder: The Nimp points to a player. That player dies. At day or night, if the Nimp dies, the Nimp swaps characters with 1 player. Show the 'You are' card, then the new character to both players individually.

syncret_ponon.ability: Each night, choose 1 player: they die. Chosen players stay evil until you kill again.
syncret_ponon.otherNightReminder: Let Ponon choose 1 player. Add an "evil" to the player and a "dead" to denote being chosen by the demon. The "evil" reminder makes the actual alignment being ignored. Inform players when they switch alignment towards the winning condition.

syncret_storytellerdemon.ability: Others think you are the Story Teller & that the Story Teller is the Demon. [Apatheist always in play]
syncret_storytellerdemon.firstNightReminder: See Other Night Reminder. The Story Teller gets true Demon info. Minion and Traveller info shows the Story Teller as Demon.
syncret_storytellerdemon.otherNightReminder: The Story Teller tries to play the Demon character. You play the actual Demon ability. You may tweak game rules if it is required to avoid a direct evil lose.
syncret_storytellerdemon.flavor: Welcome to a new game of blood and clocktowers!

syncret_vampiredemon.ability: Each night, choose 1 player: they become a not-in-play evil minion of your choice and/or die. Once per game, a Vampire can be made & you die instead. [0 minions]
syncret_vampiredemon.firstNightReminder: The game starts without minions and minion info. Rest: See Other Night Reminder
syncret_vampiredemon.otherNightReminder: Let the Vampire choose a player and a minion character (or the Vampire character). If the chosen minion character is not in play, turn the player into this minion character and evil alignment. You might decide to let this chosen player die, based on the number of in-play evil players, chosen players or chosen minion chararcters. If the Vampire is chosen as character and there is no "jumped" reminder yet, turn the chosen player into a Vampire, add the "jumped" reminder to both Vampires, and let the original Vampire die (add a shroud). If the chosen player does not change into the chosen character, they die.

jinxes.reason: The Vampire knows if a Preacher is in play. If the Vampire is in play, the Preacher turns minions into good players with their original character.
If the Vampire is chosen by the Exorcist, no-one dies but making a minion might also fail.

syncret_avenger.ability: When a player learns they died, they may ask for vengeance. If you (privately) agree, they receive it unless this would kill an Outsider or end the game.
syncret_avenger.flavor: I've consented to trade what meager life I still have for a less insulting end to this story. Your consent was your crime. Let's not pretend this is anything other than us coming together in agreement just because now you fear oblivion.

syncret_druglord.ability: Each night, choose 1 player: their nomination fails the ballot (except on the final day).
syncret_druglord.otherNightReminder: Remove the "drugged". Let the Drug Lord choose 1 player (except if the next day is a final day). Mark them with "drugged". A drugged player's nomination will not pass the ballot even if it would succeed.

syncret_factchecker.ability: Each night, choose 2 players who don't misregister (even to drunk/poisoned abilities) and – if you are evil – swap registrations, this cycle.
syncret_factchecker.otherNightReminder: At dusk, remove any "checked" s. The Fact Checker points at two players. Add the "checked" to both. Any queried properties of players with "checked" reminder are correct, bypassing misregistration, even if queried by impaired abilities. If the Fact Checker is evil, the queried properties of both "checked" players are swapped additionally.

syncret_influencer.ability: Once per game, choose 1 player. They get to know you & also win if you win this cycle, even if they would not.
syncret_influencer.otherNightReminder: If the influencer has no "used" reminder, wake the influencer to point at a player. Add the "fan" to this player and the "used" to the influencer player in the Grimoire. Wake the player with "fan" reminder, inform them, that the "Influencer" chose them and which alignment the influencer has. If the game ends and if players with the Influencer's alignment win, the player with "fan" reminder would win as well (this is evaluated after all other winning conditions and abilities). At dusk, if a player has the "fan" reminder (from last night), remove the "fan".

syncret_prevaricator.ability: You globally invert the success of specific player state transitions. You know which. All players know which when you die. You might be hidden + a Townsfolk/Minion.
syncret_prevaricator.firstNightReminder: Choose a player state transition for the Traveller. Wake the Traveller and show them the player state transition whose success is inverted. Note down the transition in the grimoire. The states at setup time or at the first dusk are not affected. If you want to protect the Traveller from being killed early, give them a Townsfolk ability (if good) or a Minion ability (if evil) and treat the Prevaricator as a Townsfolk or Minion for various game aspects as you see fit (e.g. you might declare the Traveller character but not the player or replace a setup townsfolk or minion with the Traveller and give them true Minion info). Rest: See Other Night Reminder.
syncret_prevaricator.otherNightReminder: If the Prevaricator has an ability, let them use this ability at the proper time. Whenever a player state transition would happen during the game that coincides with the transition of a Prevaricator, this transition is suppressed, if it would have succeeded, and the transition succeeds, if it would have been suppressed. The Prevaricator has no effect on player state while no transition is triggered. The Prevaricator is always exiled, not executed. When the Prevaricator dies, declare the player state transitions which have been inverted by this Traveller, if it was not declared already.

syncret_psychotherapist.ability: Each even night, choose 1 player: they get their natural alignment (if you are good) or register as neutral (if you are evil).
syncret_psychotherapist.firstNightReminder: Add the "pause" to the Psychotherapist in the Grimoire.
syncret_psychotherapist.otherNightReminder: If the Psychotherapist has a "pause" reminder, remove the "pause" and let them choose 1 player. Add a "client" to this player. If the Psychotherapist is evil, rotate the "client" reminder upside down. If the Psychotherapist has no "pause" reminder, add a "pause" to them in the Grimoire. A player with "client" reminder always registers as the aligmment, character and character type corresponding to an actual character that they have. If the "client" reminder is rotated, the player additionally registers as opposite alignment. The next time the player changes their properties, remove the "client" from that player.

syncret_commentator.ability: At day, the story teller partially reveals secrets by making an anonymized public comment on game events.

syncret_patron.ability: Any player who chooses ≥ 2 people or things doesn't need to only choose distinct people or things.

syncret_spiritofirony.ability: There can't be more than 1 extra evil player with respect to actual alignment and in-play demon.

syncret_concealer.ability: You might conceal any other in-play Fabled and Lorics. You declare the total number of concealed Lorics plus Fabled.

syncret_dazzler.ability: Townsfolk and Outsiders think they are Townsfolk or Outsider. Minions and Demons think they are Minion or Demon.
syncret_dazzler.firstNightReminder: During the setup, for each character in the setup, find another character of equal alignment but different character type. Mark demon player(s) with "demon", outsider players with "outsider". See other night reminder.
syncret_dazzler.otherNightReminder: For each player, play the abilities of both players. If marked "outsider", the outsider ability is not drunkened. If marked "demon" the demon ability is not drunkened. Otherwise, the townsfolk or minion ability is not drunkened.

jinxes.reason: Drunk Abilities which see the Grimoire don't see Dazzler reminder tokens.
Drunk Abilities which see the Grimoire don't see Dazzler reminder tokens.

syncret_demontamer.ability: Multiple equal Demon characters can be in play. [1 Demon OR -2 Minions & +1 Demon & +2 Outsiders OR -3 Minions & +2 Demons & +1 Outsider]

syncret_duelist.ability: Each nominee for the execution duels their nominator (in a mini game). The loser is executed.

syncret_fascist.ability: Each night, alive minions choose 1 player: if good they die+quit, else the Demon kills. Good players are exiled, not executed. You cannot die if minions live. Good wins if & only if you die. [+1 evil arbitrary player]
syncret_fascist.firstNightReminder: Declare that the Fascist is in play. Instead of a Demon, you may add an evil player of any character type to the setup, e.g. an Outsider. If no Demon character is added to the setup, each Minion Info also yields the same 3 character bluffs.
syncret_fascist.otherNightReminder: Let each alive minion choose ≤ 1 player (individually). Among the most chosen players, you decide the final choice. This player dies (if unprotected). Add the "quit" to this player. Players with "quit" reminder cannot interact or act anymore within the game, only communicate, sleep and walk. Only when the game ended, quit persons revert back to players with their most recent state & properties. Only if no minion is alive, wake alive Demon players to act tonight. At day, good players are nominated like normally but the condition for a successful ballot changes: ≥ 1 good+alive player must vote AND the votes are ≥ 50% of alive players or all alive good players have voted. Else, the ballot for a good player fails. Any executions of good players become exiles. Dead players regain their vote token when the nominee is exiled. Nothing changes with nominations of red players. When quit persons nominate, the ballot fails even if the success condition is satisfied. If the Fascist would die while ≥ 1 player of minion type is alive, the Dictator doesn't die. The good team only wins if they kill the Dictator. The game ends if 1 regular player is left alive (not 2). The red team (also) may win if ≥ 50% of the alive regular players are minions (except if red players don't know each other).
syncret_fascist.flavor: I could stand in the middle of 5th Avenue and shoot somebody, and I wouldn't lose voters.

syncret_immortalrole.ability: Nominations are not regulated. Invalid nominations fail covertly. ≤ 1 good player is Immortal: Only your character dies, not the player. If it died, deads can nominate & each of your dead votes gives another 1 dead evil player +1 vote token next night.
syncret_immortalrole.flavor: The 1st time, my train derailed into an icy river but I managed to swim to the riverside.The 2nd time, I survived a plane crash at landing, being suck out of the door but cushioned by hay, while everyone else died.The 3rd time, my bus skidded into a river, I could swim to the riverside but some others could not do it.The 4th time, my car took fire while I was driving it. It exploded but I could crawl out of it.3 years later the same even happened again.The 6th time, …(Frane Selak)

syncret_inspectorrole.ability: ≤1 player is Inspector: Deadly executions turn into arrest. At night, arrested players might choose+learn you. "yes" reveals their character to you & re-enables nominating+abilities. Evil players always choose on their first arrest. A "no" or 2nd arrest leads to permanent abilities loss.

syncret_introvert.ability: You are an impartial player with a not-in-play character (no demon, no traveller). Each day, certain players may privately ask about or guess it once. Who names your ability gets to know what you did or saw last night.
syncret_introvert.firstNightReminder: Find a not-in-play character (which also is not a bluff) that you can use as a player. It should be useful or interesting for others to guess and which might let you talk about hypothetical things that you do or experience with this character.
syncret_introvert.otherNightReminder: At days, allow players to ask a "yes"/"no"-question about your character or ability or else allow them to guess. You may impose an arbitrary (known or unknown) condition or limit of who or how many you allow to guess. Each of them may ask OR guess only once per day. Each day when they guess your character right, you tell about what happened to you as player or what you did.

syncret_liar.ability: You may say false things about Blood on the Clocktower, the wiki or the game rules to deceive players. [No new or beginner players]
syncret_liar.firstNightReminder: You must declare that you use the Loric Liar, even if you don't declare other Lorics or Fabled. The Liar must not apply to Homebrew rules and characters.
syncret_liar.otherNightReminder: The Liar must not apply to Homebrew rules and characters.

syncret_nightmare.ability: Non-Demon players think to be 1 good or 1 minion character. The Demon chooses (covertly) which players are Minions. No minion info. [? equal Minions,? Outsiders]
syncret_nightmare.firstNightReminder: The player with "demon" reminder has the Demon character, other players (who are not publicly known to be a Traveller) draw a good character and a minion character. When giving Demon Info, the Demon chooses Minions instead of learning them. Mark each with "minion". Players with "minion" reminder have the good character drunkened, others the minion character. As a result, multiple players with equal minion character or a different number of outsiders may be in play. Rest: See Other Night Reminder.
syncret_nightmare.otherNightReminder: For each non-Demon player, wake them when their minion ability would wake at night, show them the Minion character and let them play the ability. The ability is drunk if the player has a "drunk ‹minion›" reminder. Do the same for the good character ability of each player whose ability is drunk if they have a "drunk ‹townsfolk›" reminder or "drunk ‹outsider›" reminder.

syncret_pardoner.ability: Until next dusk, winners of nominations give their character to an unknown player. Afterwards, nomination supporters vote to execute the winner or not.

syncret_plotterrole.ability: ≤ 1 minion is the Plotter: If you live or Story Teller is executed, winning Townsfolk/Demons don't win, else winning Outsiders/Minions. Night 1 has alignment-separated Plotter info for minions and outsider. You choose your registration. If guessed publicly, the Demon kills you. On night X, Townsfolk & Demons are deranged until dusk. [X Outsiders]
syncret_plotterrole.firstNightReminder: If you want, turn 1 minion into the Plotter, add the Plotter token in the Grimoire, otherwise ignore the Plotter's night steps. Count all outsider tokens in the setup. You can add or remove outsiders arbitrarily. Fabled are ignored which restrict outsiders. This number of outsiders is X. Wake the Plotter to choose a character+alignment to register as tonight (regarding abilties AND the game rules). This may affect the minion + demon info step that happens afterwards. First show the minion and demon info. After demon info: Wake the Plotter and show them 1 not-in-play townsfolk and 1 not-in-play outsider (no demon bluffs). Afterwards, let the Plotter choose any players (no Demons & no Travellers) to get a minion character they wish (give no feedback if a wish fails e.g. when the character is already in play or because of your regulation). Wake all outsiders (except the Plotter), let them know the other outsiders and show who is the Plotter. Sleep. For each alignment, wake all minions (except the Plotter), let them know the other minions of equal alignment and show them the Plotter. Sleep. Wake the Plotter, show all final minions (no demons). Sleep. Rest: see Other Night Reminder.
syncret_plotterrole.otherNightReminder: At day, if someone validly guesses the Plotter player, the Demon has to choose the Plotter next night. Each Townsfolk & Demons can make 1 valid guess per game. After a valid guess is made, no other guess is valid at the day. There are no wasted guessing attempts. On night X (= setup number of outsiders), first make every townsfolk and demon deranged. If X = 0, it never triggers. Even when the Plotter died, the Plotter chooses to (mis)register their character+alignment after dusk AND before dawn. When the game ends, outsiders, minions and Plotter abilities win, if any Plotter lives OR if the Story Teller was executed. Else, Townsfolk & Demons win. Players lose if their alignment loses. Everyone else has a draw.
syncret_plotterrole.flavor: I am having a goal! The town of Ravenswood Bluff... WILL BE MINE!!! You shall be fearing me! I HAVE FURY!!

syncret_polymathrole.ability: On night 1, ≤1 good Townsfolk becomes outsider+Polymath: On night/day X, play ≤1 bluffable townsfolk/minion. Any chosen ability after X choices might overdrive. You register as evil. The evil might know your character. [1 evil Townsfolk/Outsider]
syncret_polymathrole.firstNightReminder: If you want, you can add 1 extra outsider who is Polymath. If you don't, ignore the Polymath night steps. Inform them to be the Polymath. The polymath must be good at setup time. You might change and inform 1 good character player to be evil, preferably an outsider. Choose a fairly compensating not-in-play outsider for the polymath from the script. Show it to the Polymath and put them to sleep. If you think, it's fair for the evil to know, wake the demon and possibly evil players with weak evil value and tell them that the polymath is that outsider. Poisoned minions may get false info. Rest: see Other Night Reminder
syncret_polymathrole.otherNightReminder: Present the polymath a script to choose a character from (townsfolk or minion) early in the night. You may disallow choices and prompt to choose again. Disallow any choices that (would) confirm the Polymath player or cannot be bluffed by good/evil players. (For this, remember any Polymath ability choices that you arranged privately at day if applicable.) Sleep. When the Polymath has chosen the N-th ability – where N > current day+night cycle – you might add the "overdriven" (= drunk + deranged) to the Polymath player. An overdriven player is either drunk or deranged, whatever helps the opposite team more. Else remove the overdriven of the Polymath if applicable. Later in the night, play the chosen character (directly after an equal in-play character would play). Do not allow the Polymath to change the demon character or person and show no grimoire. If the Polymath plays a once-per-game ability, add the "special night". If this reminder is already set, don't allow it. Sleep. Finally after dawn, they might choose an ability sometime at the day, directly in a private talk or indirectly via public claim, which is decided the same way as the choice of the night ability. It might work or not. If the Polymath plays a once-per-game ability, add the "special day". If this reminder is already set, don't allow it.

jinxes.reason: If the Polymath is a Lunatic, the demons and Polymath don't know who is Lunatic and who is a real demon. Genuine demons have a drunk polymath ability and don't know that they are really the demon. The polymath has a drunk Demon ability who learns fake Lunatic choices from the story teller.

syncret_quine.ability: Each night, a new player sees 1 player. The seen players have something in common at the time of seeing them. Players can cast a ballot to decide who gets the next info.
syncret_quine.firstNightReminder: Find a common game-related property that multiple players (at least 2) share. Wake the first player who sees one of those players.
syncret_quine.otherNightReminder: At day, allow players to volunteer or use a ballot to determine who should be next. Each player can receive this info only once per game. At night, wake this player or choose one by yourself if no-one was determined. Show 1 player who currently shares a common property with the other players when they were pointed at. At least 2 different players are shown until the game ends.

syncret_redeemerrole.ability: ≤ 1 good player is Redeemer: if you are healthy+sober+alive after a death, good wins. You resurrect after X nights (X = #good-alive-votes, else #alive-evil). Evil players also know you. If sober/healthy, you only die from execution if "#good-votes – #evil-votes" is either ≤ 1 or passes the nomination limit.
syncret_redeemerrole.flavor: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever.

syncret_saboteurrole.ability: ≤1 good player is Saboteur: executees - you raise your hand for - are falsely declared dead but they don't act/wake anymore at night. ≤1 evil player learns about these events. Sabotaged executees are declared on your death.

syncret_shopkeeper.ability: Players can earn coins for each game-related quest, achievement or minigame they win. They can spend coins for immediate item effects from you.
syncret_shopkeeper.firstNightReminder: Define the items that you want to offer during the game (up to 4 for each alignment is sufficient). Choose achievements, quests and minigames such as with the Zenomancer and their reward in coins. Decide about item prices based on the player number of an alignment and the available rewards. Of course, you also may use physical coins.
syncret_shopkeeper.otherNightReminder: You may declare all shop offers (for good and evil) at the beginning or only when people ask you (only show them the offer for their character type!). People may accomplish achievements at any day or night. When people purchase an item/upgrade from you, add its reminder to the player in the grimoire (and possibly the day number when they purchased it). The item/upgrade is effective from now on. If you figure out that someone illegitimately got the coins for the purchase, you remove their reminder again.

syncret_supervisor.ability: Beginners don't die before day 3 and their death or uncovering does not lead to a strong disadvantage of their team. You can choose characters for them.

syncret_townplanner.ability: Players successively learn their start character when they wake on night 1. The Story Teller or prior night abilities may alter them beforehand. Lorics can be declared on dawn 1.
syncret_townplanner.firstNightReminder: You may declare (and explain) some Lorics when players wake up instead of before the first night. When your setup is finished, randomly assign your setup characters to available players. Then you may carry out a sequence of character swaps such that certain players get the character that you want them to have. Now, start waking players according to the night sheet. Wake players first whose ability alters other players' start characters. Wake all players to inform them about their character, even if they would not wake up with their character.

syncret_trustmaker.ability: Anyone who declares trust for a player: your vote doesn't register for their nomination. While alive at their deadly execution (not supported by you), you: learn their private character+alignment & get – or (if evil) misregister as – unconscious from now on.
syncret_trustmaker.otherNightReminder: Check that you updated who trusts who during the day by adding the "trusted by" reminder to the trustee player. Do not use "trusted by X" or "treason by X" reminders when the player X has a "trust used" reminder. There is only one "trusted by" and "treason by" reminder per player. If the truster supported the execution for their trustee, e.g. a void vote for the executed trustee, indicate the treason by adding the "treason by X" reminder to the trustee player or remember it. With a "treason" reminder, trusters don't get character+alignment info. But if they get it, add the "trust used" reminder to the receiving player until the end of the game. A player with "trust used" reminder is unconscious except for evil players, i.e. their nomination fails, their vote fails and don't wake up except for seeing their character/alignment change). When the truster actively defends a trustee against execution, remove a treason reminder if applicable.
syncret_trustmaker.flavor: My good friend, as we are forced to leave this dire world, I trust you my secret, I am actually your father.

casa_auditor.ability: You start knowing a player and a character. The character is in play if & only if the player is good.
casa_auditor.firstNightReminder: Show the character token marked KNOWS and point to the player marked GOOD or EVIL.
casa_auditor.flavor: Now I see that you have payed everything you needed to pay and recieved everything you needed to recieve. What I worry about, is this tiny abnormality here...

casa_meteorologist.ability: Each day, you may visit the Storyteller to learn an event they think will happen tonight or tomorrow.
casa_meteorologist.flavor: 100 in Terrell. Right now in Terrell and in Dallas. Your, your heat index is 107. Everyone in McKinney is dead. The temperature-the heat index right now in McKinney is 10,000. What is that? 101,105. It's hot in McKinney.

casa_instructor.ability: Once per game, during the day, visit the Storyteller to learn which was good's biggest mistake but not why.
casa_instructor.flavor: Your Plié is rather abrupt, your Tourner clusmy and your Sauter absolutely horrendous... And please, don't get me started on your hideous Relever.

casa_defector.ability: The 1st time the Demon kills a Minion, you become evil, even if you are executed.
casa_defector.otherNightReminder: If the Demon killed a Minion for the 1st time, wake the Defector. Show the YOU ARE info token & give a thumbs down.

jinxes.reason: The 1st time the Leviathan nominates & executes a Minion, the Defector turns Evil.
The 1st time the Leviathan nominates & executes a Minion, the Defector turns Evil.

casa_defector.flavor: The worst part of betrayal, is that it always comes from a friend. Well, to me its the BEST part!

casa_peasant.ability: Evil starts knowing you are in play. [-? to +? Outsiders, all Outsiders are Peasants]
casa_peasant.firstNightReminder: During evil info, show the evil players the Peasant token. If you haven't done this yet, do so now.

jinxes.reason: The Hermit can create Peasants during setup, but can't become one.
The Huntsman's setup ability ignores the Peasant's one.

casa_peasant.flavor: Aye, forgive me mine lord, but what is a demon?

casa_spellslinger.ability: All players know you are the Spellslinger. You cannot die during the day. You start knowing 3 spells, each day, you may publicly use 1.
casa_spellslinger.firstNightReminder: Show the Spellslinger each of the spell's names & ability.

jinxes.reason: The Storyteller doesn't declare the Spellslinger is in play.
If the Spellslinger loses their ability, they learn this, and cannot die during the day.
The Storyteller doesn't declare the Spellslinger is in play.
If the Spellslinger is babysitting Lil' Monsta, they die when executed.
If the Spellslinger is in play, the Magician has no ability but is immune to the Spellslinger's spells.
If the Spellslinger loses their ability, they learn this, and cannot die during the day.

casa_spellslinger.flavor: The amathēs fear that which they can't understand. The sophos, relishes in it.

casa_pursuer.ability: A player holds your token, each night: they may pass it, then, you learn which character has it. If you can publicly guess (once) who has it, their team loses.
casa_pursuer.firstNightReminder: Give the Pursuer token to any player, they may choose a player to pass the token to. then, the Pursuer wakes to learn holder's character.
casa_pursuer.otherNightReminder: The Pursuer token's holder may choose a player to pass the token to. then, the Pursuer wakes to learn holder's character.

jinxes.reason: An Alchemist-Pursuer has no Pursuer ability & a Pursuer is in play. If the Alchemist-Pursuer can publicly guess (once) who has the Pursuer's token, the Pursuer becomes drunk (even if the Alchemist-Pursuer dies).
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.

casa_pursuer.flavor: I will find them! I will find them if I have to burn down all of Ravenswood Bluff!

casa_adviser.ability: The Storyteller might wake you to see the grimoire & make a decision in their stead (the Storyteller can decline or alter them).

jinxes.reason: An Alchemist-Adviser has no Adviser ability & an Adviser is in play. After each execution, a living Alchemist-Adviser may publicly guess a living player as the Adviser. If correct, the Demon must choose the Adviser tonight.
If the Adviser is (or has been) in play, the Damsel is poisoned.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
When the Adviser sees the Grimoire, the Demon and Magician's character tokens are removed.
The Adviser may be woken at night to decide what info the Meteorologist gets tomorrow.
If the Poppy Grower has their ability, the Adviser does not see the Grimoire.
The Adviser may be woken at night to decide what info the Savant gets tomorrow.

casa_adviser.flavor: Indeed, an incompetent jester can't crack a singular joke that is even remotely near of a chuckle. I'm afraid I will have to step in, it's time you were given the education you lacked of as a pendulant child.

casa_drackhuhlahh.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Minions you kill this way keep their ability & may choose a not in play Minion to become.
casa_drackhuhlahh.otherNightReminder: The Drackhuhlahh chooses a player. If that player is a Minion, they may choose a not in-play Minion to become.

jinxes.reason: A Mastermind that has their ability keeps it if the Drackhuhlahh dies.
If a dead Minion has the Baron's ability, up to 2 players become Outsiders.
If a dead Minion has the Scarlet Woman's ability, another Minion has it instead & learns this.
If a dead Minion has the Fearmonger's ability, another Minion has it instead & learns this.
If a dead Minion has the Evil Twin's ability, another Minion has it instead & learns this.
If a dead Minion has the Marionette's ability, they don't & a good neighbour of the Demon becomes an Evil Marionette, this can happen once.
If a dead Minion has the Summoner's ability, they don't & the Demon may swap characters with a Minion, then, the Demon may choose a new Demon character to become.
If a dead Minion has the Boomdandy's ability, another Minion has it instead & learns this.
If a dead Minion has the Goblin's ability, another Minion has it instead & learns this.

casa_drackhuhlahh.flavor: Shed your skins, mortals, it is time you join me as your true selves for the eternal night.

casa_haifmynd.ability: Evil players wake when other evil players do. Each night, choose a player: they die.

jinxes.reason: The Lunatic can't think they are the Haifmynd.
While the Magician is alive, evil players wake separately to learn what other evil players learnt or chose.
If the Haifmynd & the Poppy Grower are alive, evil players don't wake when others do.
Both twins wake separately to learn each other's character.
The Wraith's ability can't cause other evil players to open their eyes at any time.

casa_haifmynd.flavor: We are gods We are gods We are gods We are invincible We are invincible We are invincible We are sin We are sin We are sin

casa_geneticist.ability: You start knowing 2 abilities. Each night, you may choose a player & an ability you haven't given: they now have that ability.
casa_geneticist.firstNightReminder: Show the Geneticist their ability, they may choose a player & a yet to be given out ability to give them.:reminder
casa_geneticist.otherNightReminder: The Geneticist may choose a player & a yet to be given out ability to give them.:reminder
casa_geneticist.flavor: Don't question the method, just, trust it...

casa_shootingstar.ability: Players may privately choose up to 3 characters before drawing a token from the bag. The Storyteller might assign them as 1.
casa_shootingstar.flavor: If only I could feel what those close to me feel, I would give anything...

casa_branch.ability: This script contains characters being used as different types. Demons & only Demons each night, choose a player: they die.
casa_branch.flavor: Think the original as a tree and it's branches as decisions. Have you ever wondered how far were you from the tree? It's truly a question not even I could answer, we are so far we can't even see the tree that gave us light to begin with. Does that tree even exist anymore? Did it ever exist?

midsummer_bard.ability: Each day, publicly choose any players: Townsfolk among them are drunk until you choose again. Tonight, learn how many you made drunk.
midsummer_bard.otherNightReminder: Tell them how many players are currently drunk due to their ability.
midsummer_bard.flavor: Every soul my fingertips touch falls into dream. While you stagger in your cups, I count the trembling strings... three? five? Those numbers will tell me how many 'honest men' betray the shape of lies within their sweet dreams.

midsummer_perfumer.ability: Once per game, at night, you may choose a player or an evil character: they learn the Perfumer is in play.
midsummer_perfumer.firstNightReminder: Let them choose a player or a character.
midsummer_perfumer.otherNightReminder: Let them choose a player or a character.
midsummer_perfumer.flavor: Tonight I've prepared two perfumes: one frank as a love letter, the other... (suddenly leaning close) like a rose on a bear trap. Darling, guess which one you're smelling?

midsummer_donquixote.ability: 1 player registers as a Demon, even if you die. During the day, you may privately learn who, then another player will.
midsummer_donquixote.flavor: Look! That towering giant, waving its long arms, awaits my challenge! What? You say it's a windmill? No, no, you are mistaken. They move, they breathe, they mock my hesitation. My lance is ready, my steed is neighing. Don't hold me back, glory calls!

midsummer_codex.ability: Once per game, on your Xth night, choose players X times: they are poisoned until dusk. Players chosen multiple times die instead.
midsummer_codex.firstNightReminder: The number of nights they have been in play tonight is how many times they may choose (players).
midsummer_codex.otherNightReminder: The number of nights they have been in play tonight is how many times they may choose (players).
midsummer_codex.flavor: Program activated... instructions received. Executing operation on Target #1 once; target is expected to lose consciousness immediately. Executing operation on Target #2 twice; total cellular disintegration of the target is expected.

midsummer_archlich.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. The 1st time you choose each dead player, they choose 2 players: chosen non-demons die.
midsummer_archlich.flavor: I hear it. The unwillingness toward death in your soul, the hunger for power. The world fears you, but I admire you. Accept this gift. Your corpse shall become my first masterpiece; your will shall become the law that judges all living things. Breathe, this sweet terror... it shall be the first meal of your rebirth.

chamber_archduke.ability: 2 to 4 players have Outsider abilities, even if you die. You know who & they know which. [-1 Outsider]
chamber_archduke.flavor: Hmph! All you poor folk truly are not worth my time. I have important places to be and business to attend to while you lot... jest.

earth_ancienttext.ability: ??? X Ø? Y Z Z Z!.? Is from an in-play character. Ø is anything. Y is a number. You choose X. Z is a word.! Is for needed setup. [!]
earth_ancienttext.firstNightReminder: Wake the AncientTEXT and let they choose the value for their X slot. They may also wake again later if needed.
earth_ancienttext.otherNightReminder: The AncientTEXT may be woken if their ability requires them to be so.

jinxes.reason: The AncientTEXT "?" slot may also copy the Amnesiac ability given to them.

earth_metanarrative.ability: You hide a token from the Storyteller & each day, may choose to privately learn mistakes.
earth_metanarrative.flavor: This is not a Character. [ ] This is not a Homebrew belonging to Out of This Earth. [ ] I am Metanarrative. [ ] This character Manifestation is a shell. [ ] beyond your plane. [ ]

earth_nomad.ability: When both Nomads die, you swap games. [A Townsfolk Nomad with -1 Minion & a Minion Nomad with +1 Minion in different games]
earth_nomad.flavor: All that is gold does not glitter, Not all those who wander are lost.

earth_odd.ability: You receive & abide by a different rules sheet than that of default Clocktower. [This may bypass setup rules]
earth_odd.flavor: To play Werewolf in a group, you need at least five or six players. Each player has a role, either moderator, werewolf, seer, medic, or villager.

earth_turbobreaker.ability: You start knowing if you led to extra, fewer or identical Minion(s). [Minions are prioritized subtraction & addition]
earth_turbobreaker.firstNightReminder: The Turbobreaker wakes to learn if they led to extra, fewer or an identical amount of Minions than if they weren't in-play.

jinxes.reason: The Kazali picks the amount of Minions that the Turbobreaker setup effect would allow them.

earth_turbobreaker.flavor: There is a God, from the machine, the wheels will turn, and we will burn.

earth_skyaboveport.ability: After █2 dawn(s). This registers as -█ living player(s) only to win conditions. █ are Minions killed by the Demon. [Not a player]

jinxes.reason: If a Leviathan nominates & executes their Minion, the end comes 1 day sooner if the Sky Above Port is in-play.
Minions killed then regurgitated does not count towards the Sky Above Port's ability.

earth_skyaboveport.flavor: The color of a television, tuned to a dead channel.

earth_trololoo.firstNightReminder: Wake the trololoo if & when appropriate.
earth_trololoo.otherNightReminder: Wake the trololoo if & when appropriate.
earth_trololoo.flavor: Your abilities are scattered & hidden out of bounds, evidence is removed if you die.

earth_ccrrnc.ability: The pr|nt is ä!tērEđ; dead pLayers may wîthẽr their vote token & try to f!x It {çörrêct=k3pt}, even if you die.
earth_ccrrnc.flavor: My birds will avenge me! Fly! Fly, Fly! Fly! Fly! Fly! Fly! Fly! Fly! Fly! FLY. FLY FL

earth_supremearchetype.ability: You assign other' characters and also choose the seating formation & voting orders.

jinxes.reason: The Kazali learns the Supreme Archetype & choose the other Minions, if the Kazali makes a Supreme Archetype, they only change the seating formation & voting order.
The Supreme Archetype must choose an extra Townsfolk if they choose for the Damsel to be in-play. The Storyteller replaces 1 Townsfolk with the Damsel during setup.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
The Supreme Archetype choose two Demon, one of them becomes the Magician during setup.
If the Supreme Archetype assigns someone to be the Poppy Grower, they must only assign good characters & choose in-play evil character. Then the evil team is decided by the Storyteller during setup.
The Alchemist cannot have the Supreme Archetype's ability.

earth_supremearchetype.flavor: It was an All-in-One and One-in-All of limitless being and self—not merely a thing of one Space-Time continuum, but allied to the ultimate animating essence of existence’s whole unbounded sweep

earth_weewag.ability: The discussion phase takes place in Gartic Phone & you choose the settings. Each night, choose if you are drunk until dusk.

earth_fiefdom.ability: Each night choose an alive non-replica (not yourself): they replicate then die. Then pick 1 Fiefcommand for each replica. [-1 Minion]
earth_fiefdom.otherNightReminder: Wake the Fiefdom, they points to a player, that player is replicated, create a replica of them. Then that same player dies. Then, let the Fiefdom choose point to each replica and choose a Fiefcommand for each of them.

jinxes.reason: The Soldier is safe from the Fiefdom, but not the replicas abilities.
A replicated Vizier is controlled by the original one.
The Fiefdom learns if they replicated a golem.
The Fiefdom learns if they replicated a butler.
If the Fiefdom casts the Snake Charmer onto themselves, they learns this and nothing happens.

earth_fiefdom.flavor: I hear Jerusalem bells a-ringin' • Roman Cavalry choirs are singin' • Be my mirror, my sword and shield • My missionaries in a foreign field • For some reason I can't explain • I know Saint Peter won't call my name • Never an honest word... •...but that was when I ruled the world.

earth_nessie.ability: You view the main game, alive players may opt to leave it & sink to yours. Each night, pick a player to die. Good wins only if all evil are dead or sunken.
earth_nessie.otherNightReminder: Nessie wakes and name a player from either game to die.

jinxes.reason: 3 good players survives the explosion, players point at the floor to execute Nessie.
A Scarlet Woman becomes Nessie only if sunken.
The Marionette can be seated anywhere at the start, but must neighbor Nessie if they choose to sink.
Minions learn the Magician as their Demon instead of seeing a Nessie token.
If the Saint is "about to die" and sink, good loses.
All players learn if a sunken Minion tried to Damsel guess.

earth_nessie.flavor: Loch Ness is a deceptive lake in more ways than one... It's the perfect place for a shy lake monster to hide.

earth_sanchko.ability: Each night, choose 2 players: they die. 2 good players know Sanchko is in play, no Demon info. [Not on the sheet]
earth_sanchko.firstNightReminder: Wake 2 good players, one by one, to let them know Sanchko has come.
earth_sanchko.otherNightReminder: Wake the Sanchko, they point at any 2 players one by one, those players die.

earth_oicrikey.ability: Other animals may join as Travellers. Choose by touching & vote by moving.
earth_oicrikey.flavor: The Lion does not concern himself with flavor texts.

principia_accountant.ability: You start knowing 3 players who are either all the same or all different character types.

principia_telegrapher.ability: You start knowing a character neighboring the next clockwise Telegrapher. [+0 to +2 Telegraphers]
principia_telegrapher.firstNightReminder: Wake the Telegraphers one at a time and show the character token marked KNOW neighboring the next clockwise Telegrapher.

jinxes.reason: If there is a spare token, the Boffin can give the Demon the Telegrapher ability. If so, the Demon registers as a Telegrapher to the previous clockwise Telegrapher.

principia_sommelier.ability: Each night, choose 1 good & 1 evil character (not the Sommelier): you learn if exactly 1 is in play.
principia_sommelier.firstNightReminder: The Sommelier points at a good and an evil character on the character sheet. Give the head signal (nod yes, shake no) for whether exactly one of those characters is in play.
principia_sommelier.otherNightReminder: The Sommelier points at a good and an evil character on the character sheet. Give the head signal (nod yes, shake no) for whether exactly one of those characters is in play.

principia_cryptographer.ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): you learn a hand signal corresponding to their character type.
principia_cryptographer.firstNightReminder: The Cryptographer points at a player. Show the hand signal corresponding to that player's character type.
principia_cryptographer.otherNightReminder: The Cryptographer points at a player. Show the hand signal corresponding to that player's character type.

principia_informant.ability: You think you are a Townsfolk, but you receive false info. Once per game, a good player learns you are the Informant, even if you die.
principia_informant.firstNightReminder: Once, on any night, wake a good player. Point to the player marked IS THE INFORMANT and show the Informant character token.
principia_informant.otherNightReminder: Once, on any night, wake a good player. Point to the player marked IS THE INFORMANT and show the Informant character token.

jinxes.reason: If the Demon has the Informant ability, they think they have a different Townsfolk ability.
If the Vortox is in play, the Informant receives true information.

principia_clone.ability: You have a Townsfolk ability. Either you or that Townsfolk is drunk, even if you die.
principia_clone.firstNightReminder: Show the Clone the token of the Townsfolk ability they have.

principia_faerie.ability: One Townsfolk is secretly an Outsider, even if you die. You know them. [-0 or -1 Outsider]
principia_faerie.firstNightReminder: Point to the Changeling, then show the Faerie that player's Townsfolk and Outsider tokens.

jinxes.reason: If the Changeling is the Damsel, the Faerie does not learn the Changeling player or Townsfolk character.
The Changeling cannot be the Heretic.
The Changeling cannot be the Lunatic.
Any player may guess who the puzzledrunk player is, but if they are not the Puzzlemaster they receive arbitrary information.
The Changeling cannot be the Zealot.

principia_reaper.ability: If the last living marked character is executed, your team wins. [+1 marked character]

principia_fugitive.ability: Players who are mad about being an Outsider might register as evil & a Demon. [+1 Outsider]

principia_montebank.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Your Townsfolk neighbors register as evil Demons to Townsfolk.
principia_montebank.otherNightReminder: The Montebank points to a player. That player dies.

principia_effigy.ability: Each night, choose a player; they die. You start by choosing a Minion: while they live, you register as each other to Townsfolk.
principia_effigy.firstNightReminder: The Effigy points to a player. Place the "Likeness" reminder token.
principia_effigy.otherNightReminder: The Effigy points to a player. That player dies.

jinxes.reason: The Effigy and chosen Minion do not misregister to the Courtier.
If the Exorcist chooses the Effigy, they instead choose the Effigy's chosen Minion (and vice versa).
The Storyteller chooses for the Effigy on their first night.
The Storyteller chooses for the Effigy on their first night.
If the Preacher chooses the Effigy, they instead choose the Effigy's chosen Minion (and vice versa).
The Sage gets information if the Effigy kills them.
If the Snake Charmer chooses the Effigy, they instead choose the Effigy's chosen Minion (and vice versa).
The Storyteller chooses for the Effigy on their first night.

ratspath_leatherworker.ability: You start knowing a player. The 1st time they would die, they don't. [You might secretly be an Outsider]
ratspath_leatherworker.firstNightReminder: The Leatherworker is shown the player marked PROTECTED.

ratspath_bellmaker.ability: You start knowing an in play evil character. On night 3, even if you are dead, they become a different evil character.
ratspath_bellmaker.firstNightReminder: Wake the Bellmaker & show them the character token of the player marked [[EVIL SEEN]]
ratspath_bellmaker.otherNightReminder: If it is the 3rd night, wake the player marked [[EVIL SEEN]] and show them [[YOU ARE]] & their new, unique evil character.

jinxes.reason: If the Bellmaker creates a Baron, up to 2 players might become Outsiders.

ratspath_bellmaker.flavor: The armies of the dark lord are coming! They're coming very, very slowly, but you should still know!

ratspath_artisan.ability: Each night, you gain the ability of an alive neighbor until dusk. If exactly 1 of your alive neighbors is evil, you are drunk until this changes.
ratspath_artisan.firstNightReminder: Make the Artisan drunk or sober & choose an ability for them to have. -
ratspath_artisan.otherNightReminder: Make the Artisan drunk or sober & choose an ability for them to have. -
ratspath_artisan.flavor: A stroke here, a touch here, a streak carved through. A knot tied, a wish made, and someday this masterpiece will have been seen through.

ratspath_glassblower.ability: Each night, learn how many vote tokens were used by evil players today.
ratspath_glassblower.flavor: Windowpanes? The nerve! This is windowglass. My friend in the east village makes the panes.

ratspath_narcissus.ability: Once per game, at night, learn the player that could help you win the most.
ratspath_narcissus.firstNightReminder: Wake the Narcissus: they nod or shake their head. If they chose to use their ability, mark them with the [[NO ABILITY]] token and point at the player that could help them win the most.
ratspath_narcissus.otherNightReminder: Wake the Narcissus: they nod or shake their head. If they chose to use their ability, mark them with the [[NO ABILITY]] token and point at the player that could help them win the most.
ratspath_narcissus.flavor: Your gaze is stunning, darling, when you wear a mirror across it.

ratspath_lost.ability: You think you are a different Townsfolk character. Each night, an evil player is mad that something is true until dusk, or you learn them & that you are the Lost.

jinxes.reason: The Demon can't be affected by their own Lost ability.
The Mathematician learn if the Lost's ability yielded false info or failed to work properly. When the Lost learns they are the Lost, this ends.

ratspath_lost.flavor: Honey, do you remember where I left my... eh, I've forgotten what I'm even looking for.

ratspath_orchardist.ability: If the Demon kills you, neither team can win for 2 nights & 2 days.
ratspath_orchardist.otherNightReminder: If the Demon killed the Orchardist, mark them with the 1 token.
ratspath_orchardist.flavor: Smell that? That's the smell of rot! A good sign this time of year.

ratspath_hostess.ability: The 1st night a Minion is your alive neighbor, they learn this. If a Minion is not executed tomorrow, the Demon is drunk.
ratspath_hostess.firstNightReminder: If a Minion is the Hostess' alive neighbor, wake them and show them [[THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU]] and the Hostess token.
ratspath_hostess.otherNightReminder: If a Minion is the Hostess' alive neighbor, wake them and show them [[THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU]] and the Hostess token.

jinxes.reason: If the Hostess is the Marionette's alive neighbor, the Demon learns this instead of the Marionette, after they killed tonight.
If the Vizier nominates the Hostess & the Hostess is their alive neighbor, the Vizier may choose to execute immediately even if no good players voted.
While there is no Demon in play, the Summoner registers as a Demon to the Hostess.

ratspath_hostess.flavor: The regular? Ay, I'll get you the hot coffee, extra cream and sugar, and a side of almond pie! Bitter? Nay, I was told the latest shipment was edible enough.

ratspath_luckmonger.ability: Each night, something happens and you become the alignment of the team it benefited the most, even if you are dead.
ratspath_luckmonger.firstNightReminder: Something happens. Wake the Luckmonger and show them YOU ARE and their new alignment.
ratspath_luckmonger.otherNightReminder: Something happens. Wake the Luckmonger and show them YOU ARE and their new alignment.

jinxes.reason: If the Demon has the Luckmonger ability, they can't turn good this way & might learn what events occurred.
If the Pit-Hag turns an evil player into the Luckmonger, they can't turn good this way & might learn what events occurred.

ratspath_luckmonger.flavor: All odds are 50/50. It either happens, or it doesn't.

ratspath_vermin.ability: Each night, Minions choose what alignment you are. If you are evil for at least 2 nights in a row, a Townsfolk might learn this.

jinxes.reason: If the Demon has the Vermin ability, Minions instead choose if an alive neighbor of the Demon is drunk until dusk. If this happens twice in a row or more, a Townsfolk might learn this.

If the Pit-Hag turns an evil player into the Vermin, Minions instead choose if an alive neighbor of the Vermin is drunk until dusk. If this happens twice in a row or more, a Townsfolk might learn this.
If no Minion could wake to choose the Vermin's alignment, the Demon chooses instead.
Each Minion privately wakes to choose the alignment of the Vermin & the Storyteller tallies the vote.
Each Minion privately wakes to choose the alignment of the Vermin & the Storyteller tallies the vote.

ratspath_vermin.flavor: Now personally, I find being called a "mouse" very offensive. You know rats are VERY different from those little scummy mice, right? We are much better than those little wall-chewing critters. Much better. Still like cheese, though; can't go wrong with cheese.

ratspath_novice.ability: You may only nominate once per game. When the game ends, become the alignment of the player you nominated, or evil if none, even if drunk, poisoned, or dead.

jinxes.reason: If the Politician is the most responsible player for their team losing & the Novice nominated them, the Novice switches to the Politician's team after the Politician switches teams.
The Demon can't have the Novice ability.
If the Pit-Hag makes an evil player into the Novice, they can't turn good due to their ability.

ratspath_novice.flavor: Don't you think this whole "evil" business is a little theatrical? Like, do you really need all these plots and plans and assassinations... no, I'd still love the job, I just think there's some streamlining that could be done.

ratspath_sinner.ability: If you are nominated & executed by a Minion, all learn this. If a different evil player is not executed the following dusk, evil wins. The Demon knows who you are.
ratspath_sinner.firstNightReminder: Wake the Demon and show them [[THIS PLAYER IS]], the Sinner player, and the Sinner token.

ratspath_bewitched.ability: The 1st time a Minion chooses you with their ability, they learn this & act twice more, even if you are dead, drunk, or poisoned.

jinxes.reason: If the Demon chooses the Bewitched with their Boffin ability, they might act twice more with it.
If the Marionette chooses the Bewitched with their fake ability, the Demon might wake to choose a player: they become a Marionette.
The Pit-Hag acts twice more even if the Bewitched left play due to their choice.
If the Psychopath kills an unchosen Bewitched, they might be able to kill another player today.
The Summoner registers as a Demon to the Bewitched.

ratspath_bewitched.flavor: Well, see, I don't have any big story to tell. My gramps pissed off a common swamp hag and got toaded, and the rest of the family got the drawbacks too. Him? Oh, he's long gone. I think that hawk got a good meal, though.

ratspath_dealer.ability: 1 player is healthy, sober & receives true info while a different player is drunk & receives false info, even if you are dead. If 1 dies, they swap.
ratspath_dealer.flavor: When you win, you want to bet more! When you lose, you get a free drink! See it's a win-win scenario here in the pit, and anybody telling you otherwise isn't having a good time.

ratspath_patch.ability: You & only you start knowing the Minion you added & their character. They think they are a good character, but their actions work as if they were that Minion. [+1 Minion]
ratspath_patch.firstNightReminder: Wake the Patch and show them THIS PLAYER IS, the player marked PATCHED, and their real Minion character.
ratspath_patch.flavor: You'll be safe here, darling. You'll have fun here, darling. Your potential exceeds what you think. You will never be used by the corrupt and the weak. I promise to you. I promise to you.

ratspath_horologist.ability: When you die, choose a good character: an alive evil player gains their ability & learns this, even if they die.
ratspath_horologist.otherNightReminder: If the Horologist died today or tonight, they choose a character.

jinxes.reason: The Horologist can't choose the Heretic.
The Horologist can't choose the Damsel.
The Horologist can't choose the Politician.
The Horologist can't choose the Ogre.
The Horologist's given ability can't turn evil players good.
The Horologist's given ability can't turn evil players good.

ratspath_horologist.flavor: Tick... tock... will it ever... stop?

ratspath_seducer.ability: The 1st good player to nominate each evil player is poisoned until that evil player is dead.
ratspath_seducer.flavor: Come, valiant one. Enter the darkness and betray your past life. We are what you want. We are what you need.

ratspath_conductor.ability: At dusk, 1 evil player may publicly choose to die. If the Demon chooses this & no other evil players live, your team wins. You keep your ability while dead.

jinxes.reason: The Vizier can die to the Conductor's ability.
The Magician might register as evil to the Conductor.

ratspath_caravanserai.ability: Either you or the Demon appears as a Traveller & has their ability. [+? Travellers counting as normal players & of the alignment as the type they were (all but the Demon)]
ratspath_caravanserai.flavor: The travelling life must be hard on you. Sit a while. Rest.

ratspath_castellerilo.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. If all alive Minions (at least 1) voted today, a player might die.
ratspath_castellerilo.flavor: Strike once! Strike twice! Strike like the town has never seen!

ratspath_gearsworn.ability: Each night, choose any players: each wakes & chooses a player (not themself). If the majority chose players you didn't, those you chose die.
ratspath_gearsworn.otherNightReminder: The Gearsworn chooses any players. Wake each chosen player: they choose a player. If the majority didn't choose players marked CHOSEN, all CHOSEN players die.
ratspath_gearsworn.flavor: I-IF YOU A-RE COLD, Y-Y-YESTERDA-Y'S VIOLENCE, SH-ALL-L ENTER-TAIN-TAIN -- STE-L-LLAR HYDR-OGE-N-N, YES, S-SIR, EVEN TH-TH-E HIGH A-AND MIGHTY ARE BUT S-SMOKE IN D-D-DREAMS...

ratspath_sibyl.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die & one of their good neighbors is poisoned until dusk. For every poisoned player that nominates, a player might die. [No Outsiders]
ratspath_sibyl.otherNightReminder: The Sibyl chooses a player. Poison a neighboring good player.
ratspath_sibyl.flavor: There is no hope but to die and hope that every last evildoer dies with us!

ratspath_vezzulla.ability: Each night, the Demon dies & 1 of their alive neighbors "is the Demon" & poisoned. Once per game, at night, choose a different player to become "the Demon". You can't lose your ability.
ratspath_vezzulla.otherNightReminder: Kill the current Demon, then wake the Vezzulla. They might choose a different player to become the Demon: mark them with the POISONED and IS THE DEMON tokens & the Vezzulla with the ONCE token. Otherwise, mark an alive neighbor of the previous Demon with the POISONED and IS THE DEMON tokens.
ratspath_vezzulla.flavor: Ùn àbbiate paura di e cose bone, culpìtele à u core senza timore: i nemichi, unu per unu, ognunu destinatu à more solu è spaventatu.

ratspath_razzex.ability: After day 4, evil wins. The 1st time a Razzex dies, the game resets to night 1: then, you & a good player swap alignments and characters & evil wins after day 1.

jinxes.reason: Each night, the Razzex chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Banshee dies & gains their ability.
If the Exorcist chose the Razzex & they die that day or night, good wins.
Each night, the Razzex chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Farmer uses their ability but does not die.
If the Razzex is in play and the grandchild dies by execution (before a reset), evil wins.
If the Razzex nominates & executes an Innkeeper chosen player, they can't rewind while the Innkeeper lives.
If the Razzex nominates & executes an Monk chosen player, they can't rewind while the Monk lives.
If a reset occurs & no-one is executed that day, good wins.
Each night, the Razzex chooses an alive player (different to previous nights): a chosen Ravenkeeper uses their ability but does not die.
Each night, the Razzex chooses an alive player (different to previous nights): a chosen Sage uses their ability but does not die.
If the Razzex nominates & executes a Soldier, they can't rewind.
If the Razzex is in play & at least 2 players are dead or a reset has occurred, the King learns an alive character each night.

ratspath_razzex.flavor: Time creeps ever onwards. The ivy on a brick wall creeps after time. An ant on the ivy creeps after nectar. All reduced to atoms, all reduced to simple concepts. Everything returns to the source.

ratspath_mousecatcher.ability: Players who are "about to die" may publicly choose to become a new character of their type. (If you agree.)
ratspath_mousecatcher.otherNightReminder: Wake each player with the CHANGES TONIGHT token separately. Show each YOU ARE and their new character (of the same character type as they were before).
ratspath_mousecatcher.flavor: Meow (you know) purr (that all mice) mrowor (are destined) miau (for horrible, painful deaths)

ratspath_trickster.ability: Abilities might benefit you, and must if you are directly affected.

ratspath_spiritofsilence.ability: Only 1 character that could turn itself or another player evil can be in play at one time.

ratspath_hourglass.ability: If 4 nights pass without any players dying at night, the evil team wins.
ratspath_hourglass.flavor: Grains of sand? Dunes of sand? What is the difference when all will fall to time?

ratspath_chattering.ability: The Yaggababble can only kill during the day.

sleepless_gatekeeper.ability: You start knowing which Outsiders are in-play. The 1st Outsider you nominate is drunk & dies if you die. [+0 or +1 Outsider]
sleepless_gatekeeper.firstNightReminder: Wake up the Gatekeeper and tell them which Outsiders are in-play.
sleepless_gatekeeper.flavor: No-one gets in or out these city walls without my knowing. And rest assured, if I do find you, I'm dragging you out myself.

sleepless_mentor.ability: Each night, choose a player: you learn a character type they are not.
sleepless_mentor.firstNightReminder: Wake the player up and make them choose a player. Tell them a character type this player is not.
sleepless_mentor.otherNightReminder: Wake the player up and make them choose a player. Tell them a character type this player is not.
sleepless_mentor.flavor: I'm well aware of what they can do and how much hurt they can cause. After all, I trained them myself.

sleepless_barkeep.ability: Each night, choose a unique character: they are drunk until dusk. Evil players learn if you make them drunk.
sleepless_barkeep.firstNightReminder: Wake up and choose a character.
sleepless_barkeep.otherNightReminder: Wake up and choose a character.
sleepless_barkeep.flavor: I heard tell of a traveller from an antique land... I gave him three jugs of wine and a cushion to sleep on.

sleepless_decoy.ability: Each night, choose a player: if they would die tonight or tomorrow, you die instead & learn their alignment that night.
sleepless_decoy.firstNightReminder: Wake up the Decoy and make them choose a player.
sleepless_decoy.otherNightReminder: If their ability triggered today, tell them the player they chose last night's alignment. Else: wake up the Decoy and make them choose a player.
sleepless_decoy.flavor: There are two ways I might die. If I stay here and keep on fighting around Ravenswood Bluff, I can never go home, but my glory will live forever; but if I return in my ships to my own dear country, my glory will die, but my life will be long and peaceful.

sleepless_dramatist.ability: Each night, you might learn an in-play character: you are “mad” you are this character until you learn another or you might die.
sleepless_dramatist.firstNightReminder: Wake up the Dramatist and show them a character.
sleepless_dramatist.otherNightReminder: Wake up the Dramatist and show them a character.
sleepless_dramatist.flavor: As I told you all yesterday, I am the Lookout. Not once have I claimed to be anything but the Barkeep. I've kept my story as the Guardian quite straight, thank you very much. NO, YOU'RE NOT THE GORGON, I AM.

sleepless_insomniac.ability: Each night, you learn if the player you nominated today would have been a better execution than today's executee.
sleepless_insomniac.otherNightReminder: Wake up the Insomniac and tell them if their nomination today was better or worse than today's executee.
sleepless_insomniac.flavor: Eight hours a night? That feels excessive...
