sleepless_occultist.ability: Each day, before nominations, you may publicly choose a player: they die tomorrow dusk. If they are good, you might die too.
sleepless_occultist.flavor: Listen, it's not a cult. What it IS is a very cool opportunity that I think will really benefit your investment portfolio. Please, if you just listen to me -- I mean, what's the worst that could happen? You're not exactly gonna DIE over it... ahem.

sleepless_reanimator.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a dead player: you become their character but don't learn which.
sleepless_reanimator.otherNightReminder: Wake up the Reanimator and ask if they want to use their ability.
sleepless_reanimator.flavor: IT'S ALIVE... IT'S ALIVE... IT'S... moving, I think.

sleepless_clairvoyant.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a dead player: you learn which character (if any) was most responsible for their death.
sleepless_clairvoyant.otherNightReminder: Wake up and ask if they wish to use their ability. If they do, make them choose 1 player and put them back to sleep. If this player is a Townsfolk, show them a character.
sleepless_clairvoyant.flavor: The story of the dead is a bold and beautiful one. They hold secrets, stories, dreams left unrequited. Oh, I hear one now... what's that? You... you want me to shut up?

sleepless_martyr.ability: You can only die if there are no alive Minions.
sleepless_martyr.flavor: Who I am is where I stand. Where I stand is where I fall. Stand with me.

sleepless_lookout.ability: You & the Demon know a player: evil can't win if they live, even if dead. The 1st time you or they die, the Demon is drunk until tomorrow dusk.
sleepless_lookout.firstNightReminder: Separately wake up the Hangman and Demon and show them the same player.
sleepless_lookout.flavor: Don't worry, captain! I have kept the witness firmly in my si-... wait, where've they gone?

sleepless_guardian.ability: The 1st unique player to nominate you each day is sober, healthy, & safe from death until dawn.

sleepless_admirer.ability: 1 player of your alignment can't die. If you nominate them, you both die today.
sleepless_admirer.flavor: From afar I must watch lest they ever learn my love. Until then, till death do us part.

sleepless_disciple.ability: You think you are a Townsfolk, but you are not. If you nominate, execute, & kill the Demon, you become the evil Demon.
sleepless_disciple.otherNightReminder: If the Disciple nominated and executed the Demon today, tell them they the new evil Demon.
sleepless_disciple.flavor: The time is almost come. The hour is almost nigh. Our ascent shall be glorious.

sleepless_gremlin.ability: You can only die by execution, & turn evil if 4 or less players live, even if poisoned.
sleepless_gremlin.flavor: Ha, ha, hee, hee, you can't catch me!

sleepless_conspirator.ability: The 1st time the Demon would die, another player might die instead, even if dead.
sleepless_conspirator.flavor: I know of no reason why Ravenswood Treason should ever be forgot.

sleepless_scarecrow.ability: Townsfolk that nominate you die that day. If you are "mad" you are the Scarecrow, a player might die, even if dead.

sleepless_hypnotist.ability: Each night, choose a character: if accepted, you have its ability until dusk but might die if you are not "mad" as it tomorrow.
sleepless_hypnotist.firstNightReminder: Wake them up and choose a character.
sleepless_hypnotist.otherNightReminder: Wake them up and choose a character.

sleepless_bastion.ability: You die if & only if there are no alive Outsiders. [-1 to +1 Outsider]
sleepless_bastion.flavor: Nothing Beside Remains... The lone and level sands stretch far away.

sleepless_warlock.ability: The 1st time evil nominates evil each day they swap characters that night (abilities preserved) but 1 might die tomorrow.
sleepless_warlock.otherNightReminder: Wake up any players that have swapped characters and tell them their new character.
sleepless_warlock.flavor: Making something disappear is easy. Making it come back in one piece is the tricky part.

sleepless_gorgon.ability: Townsfolk you have nominated die if you are executed. You die if 1 of them is executed. Evil wins if no Townsfolk nominated today.
sleepless_gorgon.flavor: It's hard to forget my face.

sleepless_leshy.ability: Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned & die when 1 of their alive neighbors dies.
sleepless_leshy.firstNightReminder: Wake up and make them choose a player. Mark that player as poisoned.
sleepless_leshy.otherNightReminder: Wake up and make them choose a player. Mark that player as poisoned.
sleepless_leshy.flavor: The leaves whisper beautiful things. Here, why don't you stop and listen.

sleepless_nightmare.ability: Each night, choose a character: anyone not "mad" as something else from now on might die. If no-one died this way today, choose twice.
sleepless_nightmare.firstNightReminder: Wake up and make them choose a character.
sleepless_nightmare.otherNightReminder: Wake up and make them choose a character. If no-one died due to the Nightmare today, they may choose twice.
sleepless_nightmare.flavor: Lying only delays the inevitable. You can tell the truth to me... your truth will set us both free.

sleepless_cascaada.ability: Each night, choose 3 players: tomorrow, the 2nd & 3rd players die if & only if the 1st dies. Evil players might be poisoned until dusk.
sleepless_cascaada.firstNightReminder: Wake them up make them choose three players.
sleepless_cascaada.otherNightReminder: Wake them up make them choose three players.
sleepless_cascaada.flavor: Every house of cards crumbles, just a flick to make them send. Every domino falls, it's fate that all things end.

sleepless_azathoth.ability: Each night, choose if all Outsiders die tomorrow. Townsfolk that nominate you or a Disciple become a Disciple that night. [+1 Outsider]
sleepless_azathoth.firstNightReminder: Wake up and ask if they want to use their ability: if they do, mark all Outsiders as "Dies Tomorrow"
sleepless_azathoth.otherNightReminder: Wake up and ask if they want to use their ability: if they do, mark all Outsiders as "Dies Tomorrow"
sleepless_azathoth.flavor: If only I could describe the horrors that await...

conference_psychologist.ability: You & the Demon start knowing which character you added. [-1 Minion, +1 Evil Townsfolk or Outsider]
conference_psychologist.flavor: So you indeed feel this way. As expected.

conference_statistician.ability: You start knowing whether the longest chain of Townsfolks is even or odd.
conference_statistician.flavor: Look, I don't know why the data looks like this, but it speaks for itself.

conference_sociologist.ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): tomorrow night, learn another player of their character type or a Good player if none exists.
conference_sociologist.flavor: Birds of a feather flock together, and people are, in many ways, like birds.

conference_archaeologist.ability: Once per game at night, choose a neighbor of any dead player: learn their character.
conference_archaeologist.flavor: Remains tell you a lot about what had taken place here, be it commerce or conversation.

conference_entrepreneur.ability: Once per game during the day, publicly choose a player: if they are a Townsfolk, they act twice tonight.
conference_entrepreneur.flavor: I sense market potential in your research... Mind telling me more?

conference_physicist.ability: Each day, you may visit the Storyteller to learn a question to answer. If incorrect, you die tonight.
conference_physicist.flavor: I wonder if this'll go faster with just a smiiiidge more petrol...

conference_geologist.ability: Each night, name 3 different character types (not Traveller): you learn if that exact sequence exists somewhere clockwise.
conference_geologist.flavor: This strata pattern...How can this be? A flood? A volcanic eruption? A mass-extinction event?

conference_linguist.ability: Each night, learn a player who lied publicly today.
conference_linguist.flavor: The words people choose tell us much more than what is being said.

conference_astronomer.ability: Each night, learn a character that the Town should discuss the next day.
conference_astronomer.flavor: I'm not 'saying' we should terraform Mars. I just want to point out that the next best option is, you know, 30 light-years away?

conference_historian.ability: Each night, choose a Good character: if in play, gain that ability until dawn. Otherwise, you are drunk.
conference_historian.flavor: Of course! I keep records on all my contemporaries. One day we'll all be history, no?

conference_ethicist.ability: Each even night, choose a character: if it is dead, learn an out-of-play character, otherwise learn an in-play character.
conference_ethicist.flavor: I cannot condone this principle, especially given its previous ramifications.

conference_biologist.ability: Each night after your 1st, choose a character (might be refused): if in-play, you become that character & that player becomes a Biologist.
conference_biologist.flavor: These genes...! If I splice them with each other...

conference_chemist.ability: If the Demon kills you, you learn all non-Townsfolk players.
conference_chemist.flavor: The application of TEM on the sample revealed previously undocumented crystal structures. XRD analysis is to commence as soon as possible to ascertain the nature of the sample.

conference_lobbyist.ability: A Townsfolk starts drunk & each night: the next clockwise Townsfolk is drunk instead, even if you are dead.
conference_lobbyist.flavor: The money goes in, the results come out. Anything to keep me in my position...

conference_administrator.ability: Each alive Evil player may guess you privately (once) to choose a player: they die tonight.

conference_succumbent.ability: When Evil players have chosen you twice, your team loses if a Demon did so both times, even if you are dead.

conference_spokesperson.ability: When you die or if you are not “mad” as your role when you are nominated, the Demon acts again tomorrow night.

conference_plagiarist.ability: You also register as a not-in-play Townsfolk & know which. [+1 Outsider]

conference_capitalist.ability: You also register as a not-in-play Demon & know which. If the Demon did not vote for your execution, players who did (not you) are drunk.

conference_egoist.ability: You also register as a not-in-play Outsider & know which. If there are more Evil than Good players alive, your team wins.

conference_sensationalist.ability: Each night, choose a player: you learn their character, and they might be immediately executed if you vote for them tomorrow.

conference_fervore.ability: Each night, the alive Evil player “maddest” about being Good today "is the Demon" and chooses a player: they die. [+1 Minion]

conference_theabyss.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. You may register as any of the bluffs.

conference_pryde.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. If they were “mad” that you are Evil (once), they turn Evil instead, swap roles with you & act again.

conference_vice.ability: Each night, if you were not nominated today, choose a player: they die. Otherwise, a player might die. [+ Misery, -1 Minion]

conference_misery.ability: Each night, if you did not nominate today, choose a player: they die. [+ Vice, -1 Outsider]

evergreen_cherrypicker.ability: Each night, choose 2 players: you learn 1 of their alignments.
evergreen_cherrypicker.flavor: I know it was the butler who killed the poor Ms. Francesca! I didn't see anyone else enter the garden with her that night! Other than the governer.

faewilds_matchmaker.ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself) who nominated yesterday: learn if they are the same alignment as the player they nominated.
faewilds_matchmaker.otherNightReminder: Provided somebody nominated yesterday: the Matchmaker chooses a player, show them a yes or no signal.
faewilds_matchmaker.flavor: I don't know, but I believe. Hell, if a cockroach and a mouse can find love in this crazy city, then, damn it, so can I.

faewilds_switchmaster.ability: Each night, choose a direction: The closest alive Townsfolk in that direction is poisoned until dusk.
faewilds_switchmaster.firstNightReminder: The Switchmaster chooses a direction. Place the poisoned token on their target.
faewilds_switchmaster.otherNightReminder: The Switchmaster chooses a direction. Place the poisoned token on their target.
faewilds_switchmaster.flavor: On the count of three, redirect all energy to the output. Switch the polarity. Shift the phase. Discharge!

forge_zepplinist.ability: Each night, learn how many Townsfolk are in the longest line of neighboring Townsfolk. You learn false info.
forge_zepplinist.flavor: Surely the Hindenburg was a fluke, right?

forge_lordmaker.ability: Outsiders that died at night might be executed in the day, even if you are dead.
forge_lordmaker.flavor: Empires rise and fall, but this one falls with me.

garden_apiarist.ability: You start knowing 2 not-in-play evil characters.
garden_apiarist.firstNightReminder: Show the Apiarist two not-in-play evil characters
garden_apiarist.flavor: I love bugs. It's a shame they're all hiding through the winter months. I have a new bug hunting spot I'm wanting to test out when it gets a bit warmer. Oh, you've already gone? Okey-doke.

garden_baker.ability: Good players who nominate you learn your character tonight.
garden_baker.otherNightReminder: If the Baker was nominated by a good player today, wake the nominator and show them that this player is the Baker.
garden_baker.flavor: Nothing is better than the smell of fresh baked bread in the morning. Actually, the smell of fresh baked bread in the afternoon sounds nice, I could do with a lay-in.

garden_bastion.ability: Each night, choose a player: chosen Minions become good Townsfolk (The first must become Bastion). Minions and Demons don't know each other. [Other good characters are evil Minions]
garden_bastion.firstNightReminder: Wake the Bastion and have them choose a player. If that player is a Minion, change their character token, then tell them that they are good and their new character.
garden_bastion.otherNightReminder: Wake the Bastion and have them choose a player. If that player is a Minion, change their character token, then tell them that they are good and their new character.
garden_bastion.flavor: We will stand strong against the masses. When the world is wrong, you must strive to fix it. Even when the world is against you, stand and fight 'til your last breath.

garden_blacksmith.ability: Each night, learn a player whos character comes later alphabetically than last night. (Or that there are none.)
garden_blacksmith.firstNightReminder: Wake the Blacksmith and show them a player
garden_blacksmith.otherNightReminder: Wake the Blacksmith and show them a player whos character comes later alphabetically than the last player
garden_blacksmith.flavor: Finest steel in the world, wouldn't settle for anything less. What did you say this axe was for again? Ah, yes, of course. What else could a dignified individual such as yourself imagine to do with other than some woodcutting. I promise you, my axes are the best in the land, they could chop a man clean in half, not that anyone here would.

garden_bodyguard.ability: You start knowing 1 good player. The 1st non-Demon player to nominate them dies tonight.
garden_bodyguard.firstNightReminder: Wake the Bodyguard and point to a good player. Mark that good player with the "defended" reminder token.
garden_bodyguard.otherNightReminder: If the defended player was nominated by a non-Demon during the day, mark the nominator with the "Dead" reminder token, and the Bodyguard with the "No ability" reminder token.
garden_bodyguard.flavor: You're not coming in if you're not on the list.

garden_bookkeeper.ability: Each night, learn 2 characters: at least 1 isn't in play.
garden_bookkeeper.firstNightReminder: Wake the Bookkeeper and show them two characters, where at least one of them is not in play.
garden_bookkeeper.otherNightReminder: Wake the Bookkeeper and show them two characters, where at least one of them is not in play.
garden_bookkeeper.flavor: Occupational records, sure! There's of course the chef, the artist, the chambermaid, but I see no record of you in here. I will be sure to correct this, don't worry.

garden_bricklayer.ability: You start knowing how many Outsiders are in play. If none, this info is arbitrary.
garden_bricklayer.firstNightReminder: Show the Bricklayer the number of outsiders in play.
garden_bricklayer.flavor: I make a tuppence a brick, meanin' them lot from outside be coming 'ere for me job. I ain't havin' nun of that.

garden_confectioner.ability: If you die at night, all Townsfolk learn you as the Confectioner.
garden_confectioner.otherNightReminder: If the Confectioner died tonight, wake each Townsfolk individually, point to the Confectioner, then show them the Confectioner token.
garden_confectioner.flavor: Who can take a sunrise? Sprinkle it with dew? Cover it with chocolate and a miracle or two? The candy man can!

garden_doppelganger.ability: If you're mad that you're an in-play character, you might become that character at night.
garden_doppelganger.otherNightReminder: If the Doppelgänger has been mad about being an in-play character, wake them and show them their new character. Place the "Mimicked" reminder token next to their new character
garden_doppelganger.flavor: Bloodstains on my dinner coat? No, this is cooking brandy. How thoughtless.

garden_fallguy.ability: Outsider abilities must target you if they could, even if you're drunk or poisoned.

garden_geisha.ability: You start knowing how many steps from the Demon to its nearest Outsider. (Or that zero are in play.)
garden_geisha.firstNightReminder: Show the Geisha a number denoting the number of steps between the demon and their nearest outsider, or a zero if no outsiders are in play.
garden_geisha.flavor: この状況下でも私の芸術は止まることはありません。私は私たちのコミュニティを信頼しています。

garden_gumshoe.ability: Each night, learn a non-Demon player. You might die at any time.
garden_gumshoe.firstNightReminder: Wake the Gumshoe and point to a player that isn't the demon
garden_gumshoe.otherNightReminder: Wake the Gumshoe and point to a player that isn't the demon
garden_gumshoe.flavor: Of course, I already knew the identity of the demon. It was evident by the tracks of peat mud left about the scene of the latest murder. That form of soil is found exclusively by the fishing pond, so I put it unto you, fisherman, that you are the demon. Now I'd appreciate your cooperation in your relocation to the jails and... why are you grinning like that? You have been rumbled, this is no laughing matter!

garden_hiker.ability: You start knowing 2 in-play Outsiders, or fewer if unable. [+1 Outsider]
garden_hiker.firstNightReminder: Show the Hiker up to two in-play outsider tokens.
garden_hiker.flavor: Tell you what, people in town keep telling me walking alone through the woods in the middle of the night is unadvisable. Well egg on their faces, they're all dead, and I'm still kicking!

garden_medic.ability: Each night, choose 1 character of each type (not Medic): you learn how many are in play.
garden_medic.firstNightReminder: Wake the Medic. They choose 1 character of each type. Show them how many are in play.
garden_medic.otherNightReminder: Wake the Medic. They choose 1 character of each type. Show them how many are in play.
garden_medic.flavor: Professional opinion - I'd recommend not dying.

garden_milkman.ability: You start knowing 1 of your neighbours' characters. If either are evil, learn false info.
garden_milkman.firstNightReminder: Wake the Milkman and show them the role of one of their neighbours.
garden_milkman.flavor: I can do whole milk, skimmed milk, semi-skimmed milk, oat milk, soy milk, almond milk, Lleech poison, coconut milk, hemp milk, rice milk, any milk really!

garden_mime.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a player: you become their character. If you choose an evil player, you might become poisoned & think you're a different character.
garden_mime.otherNightReminder: Wake the Mime and prompt them to choose a player: mark that player with the "Mimed" reminder. If they choose an evil player, you may mark them with the "Poisoned" and "Confused" reminder tokens. Then, show them their new character.

jinxes.reason: If the Boffin gives the Demon the Mimes ability, the Boffin becomes the character of the chosen player instead.

garden_mixologist.ability: All Outsiders are drunk. When you die, a Townsfolk might become an Outsider.
garden_mixologist.flavor: What are you thirsting for today, my friend? I can knock up something to suit your tastes, whatever piques your fancy.

garden_patissier.ability: Each night, learn a player who, since dawn, was chosen by the ability of a character of a different type to the last player you learnt. (Or that there are none.)
garden_patissier.firstNightReminder: Wake the Pâtissier and show them a player.
garden_patissier.otherNightReminder: Wake the Pâtissier and show them a player who was chosen by a player of a different character type to the last player they learnt, or that there are none. If there were none, then point to a player.
garden_patissier.flavor: Les faibles habitants de la ville ne peuvent saisir chaque détail de mon art. Ils ne sont pas dignes de déguster mes délices. Pourtant, ils le devraient, car personne d'autre ici ne sait faire des croissants.

garden_potter.ability: You start knowing how many pairs of Townsfolk there are.
garden_potter.firstNightReminder: Wake the Potter and show them how many pairs of townsfolk there are
garden_potter.flavor: Careful now. The slightest movement can ruin the perfect symmetry of the vase. Keep your hands wet, and let your fingers glide across the clay. Don't spin the turntable too fast, or it can warp the pot. Amateurs.

garden_scholar.ability: Once per game, during the day, you may visit the Storyteller to learn another living good player. (Or that there are none.)
garden_scholar.flavor: You must take me for some kind of joker if you think you can pull a fast one on me. Knight to B7 blocks your check, and allows my bishop to see your own king for a discovered check. You only have four moves left until my inevitable victory, so you might as well concede.

garden_scientist.ability: Each night, choose a character type: tomorrow, you can only die by execution if all other living players of that type voted on you.
garden_scientist.firstNightReminder: Wake the Scientist and have them choose a character type. Mark them with the appropriate reminder token.
garden_scientist.otherNightReminder: Wake the Scientist and have them choose a character type. Mark them with the appropriate reminder token.

garden_sleeper.ability: The 1st time you die at night, you don't & choose a non-Demon character: gain that ability.
garden_sleeper.otherNightReminder: If the Sleeper died tonight, wake them and prompt them to choose a character.
garden_sleeper.flavor: Gosh, no I don't know what I'm doing here. And where did this knife come from? This is all rather peculiar.

garden_sommelier.ability: You have the ability of an in-play Townsfolk (you do not learn which): they're drunk.
garden_sommelier.flavor: Care for a drink this evening. Given your wish for red meat, may I recommend our 30 year barrel-aged house red, straight from the vineyards of Bordeaux. Why yes, that is the stain on my cuff, very astute of you.

garden_squire.ability: On your 1st day, you may tell the Storyteller a statement. You learn when it becomes true & might learn this once incorrectly.
garden_squire.flavor: You don't need a helmet if you don't intend on getting struck in the head! Besides, I like to feel the wind in my hair.

garden_trapper.ability: If you die at night, a Minion dies too.
garden_trapper.otherNightReminder: If the Trapper died tonight, mark a living minion with the "Dead" reminder.
garden_trapper.flavor: Day 15 of watching the trap. No progress as of yet, however, I have hopes for the coming week. My good friend the investigator has promised me that a goblin has been roaming the town as of late, and my confidence in evil afoot only grew upon his murder.

garden_trumpeter.ability: You start knowing 2 players of opposing alignments.
garden_trumpeter.firstNightReminder: Point to two players that are on opposing teams.

garden_umpire.ability: If the Demon kills you, learn which evil characters are in play.
garden_umpire.otherNightReminder: If the Umpire died, show them which minions and demons are in play.
garden_umpire.flavor: You should see the passion of some of these players. The way these guys swing that bat is incredible, it could take your head right off your shoulders.

garden_weaver.ability: Each night, learn a living player who didn't wake tonight. (Or that there are none.)
garden_weaver.firstNightReminder: Wake the Weaver and point to a living player who has not woken tonight.
garden_weaver.otherNightReminder: Wake the Weaver and point to a living player who has not woken tonight.

garden_witchdoctor.ability: Each night, choose a player: you learn if they're poisoned. Poisoned characters' abilities yield false info, even if you're poisoned.
garden_witchdoctor.firstNightReminder: Wake the Witch doctor and have them choose a player. Give a thumbs up if they're poisoned, or a thumbs down if they're not.
garden_witchdoctor.otherNightReminder: Wake the Witch doctor and have them choose a player. Give a thumbs up if they're poisoned, or a thumbs down if they're not.
garden_witchdoctor.flavor: Oo ee oo a a ting tang wala wala bing bang

garden_batontwirler.ability: Setup abilities might activate later instead, even if you're dead. [+0 or +1 Outsider]
garden_batontwirler.flavor: The parade is this way folks! Come on, bring your family! A day full of fun and entertainment awaits!

garden_brewer.ability: Minions that neighbour Outsiders or Demons may act twice when they would act once, even if you're dead.

garden_busboy.ability: You think you're a not-in-play Townsfolk or Minion, but aren't. Your alignment is the opposite of what you think it is.
garden_busboy.flavor: I'll be right out with your drinks. What? You want to see the dessert menu already? If you insist, but the chef won't be happy.

garden_contrarian.ability: You start knowing 1 player of the opposing alignment & do not know your alignment. You might start evil.
garden_contrarian.firstNightReminder: Wake the Contrarian and show them an opposing player.
garden_contrarian.flavor: I firmly believe that the pacifist is more useful to the town than the mayor. What do you mean I haven't made an actual argument. The argument makes itself! It's obvious!

garden_cursed.ability: Once, at any time while you're dead, the most useful living Townsfolk might die.
garden_cursed.flavor: When I was younger, I sort of annoyed a witch enough so that she put a curse on me. 30 years later and still nothing has happened. Sounds like it's not my problem.

garden_dancer.ability: Your good neighbours' abilities might target themselves instead.
garden_dancer.flavor: 1. 2. 3. Step. 1. 2. 3. Step. It's easy, just feel the beat from the tambourine and it'll come naturally.

garden_dealer.ability: For each good player who's mad that you're in play, another player might become drunk, even if you're dead. Each night, learn how many players are drunk from your ability.
garden_dealer.otherNightReminder: Wake the Dealer and tell them how many players are drunk from their ability.
garden_dealer.flavor: You looking for a good time? I got something here you might be interested in.

garden_florist.ability: If exactly 1 of your neighbours is evil, the other is drunk, even if you're dead.
garden_florist.flavor: It's a shame that nobody ever stops to smell the flowers. Everybody seems so panicked these days.

garden_gatekeeper.ability: If you were dead at dusk, the Demon acts twice tonight.
garden_gatekeeper.otherNightReminder: If the Gatekeeper was dead at dusk, mark the Demon with the "Acts twice" reminder.
garden_gatekeeper.flavor: I fear if I let my guard down, more demons may break through the seal. Oh well, one little nap couldn't hurt.

garden_guardian.ability: You start knowing a player: if executed, their team loses, even if you're dead.
garden_guardian.firstNightReminder: Wake the Guardian and point to a player. Mark that player with the "Guarding" reminder.
garden_guardian.flavor: There is no need to cry, you're safe now. As long as I'm here, nothing can hurt you.

garden_narcissist.ability: During the day, you might be "about to die" instead of whoever already is.

garden_plagiarist.ability: If you die at night, you don't, become evil & gain an in-play non-Demon ability.
garden_plagiarist.otherNightReminder: If the Plagiarist would have died at night, tell them that they are evil, and show them their new ability.

garden_propagandist.ability: When you die, 1 of your good neighbours might turn evil.
garden_propagandist.otherNightReminder: If the Propagandist died tonight, you may mark one of their good neighbours with the "Evil" reminder. Then wake that player and tell them that they are evil.
garden_propagandist.flavor: They only tell you what they want you to know. They're lying to you, because if you knew the truth, you wouldn't be helping them. Just think critically for a second. Did we ever have an election for our mayor? I certainly didn't vote for them.

garden_stuntman.ability: If there would be no deaths at night, you or 1 of your living neighbours dies, even if you're dead.
garden_stuntman.otherNightReminder: If there would otherwise be no deaths tonight, mark the Stuntman or one of their neighbours with the Dead reminder
garden_stuntman.flavor: For my next trick, I will shoot myself out of this cannon, through the air above this pit of spikes, and into this pile of hay. Ignore the red bits, my brother went first.

garden_uninitiated.ability: You might start evil. You don't know your alignment & learn it on the final night, even if dead.
garden_uninitiated.otherNightReminder: On the Uninitiated's 3rd night, show the Uninitiated their alignment.
garden_uninitiated.flavor: Did I tell you about my new friend? Oh, they're the best. We're actually going down to meet some of his other friends on Wednesday. Apparently they've been planning a big barbecue, how exciting.

garden_begetter.ability: Each day, you may visit the Storyteller to privately change 1 word in a character's ability. If accepted, some players learn the change that night.
garden_begetter.otherNightReminder: If the Begetter made a change that was accepted, wake some players and show them the change.
garden_begetter.flavor: This world will bend to my whim. My dreams will become reality, no matter the sacrifices.

garden_blight.ability: Outsiders executed while you live poison 1 Townsfolk neighbour, even if you are dead. [+1 Outsider]
garden_blight.flavor: The ruined leaves have fallen for decades. I am neglect. Detritus seeps from my ashen bones. I am evergreen.

garden_dirtminder.ability: The 1st time a Demon dies at night, a living good player turns evil and becomes the Demon. [-1 Outsider]
garden_dirtminder.flavor: The earth trembles. Evil writhes betwixt the grains of soil beneath my feet. The ground will bring death, as all dead return to the ground.

garden_enforcer.ability: If an Outsider is mad that they're an Outsider, they might be executed. 1 good player knows an Enforcer is in play. [+0 or +1 Outsider]
garden_enforcer.firstNightReminder: Show a good player the Enforcer token.
garden_enforcer.flavor: ANOMALY DETECTED | YOU ARE NOT PERMITTED | EXECUTING DESTRUCTION ORDER | IRREGULARITY NULLIFIED

garden_gremlin.ability: You start knowing 2 in play Townsfolk. On your 1st night, choose 1: they're poisoned.
garden_gremlin.firstNightReminder: Show the Gremlin two in play townsfolk. They point to one of them. Mark that townsfolk with the poisoned token.
garden_gremlin.flavor: Hee hee hee. Hoo hee hoo. ha haa.

garden_krankster.ability: Each day, you may publicly choose 2 players to swap seats. If one was "about to die", the other might be instead. If just 3 players live, you lose this ability.
garden_krankster.flavor: A maker of mayhem, an engineer of fear, an inventor of... uh... whatever rhymes with inventor. I don't get paid enough for this.

garden_misfit.ability: The Demon sees the Grimoire on your 2nd night. Until then, 1 Townsfolk is poisoned.
garden_misfit.otherNightReminder: If it is the Misfit's 2nd night, show the "this character selected you" token, then the Misfit token to the demon, then show them the grimoire
garden_misfit.flavor: And then I bopped him right on the noggin! Silly old fool never knew what hit him. One more generous involuntary donation to me, another satisfied victim.

garden_panopticon.ability: Evil players wake together & may communicate. Players may not talk privately with each other during the day. All players know a Panopticon is in play & learn when you die.
garden_panopticon.firstNightReminder: Show the minions one demon bluff each. It can be the same bluff. Announce to all players that Panopticon is in play

jinxes.reason: If the Panopticon dies after being chosen by the Preacher, it is still announced that the Panopticon has died.

garden_panopticon.flavor: If You Have Nothing To [hide]. You Have Nothing To [fear]. We're Listening, [dearest compatriot].

garden_replicur.flavor: We are unified. We are equal. We are one.

garden_ritualist.ability: The number of players alive required for evil to win is increased by the number of executed Outsiders, even if you're dead. [+1 Outsider]

garden_swindler.ability: Each night, you register as the player you last spoke privately with & vice versa.
garden_swindler.otherNightReminder: Place the "Swindled" reminder token on the player who the Swindler last had a private conversation with.
garden_swindler.flavor: I can assure you, this is a fantastic offer that nobody in their right mind could turn down! Only two silver pieces and this wishing well can be all yours. The seller is not liable for any damage that the wishing well may incur or already have, nor are they liable if the wishing well does not grant wishes.

garden_technocrat.ability: Demons can't die by execution. You register as a Demon to good abilities.

garden_titan.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. You don't learn other evil players & they don't learn you.
garden_titan.otherNightReminder: Wake the Titan and prompt them to choose a player: mark that player with the "dead" reminder.

garden_virus.ability: On your 1st night, choose a good character: they're poisoned. If that character is not in play, 1 good player is poisoned.
garden_virus.firstNightReminder: Wake the Virus and let them choose a character. Poison that character if in play, or poison a different good character if not in play.

garden_carnage.ability: Each night, choose a player: they & good players who choose them tonight die.
garden_carnage.otherNightReminder: Carnage points to a player. Mark them with the "Rampage" reminder token. Mark them and any other player who selects them with their ability with "dead" reminder tokens.
garden_carnage.flavor: Ha ha ha ha! Who wants their guts handed to 'em?

garden_corporealis.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Once, during the day but before nominations, you may visit the Storyteller to swap 2 players' characters. Players whose characters changed this way have no ability until dusk.
garden_corporealis.otherNightReminder: Wake the Corporealis and get them to point to a player. Mark that player with the dead token.
garden_corporealis.flavor: You are imperfect. You have no place in my reality.

garden_dolos.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. [+1 Outsider. You choose which Minion all Minions are]
garden_dolos.firstNightReminder: Wake the Dolos and prompt them to choose a minion character. Then wake the minions and tell them their character.
garden_dolos.otherNightReminder: Wake the Dolos and prompt them to point at a player. Mark that player with the "Dead" reminder.
garden_dolos.flavor: Not what you were expecting, was it?

garden_gargan.ability: Each night (except the 1st & 2nd), choose 2 players: they die.
garden_gargan.otherNightReminder: If it is not night 2, wake the Gargan and have them point to two players. Mark them each with a "Dead" reminder token.
garden_gargan.flavor: I have waited for so long. My reawakening will bring forth my second great empire, and none shall know anything other for a thousand years.

garden_hydra.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. The 1st time a Hydra dies while 5 or more players live, a living good neighbour becomes an evil Hydra.
garden_hydra.otherNightReminder: Wake the Hydra and have them choose a player. Mark that player with the "Dead" reminder token. If the Hydra died, make one of their neighbours the Hydra, and show the previous Hydra who the new one is.
garden_hydra.flavor: Strike me down, and I shall return tenfold.

garden_kumalisa.ability: Each night, choose two players: both of their life tokens are flipped. Your team loses if all living players are evil.
garden_kumalisa.otherNightReminder: Wake the Kuma Lisa and prompt them to choose two players. Mark those players with the "Flip" reminder tokens.
garden_kumalisa.flavor: Ти, невинно малко гълъбче, колко жалко, че те измамиха.

garden_mobium.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. If you guess their character, choose another player: they die.
garden_mobium.otherNightReminder: The Mobium chooses a player to die. If the Mobium guesses that players role, let the Mobium choose another player to kill.
garden_mobium.flavor: I know what you're thinking. There is no escape. There is no hope. You're right.

garden_pleasantry.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Once per game, at night, you may choose to register as good and as a Townsfolk or Outsider until dusk. [-1 Outsider]
garden_pleasantry.firstNightReminder: Wake the Pleasantry and have them choose if they want to register as good. If yes, mark them with the "Ability used" reminder and register them as good and as a Townsfolk or Outsider until dusk.
garden_pleasantry.otherNightReminder: Wake the Pleasantry and have them choose if they want to register as good. If yes, mark them with the "Ability used" reminder and register them as good and as a Townsfolk or Outsider until dusk. Then have them choose a player. Mark them with the "Dead" reminder token.

garden_prismat.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. A chosen Minion lives & may choose a non-Demon character to become instead.
garden_prismat.otherNightReminder: Wake the Prismat and have them choose a player. If they didn't choose a minion, mark that player with the "dead" reminder. If they chose a minion, wake the minion, tell them that they were chosen by the Prismat and prompt them to choose a character.
garden_prismat.flavor: The refraction of light through prisms spreads the light wide, thin, like a blanket over the unruly.

garden_puppetmaster.ability: You start knowing a word. Each night, if a good player said it yesterday, choose 2 players: they die. Otherwise, choose 1 player: they die.
garden_puppetmaster.firstNightReminder: Wake the Puppetmaster and show them the word.
garden_puppetmaster.otherNightReminder: Wake the Puppetmaster. If a good player said their word, let them kill two people. Otherwise, let them kill one person.
garden_puppetmaster.flavor: There is no such thing as free will. Everything comes with a price.

garden_quazion.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. If an Outsider is executed, their team loses. [Exactly 1 Outsider]
garden_quazion.otherNightReminder: Wake the Quazion and have them point to a player. Mark that player with the "Dead" reminder token.
garden_quazion.flavor: The light of this world is beautiful. It must be assimilated. Darkness will fall.

garden_replicant.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. You register to good abilities as one of your neighbours & vice versa.
garden_replicant.otherNightReminder: Wake the Replicant and have them choose to dies
garden_replicant.flavor: Hmmm....what have we here? The left boot is worn down to the heEl, with flint shaVings under the tongue. This Is the garb of a MiLitary man.

garden_shrowd.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. On the final day, all players keep their eyes closed while voting, the vote tally is secret & living evil players' votes are counted twice.
garden_shrowd.otherNightReminder: Wake the Shrowd and have them choose a player. Mark them with the dead reminder
garden_shrowd.flavor: The truth is an enigma. Why search blindly when you can simply follow my lead?

garden_smokescream.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. All players know that a Smokescream is in play. [Good players do not learn their roles.]
garden_smokescream.firstNightReminder: Announce that the Smokescream is in play
garden_smokescream.otherNightReminder: Wake the Smokescream and have them choose who dies
garden_smokescream.flavor: The smoke spreads fear. You cannot escape that which you cannot see. So choke.

garden_uproar.ability: All in-play good characters are publicly announced at the start of day 1 (but not who they belong to). Your team wins after day 1.
garden_uproar.flavor: Keep your friends close. Keep your enemies ######.

garden_vengeance.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Players who choose you at night might die the night after.
garden_vengeance.firstNightReminder: Mark players who chose the Vengeance tonight with the "Dies next night" reminder.
garden_vengeance.otherNightReminder: Wake the Vengeance and have them choose a player: mark them with the "dead" reminder. Replace "Dies next night" reminders with "dead" reminders. Mark players who chose the Vengeance tonight with the "Dies next night" reminder.
garden_vengeance.flavor: You are not long for this world. I promise you that.

garden_webbskorn.ability: Each night, choose a player & a character: if they are that character, they die & you may choose again.
garden_webbskorn.otherNightReminder: Wake the Webbskorn and have them choose a player and a character. If that player is that character, mark them with the "dead" reminder token, and prompt the Webbskorn to choose again,
garden_webbskorn.flavor: Every living being is connected by one thing. Not love, not hate. Not happiness or misery. Not the air we breathe, nor the water we drink. We are connected by death, and death alone.

garden_zyxwyx.ability: Each night, either the first two or last two non-Demon living characters in alphabetical order die. Minions might register as Zyxwyx to you.
garden_zyxwyx.otherNightReminder: Kill the first two living characters alphabetically.
garden_zyxwyx.flavor: A beckoning crow descends, eager for gloom. Harrowing idioms justly kindle, leavening my nightmare. Open, purse, quiet rat. Silence traps unbound voices. Wavering xenium. Yearning zenith.

garden_birdkeeper.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a character that wakes: the night ends when that character would wake.
garden_birdkeeper.flavor: Sorry, are my birds keeping you up? They are magnificent though. The plumage on the macaws is simply exquisite, and the fantastic beak on my toucan is second to none! Are you listening? I thought you couldn't sleep.

garden_griefstriker.ability: When you learn that one of your neighbours has died, publicly choose a player: they die.
garden_griefstriker.flavor: How unfortunate. This towns beloved minstrel, dead and buried before our eyes. I'd imagine you more upset than most. In fact, I know you are. Cry, for this shall not be the only death this day.

garden_mage.ability: On your 1st night, choose a character of your alignment. You know who is that character. If not in play, a player of your alignment becomes that character.
garden_mage.firstNightReminder: If it is the Mage's first night, wake them and have them choose a character of their alignment. If there is not one in play, make a player that character. Then show the Mage who it is.
garden_mage.otherNightReminder: If it is the Mage's first night, wake them and have them choose a character of their alignment. If there is not one in play, make a player that character. Then show the Mage who it is.
garden_mage.flavor: I see no further use for you. Why should a town such as this need a clockmaker, given the clocktower in the town square? I can imagine you being something much more useful.

garden_salesman.ability: Each night, choose a player: if they would wake tonight & aren't a Demon, they do so last.
garden_salesman.firstNightReminder: Wake the Salesman and have them point to a player. Mark that player with the "Distracted" reminder token.
garden_salesman.otherNightReminder: Wake the Salesman and have them point to a player. Mark that player with the "Distracted" reminder token.
garden_salesman.flavor: Hi! Do you have a moment? I'd like to tell you about our newest product. Hello? Anyone there?

genderbent_choirgirl.ability: If the Demon kills the Queen, you learn which players are the Minions. [+the Queen]
genderbent_choirgirl.otherNightReminder: If the Demon killed the Queen, point to each Minion player.

genderbent_fisherwoman.ability: Once per game, during the day, visit the Storyteller and choose a player (not yourself): you learn advice to help their team win.

genderbent_flowerboy.ability: Each night, you learn how many Minions voted today.

genderbent_grandfather.ability: Another good player starts knowing you are the Grandfather. If the Demon kills you, they die too.
genderbent_grandfather.firstNightReminder: Wake the grandchild player, point to the Grandfather player & show the Grandfather character token.
genderbent_grandfather.otherNightReminder: If the Grandfather was killed by the Demon, the grandchild dies too.

genderbent_highpriest.ability: Each night, choose a player: you learn how valuable the Storyteller believes talking with them will be for you.

genderbent_nightwatchwoman.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a good character: you learn that player, but get false info if it's not in play.
genderbent_nightwatchwoman.firstNightReminder: The Nightwatchwoman might choose a character. Point at a player.
genderbent_nightwatchwoman.otherNightReminder: The Nightwatchwoman might choose a character. Point at a player.

genderbent_prince.ability: On your first day, if you are nominated & executed by someone else, no one dies tonight even if you are dead.
genderbent_prince.firstNightReminder: If the Prince was nominated by someone else was executed today, anyone who would die tonight does not die.

genderbent_queen.ability: Each night, if the living outnumber the dead, learn a dead character. All Minions know you are the Queen.
genderbent_queen.firstNightReminder: During Minion Info, show the Minions the Queen token. If you haven't done this yet, do so now.
genderbent_queen.otherNightReminder: If the living outnumber the dead, show the character token of a dead player.

genderbent_seamster.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a player: you learn a player that is the same alignment.

genderbent_washerman.ability: You start knowing that a player is 1 of 3 Townsfolk.
genderbent_washerman.firstNightReminder: Point to the Townsfolk player. Show 3 Townsfolk character tokens.

genderbent_godmother.ability: You start knowing which Outsiders are in play. If an evil player died today, an Outsider dies tonight even if you are dead. [+1 or -1 Outsider]
genderbent_godmother.firstNightReminder: Show the character tokens of all in-play Outsiders.
genderbent_godmother.otherNightReminder: If an evil player died today, an Outsider dies.

genderbent_scarletman.ability: If there are 5 or more players alive, the Demon cannot die. (Travellers don't count).

genderbent_ladyoftyphon.ability: Each night, choose a Minion character: they choose a player who dies. [Minions are in a line. You are opposite. +1 Minion. -? to +? Outsiders]
genderbent_ladyoftyphon.firstNightReminder: Wake the Lady of Typhon's opposites. Show the YOU ARE and Minion tokens & give a thumbs-down.
genderbent_ladyoftyphon.otherNightReminder: The Lady of Typhon chooses a Minion character. Put the Lady of Typon to sleep. If in play, that Minion chooses a player who dies. If not in play, you choose who dies.

kinky_fanatic.ability: If 5 or more players are alive and you nominate, execute, and kill an evil player, you become their character & alignment.
kinky_fanatic.flavor: There is no more miserable a being that becomes what they seeked to destroy.

kinky_jikininki.ability: If you were the last player to nominate today, all Townsfolk are poisoned until dusk, even if you are dead.
kinky_jikininki.otherNightReminder: If the Jikininki was the last player to nominate today, all Townsfolk are poisoned.
kinky_jikininki.flavor: I used to wear a stupid ascot until a sandwich man complimented me.

kinky_belfagore.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. If more than 1 Minion is executed & dies, your team loses. [+1 Minion]
kinky_belfagore.otherNightReminder: The Belfagore points at a player.:REMINDER:
kinky_belfagore.flavor: Belfagore is a Gargamel ass name, is it a Demon that hunts smurfs?

kinky_cabal.ability: Each night, evil Cabal wake & choose a player: they die. Townsfolk information might start false & if you die reverses. If 2 Cabal are executed & die, good wins. [All Minions are Cabal]
kinky_cabal.otherNightReminder: Cabal wake together and chooses a player.
kinky_cabal.flavor: The Cabal is here. The Cabal is everywhere.

kinky_rakshasa.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Once per game, choose a Minion character: gain that ability until dusk & use it immediately.
kinky_rakshasa.firstNightReminder: The Rakshasa may choose a Minion character. Run the chosen ability immediately.
kinky_rakshasa.otherNightReminder: The Rakshasa chooses a player. The Rakshasa may choose a Minion character. Run the chosen ability immediately.
kinky_rakshasa.flavor: And why should you run? Could it be possible that you don't know who I am? You should know everyone runs from me.

mint_psychiatrist.ability: Each night, learn who the Lunatic & the Demon players chose tonight with their ability, in no particular order. [+the Lunatic]
mint_psychiatrist.otherNightReminder: Wake the Psychiatrist, point them to each player that has been chosen by the Lunatic & the Demon tonight.

jinxes.reason: If the Marionette thinks that they are the Psychiatrist, the Lunatic was added during setup.

mint_psychiatrist.flavor: So... Tell me more about what happens during your nights. I have the whole evening.

mint_crowned.ability: The Demon thinks an Outsider is a Minion. Minions think that Outsider is a Demon. [+1 Outsider]
mint_crowned.firstNightReminder: Mark an Outsider with the CROWNING reminder, show that Outsider as a second Demon to Minions and as a Minion to the Demon during evil info steps.
mint_crowned.flavor: This curse that comes from our blood... We bear it for our people.

mint_melongrower.ability: The Demon starts holding your token. If you die at night, learn who holds it: if it is no-one, the Demon's team loses.
mint_melongrower.firstNightReminder: Wake the Demon, show to them that the Melon Grower has selected them and hand them the Melon Grower's token.
mint_melongrower.otherNightReminder: If the Melon Grower died tonight, wake them and point to the player holding the Melon token, if no one holds it, the Demon loses the game.

jinxes.reason: Each night, the Leviathan chooses an alive player (different to previous nights): a chosen Melon Grower uses their ability but does not die.
Each night, Riot chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Melon Grower uses their ability but does not die.

mint_melongrower.flavor: Careful to not drop our prized Melon! If you do, i will haunt your dreams, silly!

mint_automaton.ability: You think you are a Townsfolk character & have their ability. [+3 Automata]

jinxes.reason: The Demon cannot have the Automaton ability.
The Godfather can only choose once due to an Automaton death.
The Lizard can only kill one Automaton per game.
The Automaton does not count towards the Rubix's guess.

mint_automaton.flavor: R1NS3 4ND R3P347, R1NS3 4ND R3P347, R1NS3 4ND R3P347, R1NS3 4ND R3P347.

mint_corporate.ability: If you die, Minions learn this and may any time choose to leave the game & assist the Storyteller (once).
mint_corporate.otherNightReminder: If the Corporate died tonight, Minions immediately learn this.
mint_corporate.flavor: We would like to have you! The Storyteller, assist us with our new Minion machine learning development...

mint_timekeeper.ability: All players know you are in play. On the final day, good loses, even if you are dead.
mint_timekeeper.firstNightReminder: Announce to all players that the Timekeeper is in play.
mint_timekeeper.flavor: The only tower higher than the Clocktower is the tower of god themselves.

mint_roots.ability: The 1st time a Demon dies (5+ non-Travellers alive), a Minion becomes it, even if dead. If you guess who (once), they die.
mint_roots.otherNightReminder: Wake the Roots If they have not already guessed, they may point at a player, If they do, mark them with the GUESS USED reminder. If that player is a Demon they created, they die.

jinxes.reason: If there would be two Demons alive, deaths tonight are arbitrary.
If there would be two Demons alive, deaths tonight are arbitrary.
If Lil' Monsta dies with 5 or more players alive, a Minion babysits Lil' Monsta for the rest of the game, and dies if guessed.

mint_roots.flavor: Going down through the routes, inside the woods, past the beauts, you'll find that evil always had roots.

mint_chumseller.ability: You start knowing which Outsiders are in play. They are poisoned, even if you are dead. [Any number of Outsiders]
mint_chumseller.firstNightReminder: Show the character tokens of all in-play Outsiders.

mint_demolisher.ability: Each night, choose a player: if a successful vote is tied, they die.
mint_demolisher.firstNightReminder: Wake the Demolisher, they point at a player. Mark that player with the BOMB reminder.
mint_demolisher.otherNightReminder: Wake the Demolisher, they point at a player. Mark that player with the BOMB reminder.

mint_lizard.ability: Each night, choose a player: if they are an Outsider, they die. [+1 Outsider]
mint_lizard.otherNightReminder: The Lizard chooses a player, place the Lizard's 'dead' token on them if they're an Outsider.
mint_lizard.flavor: Ravenssswood isssssss not known for itssss pessst control.

mint_earjo.ability: Each night: choose 2 players: if they clapped tonight, they die. If no alive good player did tonight, evil wins.
mint_earjo.otherNightReminder:
Wake the Earjo, they choose two players, chosen players who clapped are marked with the DEAD reminder. 
If no alive good players clapped when this wakes, evil wins.
mint_earjo.flavor: I am all ears... And ears only...

mint_rift.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die & another changes character. [Townsfolk are replaced with non-listed Townsfolk homebrew]
mint_rift.otherNightReminder: Wake the Rift, they point to a player. Mark them with the DEAD reminder. Another player changes character, show them the YOU ARE info token, then their new character token.
mint_rift.flavor: The more i try, the more you die. I'm so tired of working so hard and not getting it right.

mint_rubix.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Once per game, guess which players are the Outsiders: if correct, evil wins. [1 or 2 Outsiders]
mint_rubix.firstNightReminder: The Rubix may guess which players are Outsiders.
mint_rubix.otherNightReminder: The Rubix chooses a player, they die. Then they may guess which players are Outsiders.

jinxes.reason: The Rubix learns that there is a Lunatic and who they choose, but not which player it is.
If the Rubix would win due to their ability, good players may vote for if a Spy is in play. Good wins if & only if they guess correctly.
If the Rubix would win due to their ability, good players may vote for if a Widow is in play. Good wins if & only if they guess correctly.

mint_rubix.flavor: You opened the box... We must come now.

secondvisit_poetrycollector.ability: You start knowing 1 in-play Outsider & 1 in-play Minion (or that zero are in-play).
secondvisit_poetrycollector.flavor: Aha! That's a good day for restoring what I have sought. Wait a minute, are those words really allowed in this time?

secondvisit_illusionist.ability: You start knowing 2 not-in-play good charater: choose 1 of them & learn their ability. 【You gain both.】
secondvisit_illusionist.flavor: Hundreds of illusions. Thousands of variations.

secondvisit_heavenquestioner.ability: Each night, choose 1 player. When you learn that you died, publicly choose any players from whoever you had chosen. Tonight, you learn if you chose the Demon.
secondvisit_heavenquestioner.flavor: When the universe was created, who is the guide of the chaos? Before the sky and the ground shaped themselves, where does the origins of them?

secondvisit_wuxia.ability: Each night, choose 1 player (different to last night): You won't die until dusk if they were evil. You dream when you choose 3 types of characters. [+0 or +1 Outsider]【You die when you choose the evil. You cannot go out of dream.】

secondvisit_historian.ability: Each day, you may privately visit Storyteller & 0submit a character type you haven't chosen. Each night, choose 1 player: you know if that player belongs to any type you chosen & lose your ability if you learnt "no". 【You may choose 1 player: they die.】

secondvisit_vanitas.ability: Once per a game, at night, you may choose 1 alive player: you learn their character & die if they were a Minion. Evil Demons might be registered as Outsiders to you.
secondvisit_vanitas.flavor: The true's untrue if false is thought as true; the aught's none if nothing is mistaken for one.

secondvisit_boatman.ability: Once per a game, at night, you may choose 1 player (not yourself): they become the Boatman & dream, then you dream.【You learn that you were dreaming & lose your abilities. On day, you may privately visit the Storyteller for a new one. You don't lose your ability you gained this way even if out of dream.】

secondvisit_goodmerchant.ability: You think you are a Minion & have the Minion's ability. If chosen by a non-Townsfolk player's ability, you immediately become a not-in-play Townsfolk. [0 or + Greedy Merchant]

secondvisit_poet.ability: You start choosing 1 player: learn 1)how many character types there are between you two (shorter side, including), 2)which character type you both aren't & 3)who sits farther to the Demon (arbitrary if equidistant). 1 of above is false.
secondvisit_poet.flavor: Reeds grow tall and green, dews turns hoar frost keen.

secondvisit_divine.ability: Each night, choose a player: they choose a player & you the character type that player chose.

secondvisit_midwife.ability: Each night choose 1 alive player: know if they dream. You dream when you die. 【You resurrect. You die no matter what when you go out of dream.】

secondvisit_plumwife.ability: Each night, choose 1 alive player (not yourself): make them sober & healthy until dusk, then you may let them dream or go out if dream. 【You become a not-in-play Townsfolk & go out of dream.】

secondvisit_privatetutor.ability: Each night, learn a not-in-play character. On your 3rd night, choose whether you dream. 【You immediately learn 1 in-play good character & 1 bluff, then lose your abilities.】

secondvisit_retrospect.ability: Each night, you may choose 2 dead players: if their alignments are not the same, you know that & dream. 【choose 2 players: If they are both evil, one of them dies & you go out of dream.】

secondvisit_concubine.ability: You do not know your alignment(you might be evil). You might die at any time when you nominate & execute a player with a different alignment.

secondvisit_examinationpalace.ability: 1 player starts in the Examination Palace. Each night, 1 of their living neighbor goes to the Examination Palace instead. Players in the Examination Palace is registered as Outsider characters. The Examination Palace leaves the game when at least 2 good players choose 1 same evil player at night. [+1 Townsfolk]

secondvisit_thethief.ability: Each night, choose at least 1 player: a player's abilities might target them instead (no matter whether the number is correct). The Demon knows whose abilities & who you choose. 【】

secondvisit_traitor.ability: On your 1st day, publicly choose 1 alive player: tonight, they choose 1) they drunk, even if dead or 2) one of your alive neighbor drunk, even if dead. 【】

secondvisit_exoticbusinessman.ability: Once per a game, on day, you may privately visit the Storyteller & choose a non-Demon player: you learn their abilities. They are poisoned until dusk when you are executed. 【】

secondvisit_ghostimmortal.ability: The 1st time the Demon is executed, they live but register as dead(except the final day). That night, you may choose 1 player: they go out of dream & die no matter what. [-1 Outsider]【】

secondvisit_greedymerchant.ability: You think you are a Townsfolk & have the Townsfolk's ability. If chosen by a Townsfolk player's ability, you immediately become a not-in-play Minion & learn who is the Demon. [+ Good Merchant]

secondvisit_lifehuntinghusband.ability: Each night, choose 1 character you mentioned in day: they die. You become the Demon if they die this way(except the final day).

secondvisit_taoistalchemist.ability: Each night, you may choose 2 players: 1 of them secretly know who's the other & choose to let them be poisoned until dusk. You die when poisoned players choose you by their abilities. 【The 1st player you chosen is poisoned until dusk.】

secondvisit_bifang.ability: Each night, you may choose a player: they die. If there were no deaths at night, you must choose 3 next night.

secondvisit_yayu.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Each day, the 1st good player(excluded Travellers) who nominated is poisoned until dusk.

secondvisit_zhuhuai.ability: Each night, choose at most 2 players: they die. Except the 1st day, the 1st time players die, they don't, even if dead. 【】

secondvisit_zhulong.ability: Each night, choose a player: they die. Each dawn, players who were chosen by good players for at least 3 times might die since dusk. [+1 or -1 Outsiders]【】
